
## Overflow

When `overflow` is `menu` (the default), items that do not fit move into an overflow menu at the end, starting from the last item. The toolbar monitors its own size. Items keep their names in the menu (an icon-only button uses its `hint` or `aria-label`), a toggle becomes a check item, and a menu button becomes a submenu. An item's `overflow` can be `always` or `never`, and fields stay in the bar. `wrap` adds a second row, and `scroll` lets the bar scroll.

```tsx
/** A small outline icon drawn from one path. */
function icon(d: string) {
  return () => (
    <svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" aria-hidden="true">
      <path d={d} fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" />
    </svg>
  );
}

export const BoldIcon = icon('M4.5 3h4.25a2.5 2.5 0 0 1 0 5H4.5zM4.5 8h5a2.5 2.5 0 0 1 0 5h-5z');
export const ItalicIcon = icon('M7 3h5M4 13h5M10 3L6 13');
export const UnderlineIcon = icon('M4.5 2.5v5a3.5 3.5 0 0 0 7 0v-5M3.5 14h9');
export const AlignLeftIcon = icon('M2.5 4h11M2.5 8h7M2.5 12h9');
export const AlignCenterIcon = icon('M2.5 4h11M4.5 8h7M3.5 12h9');
export const AlignRightIcon = icon('M2.5 4h11M6.5 8h7M4.5 12h9');
export const UndoIcon = icon('M5.5 3.5L2.5 6.5l3 3M2.5 6.5h7a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 0 7h-2');
export const RedoIcon = icon('M10.5 3.5l3 3-3 3M13.5 6.5h-7a3.5 3.5 0 0 0 0 7h2');
export const LinkIcon = icon('M7 9a2.5 2.5 0 0 0 3.5 0l2-2a2.5 2.5 0 0 0-3.5-3.5l-.75.75M9 7a2.5 2.5 0 0 0-3.5 0l-2 2A2.5 2.5 0 0 0 7 12.5l.75-.75');
export const ImageIcon = icon('M2.5 3.5h11v9h-11zM2.5 10.5l3-3 3 3 2-2 3 3M10 6.25v.1');
```

## Orientation, size and fields

`size` and `buttonVariant` apply to child controls that do not set their own. A vertical toolbar uses Up and Down for navigation. A text field inside the toolbar keeps the arrow keys for its text.

```tsx
/** A small outline icon drawn from one path. */
function icon(d: string) {
  return () => (
    <svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" aria-hidden="true">
      <path d={d} fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" />
    </svg>
  );
}

export const BoldIcon = icon('M4.5 3h4.25a2.5 2.5 0 0 1 0 5H4.5zM4.5 8h5a2.5 2.5 0 0 1 0 5h-5z');
export const ItalicIcon = icon('M7 3h5M4 13h5M10 3L6 13');
export const UnderlineIcon = icon('M4.5 2.5v5a3.5 3.5 0 0 0 7 0v-5M3.5 14h9');
export const AlignLeftIcon = icon('M2.5 4h11M2.5 8h7M2.5 12h9');
export const AlignCenterIcon = icon('M2.5 4h11M4.5 8h7M3.5 12h9');
export const AlignRightIcon = icon('M2.5 4h11M6.5 8h7M4.5 12h9');
export const UndoIcon = icon('M5.5 3.5L2.5 6.5l3 3M2.5 6.5h7a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 0 7h-2');
export const RedoIcon = icon('M10.5 3.5l3 3-3 3M13.5 6.5h-7a3.5 3.5 0 0 0 0 7h2');
export const LinkIcon = icon('M7 9a2.5 2.5 0 0 0 3.5 0l2-2a2.5 2.5 0 0 0-3.5-3.5l-.75.75M9 7a2.5 2.5 0 0 0-3.5 0l-2 2A2.5 2.5 0 0 0 7 12.5l.75-.75');
export const ImageIcon = icon('M2.5 3.5h11v9h-11zM2.5 10.5l3-3 3 3 2-2 3 3M10 6.25v.1');
```

## Keyboard

| Key | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `Tab` | Moves focus into the toolbar, to the control used last. Pressing Tab again leaves it. |
| `Right / Left` | Moves to the next or previous control, wrapping at the ends (Left and Right are reversed on right-to-left pages). In a vertical toolbar, use Down and Up. |
| `Home / End` | Moves to the first or last control. |
| `In a text field` | The arrow keys, Home and End move within the text, and Tab leaves the field. |
| `Down on a menu button` | Opens the menu (horizontal toolbar). |

## Accessibility

| Topic | Details |
| --- | --- |
| `Role` | `role="toolbar"` with `aria-orientation`, named by `label`. |
| `Focus` | One Tab stop. The control used last has `tabindex="0"`, and the others have `-1` (roving tabindex). |
| `Separators` | `role="separator"`, oriented across the toolbar. |
| `Toggles` | Toggle items are buttons with `aria-pressed`. |
| `“More” menu` | A menu button named from `uiLocale` (“More options”). Items keep their names (an icon-only button uses its `hint` or `aria-label`), toggles become check items, and menu buttons become submenus. |

## Localization

The only string a toolbar displays on its own is the name of its overflow button, from `uiLocale.strings.moreOptions`.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, uiLocale } from '@motifx-community/ui';
import { kitTexts } from '../../../shared/kit-texts';

/** Switches the texts of the kit; the “more” buttons take the new name at once. */
export default function Localization() {
  const s = reactive({ lang: 'en' });
  const toggle = () => {
    s.lang = s.lang === 'en' ? 'tr' : 'en';
    void uiLocale.use(s.lang);
  };
  return (
    <>
      <Button text={() => (s.lang === 'en' ? 'Language: English' : 'Dil: Türkçe')} variant="outline" onclick={toggle} />
      <span>
        The “more” button is named <output class="tb-more-name">{() => kitTexts.strings.moreOptions}</output>
      </span>
    </>
  );
}
```

## Styling

| Hook | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `.mx-toolbar` | The toolbar. `data-orientation`, `data-size`, `data-overflow`, `data-disabled`. |
| `.mx-toolbar__separator` | A separator. |
| `.mx-toolbar__more` | The overflow button, a `Button` with a menu. |
| `[data-overflowed]` | Set on a control that is currently in the overflow menu. |

### Component tokens

| Token | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `toolbar.height` | The minimum height of the bar, which uses the density-aware bar height. |
| `toolbar.bar, toolbar.separator` | Units: the bar (`vertical`: a column of controls) and the separators. |

## API reference

### Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `items` | `Bind<readonly ToolbarItem[]>` | `[]` | Items defined as data, drawn before the JSX children (see Items). |
| `label` | `Bind<string>` | `''` | The accessible name of the toolbar (`aria-label`). This is the same property as `text`. |
| `orientation` | `Bind<'horizontal' \| 'vertical'>` | `'horizontal'` | The direction of the toolbar. The arrow keys follow it. |
| `size` | `Bind<ControlSize>` | `'md'` | Applied to child controls that do not set their own `size`. |
| `buttonVariant` | `Bind<ButtonVariant>` | `'ghost'` | Applied to child buttons that do not set their own `variant`. |
| `overflow` | `Bind<'menu' \| 'wrap' \| 'scroll'>` | `'menu'` | `menu` moves items that do not fit into an overflow menu, `wrap` adds a second row, and `scroll` makes the bar scroll. |
| `enabled / disabled, visible, tabStop, tabIndex` | see Control |  | `enabled={false}` disables every control inside. |

### ToolbarItem

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `type` | `Bind<'button' \| 'toggle' \| 'separator' \| 'menu'>` | The default is `'button'`. |
| `text, icon, hint` | `Bind<…>` | The caption (`&Bold` assigns an access key), an icon and a tooltip. An icon-only button is named by its `hint`. |
| `pressed` | `Bind<boolean>` | The state of a toggle. As a function, the item tracks application state, and `click` changes the value it reads. |
| `enabled, visible` | `Bind<boolean>` | Dims the item or removes it. |
| `menu` | `Bind<readonly MenuItem[]>` | The commands of a `menu` item, including submenus, check and radio items, and shortcuts. |
| `overflow` | `Bind<'auto' \| 'always' \| 'never'>` | Controls whether the item can move into the overflow menu, and takes precedence over the toolbar. A JSX child sets it with `data-overflow`. |
| `click` | `(e) => void` | Occurs when the item is pressed, in the bar or in the overflow menu. `e`: `{ item, source, event }`. |
| `data` | `unknown` | A custom value. |

### Properties

| Property | Access | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `every prop above` | read/write, reactive | Accepts a value or a function, the same as the prop. |
| `overflowed` | read-only, reactive | The controls currently in the overflow menu. |

### Methods

| Method | Returns | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `controlOf(item)` | `Control \| null` | The control created for an item in `items`. |
| `updateOverflow()` | `void` | Recalculates what fits, for example after a control changes width. |
| `refresh()` | `void` | Your items can be plain or reactive, and the toolbar reads them as they are. After changing them in place, call `refresh()`. The list and each item's fields are read again, and controls for items that remain are kept. |
| `focus()` | `boolean` | Sets focus on the control that Tab reaches. |

### Events

| Event | When |
| --- | --- |
| `onItemClick(e)` | Occurs when an item in `items` is pressed, after its own `click`. `e`: `{ item, source, event }`. |

## Example files

`Editor.tsx`

```tsx
import { Toolbar } from '@motifx-community/ui';
import { draft } from './draft';
import { editorItems } from './editor-items';

/** An editor toolbar from `items`: buttons, toggles, an alignment group, a menu, and a button kept out of the “more” menu. */
export default function Editor() {
  const preview = () =>
    `font-weight: ${draft.bold ? 600 : 400}; font-style: ${draft.italic ? 'italic' : 'normal'}; text-decoration: ${draft.underline ? 'underline' : 'none'}; text-align: ${draft.align}; inline-size: 100%; margin: 0`;
  return (
    <>
      <Toolbar label="Format" items={editorItems()} style="inline-size: 100%" />
      <p style={preview}>The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog.</p>
      <output class="tb-log">{() => draft.log}</output>
    </>
  );
}
```

`editor-items.tsx`

```tsx
import type { ToolbarItem } from '@motifx-community/ui';
import { draft } from './draft';
import { AlignCenterIcon, AlignLeftIcon, AlignRightIcon, BoldIcon, ImageIcon, ItalicIcon, LinkIcon, RedoIcon, UnderlineIcon, UndoIcon } from './icons';

const did = (what: string) => (draft.log = what);

const align = (value: 'left' | 'center' | 'right', hint: string, Icon: typeof BoldIcon): ToolbarItem => ({
  type: 'toggle',
  icon: () => <Icon />,
  hint,
  pressed: () => draft.align === value,
  click: () => (draft.align = value),
});

/** The items of the editor toolbar, bound to the draft. */
export function editorItems(): ToolbarItem[] {
  return [
    { icon: () => <UndoIcon />, hint: 'Undo', click: () => did('Undo') },
    { icon: () => <RedoIcon />, hint: 'Redo', click: () => did('Redo') },
    { type: 'separator' },
    { type: 'toggle', icon: () => <BoldIcon />, hint: 'Bold', pressed: () => draft.bold, click: () => (draft.bold = !draft.bold) },
    { type: 'toggle', icon: () => <ItalicIcon />, hint: 'Italic', pressed: () => draft.italic, click: () => (draft.italic = !draft.italic) },
    { type: 'toggle', icon: () => <UnderlineIcon />, hint: 'Underline', pressed: () => draft.underline, click: () => (draft.underline = !draft.underline) },
    { type: 'separator' },
    align('left', 'Align left', AlignLeftIcon),
    align('center', 'Center', AlignCenterIcon),
    align('right', 'Align right', AlignRightIcon),
    { type: 'separator' },
    {
      type: 'menu',
      text: 'Insert',
      menu: [
        { text: '&Link', icon: () => <LinkIcon />, shortcut: 'Ctrl+K', click: () => did('Insert link') },
        { text: '&Image', icon: () => <ImageIcon />, click: () => did('Insert image') },
        { text: '&Table', items: [2, 3, 4].map((n) => ({ text: `${n} × ${n}`, click: () => did(`Insert a ${n} × ${n} table`) })) },
      ],
    },
    { text: '&Publish', click: () => did('Publish'), overflow: 'never' },
  ];
}
```

`draft.ts`

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';

/** The text the toolbars on this page format: one state, so every toolbar shows the same. */
export const draft = reactive({
  bold: true,
  italic: false,
  underline: false,
  align: 'left' as 'left' | 'center' | 'right',
  log: 'Nothing yet.',
});
```

```tsx
export const AlignCenterIcon = icon('M2.5 4h11M4.5 8h7M3.5 12h9');
export const AlignRightIcon = icon('M2.5 4h11M6.5 8h7M4.5 12h9');
export const UndoIcon = icon('M5.5 3.5L2.5 6.5l3 3M2.5 6.5h7a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 0 7h-2');
export const RedoIcon = icon('M10.5 3.5l3 3-3 3M13.5 6.5h-7a3.5 3.5 0 0 0 0 7h2');
export const LinkIcon = icon('M7 9a2.5 2.5 0 0 0 3.5 0l2-2a2.5 2.5 0 0 0-3.5-3.5l-.75.75M9 7a2.5 2.5 0 0 0-3.5 0l-2 2A2.5 2.5 0 0 0 7 12.5l.75-.75');
export const ImageIcon = icon('M2.5 3.5h11v9h-11zM2.5 10.5l3-3 3 3 2-2 3 3M10 6.25v.1');
```

`ToggleGroups.tsx`

```tsx
import { Button, Toolbar, ToolbarSeparator } from '@motifx-community/ui';
import { draft } from './draft';
import { BoldIcon, ItalicIcon } from './icons';

/** Toggle buttons as JSX children, bound with x-model, and a separator before a plain button. */
export default function ToggleGroups() {
  return (
    <Toolbar label="Text">
      <Button icon={() => <BoldIcon />} aria-label="Bold" toggle x-model={() => draft.bold} />
      <Button icon={() => <ItalicIcon />} aria-label="Italic" toggle x-model={() => draft.italic} />
      <ToolbarSeparator />
      <Button
        text="Clear"
        onclick={() => {
          draft.bold = draft.italic = draft.underline = false;
        }}
      />
    </Toolbar>
  );
}
```

`Overflow.tsx`

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, Stack, Toolbar, type ToolbarOverflow } from '@motifx-community/ui';
import { editorItems } from './editor-items';

const OVERFLOWS: ToolbarOverflow[] = ['menu', 'wrap', 'scroll'];

/** The editor toolbar in less room: a “more” menu, a second row, or a bar that scrolls. */
export default function Overflow() {
  const s = reactive({ width: 100, overflow: 'menu' as ToolbarOverflow });
  return (
    <>
      <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center" role="group" aria-label="Width">
        {[100, 70, 45, 25].map((width) => (
          <Button key={width} text={`${width}%`} size="sm" variant={() => (s.width === width ? 'solid' : 'ghost')} aria-pressed={() => s.width === width} onclick={() => (s.width = width)} />
        ))}
      </Stack>
      <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center" role="group" aria-label="Overflow">
        {OVERFLOWS.map((mode) => (
          <Button key={mode} text={mode} size="sm" variant={() => (s.overflow === mode ? 'solid' : 'ghost')} aria-pressed={() => s.overflow === mode} onclick={() => (s.overflow = mode)} />
        ))}
      </Stack>
      <div class="tb-frame" style={() => `inline-size: ${s.width}%`}>
        <Toolbar label="Format (narrow)" items={editorItems()} overflow={() => s.overflow} />
      </div>
    </>
  );
}
```

`SizeAndOrientation.tsx`

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, Stack, TextBox, Toolbar, type ControlSize } from '@motifx-community/ui';
import { ImageIcon, LinkIcon, RedoIcon, UndoIcon } from './icons';

const SIZES: ControlSize[] = ['sm', 'md', 'lg'];

/** A size given to the controls inside, a text field in a toolbar, and a toolbar that turns vertical. */
export default function SizeAndOrientation() {
  const s = reactive({ size: 'md' as ControlSize, vertical: false, log: '' });
  const did = (what: string) => (s.log = what);
  return (
    <>
      <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center" role="group" aria-label="Size">

          <Button key={size} text={size} size="sm" variant={() => (s.size === size ? 'solid' : 'ghost')} aria-pressed={() => s.size === size} onclick={() => (s.size = size)} />
        ))}
        <Button text="Vertical" size="sm" toggle x-model={() => s.vertical} />
      </Stack>
      <Toolbar label="Find" size={() => s.size}>
        <Button text="Previous" onclick={() => did('Previous')} />
        <TextBox label="Find" labelMode="hidden" placeholder="Find" />
        <Button text="Next" onclick={() => did('Next')} />
      </Toolbar>
      <Toolbar
        label="Tools"
        size={() => s.size}
        orientation={() => (s.vertical ? 'vertical' : 'horizontal')}

          { icon: () => <UndoIcon />, hint: 'Undo', click: () => did('Undo') },
          { icon: () => <RedoIcon />, hint: 'Redo', click: () => did('Redo') },
          { type: 'separator' },
          { icon: () => <LinkIcon />, hint: 'Link', click: () => did('Link') },
          { icon: () => <ImageIcon />, hint: 'Image', enabled: false },
        ]}
      />
      <output>{() => s.log}</output>
    </>
  );
}
```

# SpeedDial

> Buttons · @motifx-community/ui 0.1.0-beta.5

A floating action button that opens a set of related actions. Place it in a corner, on an edge or inline. Actions appear in a line with labels, or on a full, half or quarter circle around the button with tooltips. If there is only one action, the main button performs it directly.

## Import

```tsx
import { SpeedDial } from '@motifx-community/ui';
```

## Linear layout

`actions` defines the buttons, which open in the given `direction`. Each action has a `glyph` from the kit's icon set or a custom `icon`, a `text` shown as its label, and a `click` handler. `open` and `x-model` control whether the actions are visible. This example uses `position='inline'` to keep the button in the page flow.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { SpeedDial, Stack } from '@motifx-community/ui';

/** Two speed dials in the page flow: one opens upward and one toward the end. Clicking an action reports it. */
export default function Inline() {
    const s = reactive({ told: '', open: false });
    const actions = [
        { key: 'note', text: 'New note', glyph: 'pencil', click: () => (s.told = 'a new note') },
        { key: 'event', text: 'New event', glyph: 'calendar', click: () => (s.told = 'a new event') },
        { key: 'file', text: 'Upload a file', glyph: 'upload', click: () => (s.told = 'a file to upload') },
        { key: 'locked', text: 'Not yet', glyph: 'lock', enabled: false }
    ];
    return (
        <Stack gap="md" style="inline-size: 100%">
            <div class="sd-row" style="display: flex; align-items: flex-end; gap: 48px; min-block-size: 260px; padding-inline-start: 140px">
                <SpeedDial class="sd-up" position="inline" direction="up" text="New" actions={actions} x-model={() => s.open} />
                <SpeedDial class="sd-end" position="inline" direction="end" text="Share" glyph="person" actions={[{ text: 'Mail', glyph: 'file', click: () => (s.told = 'shared by mail') }, { text: 'Link', glyph: 'pin', click: () => (s.told = 'a link to share') }]} />
            </div>
            <output class="sd-told">{() => `${s.told || 'nothing yet'}${s.open ? ' (open)' : ''}`}</output>
        </Stack>
    );
}
```

## Circle layout

`layout='circle'` places the actions evenly around the main button, starting from `direction`. They animate out from under the button and return there when closed. `radius` sets the distance. By default, it is calculated to keep the actions `gap` apart and clear of the button. Labels are off in circular layouts because they would overlap, so the actions show tooltips instead. You can change this with `showLabels` and `tooltip`. In this example, `relativeTo='parent'` centers the button in its box by measuring `position` against the nearest positioned ancestor.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, SpeedDial, Stack } from '@motifx-community/ui';

/** The actions on a whole circle around the button, in the centre of a box; by default just far enough out to keep them apart. */
export default function Circle() {
    const s = reactive({ radius: null as number | null, told: '' });
    const actions = [
        { text: 'Edit', glyph: 'pencil', click: () => (s.told = 'edit') },
        { text: 'Refresh', glyph: 'repeat', click: () => (s.told = 'refresh') },
        { text: 'Delete', glyph: 'trash', click: () => (s.told = 'delete') },
        { text: 'Upload', glyph: 'upload', click: () => (s.told = 'upload') },
        { text: 'Download', glyph: 'download', click: () => (s.told = 'download') }
    ];
    return (
        <Stack gap="sm" style="inline-size: 100%">
            <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center">
                <Button text="Radius by itself" variant="outline" onclick={() => (s.radius = null)} />
                <Button text="Radius 120" variant="outline" onclick={() => (s.radius = 120)} />
                <output class="sd-circle-told">{() => s.told}</output>
            </Stack>
            <div style="position: relative; inline-size: 100%; block-size: 22rem">
                <SpeedDial class="sd-circle" layout="circle" position="center" relativeTo="parent" radius={() => s.radius} text="Tools" actions={actions} />
            </div>
        </Stack>
    );
}
```

## Semi-circle layout

`layout='semi-circle'` places the actions on a half circle centered on `direction`, which works well in the middle of an edge. `position` accepts `top`, `bottom`, `start` and `end`, and `direction` defaults to pointing into the page.

```tsx
import { SpeedDial } from '@motifx-community/ui';

const ACTIONS = [
    { text: 'Edit', glyph: 'pencil' },
    { text: 'Refresh', glyph: 'repeat' },
    { text: 'Delete', glyph: 'trash' },
    { text: 'Upload', glyph: 'upload' },
    { text: 'Download', glyph: 'download' }
];

/** A half circle on the middle of each edge of a box: `direction` follows from `position`, into the box. */
export default function SemiCircle() {
    return (
        <div class="sd-semi" style="position: relative; inline-size: 100%; block-size: 26rem">
            <SpeedDial class="sd-semi-top" layout="semi-circle" position="top" relativeTo="parent" text="Tools at the top" actions={ACTIONS} />
            <SpeedDial class="sd-semi-start" layout="semi-circle" position="start" relativeTo="parent" text="Tools at the start" actions={ACTIONS} />
            <SpeedDial class="sd-semi-end" layout="semi-circle" position="end" relativeTo="parent" text="Tools at the end" actions={ACTIONS} />
            <SpeedDial class="sd-semi-bottom" layout="semi-circle" position="bottom" relativeTo="parent" text="Tools at the bottom" actions={ACTIONS} />
        </div>
    );
}
```

## Quarter-circle layout

`layout='quarter-circle'` places the actions on a quarter circle, which works well in a corner. `direction` is again derived from `position`. If you set it yourself, use a diagonal value such as `up-start`.

```tsx
import { SpeedDial } from '@motifx-community/ui';

const ACTIONS = [
    { text: 'Edit', glyph: 'pencil' },
    { text: 'Refresh', glyph: 'repeat' },
    { text: 'Delete', glyph: 'trash' },
    { text: 'Upload', glyph: 'upload' },
    { text: 'Download', glyph: 'download' }
];

/** A quarter circle in each corner of a box: `direction` follows from `position`, into the box. */
export default function QuarterCircle() {
    return (
        <div class="sd-quarter" style="position: relative; inline-size: 100%; block-size: 26rem">
            <SpeedDial class="sd-quarter-top-start" layout="quarter-circle" position="top-start" relativeTo="parent" text="Tools, top start" actions={ACTIONS} />
            <SpeedDial class="sd-quarter-top-end" layout="quarter-circle" position="top-end" relativeTo="parent" text="Tools, top end" actions={ACTIONS} />
            <SpeedDial class="sd-quarter-bottom-start" layout="quarter-circle" position="bottom-start" relativeTo="parent" text="Tools, bottom start" actions={ACTIONS} />
            <SpeedDial class="sd-quarter-bottom-end" layout="quarter-circle" position="bottom-end" relativeTo="parent" text="Tools, bottom end" actions={ACTIONS} />
        </div>
    );
}
```

## Tooltips

Use `tooltip` on the speed dial to turn tooltips on or off for all actions and to pass options to each one. `tooltip` on an action takes precedence and accepts text, options or `false`. Each tooltip is a kit `Tooltip` that opens on the outer side of the action unless `placement` specifies otherwise. With one action, the main button shows its tooltip.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, SpeedDial, Stack } from '@motifx-community/ui';

/** Tooltips on the actions: the speed dial's options for all, a text or options of an action's own, none on one. */
export default function Tooltips() {
    const s = reactive({ on: true });
    return (
        <Stack gap="md" style="inline-size: 100%">
            <Button class="sd-tips-toggle" text="Tooltips" variant="outline" toggle x-model={() => s.on} />
            <div style="min-block-size: 5rem; padding-block-start: 2rem">
                <SpeedDial
                    class="sd-tips"
                    position="inline"
                    direction="end"
                    text="Edit"
                    closeOnAction={false}
                    showLabels={false}
                    tooltip={() => (s.on ? { placement: 'top', delay: 100 } : false)}
                    actions={[
                        { text: 'Edit', glyph: 'pencil' },
                        { text: 'Upload', glyph: 'upload', tooltip: 'Upload a new version, up to 20 MB' },
                        { text: 'Delete', glyph: 'trash', tooltip: { text: 'Kept in the bin for 30 days', placement: 'bottom' } },
                        { text: 'Save', glyph: 'save', tooltip: false }
                    ]}
                />
            </div>
        </Stack>
    );
}
```

## Fixed to the viewport

By default, the button is fixed to the bottom end corner of the viewport, `inset` from the edges. Use `position` to choose another location. Turn it on here to see it over the page.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, SpeedDial, Stack } from '@motifx-community/ui';

/** A speed dial fixed to a corner of the viewport, shown while the switch is on; the corner and the fan's way can change. */
export default function Corner() {
    const s = reactive({ on: false, position: 'bottom-end' as 'bottom-end' | 'bottom-start' | 'top-end' | 'top-start', told: '' });
    return (
        <Stack gap="sm" style="inline-size: 100%">
            <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center">
                <Button class="sd-corner-toggle" text="In the corner" variant="outline" toggle x-model={() => s.on} />
                <Button text="Bottom end" variant="outline" onclick={() => (s.position = 'bottom-end')} />
                <Button text="Bottom start" variant="outline" onclick={() => (s.position = 'bottom-start')} />
                <Button text="Top end" variant="outline" onclick={() => (s.position = 'top-end')} />
                <output class="sd-corner-told">{() => s.told}</output>
            </Stack>
            <SpeedDial
                class="sd-corner"
                visible={() => s.on}
                position={() => s.position}
                text="Create"
                actions={[
                    { text: 'Document', glyph: 'file', click: () => (s.told = 'a document') },
                    { text: 'Folder', glyph: 'columns', click: () => (s.told = 'a folder') },
                    { text: 'Upload', glyph: 'upload', click: () => (s.told = 'an upload') }
                ]}
            />
        </Stack>
    );
}
```

## Single action

When exactly one action is visible, there is nothing to expand. The main button takes the action's glyph and name, and runs the action directly. `extended` shows the name next to the glyph.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { SpeedDial, Stack } from '@motifx-community/ui';

/** With one action shown, the main button does it itself and takes its glyph and name; `extended` shows the name beside the glyph. */
export default function Single() {
    const s = reactive({ saved: 0 });
    return (
        <Stack gap="sm" style="inline-size: 100%">
            <Stack orientation="horizontal" gap="lg" align="center">
                <SpeedDial class="sd-single" position="inline" actions={[{ text: 'Save', glyph: 'save', click: () => s.saved++ }]} />
                <SpeedDial class="sd-extended" position="inline" extended actions={[{ text: 'Save a copy', glyph: 'save', click: () => s.saved++ }]} />
            </Stack>
            <output class="sd-single-told">{() => `saved ${s.saved} times`}</output>
        </Stack>
    );
}
```

## Keyboard

| Key | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `Tab` | The main button is the only Tab stop. Use the arrow keys to reach the actions. |
| `Arrow keys` | On the main button, the arrow key that points along the actions opens them on the first action, and the opposite key opens them on the last. On the actions, the arrow keys move between them and wrap at the ends. A vertical line uses Up and Down, and a horizontal line uses Left and Right. In circular layouts both pairs work, with Down and Right moving forward around the circle. |
| `Home, End` | Moves to the first or last action. |
| `Enter, Space` | Presses the main button or the focused action. |
| `Escape` | Closes the actions and returns focus to the main button. Clicking outside and pressing Tab also close them. If a tooltip is visible, the first Escape dismisses the tooltip. |

## Accessibility

| Topic | Details |
| --- | --- |
| `The main button` | A button named by `text` (“Actions” in the kit language), with `aria-haspopup="menu"` and `aria-expanded`. With one action, it represents that action and takes its name. |
| `The actions` | A `menu` of `menuitem` elements named by their labels. When closed, they are hidden from assistive technology and from the keyboard (`inert`). |
| `Labels and glyphs` | Labels appear next to the actions while they are open, and each action carries its accessible name in either case. Glyphs are decorative. |
| `Tooltips` | The kit's `Tooltip`. It also appears on keyboard focus, closes with Escape and is exposed through `aria-describedby`. Tooltips do not appear on touch, so keep the labels on if a glyph alone is not clear on a touch screen. |

## Styling

| Hook | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `.mx-speed-dial` | The speed dial. `data-layout`, `data-position`, `data-relative`, `data-direction`, `data-open`, `data-labels`, `data-extended`, `data-single`. |
| `.mx-speed-dial__main, .mx-speed-dial__main-glyph, .mx-speed-dial__main-text` | The main button, its glyph and its text. |
| `.mx-speed-dial__fan, .mx-speed-dial__action, .mx-speed-dial__action-icon, .mx-speed-dial__label` | The action container, an action (`aria-disabled`, `data-side`: where its label and tooltip appear), its glyph or icon, and its label. |

### Component tokens

| Token | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `speed-dial.main, .main-glyph, .main-text, .action, .action-icon, .label, .fan` | Units: the main button (`hover`, `pressed`, `focus`, `open`, `extended`, `disabled`), its glyph (`open`) and text, an action (`hover`, `pressed`, `focus`, `disabled`), its glyph, the label and the action container. |
| `speed-dial.inset, .gap, .label-gap` | Distance from the edges, gap between buttons (the radius preserves this gap in circular layouts), and gap between an action and its label. |

## API reference

### Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `actions` | `Bind<readonly SpeedDialAction[]>` | `[]` | The actions, in order: `text`, `glyph` (from the kit's set) or `icon` (custom), `tooltip`, `enabled`, `visible`, `click`, `key` and `data`. If one action is visible, the main button performs it directly. |
| `glyph, openGlyph` | `Bind<string>` | `'plus'`, `'dismiss'` | The glyph of the main button, and its glyph while the actions are open. |
| `text` | `Bind<string>` | The kit string “Actions” | The accessible name of the main button, and its text when `extended` is set. |
| `extended` | `Bind<boolean>` | `false` | Shows `text` next to the glyph on the main button. |
| `layout` | `Bind<SpeedDialLayout>` | `'linear'` | `linear`, `circle`, `semi-circle` or `quarter-circle`: a line from the main button, or a circular layout around it. |
| `radius` | `Bind<number \| null>` | Calculated | In circular layouts, the distance in pixels from the center of the main button to the center of each action. By default, it is just large enough to keep the actions apart. An `extended` button is wider than this calculation assumes, so set a value in that case. |
| `direction` | `Bind<SpeedDialDirection>` | Into the page | `up`, `down`, `start`, `end` or a diagonal such as `up-start`. This is the direction the actions open in, and the middle of the arc in circular layouts. A linear layout uses the first part of a diagonal. By default, the actions open away from the edges named by `position`, or `up` when centered or inline. |
| `position` | `Bind<SpeedDialPosition>` | `'bottom-end'` | A corner (`bottom-end`, `bottom-start`, `top-end`, `top-start`), the middle of an edge (`top`, `bottom`, `start`, `end`), `center`, or `inline` to stay in the page flow. |
| `relativeTo` | `Bind<SpeedDialRelativeTo>` | `'viewport'` | The reference for `position`: `viewport`, or `parent` for the nearest positioned ancestor. |
| `open` | `Bind<boolean>` | `false` | Indicates whether the actions are open. `x-model` provides two-way binding. |
| `closeOnAction` | `Bind<boolean>` | `true` | Closes the actions when one is selected. |
| `showLabels` | `Bind<boolean>` | On for linear, off for circular | Shows labels next to the actions while they are open. |
| `tooltip` | `Bind<boolean \| SpeedDialTooltip>` | On when labels are off | Shows tooltips on the actions, using their `text`. Options are passed to each `Tooltip` (`placement`, `delay`, `hideDelay`, `showOn`, `content`…). By default, they open on the outer side after 200 ms. An action's own `tooltip` takes precedence and can be text, options, or `false` to disable it. |

### Events, properties and methods

| Member | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `onOpened, onClosed` | event | Occurs when the actions open or close (`byUser`). |
| `onActionClick` | event | Occurs when an action is selected (`index`, `action`). The action's own `click` runs first. |
| `isOpen` | read-only | Indicates whether the actions are open. |
| `single` | read-only | The single visible action, or `null` if there is more than one. |
| `mainElement` | read-only | The main button. |
| `show(), close(), toggle()` | `void` | Opens or closes the actions. |
| `refresh()` | `void` | Re-reads the actions after they have been changed in place. |

# MenuBar and ContextMenu

> Buttons · @motifx-community/ui 0.1.0-beta.5

An application menu bar (File, Edit, View) and a context menu that opens on right-click. Both use the same menu items, which support submenus, check and radio items, shortcuts and access keys.

## Import

```tsx
import { MenuBar, ContextMenu, attachContextMenu, type MenuItem } from '@motifx-community/ui';
```

## MenuBar

A `MenuBar` takes its top-level items as `items`, and the `items` of each one define its menu. `&File` assigns Alt+F to open File. Left and Right move along the bar and, while a menu is open, to the next menu. Escape returns to the bar.

```tsx
import { reactive, type Component } from '@motifx/core';
import { CheckBox, MenuBar, Stack, type MenuItem } from '@motifx-community/ui';

/** An application menu bar created with `new`: submenus, check and radio items, shortcuts, access keys and `onItemClick`. */
export default function MainMenu() {
  const s = reactive({
    log: 'Nothing chosen yet.',
    chosen: 0,
    wrap: true,
    statusBar: false,
    zoom: '100%',
    theme: 'light',
    f10: false,
    canUndo: true,
  });

  const did = (what: string) => (s.log = what);
  const undo = (back: boolean) => {
    s.canUndo = !back;
    did(back ? 'Undo' : 'Redo');
  };
  const zoom = (value: string): MenuItem => ({ text: value, group: 'zoom', checked: () => s.zoom === value, click: () => (s.zoom = value) });
  const theme = (value: string, text: string): MenuItem => ({ text, group: 'theme', checked: () => s.theme === value, click: () => (s.theme = value) });

  const menus: MenuItem[] = [
    {
      text: '&File',
      items: [
        { text: '&New', shortcut: 'Ctrl+N', click: () => did('New') },
        { text: '&Open…', shortcut: 'Ctrl+O', click: () => did('Open…') },
        { text: 'Open &recent', items: ['report.docx', 'budget.xlsx', 'notes.md'].map((name) => ({ text: name, click: () => did(`Open ${name}`) })) },
        { text: '&Save', shortcut: 'Ctrl+S', beginGroup: true, click: () => did('Save') },
        { text: 'Save &as…', click: () => did('Save as…') },
        { text: 'E&xit', beginGroup: true, click: () => did('Exit') },
      ],
    },
    {
      text: '&Edit',
      items: [
        { text: '&Undo', shortcut: 'Ctrl+Z', enabled: () => s.canUndo, click: () => undo(true) },
        { text: '&Redo', shortcut: 'Ctrl+Y', click: () => undo(false) },
        { text: 'Cu&t', shortcut: 'Ctrl+X', beginGroup: true, click: () => did('Cut') },
        { text: '&Copy', shortcut: 'Ctrl+C', click: () => did('Copy') },
        { text: '&Paste', shortcut: 'Ctrl+V', click: () => did('Paste') },
        { text: 'Paste &special', enabled: false },
      ],
    },
    {
      text: '&View',
      items: [
        { text: '&Word wrap', checked: () => s.wrap, click: () => (s.wrap = !s.wrap) },
        { text: '&Status bar', checked: () => s.statusBar, click: () => (s.statusBar = !s.statusBar) },
        { ...zoom('100%'), beginGroup: true },
        zoom('125%'),
        zoom('150%'),
        { text: '&Theme', beginGroup: true, items: [theme('light', 'Light'), theme('dark', 'Dark'), theme('system', 'Same as the system')] },
      ],
    },
    { text: '&Help', items: [{ text: '&About', click: () => did('About') }] },
  ];

  const bar = new MenuBar({ label: 'Main', items: menus, focusOnF10: () => s.f10 });
  bar.onItemClick(() => s.chosen++);

  return (
    <>
      <div style="inline-size: 100%" ref={(c: Component<HTMLDivElement>) => c.controls.add(bar)} />
      <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center">
        <CheckBox label="F10 focuses the bar" x-model={() => s.f10} />
        <output class="mb-log">{() => s.log}</output>
        <output class="mb-count">{() => `onItemClick ran ${s.chosen} times.`}</output>
      </Stack>
      <span class="mb-view">{() => `Word wrap ${s.wrap ? 'on' : 'off'} · status bar ${s.statusBar ? 'on' : 'off'} · zoom ${s.zoom} · theme ${s.theme}`}</span>
    </>
  );
}
```

## Submenus, check items, radio items and shortcuts

An item with `items` opens a submenu at its side. Right (Left on right-to-left pages), Enter or Space opens it, Left and Escape close it, and hovering opens it after a short delay. `checked` creates a check item, and `checked` with a `group` creates one choice in a set, shown with a dot. `shortcut` is displayed at the end of the item, so register the key separately with `addShortcut`. The same items work in a `Button` menu.

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `text` | `Bind<string>` | The label. `&Copy` makes C select the item while the menu is open (Alt+C on a top-level menu bar item). |
| `icon, hint` | `Bind<…>` | An icon at the start, and a tooltip. |
| `shortcut` | `Bind<string>` | A key combination displayed at the end (`Ctrl+S`). It is for display only, so register the key with `addShortcut`. |
| `description` | `Bind<string>` | A second, dimmer text after the label that distinguishes the item, such as a folder name. It is part of the item's name and never a key. |
| `items` | `Bind<readonly MenuItem[]>` | A submenu that opens at the side. |
| `checked` | `Bind<boolean>` | A check item (`menuitemcheckbox`). |
| `group` | `Bind<string>` | With `checked`, one choice in a group (`menuitemradio`), shown with a dot. |
| `enabled, visible` | `Bind<boolean>` | Dims the item so it cannot be selected, or removes it. |
| `beginGroup` | `Bind<boolean>` | Draws a separator before the item. |
| `tone` | `Bind<'standard' \| 'accent' \| 'success' \| 'caution' \| 'danger'>` | Colors the item with a kit tone (`danger` for destructive actions). A toolbar button moved into the overflow menu keeps its tone. |
| `click` | `(e) => void` | Occurs when the item is selected, after the menu closes. `e`: `{ item, source, event }`. |
| `data` | `unknown` | A custom value. |

## ContextMenu

A `ContextMenu` opens at the pointer when its target is right-clicked, and at the focused element with the Menu key or Shift+F10. `onOpening` receives the element (`e.target`) and builds the items for it, in this case for a row in a list. Setting `e.cancel = true` leaves the browser's own menu. The menu closes on Escape or a click outside. When the page scrolls, it follows the element it opened on and closes once that element is out of view.

```tsx
import { reactive, type Component } from '@motifx/core';
import { ContextMenu, type MenuItem } from '@motifx-community/ui';

interface FileRow {
  id: number;
  name: string;
  locked: boolean;
  starred: boolean;
}

const BOX = 'inline-size: 100%; margin: 0; list-style: none; padding: var(--mx-space-4); background: var(--mx-color-bg-card); border: var(--mx-border-width-1) solid var(--mx-color-stroke-card); border-radius: var(--mx-radius-lg)';

/** A context menu whose items `onOpening` builds for the row of a list it opens on. */
export default function FileList() {
  const s = reactive({
    log: 'Nothing chosen yet.',
    files: [
      { id: 1, name: 'report.docx', locked: false, starred: true },
      { id: 2, name: 'budget.xlsx', locked: true, starred: false },
      { id: 3, name: 'photo.png', locked: false, starred: false },
    ] as FileRow[],
  });
  let renamed = 0;
  let list: Component<HTMLUListElement> | null = null;

  const did = (what: string) => (s.log = what);
  const rename = (row: FileRow) => {
    row.name = `copy-${++renamed}-${row.name}`;
    did(`Renamed to ${row.name}`);
  };

  const rowItems = (row: FileRow): MenuItem[] => [
    { text: '&Open', click: () => did(`Open ${row.name}`) },
    { text: '&Rename', enabled: !row.locked, click: () => rename(row) },
    { text: '&Star', checked: row.starred, click: () => (row.starred = !row.starred) },
    { text: '&Move to', items: ['Documents', 'Pictures', 'Archive'].map((folder) => ({ text: folder, click: () => did(`Move ${row.name} to ${folder}`) })) },
    { text: '&Delete', shortcut: 'Del', beginGroup: true, enabled: !row.locked, click: () => (s.files = s.files.filter((f) => f !== row)) },
  ];

  const rowOf = (el: Element) => {
    const id = Number(el.closest('[data-id]')?.getAttribute('data-id'));
    return s.files.find((f) => f.id === id);
  };

  return (
    <>
      <ul class="cm-list" aria-label="Files" ref={(c: Component<HTMLUListElement>) => (list = c)} style={BOX}>
        {s.files.map((file) => (
          <li key={file.id} data-id={String(file.id)} tabindex="0" style="padding-block: var(--mx-space-2)">
            {() => `${file.starred ? '★ ' : ''}${file.name}${file.locked ? ' (locked)' : ''}`}
          </li>
        ))}
      </ul>
      <ContextMenu
        target={() => list}
        label="File"
        onOpening={(e) => {
          const row = rowOf(e.target);
          if (row) e.items = rowItems(row);
          else e.cancel = true;
        }}
      />
      <output class="cm-log">{() => s.log}</output>
    </>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import { reactive, type Component } from '@motifx/core';
import { attachContextMenu } from '@motifx-community/ui';

const START = 'Right-click here, or focus me and press the Menu key.';
const BOX = 'padding: var(--mx-space-4); background: var(--mx-color-bg-card); border: var(--mx-border-width-1) solid var(--mx-color-stroke-card); border-radius: var(--mx-radius-lg)';

/** A menu given to an element with `attachContextMenu`, its items built from the opening. */
export default function AttachedMenu() {
  const s = reactive({ zone: START });

  const attach = (c: Component<HTMLDivElement>) => {
    const remove = attachContextMenu(c, (e) => [
      { text: '&Say where', click: () => (s.zone = `Opened ${e.byKeyboard ? 'from the keyboard' : 'with the pointer'} on <${e.target.tagName.toLowerCase()}>.`) },
      { text: '&Reset', click: () => (s.zone = START) },
    ]);
    c.motif.setDisposable(remove);
  };

  return (
    <div class="cm-zone" tabindex="0" style={BOX} onBuilt={attach}>
      {() => s.zone}
    </div>
  );
}
```

## Keyboard

| Key | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `Tab` | Moves focus into the menu bar (one Tab stop) and out of it. |
| `Left / Right` | On the bar, moves to the previous or next top-level item. In a menu, moves to the adjacent menu or closes a submenu (Right opens one). These keys are mirrored on right-to-left pages. |
| `Down, Enter, Space` | On the bar, opens the menu on its first item. Up opens it on the last item. |
| `Up / Down, Home / End` | In a menu, moves between items and wraps at the ends. |
| `A letter` | Moves to the next item that starts with that letter. An item's `&` key selects it. |
| `Alt + key` | Opens the top-level item with that `&` key (Control + Option on Apple platforms). |
| `Escape` | Closes a submenu, then the menu, and returns to where it opened. |
| `F10` | Moves focus to the menu bar when `focusOnF10` is set. |
| `Menu key, Shift+F10` | Opens a context menu at the focused element. |

## Accessibility

| Topic | Details |
| --- | --- |
| `MenuBar` | `role="menubar"` named by `label`. Top-level items are `menuitem` elements with `aria-haspopup` and `aria-expanded`, and the bar is one Tab stop (roving tabindex). |
| `Menus` | `role="menu"`. Items are `menuitem`, `menuitemcheckbox` or `menuitemradio` with `aria-checked`. Disabled items have `aria-disabled` and remain reachable. |
| `Submenus` | The item has `aria-haspopup="menu"` and `aria-expanded`. The submenu opens next to it, focus moves in and returns when it closes. |
| `Focus` | A menu opened from the keyboard focuses its first item, and a menu opened with the pointer focuses the menu itself. Closing returns focus. |
| `Shortcuts` | The shortcut text is part of the item's name. Access keys are exposed through `aria-keyshortcuts` on top-level items. |

## Localization

Menus have no strings of their own. Every label, shortcut and name comes from your items, so they follow your own translations. A function in `text` updates immediately when the language changes.

## Styling

| Hook | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `.mx-menubar, .mx-menubar__bar, .mx-menubar__item` | The menu bar, its row and a top-level item (`aria-expanded="true"` while open). |
| `.mx-context-menu, .mx-context-menu__anchor` | The context menu, which has no box of its own, and the point it opens at. |
| `.mx-menu, .mx-menu__item, .mx-menu__separator` | A menu (shared with Button), an item and a separator. |
| `.mx-menu__check, .mx-menu__icon, .mx-menu__label, .mx-menu__description, .mx-menu__shortcut, .mx-menu__arrow` | The parts of an item. |

### Component tokens

| Token | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `menubar.height, menubar.item-height` | The height of the bar and of a top-level item. |
| `menubar.bar, menubar.item, menubar.icon, menubar.mnemonic` | Units: the bar, a top-level item with its box per state (`hover`, `pressed`, `open`, `disabled`, `focus`), its icon, and its access key indicator (`shown`). |
| `menu.item, menu.item-height, menu.item-white-space` | Menu items, shared with the Button menu: the item unit in each state (`highlight`, `pressed`, `focus`, `checked`, `disabled`, `first`, `last`, each tone and `<tone>-highlight`), the row height, and text wrapping. |
| `menu.panel, menu.check, menu.icon, menu.check-mark, menu.radio-mark, menu.separator` | Units: the item column, the leading indicator and icon, the check and radio marks, and the separator between groups. |
| `menu.label, menu.description, menu.shortcut, menu.arrow` | Units: the item text, its description, the shortcut and the submenu arrow. |

## API reference

### MenuBar props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `items` | `Bind<readonly MenuItem[]>` | `[]` | The top-level items, whose `items` define the menus they open. A top-level item without `items` runs its `click`. |
| `label` | `Bind<string>` | `''` | The accessible name of the bar. This is the same property as `text`. |
| `focusOnF10` | `Bind<boolean>` | `false` | F10 moves focus to the bar from anywhere on the page. This is off by default because browsers use F10. |
| `openOnHover` | `Bind<boolean>` | `true` | While a menu is open, hovering another top-level item opens its menu, and hovering an item opens its submenu. |
| `enabled / disabled, visible, tabStop, tabIndex` | see Control |  | Properties shared by all controls. |

### ContextMenu props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `items` | `Bind<readonly MenuItem[]>` | `[]` | The commands. `onOpening` can provide different ones for each element. |
| `target` | `Bind<Element \| Component \| null>` | Its parent | The element the menu belongs to. If not set, this is the element the `ContextMenu` is placed in. |
| `label` | `Bind<string>` | `''` | The accessible name of the menu. |
| `keyboard` | `Bind<boolean>` | `true` | The Menu key and Shift+F10 open the menu at the focused element. |
| `closeOnScroll` | `Bind<boolean>` | `true` | Scrolling the element out of view closes the menu. Until then, the menu follows the element. |
| `openOnHover` | `Bind<boolean>` | `true` | Hovering an item opens its submenu. |
| `enabled` | `Bind<boolean>` | `true` | `false` shows the browser's own menu. |

### Properties

| Property | Access | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `MenuBar.openItem` | read-only, reactive | The top-level item whose menu is open. |
| `ContextMenu.opened` | read-only, reactive | Indicates whether it is open. |
| `ContextMenu.targetElement` | read-only, reactive | The element the menu was last opened on. |
| `ContextMenu.target` | read/write, reactive | The element the menu listens on. |

### Methods

| Method | Returns | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `MenuBar.open(item \| index)` | `boolean` | Opens a top-level item's menu with focus on its first item. |
| `MenuBar.close()` | `void` | Closes the open menu. |
| `ContextMenu.open(at, target?)` | `boolean` | Opens the menu programmatically, at `{ x, y }` or at an element. |
| `ContextMenu.close()` | `void` | Closes it. |
| `MenuBar.refresh(), ContextMenu.refresh()` | `void` | Your items can be plain or reactive, and the menu reads them as they are. After changing them in place, call `refresh()`. The bar, the open menu and its submenus update. |
| `attachContextMenu(target, items)` | `() => void` | Attaches a menu to an element or component. `items` can be a function of the opening event (`e.target`). Returns a function that removes the menu. |

### Events

| Event | When |
| --- | --- |
| `onItemClick(e)` | On both components, occurs when an item is selected, after its own `click`. |
| `ContextMenu.onOpening(e)` | Occurs before the menu opens. `e`: `{ target, items, cancel, byKeyboard, event, source }`. Set `e.items` for the element, or set `e.cancel = true`. |
| `ContextMenu.onClosed(reason)` | `escape`, `outside`, `focus` or `code`. |

# TextBox

> Editors · @motifx-community/ui 0.1.0-beta.5

A single-line text input with a label, help text and error display. It supports a placeholder, a prefix and suffix, buttons inside the box, a clear button, a password reveal button, a character counter, an input mask and validation, either on its own, in a group, or across all fields in a panel.

## Import

```tsx
import { TextBox, ValidationGroup, validateFields, type ValidationRule } from '@motifx-community/ui';
```

## Declarative and programmatic

Every prop accepts a value or a function, and a function that reads a reactive object keeps the field in sync with it. `x-model` provides two-way binding for the value. When you create the component with `new`, set the same properties programmatically.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, Stack, TextBox } from '@motifx-community/ui';

/** A field bound to state with x-model, and fields created with `new` and added programmatically. */
export default function Programmatic() {
  const form = reactive({ name: 'Ada', result: '' });
  let added = 0;
  let host: Stack | null = null;

  const addProgrammatic = () => {
    const box = new TextBox({ label: `Field ${++added}`, clearButton: true, placeholder: 'Created with new' });
    box.onValueChanged((e) => (form.result = `${box.label}: ${e.value}`));
    host?.controls.add(box);
    box.focus();
  };

  return (
    <>
      <TextBox label="&Name" x-model={() => form.name} clearButton helpText={() => `Hello, ${form.name || 'stranger'}.`} />
      <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center">
        <Button text="Add a field programmatically" variant="outline" onclick={addProgrammatic} />
        <output class="tb-result">{() => form.result}</output>
      </Stack>
      <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center" ref={(c: Stack) => (host = c)} />
    </>
  );
}
```

## Label

The label can appear above the box, next to it (`side`), inside it until there is a value (`floating`), or only for screen readers (`hidden`). `&` marks its access key.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, Stack, TextBox, type FieldLabelMode } from '@motifx-community/ui';

const MODES: FieldLabelMode[] = ['top', 'side', 'floating', 'hidden'];

/** The label above the box, next to it, floating inside it, or only for screen readers. */
export default function LabelModes() {
  const s = reactive({ email: '', labelMode: 'top' as FieldLabelMode });
  return (
    <>
      <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center" role="group" aria-label="Label mode">
        {MODES.map((mode) => (
          <Button
            key={mode}
            text={mode}
            size="sm"
            variant={() => (s.labelMode === mode ? 'solid' : 'ghost')}
            aria-pressed={() => s.labelMode === mode}
            onclick={() => (s.labelMode = mode)}
          />
        ))}
      </Stack>
      <TextBox label="&Email" labelMode={() => s.labelMode} type="email" x-model={() => s.email} helpText="We never share it." />
    </>
  );
}
```

## Variants and sizes

```tsx
import { Stack, TextBox, type FieldVariant } from '@motifx-community/ui';

const VARIANTS: FieldVariant[] = ['outline', 'filled', 'underline'];

/** Every variant in the three sizes. */
export default function VariantsAndSizes() {
  return (
    <>
      {VARIANTS.map((variant) => (
        <Stack key={variant} orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center">
          <TextBox label={`${variant} sm`} variant={variant} size="sm" placeholder="Small" />
          <TextBox label={`${variant} md`} variant={variant} placeholder="Medium" />
          <TextBox label={`${variant} lg`} variant={variant} size="lg" placeholder="Large" />
        </Stack>
      ))}
    </>
  );
}
```

## Prefix, suffix, icon and buttons

`prefix` and `suffix` add fixed text around the value, and `icon` appears at the start. `buttons` adds custom buttons, each with its own `enabled`, `visible` and `position`.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { TextBox } from '@motifx-community/ui';

const SearchIcon = () => (
  <svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" aria-hidden="true">
    <circle cx="7" cy="7" r="4.5" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" />
    <path d="M10.5 10.5l3 3" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round" />
  </svg>
);

const CopyIcon = () => (
  <svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" aria-hidden="true">
    <path d="M5.5 5.5h8v8h-8zM3 10.5h-.5v-8h8v.5" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.3" stroke-linejoin="round" />
  </svg>
);

/** Fixed text around the value, an icon at the start, and a custom button in the box. */
export default function PrefixSuffix() {
  const s = reactive({ site: '', query: '' });
  const link = 'https://motifjs.com/invite/42';
  return (
    <>
      <TextBox label="Site" prefix="https://" suffix=".com" x-model={() => s.site} />
      <TextBox label="Search" type="search" icon={() => <SearchIcon />} clearButton x-model={() => s.query} />
      <TextBox
        label="Invite link"
        readOnly
        value={link}
        buttons={[{ icon: () => <CopyIcon />, hint: 'Copy', click: () => navigator.clipboard.writeText(link) }]}
      />
    </>
  );
}
```

## Password and character counter

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Stack, TextBox } from '@motifx-community/ui';

/** A password that can be shown, and a field that counts its characters; a password sits in a form. */
export default function PasswordCounter() {
  const s = reactive({ password: '', note: '' });
  return (
    <form onsubmit={(e: SubmitEvent) => e.preventDefault()}>
      <Stack>
        <TextBox label="Password" type="password" x-model={() => s.password} autocomplete="new-password" />
        <TextBox label="Note" maxLength={40} showCounter x-model={() => s.note} />
      </Stack>
    </form>
  );
}
```

## Input mask

A mask keeps the text in the required format as the user types, deletes or pastes, and the caret skips fixed characters. The value contains only the typed characters, or the displayed text with `maskValue="formatted"`. An incomplete mask fails validation.

| Character | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `0` | A digit. |
| `9` | An optional digit. |
| `a` | A letter. |
| `*` | A letter or a digit. |
| `\\` | Treats the next character as fixed: `\\0` is a fixed zero. |
| `anything else` | A fixed character, skipped during typing. |

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Stack, TextBox } from '@motifx-community/ui';

/** A phone number, an IBAN kept with its spaces, and a plate with a mask character of its own. */
export default function Masks() {
  const s = reactive({ phone: '', iban: '', plate: '' });
  return (
    <>
      <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center">
        <TextBox label="Phone" type="tel" mask="(000) 000 00 00" x-model={() => s.phone} />
        <output class="tb-phone">{() => `value: "${s.phone}"`}</output>
      </Stack>
      <TextBox label="IBAN" mask="TR00 0000 0000 0000 0000 0000 00" maskValue="formatted" stretch x-model={() => s.iban} />
      <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center">
        <TextBox label="Plate" mask="00 LLL 099" maskChars={{ L: { test: /\p{L}/u, transform: 'upper' } }} x-model={() => s.plate} />
        <output>{() => `value: "${s.plate}"`}</output>
      </Stack>
    </>
  );
}
```

## Validation

A field validates itself when it loses focus after a change, and then on every change until the value is valid. `required`, `minLength`, `type="email"` and a mask bring their own rules, and `rules` adds your own, including asynchronous ones. `error` displays a message from an external source, such as the server.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, Stack, TextBox, ValidationGroup } from '@motifx-community/ui';

/** Simulates a server call: "ada" is taken. */
const isFree = (value: string) =>
  new Promise<boolean | string>((done) => setTimeout(() => done(value.toLowerCase() === 'ada' ? `“${value}” is taken.` : true), 600));

/** Built-in rules, custom rules including an async one, an external error, and a group validated on Save. */
export default function Validation() {
  const s = reactive({ user: '', serverError: '' as string | null, result: '' });
  const group = new ValidationGroup();

  const save = async () => {
    const result = await group.validate();
    s.result = result.valid ? 'Saved.' : `${result.invalid.length} field(s) to fix.`;
  };

  return (
    <>
      <TextBox label="Email" type="email" required validationGroup={group} />
      <TextBox
        label="User name"
        required
        helpText="Try “ada”: the server says it is taken."
        x-model={() => s.user}
        rules={[
          { type: 'length', min: 3 },
          { type: 'pattern', pattern: '[a-z0-9_]+', message: 'Lower case letters, digits and _ only.' },
          { type: 'custom', check: isFree },
        ]}
        validationGroup={group}
      />
      <TextBox label="Code" error={() => s.serverError} validationGroup={group} helpText="An error from outside shows until cleared." />
      <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center">
        <Button text="Save" tone="accent" onclick={save} />
        <Button text="Server error" variant="outline" onclick={() => (s.serverError = s.serverError ? null : 'This code expired.')} />
        <Button text="Reset" variant="ghost" onclick={() => group.reset()} />
        <output class="tb-save">{() => s.result}</output>
      </Stack>
    </>
  );
}
```

Without a group, `validateFields(panel)` validates every field inside a component or element, such as a panel, a dialog or a page.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, Stack, TextBox, validateFields } from '@motifx-community/ui';

/** Every field inside a panel checked at once, without a group. */
export default function CheckPanel() {
  const s = reactive({ result: '' });
  let panel: Stack | null = null;

  const check = async () => {
    const result = await validateFields(panel!);
    s.result = result.valid ? 'All fields are fine.' : `${result.invalid.length} field(s) to fix.`;
  };

  return (
    <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center" ref={(c: Stack) => (panel = c)}>
      <TextBox label="First name" required />
      <TextBox label="Last name" required />
      <Button text="Check the panel" variant="outline" onclick={check} />
      <output>{() => s.result}</output>
    </Stack>
  );
}
```

## Read-only and disabled

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, TextBox } from '@motifx-community/ui';

/** Read-only and disabled, both following state. */
export default function ReadOnly() {
  const s = reactive({ editing: true });
  return (
    <>
      <Button text="Toggle" variant="outline" onclick={() => (s.editing = !s.editing)} />
      <TextBox label="Read-only" value="#1042" readOnly={() => !s.editing} clearButton />
      <TextBox label="Disabled" value="#1042" enabled={() => s.editing} />
    </>
  );
}
```

## Keyboard

| Key | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `Alt + key (`&Name`)` | Moves focus to the field (Control + Option + key on Apple platforms). |
| `Enter` | Commits the value (with `updateOn="change"`) and raises `onEnter`. |
| `Escape` | With `clearButton`, clears a field that has a value. Otherwise, the key passes to the containing window. |
| `Tab` | Custom buttons and the password button are Tab stops. The clear button is not, because Escape does the same thing. |

## Accessibility

| Topic | Details |
| --- | --- |
| `Element` | A native `<input>` associated with its `<label>` through `for`. |
| `Description` | `aria-describedby` references the prefix, the suffix and the help text. |
| `Errors` | `aria-invalid="true"`. The message is a polite live region, so new errors are announced. |
| `Required check boxes` | `aria-required="true"`. The indicator after the label is hidden from screen readers. |
| `Buttons` | The clear and password buttons get their names from `uiLocale`, and the password button has `aria-pressed`. |

## Localization

The names of the clear and password buttons and all validation messages come from `uiLocale.strings`. Every field updates immediately when they change, including errors already on screen.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, uiLocale } from '@motifx-community/ui';
import { kitTexts } from '../../../shared/kit-texts';

/** Switches the texts of every field on the page; errors already shown follow too. */
export default function Localization() {
  const s = reactive({ lang: 'en' });
  const toggle = () => {
    s.lang = s.lang === 'en' ? 'tr' : 'en';
    void uiLocale.use(s.lang);
  };
  return (
    <>
      <Button text={() => (s.lang === 'en' ? 'Language: English' : 'Dil: Türkçe')} variant="outline" onclick={toggle} />
      <span>
        Required reads <output class="tb-required">{() => kitTexts.strings.required}</output>
      </span>
    </>
  );
}
```

## Styling

| Hook | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `.mx-field` | The field. `data-size`, `data-variant`, `data-label-mode`, `data-invalid`, `data-readonly`, `data-disabled`, `data-filled`, `data-required`, `data-stretch`. |
| `.mx-text-box` | Added by TextBox. |
| `.mx-field__label, .mx-field__box, .mx-field__input` | The label, the box and the input. |
| `.mx-field__icon, .mx-field__prefix, .mx-field__suffix` | The parts on either side of the input. |
| `.mx-field__button, .mx-text-box__clear, .mx-text-box__reveal` | Buttons inside the box. |
| `.mx-field__message, .mx-field__counter` | Help text below the box. |

### Component tokens

| Token | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `field.width` | The width when the field is not stretched. |
| `field.height.*, field.padding.*, field.font-size.*` | Sizes are defined by the density tokens. |
| `field.box, field.layer, field.frame, field.indicator, field.ring` | Units: the box, a state layer over its fill, the frame (with `frame-start`, `frame-notch` and `frame-end` around a notch), the line along the bottom, and a ring for keyboard focus. Each has a box per state: by variant (`filled-…`, `underline-…`), by status (`invalid`, `readonly`, `disabled`), and for `hover`, `focus` and `pressed`. |
| `field.label, field.required, field.icon, field.prefix, field.suffix, field.placeholder` | Units: the label (`focus`, `invalid`, `disabled`, `floating-…`), the required indicator and the parts next to the text. |
| `field.slot, field.button, field.glyph, field.button-icon` | Units: button groups in the box, the buttons (`hover`, `pressed`, `focus`, `disabled`) and their contents. |
| `field.foot, field.message, field.counter` | Units: the line below the box (`shown`, `invalid`, `disabled`), the help or error text, and the counter. |
| `field.border-width, field.gap, field.label-gap, field.label-width, field.label-font-weight, field.label-font-size` | Frame width, spacing and the label. |
| `field.icon-size, field.button-inset` | Icons, and the distance between the buttons and the edges of the box. |
| `field.floating-height, field.floating-font-size, field.floating-padding, field.notch-gap` | The floating label and the notch cut for it. |

## API reference

### Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `Bind<string>` | `''` | The text. `x-model` provides two-way binding. |
| `label` | `Bind<string>` | `''` | The field label. Writing `&Name` assigns Alt+N as the access key. This is the same property as `text`. |
| `labelMode` | `Bind<FieldLabelMode>` | `'top'` | `top`, `side` (next to the box), `floating` (inside the box until there is a value) or `hidden` (for screen readers only). |
| `placeholder` | `Bind<string>` | `''` | Displayed when the field is empty. |
| `helpText` | `Bind<string>` | `''` | Help text shown below the box. An error message replaces it. |
| `hint` | `Bind<string>` | `''` | The tooltip text. |
| `type` | `Bind<TextBoxType>` | `'text'` | `text`, `password`, `email`, `search`, `tel` or `url`. `email` and `url` also validate the format. |
| `prefix / suffix` | `Bind<string>` | `''` | Fixed text before or after the value inside the box (`https://`, `kg`). |
| `icon` | `Bind<IconSource \| null>` | — | An icon at the start of the box. |
| `buttons` | `Bind<readonly FieldButton[]>` | `[]` | Custom buttons inside the box, at the start or end. |
| `clearButton` | `Bind<boolean>` | `false` | Shows a button that clears the field. Pressing Escape also clears it. |
| `passwordReveal` | `Bind<boolean>` | `true` | With `type="password"`, shows a button that reveals the password. |
| `maxLength / minLength` | `Bind<number>` | — | Length limits. `minLength` is enforced by validation. |
| `showCounter` | `Bind<boolean>` | `false` | Shows `12/50` below the box (`12` without `maxLength`). |
| `updateOn` | `Bind<'input' \| 'change'>` | `'input'` | With `change`, the value updates when the field loses focus or the user presses Enter. |
| `selectOnFocus` | `Bind<boolean>` | `false` | Selects all text when the field receives focus. |
| `align` | `Bind<'start' \| 'center' \| 'end'>` | `'start'` | Text alignment. |
| `readOnly` | `Bind<boolean>` | `false` | The value can be read, selected and copied, but not changed. |
| `required` | `Bind<boolean>` | `false` | Adds an indicator after the label, `aria-required` and a `required` rule. |
| `size` | `Bind<ControlSize>` | `'md'` | `sm`, `md`, `lg`, from the density tokens. |
| `variant` | `Bind<FieldVariant>` | `'outline'` | `outline`, `filled`, `underline`. |
| `stretch` | `Bind<boolean>` | `false` | Stretches to the full width of its container. |
| `mask` | `Bind<string>` | `''` | See Input mask. |
| `maskChars` | `Bind<Record<string, MaskChar>>` | `{}` | Custom mask characters. |
| `maskPlaceholder` | `Bind<string>` | `'_'` | Shown in positions that are not filled yet. |
| `maskValue` | `Bind<'raw' \| 'formatted'>` | `'raw'` | `raw` returns only the typed characters, and `formatted` includes the fixed ones. |
| `showMask` | `Bind<'always' \| 'focus'>` | `'focus'` | With `focus`, an empty mask appears only while the field has focus. |
| `rules` | `Bind<readonly ValidationRule[]>` | `[]` | See Validation. |
| `error` | `Bind<string \| null>` | — | An error from an external source, such as the server. It stays until cleared. |
| `validateOn` | `Bind<ValidateOn>` | `'blur'` | `blur`, `input`, `manual`. |
| `validationGroup` | `Bind<ValidationGroup \| null>` | — | The group the field is validated with. |
| `inputMode, autocomplete, spellcheck, name` | `Bind<…>` | — | Passed to the `<input>`. |
| `enabled / disabled, visible, tabStop, tabIndex` | see Control |  | Properties shared by all controls. |

### Properties

| Property | Access | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `every prop above` | read/write, reactive | Accepts a value or a function, the same as the prop: `box.error = () => this.model.nameError` is tracked. |
| `isValid` | read-only, reactive | `false` while an error is displayed. |
| `validationMessage` | read-only, reactive | The error being displayed, or `''` if there is none. |
| `validating` | read-only, reactive | Indicates that an asynchronous rule is running. |
| `maskComplete` | read-only | Indicates that every position of the mask is filled. |
| `inputElement` | read-only | The native `<input>`. |

### Methods

| Method | Returns | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `validate()` | `Promise<boolean>` | Validates the value and displays the result. |
| `resetValidation()` | `void` | Clears the results of previous validation. |
| `focus()` | `boolean` | Sets focus on the input. |
| `select()` | `void` | Selects all text. |
| `clear()` | `void` | Clears the field, as the clear button does. |
| `refresh()` | `void` | Your `buttons` can be plain or reactive, and the field reads them as they are. After changing them in place, call `refresh()`. Every editor has this method, and list editors also re-read their items. |

### Events

| Event | When |
| --- | --- |
| `onValueChanged(e)` | Occurs when the value changes. `e`: `{ value, previousValue, byUser, source, event? }`. `byUser` distinguishes user input from programmatic changes. |
| `onValidated(e)` | Occurs when validation finishes. `e`: `{ valid, message, source }`. |
| `onEnter(e)` | Occurs when the user presses Enter. `e`: `{ value, source, event }`. |
| `oninput, onchange, onkeydown, onfocusin, onfocusout` | DOM events from the input bubble up to the field. |

### Validation rules

| Rule | Validators |
| --- | --- |
| `{ type: 'required' }` | A value is required. |
| `{ type: 'email' } / { type: 'url' }` | An email address or a web address. |
| `{ type: 'pattern', pattern }` | A `RegExp`, or a string that must match the whole value, like the HTML `pattern` attribute. |
| `{ type: 'length', min?, max? }` | The number of characters. |
| `{ type: 'range', min?, max? }` | A number or date within a range. |
| `{ type: 'compare', with, not? }` | Equal to another value, such as a repeated password, or different from it with `not`. |
| `{ type: 'custom', check, ignoreEmpty? }` | `check(value)` returns `true`, `false`, a message, or a promise of one of these, such as a server call. |
| `every rule` | `message` (a value or a function) and `enabled`. Empty values pass every rule except `required` and `compare`. |

The frame (`Field`), the mask (`InputMask`, which works on any `<input>`) and validation (`ValidationGroup`, `validateFields`, `checkRules`) are shared parts, exported for use in other components and your own code.
