# TextArea

> Editors · @motifx-community/ui 0.1.0-beta.5

A multi-line text input. The box can grow with its content or be resized by the user, and it supports a character counter, a clear button and Ctrl+Enter to submit, along with the label, help text and validation common to all fields.

## Import

```tsx
import { TextArea, type TextAreaProps } from '@motifx-community/ui';
```

## Declarative and programmatic

Every prop accepts a value or a function, and `x-model` provides two-way binding for the text. When you create the component with `new`, set the same properties programmatically.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, Stack, TextArea } from '@motifx-community/ui';

/** A textarea bound with x-model, and notes created with `new` and added programmatically. */
export default function Programmatic() {
  const s = reactive({ comment: 'MotifJS keeps the DOM it builds.', log: '' });
  let added = 0;
  let host: Stack | null = null;

  const addProgrammatic = () => {
    const note = new TextArea({ label: `Note ${++added}`, rows: 2, autoGrow: true, maxRows: 5, clearButton: true });
    note.onValueChanged((e) => (s.log = `${note.label}: ${e.value.split('\n').length} line(s)`));
    host?.controls.add(note);
    note.focus();
  };

  return (
    <>
      <TextArea label="&Comment" x-model={() => s.comment} helpText={() => `${s.comment.length} characters`} stretch />
      <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center">
        <Button text="Add a note programmatically" variant="outline" onclick={addProgrammatic} />
        <output class="ta-log">{() => s.log}</output>
      </Stack>
      <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center" ref={(c: Stack) => (host = c)} />
    </>
  );
}
```

## Auto-grow

With `autoGrow`, the box adjusts to its content. It stays between `minRows` and `maxRows` lines and scrolls beyond that. When the box gets narrower, text wraps onto more lines and the box grows accordingly.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { TextArea } from '@motifx-community/ui';

/** A box that grows with the text from two lines to six, then scrolls. */
export default function AutoGrow() {
  const s = reactive({ story: '' });
  return <TextArea label="Story" autoGrow minRows={2} maxRows={6} placeholder="Type a few lines…" x-model={() => s.story} stretch />;
}
```

## Resizing

The grip in the corner of the box lets the user resize it vertically (`vertical`, the default) or in both directions (`both`). Set `none` to disable resizing.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, Stack, TextArea, type TextAreaResize } from '@motifx-community/ui';

const RESIZES: TextAreaResize[] = ['none', 'vertical', 'both'];

/** Which way the user can drag the box bigger. */
export default function Resize() {
  const s = reactive({ resize: 'vertical' as TextAreaResize });
  return (
    <>
      <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center" role="group" aria-label="Resize">
        {RESIZES.map((resize) => (
          <Button
            key={resize}
            text={resize}
            size="sm"
            variant={() => (s.resize === resize ? 'solid' : 'ghost')}
            aria-pressed={() => s.resize === resize}
            onclick={() => (s.resize = resize)}
          />
        ))}
      </Stack>
      <TextArea label="Notes" resize={() => s.resize} rows={4} />
    </>
  );
}
```

## Character counter and limits

`maxLength` stops input at the limit, and `minLength` is checked when the field loses focus. `showCounter` displays the count below the box.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { TextArea } from '@motifx-community/ui';

/** A limit while typing, a minimum checked on leaving, a counter and a clear button. */
export default function CounterAndLimits() {
  const s = reactive({ bio: '' });
  return <TextArea label="Bio" maxLength={160} minLength={10} showCounter clearButton x-model={() => s.bio} stretch />;
}
```

## Ctrl+Enter

Enter starts a new line. Ctrl+Enter (Cmd+Enter on a Mac) raises `onEnter` with the value, which is the usual way to send a message or save a note.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { TextArea } from '@motifx-community/ui';

/** A message box: Enter starts a new line, Ctrl+Enter sends. */
export default function CtrlEnter() {
  const s = reactive({ message: '', sent: [] as { id: number; text: string }[] });
  let sentCount = 0;

  const send = (text: string) => {
    if (!text.trim()) return;
    s.sent.push({ id: ++sentCount, text });
    s.message = '';
  };

  return (
    <>
      <ul class="ta-sent">
        {s.sent.map((m) => (
          <li key={m.id}>{m.text}</li>
        ))}
      </ul>
      <TextArea label="Message" helpText="Ctrl+Enter sends." autoGrow rows={1} maxRows={4} x-model={() => s.message} onEnter={(e) => send(e.value)} stretch />
    </>
  );
}
```

## Label

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, Stack, TextArea, type FieldLabelMode } from '@motifx-community/ui';

const MODES: FieldLabelMode[] = ['top', 'side', 'floating', 'hidden'];

/** The label above the box, next to it, floating inside it, or only for screen readers. */
export default function LabelModes() {
  const s = reactive({ labelMode: 'top' as FieldLabelMode });
  return (
    <>
      <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center" role="group" aria-label="Label mode">
        {MODES.map((mode) => (
          <Button
            key={mode}
            text={mode}
            size="sm"
            variant={() => (s.labelMode === mode ? 'solid' : 'ghost')}
            aria-pressed={() => s.labelMode === mode}
            onclick={() => (s.labelMode = mode)}
          />
        ))}
      </Stack>
      <TextArea label="Address" labelMode={() => s.labelMode} rows={2} />
    </>
  );
}
```

## Read-only, disabled and required

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, TextArea } from '@motifx-community/ui';

const TERMS = 'Line one of the terms.\nLine two of the terms.';

/** Read-only and disabled, both following state, and a required field. */
export default function States() {
  const s = reactive({ editing: true });
  return (
    <>
      <Button text="Toggle" variant="outline" onclick={() => (s.editing = !s.editing)} />
      <TextArea label="Terms" readOnly={() => !s.editing} value={TERMS} rows={2} />
      <TextArea label="Reason" required enabled={() => s.editing} rows={2} />
    </>
  );
}
```

## Keyboard

| Key | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `Enter` | Inserts a new line. |
| `Ctrl + Enter, Cmd + Enter` | Commits the value (with `updateOn="change"`) and raises `onEnter`. |
| `Escape` | With `clearButton`, clears a field that has a value. Otherwise, the key passes to the containing window. |
| `Alt + key (`&Name`)` | Moves focus to the field (Control + Option + key on Apple platforms). |
| `Tab` | Moves focus out of the field. The clear button is not a Tab stop, because Escape does the same thing. |

## Accessibility

| Topic | Details |
| --- | --- |
| `Element` | A native `<textarea>` associated with its `<label>` through `for`. |
| `Description` | `aria-describedby` references the prefix, the suffix and the help text. |
| `Errors` | `aria-invalid="true"`. The message is a polite live region. |
| `Required check boxes` | `aria-required="true"`. The indicator after the label is hidden from screen readers. |
| `Ctrl + Enter` | If Ctrl+Enter sends something, mention it in the label or help text, as the example above does. |

## Localization

The name of the clear button and the validation messages come from `uiLocale.strings`.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, uiLocale } from '@motifx-community/ui';
import { kitTexts } from '../../../shared/kit-texts';

/** Switches the texts of every field on the page, the clear button's name included. */
export default function Localization() {
  const s = reactive({ lang: 'en' });
  const toggle = () => {
    s.lang = s.lang === 'en' ? 'tr' : 'en';
    void uiLocale.use(s.lang);
  };
  return (
    <>
      <Button text={() => (s.lang === 'en' ? 'Language: English' : 'Dil: Türkçe')} variant="outline" onclick={toggle} />
      <span>
        The clear button reads <output>{() => kitTexts.strings.clear}</output>
      </span>
    </>
  );
}
```

## Styling

TextArea uses the field tokens (`field.*`, see TextBox) and has none of its own, so its first line aligns with a single-line field of the same size.

| Hook | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `.mx-field.mx-text-area` | The field. `data-resize`, `data-auto-grow` and the field attributes (`data-size`, `data-variant`, `data-label-mode`, `data-invalid`, `data-readonly`, `data-disabled`, `data-filled`). |
| `.mx-field__box` | The box, which carries the resize grip. |
| `.mx-field__input.mx-text-area__input` | The textarea. |
| `.mx-text-area__clear` | The clear button. |
| `.mx-field__message, .mx-field__counter` | Help text below the box. |

## API reference

### Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `Bind<string>` | `''` | The text, with lines separated by `\n`. `x-model` provides two-way binding. |

| `selectOnFocus` | `Bind<boolean>` | `false` | Selects all text when the field receives focus. |
| `wrap` | `Bind<'soft' \| 'hard' \| 'off'>` | `'soft'` | `off` keeps long lines on one line and scrolls horizontally. |
| `helpText, hint, prefix, suffix, icon, buttons` | see TextBox |  | Parts common to all fields. |
| `readOnly, required, size, variant, stretch` | see TextBox |  | States and appearance common to all fields. |
| `rules, error, validateOn, validationGroup` | see TextBox |  | Validation works the same way as for all fields. |
| `spellcheck, name, autocomplete` | `Bind<…>` | — | Passed to the `<textarea>`. |
| `enabled / disabled, visible, tabStop, tabIndex` | see Control |  | Properties shared by all controls. |

| `textAreaElement` | read-only | The native `<textarea>`. |

# NumberBox

> Editors · @motifx-community/ui 0.1.0-beta.5

A numeric input with arrow key support, PageUp and PageDown, spin buttons that repeat while held, min and max limits, exact decimal stepping, display formats such as currency and percent, and locale-aware input.

## Import

```tsx
import { NumberBox, type NumberBoxProps } from '@motifx-community/ui';
```

## Declarative and programmatic

`x-model` binds a number (`null` when empty). When you create the component with `new`, set the same properties programmatically.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, NumberBox, Stack } from '@motifx-community/ui';

const show = (value: number | null) => (value === null ? 'null' : String(value));

/** A field bound to a number with x-model, and fields created with `new` and stepped programmatically. */
export default function Programmatic() {
  const s = reactive({ quantity: 3 as number | null, log: '' });
  let added = 0;
  let host: Stack | null = null;

  const addProgrammatic = () => {
    const box = new NumberBox({ label: `Count ${++added}`, min: 0, max: 10, value: 5, locale: 'en' });
    box.onValueChanged((e) => (s.log = `${box.label}: ${show(e.value)}`));
    host?.controls.add(box);
    box.stepUp();
    box.focus();
  };

  return (
    <>
      <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center">
        <NumberBox label="&Quantity" min={1} max={99} locale="en" x-model={() => s.quantity} />
        <output class="nb-quantity">{() => `value: ${show(s.quantity)}`}</output>
      </Stack>
      <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center">
        <Button text="Add a field programmatically" variant="outline" onclick={addProgrammatic} />
        <output class="nb-log">{() => s.log}</output>
      </Stack>
      <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center" ref={(c: Stack) => (host = c)} />
    </>
  );
}
```

## Steps and keyboard input

Up and Down add `step`, PageUp and PageDown add `largeStep` (10 × `step` by default), and Home and End go to `min` and `max`. Steps are calculated on the decimal digits, so 0.1 + 0.2 equals 0.3. With `wheel`, the mouse wheel changes the value while the field has focus.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { NumberBox } from '@motifx-community/ui';

const show = (value: number | null) => (value === null ? 'null' : String(value));

/** A step of 0.1 without float noise, and the mouse wheel stepping while the field has focus. */
export default function Steps() {
  const s = reactive({ rate: 0.1 as number | null });
  return (
    <>
      <NumberBox label="Rate" step={0.1} min={0} max={5} wheel locale="en" x-model={() => s.rate} />
      <output class="nb-rate">{() => `value: ${show(s.rate)}`}</output>
    </>
  );
}
```

## Spin buttons

Clicking a spin button changes the value by one step. Holding it repeats until the button is released or a limit is reached. The buttons can be `stacked`, `inline` or hidden.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, NumberBox, Stack, type SpinLayout } from '@motifx-community/ui';

const LAYOUTS: SpinLayout[] = ['stacked', 'inline'];

/** Spin buttons on top of each other, side by side, or none. */
export default function SpinButtons() {
  const s = reactive({ seats: 2 as number | null, layout: 'stacked' as SpinLayout, spin: true });
  return (
    <>
      <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center" role="group" aria-label="Spin buttons">
        {LAYOUTS.map((layout) => (
          <Button
            key={layout}
            text={layout}
            size="sm"
            variant={() => (s.spin && s.layout === layout ? 'solid' : 'ghost')}
            aria-pressed={() => s.spin && s.layout === layout}
            onclick={() => {
              s.layout = layout;
              s.spin = true;
            }}
          />
        ))}
        <Button text="none" size="sm" variant={() => (s.spin ? 'ghost' : 'solid')} aria-pressed={() => !s.spin} onclick={() => (s.spin = false)} />
      </Stack>
      <NumberBox label="Seats" min={1} max={9} locale="en" spinLayout={() => s.layout} showSpinButtons={() => s.spin} x-model={() => s.seats} />
    </>
  );
}
```

## Format and locale

Without focus, the value is displayed through `Intl.NumberFormat` using `format` and `locale` (the page `lang` by default). With focus, it switches to a plain number for editing. Input is parsed in the same locale: `1.234,5` in Turkish and `1,234.5` in English. A `.` also works as the decimal point where it cannot be a group separator. A percent is edited as displayed, so 0.125 is entered as 12.5.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { NumberBox, Stack } from '@motifx-community/ui';

const show = (value: number | null) => (value === null ? 'null' : String(value));

/** A Turkish lira price, a percent edited as shown, and US dollars. */
export default function Format() {
  const s = reactive({ price: 1234.5 as number | null, share: 0.125 as number | null, dollars: 99.99 as number | null });
  return (
    <>
      <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center">
        <NumberBox label="Price" locale="tr-TR" min={0} format={{ style: 'currency', currency: 'TRY' }} x-model={() => s.price} />
        <output class="nb-price">{() => `value: ${show(s.price)}`}</output>
      </Stack>
      <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center">
        <NumberBox label="Share" locale="en" min={0} max={1} step={0.01} format={{ style: 'percent', maximumFractionDigits: 1 }} x-model={() => s.share} />
        <output class="nb-share">{() => `value: ${show(s.share)}`}</output>
      </Stack>
      <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center">
        <NumberBox label="Amount" locale="en-US" format={{ style: 'currency', currency: 'USD' }} x-model={() => s.dollars} />
        <output>{() => `value: ${show(s.dollars)}`}</output>
      </Stack>
    </>
  );
}
```

## Min, max and clamping

A value outside `min` and `max` is brought into range when the field loses focus. With `clamp={false}`, it stays as typed and the range validation reports it.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { NumberBox } from '@motifx-community/ui';

/** A value brought inside its bounds, and one left as typed for the range check to report. */
export default function MinMaxClamp() {
  const s = reactive({ score: 50 as number | null, age: null as number | null });
  return (
    <>
      <NumberBox label="Score" min={0} max={100} locale="en" x-model={() => s.score} helpText="Try 250." />
      <NumberBox label="Age" min={18} max={120} clamp={false} locale="en" x-model={() => s.age} helpText="Try 12." />
    </>
  );
}
```

## Decimals and empty values

`decimals` rounds every value, whether set in code or entered by the user, and displays exactly that many digits while the field is not being edited (`72.50`). `format` can override how they are displayed. An empty field is `null`. With `allowEmpty={false}`, it receives `min` (or 0) when it loses focus.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { NumberBox, Stack } from '@motifx-community/ui';

const show = (value: number | null) => (value === null ? 'null' : String(value));

/** Rounding to one decimal, and a field that cannot stay empty. */
export default function DecimalsAndEmpty() {
  const s = reactive({ weight: 72.456 as number | null });
  return (
    <>
      <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center">
        <NumberBox label="Weight" decimals={1} step={0.1} suffix="kg" locale="en" x-model={() => s.weight} />
        <output class="nb-weight">{() => `value: ${show(s.weight)}`}</output>
      </Stack>
      <NumberBox label="Guests" min={1} allowEmpty={false} locale="en" value={2} />
    </>
  );
}
```

## Keyboard

| Key | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `Up / Down arrow` | Adds or subtracts `step`. |
| `PageUp / PageDown` | Adds or subtracts `largeStep`. |
| `Home / End` | Goes to `min` or `max` when set. Otherwise, moves the caret. |
| `Enter` | Commits the typed text, rounded and within range, and raises `onEnter`. |
| `Mouse wheel` | With `wheel`, changes the value by one step while the field has focus. |
| `Alt + key (`&Name`)` | Moves focus to the field (Control + Option + key on Apple platforms). |

## Accessibility

| Topic | Details |
| --- | --- |
| `Role` | `spinbutton` on a text `<input inputmode="decimal">`, so phones show a numeric keyboard and any locale can be typed. |
| `Value` | `aria-valuenow`, `aria-valuemin`, `aria-valuemax`, and `aria-valuetext` with the formatted value (`₺1.234,50`). |
| `Spin buttons` | Named “Increase” and “Decrease” from `uiLocale`. They are not Tab stops, because the arrow keys do the same thing. |
| `Errors` | `aria-invalid="true"`. The message is a polite live region. |

## Localization

The spin button names and range messages come from `uiLocale.strings`. Numbers follow `locale`.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, uiLocale } from '@motifx-community/ui';
import { kitTexts } from '../../../shared/kit-texts';

/** Switches the names of the spin buttons and the range messages. */
export default function Localization() {
  const s = reactive({ lang: 'en' });

  const toggle = () => {
    s.lang = s.lang === 'en' ? 'tr' : 'en';
    void uiLocale.use(s.lang);
  };

  return (
    <>
      <Button text={() => (s.lang === 'en' ? 'Language: English' : 'Dil: Türkçe')} variant="outline" onclick={toggle} />
      <span>
        The up button reads <output class="nb-increase">{() => kitTexts.strings.increase}</output>
      </span>
    </>
  );
}
```

## Styling

| Hook | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `.mx-field.mx-number-box` | The field. `data-spin` while spin buttons are shown, plus the field attributes. |
| `.mx-number-box__spin` | The spin buttons; `data-layout="stacked" \| "inline"`. |
| `.mx-number-box__step` | One spin button; `data-step="up" \| "down"`. |

### Component tokens

| Token | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `number-box.spin, number-box.step, number-box.glyph` | Units: the spin button group (`stacked`, `inline`, `disabled`), each step (`up`, `down`, `next`, `hover`, `pressed`, `disabled`) and its glyph. |
| `number-box.spin-layout, number-box.spin-order` | Where the steps are placed (stacked at the end, or one on each side) and their order. |
| `number-box.spin-inset` | The space around stacked spin buttons. |
| `field.*` | Everything else works as in TextBox. |

## API reference

### Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `Bind<number \| null>` | `null` | The number, or `null` when empty. `x-model` provides two-way binding. |
| `min / max` | `Bind<number \| null>` | `null` | The limits. Steps stop there, Home and End go there, entered values are kept inside (see `clamp`), and the range is validated. |
| `step` | `Bind<number>` | `1` | The amount added by the arrow keys, the spin buttons and the wheel. |
| `largeStep` | `Bind<number>` | 10 × `step` | The amount added by PageUp and PageDown. |
| `showSpinButtons` | `Bind<boolean>` | `true` | Shows up and down buttons in the box. |
| `spinLayout` | `Bind<SpinLayout>` | `'stacked'` | `stacked` shows arrows on top of each other, and `inline` shows − and + side by side. |
| `wheel` | `Bind<boolean>` | `false` | The mouse wheel changes the value while the field has focus. |
| `format` | `Bind<Intl.NumberFormatOptions>` | `{}` | The display format without focus: `{ style: 'currency', currency: 'TRY' }`, `{ style: 'percent' }`, `{ minimumFractionDigits: 2 }`… |
| `locale` | `Bind<string>` | The page `lang` | The locale of the format and of the input. |
| `decimals` | `Bind<number \| null>` | `null` | The number of digits after the decimal point. Every value is rounded to this precision (half away from zero) regardless of its source, and displayed with exactly that many digits while the field is not being edited. |
| `clamp` | `Bind<boolean>` | `true` | Brings a value outside `min` and `max` into range when entered. `false` leaves it to the range validation. |
| `allowEmpty` | `Bind<boolean>` | `true` | An empty field is `null`. `false` replaces it with `min` (or 0) when the field loses focus. |
| `updateOn` | `Bind<'input' \| 'change'>` | `'input'` | With `input`, the value updates as soon as the text is a complete number in range. With `change`, it updates when the field loses focus or the user presses Enter. |
| `placeholder` | `Bind<string>` | `''` | Displayed when the field is empty. |
| `selectOnFocus` | `Bind<boolean>` | `false` | Selects all text when the field receives focus. |
| `align` | `Bind<'start' \| 'center' \| 'end'>` | `'start'` | Text alignment. |
| `label, labelMode, helpText, hint, prefix, suffix, icon, buttons` | see TextBox |  | Parts common to all fields. |
| `readOnly, required, size, variant, stretch` | see TextBox |  | States and appearance common to all fields. |
| `rules, error, validateOn, validationGroup` | see TextBox |  | Validation works the same way as for all fields. |
| `name, autocomplete` | `Bind<string>` | —, `'off'` | Passed to the `<input>`. |
| `enabled / disabled, visible, tabStop, tabIndex` | see Control |  | Properties shared by all controls. |

### Properties

| Property | Access | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `every prop above` | read/write, reactive | Accepts a value or a function, the same as the prop. `locale` returns the locale in use. |
| `formattedValue` | read-only, reactive | The value as displayed without focus, or `''` when empty. |
| `isValid, validationMessage, validating` | read-only, reactive | The validation result. |
| `inputElement` | read-only | The native `<input>`. |

### Methods

| Method | Returns | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `stepUp(times = 1)` | `void` | Adds `step` × `times`, kept within `min` and `max`. |
| `stepDown(times = 1)` | `void` | Subtracts `step` × `times`. |
| `validate()` | `Promise<boolean>` | Validates the value and displays the result. |
| `resetValidation()` | `void` | Clears the results of previous validation. |
| `focus()` | `boolean` | Sets focus on the input. |
| `select()` | `void` | Selects all text. |

### Events

| Event | When |
| --- | --- |
| `onValueChanged(e)` | Occurs when the value changes. `e`: `{ value, previousValue, byUser, source, event? }`. A held spin button reports every step. |
| `onValidated(e)` | Occurs when validation finishes. `e`: `{ valid, message, source }`. |
| `onEnter(e)` | Occurs when the user presses Enter. `e`: `{ value, source, event }`. |

# DateBox

> Editors · @motifx-community/ui 0.1.0-beta.5

An input for a date, a time or both. Users can type through a mask in the locale's order, or pick from a calendar and a list of times. `min`, `max` and `disabledDates` apply to both methods.

## Import

```tsx
import { DateBox } from '@motifx-community/ui';
```

## Declarative and programmatic

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, DateBox, Stack } from '@motifx-community/ui';

const today = new Date();

/** A date box bound with x-model, and date boxes created with `new`, given a value and added programmatically. */
export default function Programmatic() {
  const order = reactive({ delivery: new Date(today.getFullYear(), today.getMonth(), today.getDate() + 3) as Date | null, result: '' });
  let added = 0;
  let host: Stack | null = null;

  const addProgrammatic = () => {
    const due = new DateBox({ label: `Due ${++added}`, locale: 'tr-TR', clearButton: true });
    due.value = new Date(2026, 9, 25);
    due.onValueChanged((e) => (order.result = `${due.label}: ${e.value ? e.value.toDateString() : '—'}`));
    host?.controls.add(due);
    due.focus();
  };

  return (
    <>
      <DateBox label="&Delivery" x-model={() => order.delivery} clearButton />
      <output class="db-day">{() => (order.delivery ? order.delivery.toDateString() : '—')}</output>
      <Button text="Add a date box programmatically" variant="outline" onclick={addProgrammatic} />
      <output class="db-made">{() => order.result}</output>
      <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center" ref={(c: Stack) => (host = c)} />
    </>
  );
}
```

## Locales

The mask follows the locale, including the order of day, month and year and the separators. Month and day names in the calendar and the first day of the week also come from the locale.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { DateBox } from '@motifx-community/ui';

/** One date in three locales: each types and shows it in its own order and separators. */
export default function Locales() {
  const s = reactive({ trip: null as Date | null });
  return (
    <>
      <DateBox label="Türkçe" locale="tr-TR" x-model={() => s.trip} />
      <DateBox label="English (US)" locale="en-US" x-model={() => s.trip} />
      <DateBox label="日本語" locale="ja-JP" x-model={() => s.trip} />
    </>
  );
}
```

## Time and date with time

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { DateBox } from '@motifx-community/ui';

/** A date with a time in steps of 15 minutes, and a time alone. */
export default function TimeAndDate() {
  const s = reactive({ meeting: null as Date | null, alarm: null as Date | null });
  return (
    <>
      <DateBox label="Meeting" type="datetime" timeStep={15} displayFormat={{ dateStyle: 'medium', timeStyle: 'short' }} x-model={() => s.meeting} stretch />
      <DateBox label="Alarm" type="time" x-model={() => s.alarm} />
    </>
  );
}
```

## Limits and validation

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, DateBox, ValidationGroup } from '@motifx-community/ui';

const today = new Date();
const inDays = (n: number) => new Date(today.getFullYear(), today.getMonth(), today.getDate() + n);

/** A required weekday in the next 60 days: `min`, `max` and `disabledDates` limit typing and picking, a group checks it. */
export default function Limits() {
  const s = reactive({ result: '' });
  const group = new ValidationGroup();

  const check = async () => {
    const result = await group.validate();
    s.result = result.valid ? 'Booked.' : 'Pick a weekday in the next 60 days.';
  };

  return (
    <>
      <DateBox
        label="Appointment"
        required
        min={today}
        max={inDays(60)}
        disabledDates={(d: Date) => d.getDay() === 0 || d.getDay() === 6}
        helpText="A weekday in the next 60 days."
        validationGroup={group}
        showTodayButton
      />
      <Button text="Check" variant="outline" onclick={check} />
      <output class="db-check">{() => s.result}</output>
    </>
  );
}
```

## Keyboard

| Key | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `Digits` | Fills in the mask and skips separators. The value changes once the date is complete and valid. |
| `Alt + Down, the button` | Opens the calendar or the list of times, with focus on the selected day. |
| `In the calendar` | Arrow keys, Home, End, Page Up and Page Down (with Shift, a year), and Enter to select. See Calendar. |
| `In the times` | Up, Down, Home, End, Page Up, Page Down and Enter. |
| `Escape` | Closes the picker. With `clearButton` and the picker closed, clears the value. |

## Accessibility

| Topic | Details |
| --- | --- |
| `Field` | A native `<input>` with its label. The format is the mask the user types into. |
| `Button` | `aria-haspopup="dialog"` and `aria-expanded`, named from `uiLocale` ("Choose date" or "Choose time"). |
| `Picker` | A `role="dialog"` containing the calendar grid (see Calendar) and a list of times (`role="listbox"`). |
| `Errors` | A date that does not exist, falls outside `min` and `max`, or is disabled fails validation with a message from `uiLocale`. |

## Localization

Button names and messages come from `uiLocale.strings`. Dates and names come from `locale`.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, uiLocale } from '@motifx-community/ui';

/** Switches the button names and messages of every date box on the page. */
export default function Localization() {
  const s = reactive({ lang: 'en' });
  const toggle = () => {
    s.lang = s.lang === 'en' ? 'tr' : 'en';
    void uiLocale.use(s.lang);
  };
  return <Button text={() => (s.lang === 'en' ? 'Language: English' : 'Dil: Türkçe')} variant="outline" onclick={toggle} />;
}
```

## Styling

| Hook | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `.mx-date-box` | Added to the field; `data-type="date\|time\|datetime"`. |
| `.mx-date-box__toggle, .mx-date-box__clear` | The picker and clear buttons. |
| `.mx-date-box__popup, .mx-date-box__times` | The picker and its list of times. |
| `date-box.times, date-box.popup-gap, date-box.calendar` | The list of times (a unit: `focus`, `beside`), the space between the field and its popup, and the calendar as it appears in the popup (a place). Everything else comes from `field.*` and `calendar.*`. |

## API reference

### Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `Bind<Date \| null>` | `null` | The date. `x-model` provides two-way binding. |
| `type` | `Bind<'date' \| 'time' \| 'datetime'>` | `'date'` | A date, a time of day, or both. |
| `locale` | `Bind<string>` | From the page | Sets the order of the parts (`25.10.2026`, `10/25/2026`), the month and day names, and the first day of the week. |
| `min / max` | `Bind<Date \| null>` | — | Limits for typing and picking, enforced by validation. |
| `disabledDates` | `Bind<(date) => boolean>` | — | Days that cannot be selected, such as weekends. |
| `displayFormat` | `Bind<Intl.DateTimeFormatOptions \| null>` | — | How the value is displayed while the field is not being edited: `{ dateStyle: 'long' }`. |
| `placeholder` | `Bind<string>` | `''` | Displayed when the field is empty and has no focus. |
| `clearButton` | `Bind<boolean>` | `false` | Clears the value. Escape does the same. |
| `showPickerButton` | `Bind<boolean>` | `true` | The button that opens the calendar or the list of times. |
| `timeStep` | `Bind<number>` | `30` | The interval between the times offered, in minutes. |
| `showSeconds` | `Bind<boolean>` | `false` | Includes seconds in the time. |
| `firstDayOfWeek, showWeekNumbers, showTodayButton` | See Calendar |  | Passed to the calendar. |
| `label, helpText, required, rules, readOnly, size, variant, …` | see TextBox |  | Field props shared by all editors. |

### Properties, methods, events

| Member | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `unfinished` | Indicates that the typed text is not yet a complete, valid date. |
| `opened, open(), close()` | The picker. |
| `clear()` | Clears the value. |
| `inputElement` | The native `<input>`. |
| `onValueChanged, onOpened, onClosed, onValidated` | These work the same way as in DropDown and TextBox. |

The date helpers are shared: `datePatternOf(locale, kind)`, `dateToDigits`, `digitsToDate`.

# DateRangeBox

> Editors · @motifx-community/ui 0.1.0-beta.5

A single field for a start date and an end date. Users can type through two masks, or pick from two side-by-side months and a list of presets, within the allowed dates and range length. The value is a `[start, end]` pair.

## Import

```tsx
import { DateRangeBox, type DateRange } from '@motifx-community/ui';
```

## Declarative and programmatic

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, DateRangeBox, Stack, type DateRange } from '@motifx-community/ui';

const say = (d: Date | null) => (d ? d.toLocaleDateString('en-GB') : '—');

/** A range bound with x-model, and one created programmatically and read through its properties. */
export default function Programmatic() {
    const s = reactive({ stay: [new Date(2026, 2, 10), new Date(2026, 2, 14)] as DateRange, told: '' });
    const coded = new DateRangeBox({ label: 'Report period', clearButton: true, onValueChanged: e => (s.told = `${say(e.value[0])} to ${say(e.value[1])}`) });

    return (
        <Stack gap="md">
            <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center">
                <DateRangeBox label="Stay" x-model={() => s.stay} clearButton />
                <output class="dr-stay">{() => `${say(s.stay[0])} to ${say(s.stay[1])}`}</output>
            </Stack>
            <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center">
                <span onConfig={c => c.controls.add(coded)} />
                <Button text="This week" variant="outline" onclick={() => (coded.value = [new Date(2026, 2, 16), new Date(2026, 2, 22)])} />
                <output class="dr-told">{() => s.told}</output>
            </Stack>
        </Stack>
    );
}
```

## Presets

`presets` adds ready-made ranges next to the calendars. Use `true` for the built-in presets, or provide your own, each calculated when selected. `calendars={1}` shows a single month.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { DateRangeBox, Stack, type DateRange, type DateRangePreset } from '@motifx-community/ui';

const day = (offset: number) => {
    const d = new Date();
    d.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
    d.setDate(d.getDate() + offset);
    return d;
};

// Custom ranges, calculated when selected so that they are relative to today.
const QUARTERS: DateRangePreset[] = [
    { text: 'Next 3 days', range: () => [day(0), day(2)] },
    { text: 'Next week', range: () => [day(1), day(7)] },
    { text: 'Next 90 days', range: () => [day(0), day(89)] }
];

/** The kit's presets beside the calendars, and custom presets. */
export default function Presets() {
    const s = reactive({ sales: [null, null] as DateRange, plan: [null, null] as DateRange });
    return (
        <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center">
            <DateRangeBox label="Sales period" presets x-model={() => s.sales} />
            <DateRangeBox label="Planning" presets={QUARTERS} calendars={1} x-model={() => s.plan} />
        </Stack>
    );
}
```

## Limits

`min`, `max` and `disabledDates` limit both ends, whether typed or picked. `minDays` and `maxDays` limit the length of the range, and while the end date is being picked, the calendars only offer days within that limit. When a rule fails, the message says which one.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, DateRangeBox, Stack, type DateRange } from '@motifx-community/ui';

const today = new Date();
const inMonths = (n: number) => new Date(today.getFullYear(), today.getMonth() + n, today.getDate());

/** A stay of one to fourteen nights, within the next six months, never starting on a Sunday. The message identifies the rule that failed. */
export default function Limits() {
    const s = reactive({ stay: [null, null] as DateRange, told: '' });
    let box!: DateRangeBox;
    return (
        <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center">
            <DateRangeBox
                ref={(b: DateRangeBox) => (box = b)}
                label="Stay"
                min={today}
                max={inMonths(6)}
                minDays={1}
                maxDays={14}
                disabledDates={d => d.getDay() === 0}
                required
                x-model={() => s.stay}
            />
            <Button text="Check" variant="outline" onclick={() => void box.validate().then(ok => (s.told = ok ? 'Fine.' : box.validationMessage))} />
            <output class="dr-check">{() => s.told}</output>
        </Stack>
    );
}
```

## Time and other locales

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { DateRangeBox, Stack, type DateRange } from '@motifx-community/ui';

/** Date and time on both ends: the time is typed after the date, the calendars keep it; one box in Turkish. */
export default function DateTime() {
    const s = reactive({ shift: [new Date(2026, 2, 10, 8, 30), new Date(2026, 2, 10, 17, 0)] as DateRange, trip: [null, null] as DateRange });
    return (
        <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center">
            <DateRangeBox label="Shift" type="datetime" x-model={() => s.shift} displayFormat={{ dateStyle: 'short', timeStyle: 'short' }} />
            <DateRangeBox label="Seyahat" locale="tr-TR" showWeekNumbers x-model={() => s.trip} startPlaceholder="gidiş" endPlaceholder="dönüş" />
        </Stack>
    );
}
```

## Behavior

| Topic | Details |
| --- | --- |
| `Typing` | Each side is a masked input in the locale's order (`22.11.2006`). A complete, valid date is accepted as soon as it is finished, and a cleared side becomes `null`. Tab moves from the start date to the end date. |
| `Picking` | In the popup, the first pick sets the start and the second sets the end. If the second pick is earlier, it becomes the start. With both dates selected, the next pick starts a new range. While the end is being picked, hovering shows the resulting range. |
| `Two months` | The calendars show the month of the start date and the next month, and they page together. |
| `Presets` | A list next to the calendars. Selecting a preset applies the range and closes the popup. |
| `Keyboard` | Alt+Down opens the popup. Inside it, the calendars handle the arrow keys and Enter selects. Escape closes the popup, and clears the field if `clearButton` is on and the popup is already closed. |

## Accessibility

| Topic | Details |
| --- | --- |
| `Inputs` | Two text inputs named “<label>, Start date” and “<label>, End date” in the kit language. The field label is associated with the start input. |
| `Popup` | A dialog named “Choose date”. The calendars are kit grids, and the presets are a list box. |
| `Messages` | Rule messages use the kit language. Custom rules use your own text. |

## Styling

| Hook | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `.mx-date-range-box` | The field. `data-type`. |
| `.mx-date-range-box__start, .mx-date-range-box__end, .mx-date-range-box__separator` | The inputs and the glyph between them. |
| `.mx-date-range-box__toggle, .mx-date-range-box__clear` | Buttons inside the box. |
| `.mx-date-range-box__popup, .mx-date-range-box__calendar, .mx-date-range-box__presets` | The popup, each calendar and the presets. |

### Component tokens

| Token | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `date-range-box.separator, .presets` | Units: the glyph between the inputs (`icon`, `bg`) and the preset list (`focus`, `beside`). |
| `date-range-box.calendar` | Place: a calendar in the popup. |
| `date-range-box.popup-gap` | The gap between the calendars and the presets. |
| `calendar.cell range-start, range-end, range-single, range-in` | The calendar cells in a range: its ends and the days between them, drawn by each design language. |

## API reference

### Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `Bind<DateRange>` | `[null, null]` | The `[start, end]` pair, where either value can be `null` until selected. `x-model` provides two-way binding. |
| `type` | `Bind<'date' \| 'datetime'>` | `'date'` | With `datetime`, the time is typed after the date and the calendars preserve it. |
| `min, max, disabledDates` | `Bind<Date \| null>`, `Bind<(d: Date) => boolean>` | — | The dates allowed at both ends, typed or picked. |
| `minDays, maxDays` | `Bind<number \| null>` | `null` | The minimum and maximum length of a range in days, counted from the start. While the end is being picked, the calendars only offer days within this limit. |
| `presets` | `Bind<readonly DateRangePreset[] \| boolean>` | `false` | `true` shows the built-in ranges next to the calendars (today, yesterday, the last 7 and 30 days, this month and last month). Custom presets use `{ text, range: () => DateRange }`. |
| `calendars` | `Bind<1 \| 2>` | `2` | The number of months side by side in the popup. Two months stay one month apart when paging. |
| `closeOnComplete` | `Bind<boolean>` | `true` | Closes the popup once both ends are selected. |
| `locale, displayFormat, firstDayOfWeek, showWeekNumbers, showSeconds` |  |  | These work the same way as in `DateBox`. |
| `startPlaceholder, endPlaceholder` | `Bind<string>` | `''` | Displayed in an empty box. |
| `clearButton, showPickerButton` | `Bind<boolean>` | `false`, `true` | The clear button and the button that opens the calendars. |
| `label, helpText, required, rules, readOnly, size, variant…` |  |  | Field props shared by all editors. |

### Events, properties and methods

| Member | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `startDate, endDate` | `Date \| null` | The start and end as separate properties. |
| `inputElement, endInputElement` | read-only | The start and end inputs. |
| `open(), close(), opened` | `boolean` / `void` | The popup with the calendars, along with `onOpened` and `onClosed`. |
| `clear()` | `void` | Clears both ends. |
| `validate(), validationMessage, isValid` |  | Works the same way as on all fields. Validation covers incomplete dates, dates outside `min`, `max` or `disabledDates`, a start after the end, and ranges shorter than `minDays` or longer than `maxDays`. |
| `onValueChanged` | event | Occurs when the pair changes (`value`, `previousValue`, `byUser`). |

# Signature

> Editors · @motifx-community/ui 0.1.0-beta.5

A pad to sign on with a pen, a finger or a mouse. The value is the strokes themselves, so a signature can be stored as data, drawn again at any size and exported as an image.

## Import

```tsx
import { Signature } from '@motifx-community/ui';
```

## Signing

`x-model` binds the strokes. A pen that reports pressure sets the width of the line, and otherwise it follows the speed. The buttons in the corner remove the last stroke and the whole signature.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Signature, Stack, type SignatureStroke } from '@motifx-community/ui';

/** A pad bound to a value. The value is the strokes themselves, so it can be stored and drawn again. */
export default function Basic() {
    const s = reactive({ strokes: [] as readonly SignatureStroke[] });
    return (
        <Stack gap="md" style="inline-size: 100%">
            <Signature class="sig-basic" label="Your signature" helpText="Sign with a pen, a finger or the mouse." x-model={() => s.strokes} />
            <output class="sig-told">{() => `Strokes: ${s.strokes.length}`}</output>
        </Stack>
    );
}
```

## Creating an image

`toDataURL()`, `toBlob()` and `toSVG()` give an image. It is drawn in black so that it does not depend on the theme, and the background is transparent unless you set one.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, Signature, Stack } from '@motifx-community/ui';

/** An image of the signature. It is drawn in black on a transparent background unless told otherwise. */
export default function Export() {
    const s = reactive({ image: '' });
    let pad!: Signature;
    return (
        <Stack gap="md" style="inline-size: 100%">
            <Signature ref={(x: Signature) => (pad = x)} class="sig-export" label="Sign to create an image" />
            <Button text="Create the image" variant="outline" onclick={() => (s.image = pad.toDataURL('image/png', { background: '#ffffff', width: 420 }))} />
            {s.image && <img class="sig-image" alt="The signature as an image" src={() => s.image} style="max-inline-size: 100%; border: 1px solid var(--mx-color-stroke-divider)" />}
        </Stack>
    );
}
```

## The pen and the pad

`penColor`, `minWidth` and `maxWidth` set the pen, and `height` the pad. `showGuide`, `showClear`, `showUndo` and `placeholder` turn its parts on and off.

```tsx
import { Signature, Stack } from '@motifx-community/ui';

/** The pen, the size of the pad and which parts it shows. */
export default function Options() {
    return (
        <Stack gap="lg" style="inline-size: 100%">
            <Signature class="sig-pen" label="A thick blue pen" penColor="#1d4ed8" minWidth={2} maxWidth={6} height={120} />
            <Signature class="sig-plain" label="Only the pad" showGuide={false} showClear={false} showUndo={false} placeholder="" height={120} />
        </Stack>
    );
}
```

## Saved signatures and states

Giving the stored strokes as `value` draws the signature again. `required`, `readOnly` and `enabled` work as in every field.

```tsx
import { Button, Signature, Stack, type SignatureStroke } from '@motifx-community/ui';

const SAVED: readonly SignatureStroke[] = [
    {
        points: Array.from({ length: 40 }, (_, i) => ({
            x: 0.12 + (i / 39) * 0.76,
            y: 0.5 + Math.sin(i / 3) * 0.2 * (1 - i / 60),
            pressure: 0.3 + (i % 8) / 12
        }))
    }
];

/** A saved signature drawn again, a required field, and a pad that cannot be changed. */
export default function States() {
    let pad!: Signature;
    return (
        <Stack gap="lg" style="inline-size: 100%">
            <Signature class="sig-saved" label="Saved signature" value={SAVED} height={120} readOnly />
            <Signature ref={(x: Signature) => (pad = x)} class="sig-required" label="Required" required height={120} />
            <Button text="Validate" variant="outline" onclick={() => void pad.validate()} />
            <Signature class="sig-disabled" label="Disabled" enabled={false} height={100} />
        </Stack>
    );
}
```

## Programmatic use

`new Signature(props)` creates the pad without JSX. Each prop is also a property.

```tsx
import { Component } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, Signature, Stack } from '@motifx-community/ui';

/** A pad created programmatically. `undo()` and `clear()` do what its buttons do. */
export default class Programmatic extends Component<HTMLDivElement> {
    constructor() {
        super('div');
        const pad = new Signature({ label: 'Programmatic signature', height: 120, showUndo: false, showClear: false });
        const clear = new Button({ text: 'Clear', variant: 'outline', onclick: () => pad.clear() });
        const stack = new Stack({ gap: 'md' });
        stack.controls.add(pad, clear);
        this.controls.add(stack);
    }
}
```

## API reference

### Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `height` | `Bind<number \| null>` | From the design language | The height of the pad in pixels. |
| `penColor` | `Bind<string \| null>` | From the design language | The color of the lines. |
| `minWidth, maxWidth` | `Bind<number>` | `1`, `3` | The width of a line at its thinnest and thickest, in pixels. |
| `placeholder` | `Bind<string>` | The kit string “Sign here” | The text of the empty pad. `''` removes it. |
| `showGuide` | `Bind<boolean>` | `true` | Draws the line to sign on. |
| `showClear, showUndo` | `Bind<boolean>` | `true` | Show the buttons that remove the signature and the last stroke. |
| `label, helpText, readOnly, required, rules, error, validateOn` |  |  | Same as `TextBox`. |

### Properties and methods

| Member | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `readonly SignatureStroke[]` | The strokes. `x-model` provides two-way binding. |
| `isEmpty` | `boolean` | Indicates that nothing has been signed. |
| `clear()` | `void` | Removes the signature. |
| `undo()` | `void` | Removes the last stroke. |
| `toDataURL(type?, options?)` | `string` | The signature as a data URL, a PNG by default. |
| `toBlob(type?, options?)` | `Promise<Blob \| null>` | The signature as an image file, a PNG by default. |
| `toSVG(options?)` | `string` | The signature as an SVG document. |

### Image options

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `width, height` | `number` | Twice the pad | The size of the image in pixels. The height keeps the shape of the pad. |
| `color` | `string` | `'#000000'` | The color of the lines, which does not depend on the theme. |
| `background` | `string` | Transparent | The background. |

### Types

| Member | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `SignatureStroke` | `{ points: readonly SignaturePoint[] }` | One line drawn without lifting the pen. |
| `SignaturePoint` | `{ x, y, pressure }` | `x` and `y` run from `0` to `1` across the pad, so a signature fits a pad of any size. `pressure` runs from `0` to `1`. |

### Events

| Event | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `onStrokeBegan` | `{ stroke, originalEvent, source }` | Occurs when the pen touches the pad. |
| `onStrokeEnded` | `{ stroke, originalEvent, source }` | Occurs when the pen leaves the pad, after the value has changed. |
| `onValueChanged` | `{ value, previousValue, byUser, source, event }` | Same as `TextBox`. |

### Keyboard

| Key | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `Delete` | Removes the signature. |
| `Ctrl+Z` | Removes the last stroke. |
| `Tab` | Moves focus to the pad, and then to its buttons. |

### Accessibility

| Topic | Details |
| --- | --- |
| `Pad` | The pad has the role `img`, the name of its label, and says whether it is signed. |
| `Signing` | A signature is drawn with a pointer. Where a person may not be able to draw, offer another way, such as typing the name in a `TextBox`. |
| `Touch` | The pad takes every touch, so signing does not scroll the page. |

### Styling hooks

| Hook | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `.mx-signature` | The field. `data-invalid`, `data-readonly` and `data-disabled` describe its state. |
| `.mx-signature__pad, .mx-signature__canvas, .mx-signature__guide, .mx-signature__placeholder` | The pad, the canvas, the line to sign on and the text. |
| `.mx-signature__actions` | The buttons in the corner of the pad. |

### Design tokens

| Token | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `signature.width, .height, .guide-inset, .actions-inset` | The size of the field and of the pad, and the distances of the line and the buttons. |
| `signature.pad, .guide, .placeholder` | Units: the pad, whose `color` is the color of the ink (`focus`, `invalid`, `readonly`, `disabled`), the line and the text. |
| `signature.field` | Place: the field under the pad, without a box of its own. |

# OtpInput

> Editors · @motifx-community/ui 0.1.0-beta.5

A one-time code in a row of boxes. Typing, pasting a whole code, the code a phone offers from a message and screen readers work as in any text box, because the boxes are drawn over one real input.

## Import

```tsx
import { OtpInput } from '@motifx-community/ui';
```

## Entering a code

`x-model` binds the code, and `onCompleted` occurs when the last box is filled. Paste a code into the field, or type part of it and use the arrow keys.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, OtpInput, Stack } from '@motifx-community/ui';

/** A six-digit code bound to a value. `onCompleted` occurs once, when the last box is filled. */
export default function Basic() {
    const s = reactive({ code: '', told: 'nothing yet' });
    return (
        <Stack gap="md">
            <OtpInput class="otp-basic" label="Verification code" helpText="We sent it to your phone." x-model={() => s.code} onCompleted={e => (s.told = e.value)} />
            <output class="otp-value">{() => `Value: ${s.code || 'empty'}`}</output>
            <output class="otp-told">{() => `Completed: ${s.told}`}</output>
            <Button text="Clear" variant="outline" onclick={() => (s.code = '')} />
        </Stack>
    );
}
```

## Formats

`length` sets the number of boxes, and `charset` or `pattern` the characters. `groupSize` separates the boxes, `masked` hides the characters, and `placeholder` marks empty boxes.

```tsx
import { OtpInput, Stack } from '@motifx-community/ui';

/** Other lengths and characters, groups of boxes, and a masked PIN. */
export default function Formats() {
    return (
        <Stack gap="lg">
            <OtpInput class="otp-key" label="Access key" length={8} charset="alphanumeric" uppercase groupSize={4} />
            <OtpInput class="otp-pin" label="PIN" length={4} masked />
            <OtpInput class="otp-hint" label="Code" length={4} placeholder="0" />
            <OtpInput class="otp-hex" label="Color code" length={6} pattern={/[0-9a-f]/i} uppercase size="sm" />
        </Stack>
    );
}
```

## Validation

A code that is not complete fails on its own. `rules` adds your own checks, as in every field.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, OtpInput, Stack } from '@motifx-community/ui';

/** An incomplete code fails on its own, and a rule of the application can refuse a complete one. */
export default function Validation() {
    const s = reactive({ code: '' });
    let field!: OtpInput;
    return (
        <Stack gap="md">
            <OtpInput
                ref={(x: OtpInput) => (field = x)}
                class="otp-valid"
                label="Code"
                length={4}
                required
                x-model={() => s.code}
                rules={[{ type: 'custom', check: value => value === '1234', message: 'This code is not correct.' }]}
            />
            <Button text="Verify" variant="outline" onclick={() => void field.validate()} />
        </Stack>
    );
}
```

## Sizes and states

`size` sets the size of the boxes. `readOnly` and `enabled` work as in every field.

```tsx
import { OtpInput, Stack } from '@motifx-community/ui';

/** The sizes, and a field that cannot be changed. */
export default function States() {
    return (
        <Stack gap="lg">
            <OtpInput class="otp-small" label="Small" size="sm" length={4} value="12" />
            <OtpInput class="otp-large" label="Large" size="lg" length={4} value="12" />
            <OtpInput class="otp-readonly" label="Read-only" length={4} value="1234" readOnly />
            <OtpInput class="otp-disabled" label="Disabled" length={4} value="12" enabled={false} />
        </Stack>
    );
}
```

## Programmatic use

`new OtpInput(props)` creates the field without JSX. Each prop is also a property.

```tsx
import { Component } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, OtpInput, Stack } from '@motifx-community/ui';

/** A field created programmatically. `clear()` empties it and puts the caret in the first box. */
export default class Programmatic extends Component<HTMLDivElement> {
    constructor() {
        super('div');
        const code = new OtpInput({ label: 'Programmatic code', length: 4, value: '12' });
        const clear = new Button({ text: 'Clear', variant: 'outline', onclick: () => code.clear() });
        const stack = new Stack({ gap: 'md' });
        stack.controls.add(code, clear);
        this.controls.add(stack);
    }
}
```

## API reference

### Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `length` | `Bind<number>` | `6` | The number of characters. |
| `charset` | `Bind<'digits' \| 'letters' \| 'alphanumeric'>` | `'digits'` | Which characters are accepted. Anything else is left out, also in a pasted code. |
| `pattern` | `Bind<RegExp \| null>` | `null` | Accepts the characters this matches instead of `charset`. It is tested on one character at a time. |
| `uppercase` | `Bind<boolean>` | `false` | Turns letters into capitals as they are typed. |
| `masked` | `Bind<boolean>` | `false` | Draws a mark in place of each character. |
| `maskCharacter` | `Bind<string>` | `'•'` | The mark of `masked`. |
| `placeholder` | `Bind<string>` | `''` | Shown in a box that is still empty. |
| `groupSize` | `Bind<number \| null>` | `null` | Puts a separator after every so many boxes, such as `3` for `123-456`. |
| `separator` | `Bind<string>` | `'–'` | The text of that separator. |
| `autoComplete` | `Bind<string>` | `'one-time-code'` | The `autocomplete` of the input, which lets a phone offer the code from a message. |
| `label, helpText, size, readOnly, required, rules, error, validateOn` |  |  | Same as `TextBox`. |

### Properties and methods

| Member | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `string` | The characters entered so far. `x-model` provides two-way binding. |
| `isComplete` | `boolean` | Indicates that every box is filled. |
| `clear()` | `void` | Empties the boxes and puts the caret in the first one. |
| `validate()` | `Promise<boolean>` | Same as `TextBox`. |
| `focus()` | `boolean` | Moves focus to the first empty box. |

### Events

| Event | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `onCompleted` | `{ value, source, originalEvent }` | Occurs when the user has entered every character, by typing, pasting or from the phone. It occurs once for a code. |
| `onValueChanged` | `{ value, previousValue, byUser, source, event }` | Same as `TextBox`. |

### Keyboard

| Key | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `Characters` | Fill the box with the caret, and the caret moves on. In a filled box, the character takes its place. |
| `Backspace, Delete` | Remove a character, and those after it move back. |
| `Left, Right, Home, End` | Move the caret between the boxes. |
| `Ctrl+V` | Pastes a whole code. Characters that are not accepted, such as spaces and dashes, are left out. |

### Accessibility

| Topic | Details |
| --- | --- |
| `Input` | One real `<input>` with its label, one Tab stop. Screen readers treat it as a text box, and the boxes are hidden from them. |
| `Direction` | The boxes run left to right in every page, as a code is read. |
| `Phones` | `autocomplete="one-time-code"` offers the code from a message, and `inputmode="numeric"` opens the number keypad for digits. |
| `Masked codes` | `masked` only changes what the boxes draw. Use it where the code should not be read over a shoulder. |

### Styling hooks

| Hook | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `.mx-otp-input` | The field. `data-size`, `data-invalid`, `data-readonly` and `data-disabled` describe its state. |
| `.mx-otp-input__input` | The real input, unseen over the boxes. |
| `.mx-otp-input__cells, .mx-otp-input__cell, .mx-otp-input__char, .mx-otp-input__caret, .mx-otp-input__separator` | The row, a box, a character, the caret and the separator. `data-active` and `data-filled` describe a box. |

### Design tokens

| Token | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `otp-input.cell-width, .cell-height, .font-size` | The size of a box and of a character, for `sm`, `md` and `lg`. |
| `otp-input.input-font-size` | The text of the input under the boxes. Below 16 px a phone zooms in on focus. |
| `otp-input.cells, .cell, .char, .caret, .separator` | Units: the row, a box (`hover`, `filled`, `active`, `invalid`, `invalid-active`, `readonly`, `disabled`), a character, the caret and the separator. |
| `otp-input.field` | Place: the field under the boxes, without a box of its own. |

# ColorBox and ColorPicker

> Editors · @motifx-community/ui 0.1.0-beta.5

A color field with a popup picker, or the picker on its own. The picker has a saturation and brightness area, a hue slider, an opacity slider, channel inputs and preset colors.

## Import

```tsx
import { ColorBox, ColorPicker } from '@motifx-community/ui';
```

## Color field

Type a hex value or any `rgb(…)` form, or open the picker. The value is stored as hex. Every prop accepts a value or a function.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { ColorBox, Stack } from '@motifx-community/ui';

const PALETTE = ['#3b5bdb', '#1971c2', '#0c8599', '#2b8a3e', '#f08c00', '#e8590c', '#e03131', '#c2255c', '#862e9c', '#495057'];

/** A color field bound with `x-model`: type a hex value or open the picker (Alt+Down). One is created programmatically with `new`. */
export default function Programmatic() {
  const s = reactive({ accent: '#3b5bdb' as string | null });
  const coded = new ColorBox({ label: 'Made in code', value: '#2b8a3e', clearButton: true });

  return (
    <Stack gap="lg" style="inline-size: 18rem; max-inline-size: 100%">
      <ColorBox label="&Accent" palette={PALETTE} x-model={() => s.accent} helpText={() => `Value: ${s.accent ?? 'none'}`} />
      <span onConfig={(c) => c.controls.add(coded)} />
    </Stack>
  );
}
```

## Standalone picker

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { ColorPicker, Stack } from '@motifx-community/ui';

const PALETTE = ['#ffffff', '#ced4da', '#495057', '#000000', '#e03131', '#f08c00', '#2b8a3e', '#1971c2', '#862e9c', '#3b5bdb80'];

/** The standalone picker in the page, with opacity (`alpha`) and preset colors. */
export default function Picker() {
  const s = reactive({ color: '#1971c2cc' as string | null });

  return (
    <Stack gap="lg">
      <ColorPicker alpha palette={PALETTE} x-model={() => s.color} />
      <span>{() => `Value: ${s.color}`}</span>
    </Stack>
  );
}
```

## OK and Cancel buttons

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { ColorBox, Stack } from '@motifx-community/ui';

/** Applied with buttons: the value changes on OK, and Cancel discards the change. With opacity, it keeps `#rrggbbaa`. */
export default function Buttons() {
  const s = reactive({ overlay: '#00000080' as string | null });

  return (
    <Stack gap="lg" style="inline-size: 18rem; max-inline-size: 100%">
      <ColorBox label="Overlay" alpha apply="useButtons" x-model={() => s.overlay} />
      <span>{() => `Value: ${s.overlay ?? 'none'}`}</span>
    </Stack>
  );
}
```

## Keyboard

| Key | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `Arrow keys` | In the area, arrow keys change saturation (Left, Right) and brightness (Up, Down). On a slider, they change hue or opacity. Shift moves in steps of 10. |
| `Home, End` | Moves to either end of a slider. |
| `Alt+Down` | In the color box, opens the picker. |
| `Enter` | In the color box, applies the typed hex value. |

## Accessibility

| Topic | Details |
| --- | --- |
| `Handles` | Sliders named “Saturation and brightness”, “Hue” and “Opacity”, which announce their position in the kit language. |
| `Inputs` | Kit text and number boxes, each with a label (Hex, Red, Green, Blue, Opacity). |
| `Presets` | Buttons named by their color. The selected one is pressed (`aria-pressed`). |
| `Popup` | A dialog named “Choose color”. Focus moves to the area and returns to the box when it closes. |

## Styling

| Hook | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `.mx-color-picker` | The picker. `data-alpha`. |
| `.mx-color-picker__area, __strip, __hue, __alpha, __thumb` | The area, the sliders and their handles. |
| `.mx-color-picker__preview, __inputs, __hex, __channel, __swatches, __swatch, __pick` | The rest of the picker. |
| `.mx-color-box, .mx-color-box__swatch, .mx-color-box__toggle, .mx-color-box__popup` | The color box and its parts. |

### Component tokens

| Token | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `color-picker.area, .strip, .thumb, .preview, .swatch` | Units: corners, the handle's ring and focus state, and the hover, selected and focus states of a preset. |
| `color-picker.width, .gap, .area-height, .strip-height, .thumb-size, .preview-size, .swatch-size, .swatch-gap` | The sizes and spacing of the picker. |
| `color-picker.checker-*, color-box.checker-*` | The checkerboard behind a transparent color. |
| `color-box.swatch, color-box.swatch-size, color-box.popup-gap` | The swatch in the box and the spacing in the popup. |

## API reference

### ColorBox props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `Bind<string \| null>` | `null` | The color, stored as `#rrggbb` (`#rrggbbaa` with `alpha`). Any `#…` or `rgb(…)` form is accepted. `x-model` provides two-way binding. |
| `alpha` | `Bind<boolean>` | `false` | Adds an opacity slider and input, and the value keeps its opacity. |
| `palette` | `Bind<readonly string[] \| null>` | `null` | Preset colors in the popup. |
| `apply` | `Bind<ColorBoxApply>` | `'instantly'` | With `instantly`, the value follows every change in the popup. With `useButtons`, it changes on OK, and Cancel discards the change. |
| `clearButton` | `Bind<boolean>` | `false` | Shows a button that clears the field. |
| `placeholder` | `Bind<string>` | `''` | Displayed when the field is empty. |
| `label, helpText, readOnly, required, rules, size…` | see Field |  | All standard field props. Text that is not a color is reported as invalid. |

### ColorBox properties, methods and events

| Member | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `open(), close()` | methods | Opens or closes the picker (Alt+Down also opens it). |
| `opened` | read-only | Indicates whether the picker is open. |
| `onOpened, onClosed` | events | Occurs when the picker opens or closes (with the reason). |
| `picker` | read-only | The `ColorPicker` in the popup, after it has been opened. |
| `clear()` | method | Clears the value. |

### ColorPicker props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `Bind<string \| null>` | `null` | The color, updated with every change. `x-model` provides two-way binding. |
| `alpha` | `Bind<boolean>` | `false` | Adds an opacity slider and input. |
| `palette` | `Bind<readonly string[] \| null>` | `null` | Preset colors that can be selected with one click. |
| `showInputs` | `Bind<boolean>` | `true` | Shows the hex and red, green and blue inputs. |
| `eyeDropper` | `Bind<boolean>` | `true` | Shows a button that picks a color from the screen, in browsers that support EyeDropper. |
| `onValueChanged` | `ColorChangedEventArgs` |  | Occurs when the color changes (`value`), either through user input or programmatically (`byUser`). |

### Functions

| Function | Returns | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `parseColor(text)` | `ColorRgba \| null` | Parses `#rgb`, `#rgba`, `#rrggbb`, `#rrggbbaa`, `rgb(…)` and `rgba(…)`. |
| `formatColor(rgba)` | `string` | Returns `#rrggbb`, or `#rrggbbaa` when the color is not opaque. |

# Calendar

> Editors · @motifx-community/ui 0.1.0-beta.5

A month view for selecting a date, with year and decade views for quick navigation. It serves as the DateBox picker and can also be used on its own.

## Import

```tsx
import { Calendar } from '@motifx-community/ui';
```

## Declarative and programmatic

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, Calendar, Stack } from '@motifx-community/ui';

/** A calendar bound with x-model, and calendars created with `new`, added programmatically and moved to a month. */
export default function Programmatic() {
  const form = reactive({ day: new Date() as Date | null, result: '' });
  let host: Stack | null = null;

  const addProgrammatic = () => {
    const calendar = new Calendar({ locale: 'tr-TR' });
    calendar.onValueChanged((e) => (form.result = e.value ? e.value.toDateString() : '—'));
    host?.controls.add(calendar);
    calendar.goTo(new Date(2027, 0, 1));
  };

  return (
    <>
      <Calendar x-model={() => form.day} showWeekNumbers showTodayButton />
      <output class="cal-day">{() => (form.day ? form.day.toDateString() : '—')}</output>
      <Button text="Add a calendar programmatically" variant="outline" onclick={addProgrammatic} />
      <output class="cal-made">{() => form.result}</output>
      <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center" ref={(c: Stack) => (host = c)} />
    </>
  );
}
```

## Limits

```tsx
import { Calendar } from '@motifx-community/ui';

/** No day before today and no Sunday, in Turkish. */
export default function Limits() {
  return <Calendar min={new Date()} disabledDates={(d: Date) => d.getDay() === 0} locale="tr-TR" />;
}
```

## Views

Clicking the title zooms out to the months of the year and then to twelve years, and making a selection zooms back in. `minView` makes a month or a year the final selection.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, Calendar, Stack, type CalendarView } from '@motifx-community/ui';

const views: CalendarView[] = ['month', 'year', 'decade'];

/** The view set from state, and a calendar whose choice is a month. */
export default function Views() {
  const s = reactive({ view: 'month' as CalendarView, month: null as Date | null });
  return (
    <>
      <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center" role="group" aria-label="View">
        {views.map((view) => (
          <Button key={view} text={view} size="sm" variant={() => (s.view === view ? 'solid' : 'ghost')} aria-pressed={() => s.view === view} onclick={() => (s.view = view)} />
        ))}
      </Stack>
      <Calendar currentView={() => s.view} />
      <Calendar minView="year" x-model={() => s.month} />
      <output>{() => (s.month ? s.month.toLocaleDateString(undefined, { month: 'long', year: 'numeric' }) : '—')}</output>
    </>
  );
}
```

## Keyboard

| Key | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `Left / Right` | Moves to the previous or next day, mirrored on right-to-left pages. In the other views, moves by month or year. |
| `Up / Down` | Moves to the same day one week earlier or later. In the other views, moves by four months or years. |
| `Home / End` | Moves to the first or last day of the week. In the other views, moves to the start or end of the row. |
| `Page Up / Page Down` | Moves to the previous or next month, or by a year with Shift. In the other views, moves by a year or a decade. |
| `Enter, Space` | Selects the day. In the other views, opens the month or year. |

## Accessibility

| Topic | Details |
| --- | --- |
| `Pattern` | The APG date picker grid: `role="grid"`, one Tab stop on the focused day, and arrow keys inside. |
| `Cells` | Each day has a full name ("Sunday, 25 October 2026"), with `aria-selected`, `aria-current="date"` for today and `aria-disabled`. |
| `Header` | Weekday names carry their full form in `abbr`. The title is a live region, so a new month is announced. |
| `Buttons` | The previous and next buttons get names from `uiLocale` for the current view. |

## Styling

| Hook | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `.mx-calendar` | `data-view="month\|year\|decade"`. |
| `.mx-calendar__header, __previous, __title, __next` | The header. |
| `.mx-calendar__cell` | `aria-selected`, `aria-disabled`, `data-today`, `data-outside`. |
| `calendar.container, header, title, nav, nav-icon, weekday, week, cell, ring, foot, today` | Units: every part in each state (for a cell: `block`, `hover`, `pressed`, `focus`, `outside`, `today`, `selected`, `disabled` …). |
| `calendar.day-size, calendar.view-cell-width-scale, calendar.view-cell-height-scale, calendar.previous-rotate, calendar.next-rotate` | The size of a day, which the grid is built on, the cells of the zoomed-out views, and the arrow rotation. |

## API reference

### Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `Bind<Date \| null>` | `null` | The selected date. `x-model` provides two-way binding. |
| `min / max` | `Bind<Date \| null>` | — | Days outside these limits cannot be selected, and the arrow keys stop there. |
| `disabledDates` | `Bind<(date) => boolean>` | — | Days that cannot be selected. |
| `locale` | `Bind<string>` | From the page | Sets the month and day names and the first day of the week. |
| `firstDayOfWeek` | `Bind<number \| null>` | From the locale | 0 (Sunday) through 6 (Saturday). |
| `showWeekNumbers` | `Bind<boolean>` | `false` | Shows ISO week numbers before each week. |
| `showOtherMonths` | `Bind<boolean>` | `true` | Shows days from the previous and next months. |
| `showTodayButton` | `Bind<boolean>` | `false` | Shows a Today button below the grid. |
| `currentView` | `Bind<'month' \| 'year' \| 'decade'>` | `'month'` | The current view. The title zooms out, and a selection zooms in. |
| `minView` | `Bind<CalendarView>` | `'month'` | The view a selection is made in: `year` selects a month, and `decade` selects a year. |

### Properties, methods, events

| Member | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `focusedDate` | The day with the Tab stop, whose month is on screen. |
| `goTo(date)` | Shows the month of a date. |
| `canChoose(date)` | Indicates whether a day can be selected. |
| `focus()` | Sets focus on the day with the Tab stop. |
| `onValueChanged(e)` | `{ value, previousValue, byUser, source, event? }`. |
