# Slider

> Editors · @motifx-community/ui 0.1.0-beta.5

Selects a value on a track by dragging a thumb or using the keyboard. It supports a single number or a range with two thumbs, steps, labeled tick marks, a value tooltip, a vertical orientation and number formatting, along with the label, help text and validation common to all fields.

## Import

```tsx
import { Slider, type SliderValue } from '@motifx-community/ui';
```

## Declarative and programmatic

Every prop accepts a value or a function, and `x-model` provides two-way binding for the value. When you create the component with `new`, set the same properties programmatically.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, Slider, Stack } from '@motifx-community/ui';

/** A slider bound to state with x-model, and sliders created with `new` and added programmatically. */
export default function Programmatic() {
  const s = reactive({ volume: 40, result: '' });
  let added = 0;
  let host: Stack | null = null;

  const addProgrammatic = () => {
    const slider = new Slider({ label: `Slider ${++added}`, showValue: 'drag' });
    slider.value = 50;
    slider.onValueChanged((e) => (s.result = `${slider.label}: ${String(e.value)}`));
    host?.controls.add(slider);
    slider.focus();
  };

  return (
    <>
      <Slider label="&Volume" x-model={() => s.volume} helpText={() => `Volume: ${s.volume}`} />
      <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center">
        <Button text="Add a slider programmatically" variant="outline" onclick={addProgrammatic} />
        <output class="sl-result">{() => s.result}</output>
      </Stack>
      <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center" ref={(c: Stack) => (host = c)} />
    </>
  );
}
```

## Range slider

With `range`, there are two thumbs and the value is `[start, end]`. The thumbs cannot cross, and `minDistance` keeps them apart. Clicking the track moves the nearest thumb.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Slider, type SliderValue } from '@motifx-community/ui';

const EURO: Intl.NumberFormatOptions = { style: 'currency', currency: 'EUR', maximumFractionDigits: 0 };

/** Two thumbs that cannot cross, kept apart by minDistance. */
export default function Range() {
  const s = reactive({ price: [120, 380] as SliderValue });
  return (
    <>
      <Slider label="Price" range max={500} step={10} minDistance={50} format={EURO} showValue="drag" x-model={() => s.price} />
      <output class="sl-price">{() => `value: [${(s.price as number[]).join(', ')}]`}</output>
    </>
  );
}
```

## Centered slider

With `origin`, the active part of the track runs from that value to the thumb in either direction. Use it for values such as balance, offset or correction.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Slider } from '@motifx-community/ui';

/** A value on either side of a middle: the active part runs from the origin to the thumb. */
export default function Centred() {
  const s = reactive({ balance: -30 });
  return (
    <>
      <Slider label="Balance" min={-100} max={100} origin={0} showValue="drag" x-model={() => s.balance} />
      <output class="sl-balance">{() => `balance: ${s.balance}`}</output>
    </>
  );
}
```

## Steps and tick marks

`step` sets the values a thumb stops at. `ticks` draws a mark at every step, or divides the track into that many equal parts when set to a number. `tickLabels` shows the values under the marks.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Slider } from '@motifx-community/ui';

/** Steps, a mark at every step or in equal parts, and formatted labels under them. */
export default function StepsAndMarks() {
  const s = reactive({ zoom: 100, rating: 6 });
  return (
    <>
      <Slider label="Zoom" min={25} max={200} step={25} ticks tickLabels format={{ style: 'unit', unit: 'percent' }} x-model={() => s.zoom} />
      <Slider label="Rating" max={10} ticks={5} tickLabels x-model={() => s.rating} />
      <Slider label="Opacity" max={1} step={0} value={0.5} tickLabels showValue="drag" format={{ style: 'percent' }} />
    </>
  );
}
```

## Value tooltip and format

`showValue` displays the value in a tooltip above the thumb, either while it moves (`drag`, which includes keyboard changes) or `always`. `format` formats it with `Intl.NumberFormat`, and `valueText` provides custom text for screen readers.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, Slider, Stack, type SliderShowValue } from '@motifx-community/ui';

const SHOW: SliderShowValue[] = ['never', 'drag', 'always'];

/** The value bubble shown never, while moved or always, written with a format and read out with valueText. */
export default function ValueBubble() {
  const s = reactive({ show: 'drag' as SliderShowValue, temp: 21 });
  return (
    <>
      <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center" role="group" aria-label="Show value">
        {SHOW.map((show) => (
          <Button
            key={show}
            text={show}
            size="sm"
            variant={() => (s.show === show ? 'solid' : 'ghost')}
            aria-pressed={() => s.show === show}
            onclick={() => (s.show = show)}
          />
        ))}
      </Stack>
      <Slider
        label="Temperature"
        min={16}
        max={28}
        step={0.5}
        showValue={() => s.show}
        format={{ style: 'unit', unit: 'celsius' }}
        valueText={(v) => `${v} degrees`}
        x-model={() => s.temp}
      />
    </>
  );
}
```

## Vertical orientation

`orientation="vertical"` makes the track vertical. Up is greater, and the Up arrow moves the thumb up.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Slider } from '@motifx-community/ui';

/** Three vertical sliders, as in an equalizer: up is more. */
export default function Vertical() {
  const s = reactive({ bass: 4, mid: 0, treble: -2 });
  return (
    <>
      <Slider label="Bass" orientation="vertical" min={-12} max={12} ticks={4} tickLabels showValue="drag" x-model={() => s.bass} />
      <Slider label="Mid" orientation="vertical" min={-12} max={12} ticks={4} tickLabels showValue="drag" x-model={() => s.mid} />
      <Slider label="Treble" orientation="vertical" min={-12} max={12} ticks={4} tickLabels showValue="drag" x-model={() => s.treble} />
    </>
  );
}
```

## Update timing

By default, the value updates as the thumb is dragged. With `updateOn="change"`, it updates once when the thumb is released, which is useful for work that should not run on every movement, such as a search. Keyboard changes apply immediately in both cases.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Slider } from '@motifx-community/ui';

/** A value that follows the thumb, next to one that changes only when the thumb is let go. */
export default function UpdateOn() {
  const s = reactive({ live: 50, committed: 50 });
  return (
    <>
      <Slider label="Live" showValue="drag" x-model={() => s.live} />
      <output class="sl-live">{() => `live: ${s.live}`}</output>
      <Slider label="On release" updateOn="change" showValue="drag" x-model={() => s.committed} />
      <output class="sl-committed">{() => `on release: ${s.committed}`}</output>
    </>
  );
}
```

## Sizes, read-only, disabled and validation

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, Slider, Stack } from '@motifx-community/ui';

/** The three sizes, read-only and disabled following state, and a range rule checked while it moves. */
export default function States() {
  const s = reactive({ editable: true, age: 16 });
  return (
    <>
      <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center">
        <Slider label="Small" size="sm" value={30} />
        <Slider label="Medium" value={50} />
        <Slider label="Large" size="lg" value={70} />
      </Stack>
      <Button text="Toggle" variant="outline" onclick={() => (s.editable = !s.editable)} />
      <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center">
        <Slider label="Read-only" value={30} readOnly={() => !s.editable} />
        <Slider label="Disabled" range value={[20, 60]} enabled={() => s.editable} />
      </Stack>
      <Slider label="Age" max={99} validateOn="input" rules={[{ type: 'range', min: 18, message: 'You must be 18 or older.' }]} x-model={() => s.age} />
    </>
  );
}
```

## Keyboard

| Key | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `Right / Up arrow` | Increases the value by one step. On right-to-left pages, Left increases the value on a horizontal slider. |
| `Left / Down arrow` | Decreases the value by one step. |
| `Page Up / Page Down` | Increases or decreases the value by `largeStep`. |
| `Home / End` | Moves to the minimum or maximum. With two thumbs, the other thumb sets the limit. |
| `Tab` | Each thumb is a Tab stop. |
| `Alt + key (`&Name`)` | Sets focus on the first thumb. |

## Accessibility

| Topic | Details |
| --- | --- |
| `Thumb` | `role="slider"` with `aria-valuenow`, `aria-valuemin`, `aria-valuemax` and `aria-orientation`, and `aria-valuetext` when `format` or `valueText` is set. |
| `Name` | A single thumb is named by the label. Two thumbs sit in a `role="group"` named by the label, and each thumb is named by the label and its end ("Minimum", "Maximum"). |
| `Two thumbs` | The `aria-valuemax` of the start thumb is the value of the end thumb, and vice versa, as the APG multi-thumb slider pattern specifies. |
| `States` | `aria-readonly`, `aria-invalid` and `aria-disabled` on the thumbs. The help text describes them. |
| `Pointer` | The pointer is captured during a drag, and clicking the track moves the nearest thumb. The track is as tall as a touch target. |

## Localization

The names of the two thumbs in a range come from `uiLocale.strings` (`minimum`, `maximum`). Numbers use `locale`, which defaults to the page `lang`.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, Slider, uiLocale } from '@motifx-community/ui';
import { kitTexts } from '../../../shared/kit-texts';

/** Switches the names of the thumbs; the price slider writes its numbers in the chosen language. */
export default function Localization() {
  const s = reactive({ lang: 'en' });
  const toggle = () => {
    s.lang = s.lang === 'en' ? 'tr' : 'en';
    void uiLocale.use(s.lang);
  };
  return (
    <>
      <Button text={() => (s.lang === 'en' ? 'Language: English' : 'Dil: Türkçe')} variant="outline" onclick={toggle} />
      <span>
        The start thumb is named <output class="sl-minimum">{() => kitTexts.strings.minimum}</output>
      </span>
      <Slider
        label={() => (s.lang === 'en' ? 'Price' : 'Fiyat')}
        range
        max={1000}
        step={50}
        value={[200, 800]}
        showValue="drag"
        locale={() => s.lang}
        format={{ style: 'currency', currency: 'TRY', maximumFractionDigits: 0 }}
      />
    </>
  );
}
```

## Styling

| Hook | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `.mx-slider` | The field. `data-size`, `data-orientation`, `data-range`, `data-show-value`, `data-ticks`, `data-tick-labels`, `data-dragging`, `data-readonly`, `data-disabled`, `data-invalid`, `data-split`. |
| `.mx-slider__control` | The pointer target: the track and the tick marks. |
| `.mx-slider__track, .mx-slider__rail` | The track and the rail that holds its segments (`--_from`, `--_to`; `data-from="start \| thumb \| origin"`, `data-to="thumb \| origin \| end"`, `data-start-active`, `data-end-active`). |
| `.mx-slider__fill, .mx-slider__segment` | The active segment and the inactive segments before and after it (`data-side`). |
| `.mx-slider__thumb` | A thumb's pressable area (`data-thumb="start \| end"`, `data-dragging`, `--_at`). |
| `.mx-slider__halo, .mx-slider__knob, .mx-slider__core` | The visual parts of a thumb, centered on it: a halo, the knob and the inner part of the knob. |
| `.mx-slider__bubble` | The value tooltip above a thumb. |
| `.mx-slider__ticks, .mx-slider__tick, .mx-slider__tick-label` | The tick marks (`data-mark`, `data-active`, `--_at`) and their labels. |

### Component tokens

| Token | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `slider.track, slider.active, slider.stop` | Units: the inactive segments (`before`, `after`), the active segment (`from-start`, `to-end`) and the end dots (`active`), each with a box per state (`hover`, `focus`, `pressed`, `readonly`, `disabled`). |
| `slider.halo, slider.knob, slider.core` | Units: the visual parts of a thumb, with a box per state (`hover`, `focus`, `pressed`, `readonly`, `disabled`). |
| `slider.bubble, slider.bubble-arrow, slider.tick, slider.tick-label, slider.ring` | Units: the value tooltip and its arrow, the tick marks and labels, and a ring around the whole control during keyboard use. |
| `slider.track-thickness.*, slider.active-thickness.*` | The inactive and active segments, per size. |
| `slider.thumb-width.*, slider.thumb-height.*, slider.thumb-core-size.*` | The knob along and across the track, and its inner part, per size. |
| `slider.track-gap, slider.origin-gap, slider.stop-inset` | A track split around the thumbs and the origin, and the position of its end dots. |
| `slider.hit-size` | The height of the track for the pointer, and the touch target of a thumb. |
| `slider.vertical-length` | The length of a vertical slider. |
| `slider.tick-length, slider.tick-width, slider.tick-offset, slider.tick-gap, slider.tick-line-height, slider.tick-label-width` | The position of the tick marks and their labels. |
| `slider.bubble-gap, slider.bubble-arrow-size` | The distance between the tooltip and its thumb, and the tooltip arrow. |
| `field.width` | The width of a horizontal slider, the same as all fields. |

## API reference

### Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `Bind<number \| [number, number]>` | `min` / `[min, max]` | The value, or `[start, end]` with `range`. `x-model` provides two-way binding. The value is kept on a step and within the limits. |
| `label` | `Bind<string>` | `''` | The label. Writing `&Name` makes Alt+N move focus to the thumb. This is the same property as `text`. |
| `min / max` | `Bind<number>` | `0` / `100` | The limits. When they change, the value is adjusted and written back. |
| `step` | `Bind<number>` | `1` | The values a thumb stops at, counted from `min`. Use `0` for continuous values. |
| `largeStep` | `Bind<number>` | `10 × step` | The amount Page Up and Page Down move the thumb. |
| `range` | `Bind<boolean>` | `false` | Shows two thumbs, and the value is `[start, end]`. The thumbs cannot cross. |
| `minDistance` | `Bind<number>` | `0` | The minimum distance between the two thumbs. |
| `origin` | `Bind<number \| undefined>` | `undefined` | Creates a centered slider, where the active part of the track runs from this value to the thumb in either direction. It cannot be used with `range`. |
| `orientation` | `Bind<'horizontal' \| 'vertical'>` | `'horizontal'` | Makes the slider vertical, with higher values at the top. |
| `ticks` | `Bind<boolean \| number>` | `false` | `true` adds a mark at every step (up to 1000), and a number adds that many equal parts. |
| `tickLabels` | `Bind<boolean>` | `false` | Shows values under the marks, or at the two ends if there are no marks. |
| `showValue` | `Bind<'never' \| 'drag' \| 'always'>` | `'never'` | Shows a value tooltip above the thumb: never, while it moves (with the pointer or keyboard), or always. |
| `format` | `Bind<Intl.NumberFormatOptions \| null>` | `null` | The format used by the tooltip, the tick labels and screen readers. |
| `locale` | `Bind<string>` | The page `lang` | The locale of `format`. |
| `valueText` | `(value: number) => string` | — | The text screen readers announce for a value. Because it is a function, it is stored as is and not bound. |
| `updateOn` | `Bind<'input' \| 'change'>` | `'input'` | With `change`, the value updates when the thumb is released. The thumb still moves during the drag. |
| `name` | `Bind<string>` | `''` | The name submitted with the form. A range submits two values. |
| `helpText, hint, prefix, suffix, icon` | see TextBox |  | Parts common to all fields. `prefix` and `suffix` appear at the two ends of the track. |
| `readOnly` | `Bind<boolean>` | `false` | The slider can receive focus and be read, but not moved. |
| `size` | `Bind<ControlSize>` | `'md'` | `sm`, `md` or `lg`, which set the size of the rail and the thumbs. |
| `stretch` | `Bind<boolean>` | `false` | Stretches to the full width of its container. |
| `rules, error, validateOn, validationGroup` | see TextBox |  | Validation works the same way as for all fields. |
| `enabled / disabled, visible, tabStop, tabIndex` | see Control |  | Properties shared by all controls. |

### Properties

| Property | Access | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `every prop above` | read/write, reactive | Accepts a value or a function, the same as the prop. |
| `thumbElements` | read-only | The thumb elements, `[start, end]`. The end thumb is hidden without `range`. |
| `isValid, validationMessage, validating` | read-only, reactive | These work the same way as on all fields. |

### Methods

| Method | Returns | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `formatValue(value)` | `string` | Formats a value the same way as the tooltip. |
| `focus()` | `boolean` | Sets focus on the first thumb. |
| `validate() / resetValidation()` | `Promise<boolean>` / `void` | These work the same way as on all fields. |

### Events

| Event | When |
| --- | --- |
| `onValueChanged(e)` | Occurs when the value changes. `e`: `{ value, previousValue, byUser, source, event? }`. |
| `onValidated(e)` | Occurs when validation finishes. |

# Rating

> Editors · @motifx-community/ui 0.1.0-beta.5

A row of stars for entering or displaying a score, in whole or half steps. Rating is a field, so the label, help text, rules and `x-model` work the same way as on any other field.

## Import

```tsx
import { Rating } from '@motifx-community/ui';
```

## Declarative and programmatic

Every prop accepts a value or a function, and `x-model` provides two-way binding for the score. On hover, the stars preview the score a click would set.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Rating, Stack } from '@motifx-community/ui';

/** A rating bound with `x-model`, with a label and help text like any field, and one created with `new` programmatically. */
export default function Programmatic() {
  const s = reactive({ stars: 3 as number | null });
  const coded = new Rating({ label: 'Made in code', max: 10, value: 7 });

  return (
    <Stack gap="lg">
      <Rating label="Your rating" x-model={() => s.stars} helpText={() => (s.stars ? `You gave ${s.stars}` : 'Not rated yet')} />
      <span onConfig={(c) => c.controls.add(coded)} />
    </Stack>
  );
}
```

## Half stars, sizes and tones

```tsx
import { Rating, Stack, type ControlSize, type RatingTone } from '@motifx-community/ui';

const SIZES: ControlSize[] = ['sm', 'md', 'lg'];
const TONES: RatingTone[] = ['accent', 'neutral'];

/** Halves, each size and tone, and a score only shown (`readOnly`). */
export default function Looks() {
  return (
    <Stack gap="lg">
      <Rating label="By halves" step={0.5} value={3.5} />
      {SIZES.map((size) => (
        <Rating key={size} label={`Size ${size}`} size={size} value={4} />
      ))}
      {TONES.map((tone) => (
        <Rating key={tone} label={`Tone ${tone}`} tone={tone} value={2} />
      ))}
      <Rating label="Shown only" readOnly step={0.5} value={4.5} />
      <Rating label="Disabled" disabled value={3} />
    </Stack>
  );
}
```

## Custom icons

```tsx
import { Rating } from '@motifx-community/ui';

// A custom heart as image addresses: an outline and a filled version, drawn in the star colors.
const svg = (body: string) => `data:image/svg+xml,${encodeURIComponent(`<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 16 16">${body}</svg>`)}`;
const HEART = 'M8 13.5S2 10 2 5.75A2.75 2.75 0 0 1 8 4.5a2.75 2.75 0 0 1 6 1.25C14 10 8 13.5 8 13.5z';
const EMPTY = svg(`<path d="${HEART}" fill="none" stroke="black" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linejoin="round"/>`);
const FILLED = svg(`<path d="${HEART}" fill="black"/>`);

/** Custom icons: a name from the kit's set, or an image address. */
export default function Icons() {
  return <Rating label="How much do you like it?" emptyIcon={EMPTY} filledIcon={FILLED} value={3} />;
}
```

## Keyboard

| Key | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `Arrow keys` | Increases or decreases the score by one step (by half with `step={0.5}`). |
| `Home, End` | Sets no stars (the minimum, without `allowClear`), or all stars. |
| `1 … 9` | Sets that number of stars. |
| `Delete, Backspace` | Clears the score (with `allowClear`). |

## Accessibility

| Topic | Details |
| --- | --- |
| `Role` | A `slider` from 0 to `max`, named by its label. The value is announced as “3 of 5” or “Not rated” in the kit language. |
| `Read-only` | `aria-readonly`. The stars only display the score. |

## Styling

| Hook | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `.mx-rating` | The field. `data-tone`, `data-size`, `data-readonly`, `data-disabled`. |
| `.mx-rating__stars` | The row of stars, which is the slider and receives focus. |
| `.mx-rating__item, .mx-rating__star, .mx-rating__fill` | One star, its empty shape and its filled part (`--_fill`: the filled share). |

### Component tokens

| Token | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `rating.stars, rating.item, rating.star, rating.fill` | Units: the row (focus, disabled), a star growing on hover, the empty shape, and the filled part in each tone. |
| `rating.size.*, rating.gap.*` | A star and the space between stars, per size. |
| `rating.tone` | The default tone. |
| `rating.field.*` | Place: the field below a rating, without a box. |

## API reference

### Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `Bind<number \| null>` | `null` | The score, rounded to `step`. `null` means no score. `x-model` provides two-way binding. |
| `max` | `Bind<number>` | `5` | The number of stars. |
| `step` | `Bind<1 \| 0.5>` | `1` | `0.5` allows half stars, using the first half of a star or the arrow keys. |
| `allowClear` | `Bind<boolean>` | `true` | Clicking the selected value, or pressing Delete or Backspace, clears the score. |

| `emptyIcon, filledIcon` | `Bind<string \| null>` | Set by the design language | The shape of an empty and a filled star: a name from the kit's icon set, or an image address (drawn in the star colors). |
| `label, helpText, readOnly, required, rules, size…` | see Field |  | All standard field props, because a rating is a field. |

# ValidationSummary

> Editors · @motifx-community/ui 0.1.0-beta.5

Lists the invalid fields of a `ValidationGroup` under a header, with each field's label and message on its own line. Clicking a line moves focus to the field. The summary updates whenever a field in the group is validated or reset, and it is hidden when there are no errors.

## Import

```tsx
import { ValidationSummary, ValidationGroup } from '@motifx-community/ui';
```

## Using a summary above a form

Set `group` to the group the fields join with `validationGroup`. After `group.validate()`, the invalid fields are listed. A field that becomes valid leaves the list, and `group.reset()` clears it. Clicking a line moves focus to the field (`focusOnClick`).

```tsx
import { Button, NumberBox, Stack, TextBox, ValidationGroup, ValidationSummary } from '@motifx-community/ui';

/** The invalid fields of a form, listed above it after Save. Clicking a line moves to the field. */
export default function Form() {
    const group = new ValidationGroup();
    return (
        <Stack gap="md" style="inline-size: 100%; max-inline-size: 420px">
            <ValidationSummary class="vs-form" group={group} />
            <TextBox label="Name" required validationGroup={group} />
            <TextBox label="E-mail" required rules={[{ type: 'email' }]} validationGroup={group} />
            <NumberBox label="Guests" required rules={[{ type: 'range', min: 1, max: 8 }]} validationGroup={group} />
            <Stack orientation="horizontal" gap="sm">
                <Button class="vs-save" text="Save" tone="accent" onclick={() => void group.validate({ focus: false })} />
                <Button class="vs-reset" text="Start again" variant="outline" onclick={() => group.reset()} />
            </Stack>
        </Stack>
    );
}
```

## Programmatic use

`header` sets the line above the list, and `showHeader` hides it. `onItemClick` reports which line was clicked, and `failed` and `count` report what is listed.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, Stack, TextBox, ValidationGroup, ValidationSummary } from '@motifx-community/ui';

/** A custom header or none. The lines report which field was clicked, and `failed` reports how many there are. */
export default function Programmatic() {
    const group = new ValidationGroup();
    const s = reactive({ header: true, told: '', count: 0 });
    const summary = new ValidationSummary({
        group,
        header: 'Before you send it',
        showHeader: () => s.header,
        onItemClick: e => (s.told = `pressed: ${e.text}`)
    });
    return (
        <Stack gap="md" style="inline-size: 100%; max-inline-size: 420px">
            <span class="vs-coded" onConfig={c => c.controls.add(summary)} />
            <TextBox label="Street" required validationGroup={group} />
            <TextBox label="Town" required validationGroup={group} />
            <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center">
                <Button class="vs-coded-check" text="Check" tone="accent" onclick={async () => {
                    await group.validate({ focus: false });
                    s.count = summary.count;
                }} />
                <Button text="Header on and off" variant="outline" onclick={() => (s.header = !s.header)} />
                <output class="vs-coded-told">{() => `${s.count} failed${s.told ? `, ${s.told}` : ''}`}</output>
            </Stack>
        </Stack>
    );
}
```

## Accessibility

| Topic | Details |
| --- | --- |
| `The summary` | A live region (`polite`). The lines are announced when they appear, and the summary is hidden when there are no errors. |
| `A line` | A button with the field's label and message (“E-mail: Enter a valid e-mail address”). Clicking it moves focus to the field. |
| `Glyph` | The icon before the header is decorative. |

## Styling

| Hook | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `.mx-validation-summary` | The summary. `data-empty` while there are no errors. |
| `.mx-validation-summary__header, .mx-validation-summary__icon, .mx-validation-summary__header-text` | The header, its glyph and its text. |
| `.mx-validation-summary__list, .mx-validation-summary__line, .mx-validation-summary__item` | The list, a line and the button inside it. |

### Component tokens

| Token | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `validation-summary.box, .icon, .header, .item` | Units: the box, the glyph before the header (`icon`), the header text and a line (`hover`, `focus`). |
| `validation-summary.gap, .line-gap` | The space between the header and the list, and between the lines. |

## API reference

### Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `group` | `Bind<ValidationGroup \| null>` | `null` | The group whose invalid fields are listed. |
| `header` | `Bind<string>` | The kit string “Please correct the following” | The text above the list. |
| `showHeader` | `Bind<boolean>` | `true` | Shows the header. |
| `focusOnClick` | `Bind<boolean>` | `true` | Clicking a line moves focus to its field. |

### Events, properties and methods

| Member | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `onItemClick` | event | Occurs when a line is clicked (`target`, `text`). |
| `failed` | read-only | The invalid targets currently listed, in group order. |
| `count` | read-only | The number of lines. |
| `refresh()` | `void` | Redraws the lines from the current state of the fields. |

# FileUploader

> Editors · @motifx-community/ui 0.1.0-beta.5

Lets users select files with a button or drop them on the box. Files are listed with their size and status, and can upload automatically, on a button click or programmatically, with progress, cancel, retry and remove for each file. Files that exceed the limits are listed with the reason.

## Import

```tsx
import { FileUploader } from '@motifx-community/ui';
```

## Selecting, dropping and uploading

`upload` is your own function for sending a file. Report progress, stop on the signal, and resolve to the response. Alternatively, with `uploadUrl`, the uploader sends the file itself, either in one request or in chunks (`chunkSize`).

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { FileUploader, Stack } from '@motifx-community/ui';

// Simulates a server: takes two seconds per megabyte, reports progress and stops on the signal.
const send = (file: File, report: (fraction: number) => void, signal: AbortSignal) =>
    new Promise<string>((resolve, reject) => {
        const steps = 20;
        const wait = Math.max(600, Math.min(4000, (file.size / 1_000_000) * 2000)) / steps;
        let step = 0;
        const timer = setInterval(() => {
            step++;
            report(step / steps);
            if (step === steps) {
                clearInterval(timer);
                resolve(`id-${file.name}`);
            }
        }, wait);
        signal.addEventListener('abort', () => {
            clearInterval(timer);
            reject(new Error('stopped'));
        });
    });

/** Selected or dropped files upload immediately through a custom function, and each row shows progress, cancel, retry and remove. */
export default function Basic() {
    const s = reactive({ files: [] as readonly File[], told: '' });
    return (
        <Stack gap="md" style="inline-size: 100%">
            <FileUploader
                label="Attachments"
                helpText="Any files; a stand-in server takes them."
                upload={send}
                x-model={() => s.files}
                onUploaded={e => (s.told = `${e.file.name} is up as ${String(e.item.response)}.`)}
                onUploadAborted={e => (s.told = `${e.file.name} was stopped.`)}
            />
            <output class="fu-told">{() => s.told || `${s.files.length} file(s) taken`}</output>
        </Stack>
    );
}
```

## Limits

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { FileUploader, Stack } from '@motifx-community/ui';

/** Only pictures and PDFs, up to 2 MB each and three in all; a file outside is listed with the reason. */
export default function Limits() {
    const s = reactive({ files: [] as readonly File[], refused: '' });
    return (
        <Stack gap="md" style="inline-size: 100%">
            <FileUploader
                label="Documents"
                accept=".pdf,image/*"
                maxFileSize={2_000_000}
                maxFiles={3}
                required
                x-model={() => s.files}
                onFilesAdded={e => (s.refused = e.refused.length ? e.refused.map(r => r.message).join(' ') : '')}
            />
            <output class="fu-refused">{() => s.refused}</output>
        </Stack>
    );
}
```

## Upload modes

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, FileUploader, Stack } from '@motifx-community/ui';

const quick = (file: File, report: (fraction: number) => void) =>
    new Promise<void>(resolve => {
        let step = 0;
        const timer = setInterval(() => {
            report(++step / 10);
            if (step === 10) {
                clearInterval(timer);
                resolve();
            }
        }, 120);
    });

/** An Upload button sends the selected files, or nothing is sent until code requests it. One file only, with no dropping. */
export default function Modes() {
    const s = reactive({ one: [] as readonly File[] });
    let manual!: FileUploader;
    return (
        <Stack gap="md" style="inline-size: 100%">
            <FileUploader label="Photo" multiple={false} allowDrop={false} accept="image/*" upload={quick} uploadMode="button" x-model={() => s.one} />
            <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center">
                <FileUploader ref={(u: FileUploader) => (manual = u)} label="Logs" accept=".log,.txt" upload={quick} uploadMode="manual" />
                <Button text="Send the logs" variant="outline" onclick={() => void manual.upload()} />
            </Stack>
        </Stack>
    );
}
```

## Uploading to a server

The uploader posts a form with the file in `uploadField` (`file` by default) to `uploadUrl`, using `uploadHeaders`. A 2xx response becomes the item's `response`, and JSON is parsed. With `chunkSize`, each chunk carries `Content-Range` and the `chunkIndex` and `chunkCount` fields.

```tsx
<FileUploader
  label="Attachments"
  uploadUrl="/api/files"
  uploadHeaders={{ Authorization: 'Bearer ' + token }}
  chunkSize={1_000_000}
  onUploaded={(e) => this.attachments.push(e.item.response as Attachment)}
/>
```

## Behavior

| Topic | Details |
| --- | --- |
| `Choosing` | The button opens the file dialog. Files can also be dropped on the box, which is highlighted while they are over it. |
| `Refusing` | A file that does not meet `accept`, the size limits or `maxFiles` is listed as rejected with the reason, and is not added to the value. |
| `Uploading` | Uploads start on selection, on the Upload button, or programmatically. Each row shows progress and a Cancel button during the upload, then “Uploaded” or the failure with Retry. The server response is available as the item's `response`, with JSON parsed. |
| `Chunks` | With `chunkSize`, the file is sent in chunks, each in a request with `Content-Range: bytes start-end/total`, and progress covers the whole file. |
| `Removing chips` | Each row has a remove button. A running upload is stopped first. |

## Accessibility

| Topic | Details |
| --- | --- |
| `Button` | The select button is the field's control. The label is associated with it, and Space and Enter open the dialog. |
| `List` | A list of rows with the name, size and status as text, a progress bar named after the file, and buttons named “Cancel the upload of …”, “Retry” and “Remove …”. |
| `Messages` | Rejection reasons and failures use the kit language or the server's message. |

## Styling

| Hook | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `.mx-file-uploader` | The field. `data-dragover` while files are over it. |
| `.mx-file-uploader__select, .mx-file-uploader__drop, .mx-file-uploader__upload` | The select button, the hint and the Upload button. |
| `.mx-file-uploader__list, .mx-file-uploader__item` | The list and each row. `data-status` on the row. |
| `.mx-file-uploader__icon, __name, __size, __state, __progress, __actions, __action` | The parts of a row. |

### Component tokens

| Token | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `file-uploader.over, .select, .upload, .hint, .list, .item, .icon, .name, .size, .state` | Units: the box with files over it, the two buttons (`hover`, `pressed`, `focus`, `disabled`), the hint, the list, a row per status, the file glyph and the text. |
| `file-uploader.field, .action` | Places: the field box as a drop zone (a dashed frame, its corners and its padding) and the row buttons. |
| `file-uploader.box-gap, .button-gap, .item-gap` | The spacing in the box, in a button and in a row. |

## API reference

### Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `Bind<readonly File[]>` | `[]` | The accepted files, excluding rejected ones. `x-model` provides two-way binding. |
| `multiple` | `Bind<boolean>` | `true` | Allows several files at once. `false` keeps only the most recent one. |
| `accept` | `Bind<string>` | `''` | The accepted file types, as in `<input type="file">`: `.png,.jpg`, `image/*`, `application/pdf`. |
| `maxFileSize, minFileSize` | `Bind<number \| null>` | `null` | Size limits in bytes. A file outside the limits is listed as rejected with the reason. |
| `maxFiles` | `Bind<number \| null>` | `null` | The maximum number of files. |
| `allowDrop` | `Bind<boolean>` | `true` | Allows files to be dropped on the box. |
| `uploadMode` | `Bind<UploadMode>` | `instant` / `manual` | `instant` uploads on selection, `button` adds an Upload button, and `manual` uses `upload()` programmatically. The default is `instant` with `uploadUrl` or `upload`, and `manual` otherwise. |
| `uploadUrl, uploadMethod, uploadHeaders, uploadField` | `Bind<string \| null>`, … | `null`, `POST`, `null`, `file` | Where and how the uploader sends a file itself, using XMLHttpRequest with progress, as a form with the file in `uploadField`. |
| `chunkSize` | `Bind<number \| null>` | `null` | Bytes per request. The file is sent in chunks, each with `Content-Range` and the `chunkIndex` and `chunkCount` fields, and the last response is used. |
| `upload` | `(file, report, signal) => Promise<unknown>` | — | A custom upload function used instead of `uploadUrl`. Call `report(0…1)` to report progress and stop on `signal`. The value it resolves to becomes the response. |
| `selectText, dropText, uploadText` | `Bind<string>` | Kit default | The button, the hint next to it and the Upload button. |
| `showFileList` | `Bind<boolean>` | `true` | The list of files below the box. |
| `label, helpText, required, rules, readOnly, size, variant…` |  |  | Field props shared by all editors. |

### Events, properties and methods

| Member | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `items` | read-only | Every file in the list with its state: `file`, `status` (`ready`, `uploading`, `done`, `error`, `aborted`, `invalid`), `progress`, `response` and `message`. |
| `isUploading` | read-only | Indicates that an upload is running. |
| `openDialog()` | `void` | Opens the browser's file dialog, the same as the button. |
| `addFiles(files)` | `void` | Adds files as if the user selected them. The limits apply, `onFilesAdded` is raised, and uploads start according to the mode. |
| `upload(item?)` | `Promise<void>` | Uploads the waiting files, or one of them. This is what `manual` mode calls. |
| `abort(item?), remove(item), clear()` | `void` | Stops an upload (the file remains, marked as canceled), removes a file, or removes all files. |
| `onFilesAdded` | event | Occurs when files are selected or dropped (`files`, `refused`). Set `cancel = true` to accept none. |
| `onFileRemoved, onUploadStarted, onProgress, onUploaded, onUploadError, onUploadAborted` | event | Reports each stage of a file's upload, with `item` and `file`, and `error` on failure. |
| `onValueChanged` | event | Occurs when the accepted files change. |

# CheckBox

> Choice · @motifx-community/ui 0.1.0-beta.5

A check box with a label that can be checked, unchecked or indeterminate. It supports an optional three-state cycle, read-only and required states, and validation with its group. It is a native check box styled with design tokens.

## Import

```tsx
import { CheckBox } from '@motifx-community/ui';
```

## Declarative and programmatic

Every prop accepts a value or a function, and `x-model` provides two-way binding for the value. When you create the component with `new`, set the same properties programmatically.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, CheckBox, Stack } from '@motifx-community/ui';

/** A checkbox bound to state with x-model, and checkboxes created with `new` and added programmatically. */
export default function Programmatic() {
  const s = reactive({ remember: true, result: '' });
  let added = 0;
  let host: Stack | null = null;

  const addProgrammatic = () => {
    const box = new CheckBox({ label: `Option ${++added}`, threeState: true });
    box.onValueChanged((e) => (s.result = `${box.label}: ${String(e.value)}`));
    host?.controls.add(box);
    box.focus();
  };

  return (
    <>
      <CheckBox label="&Remember me" x-model={() => s.remember} helpText={() => (s.remember ? 'You stay signed in.' : 'You sign in every time.')} />
      <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center">
        <Button text="Add a checkbox programmatically" variant="outline" onclick={addProgrammatic} />
        <output class="cb-result">{() => s.result}</output>
      </Stack>
      <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center" ref={(c: Stack) => (host = c)} />
    </>
  );
}
```

## Checked, unchecked and indeterminate

`null` shows the indeterminate dash. Clicking it checks the box. With `threeState`, the user cycles through all three states: unchecked, checked and indeterminate.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { CheckBox } from '@motifx-community/ui';

/** Unchecked, checked and indeterminate, and a box the user takes through all three. */
export default function States() {
  const s = reactive({ mixed: null as boolean | null, three: false as boolean | null });
  return (
    <>
      <CheckBox label="Unchecked" value={false} />
      <CheckBox label="Checked" value={true} />
      <CheckBox label="Indeterminate" x-model={() => s.mixed} />
      <CheckBox label="Three st&ates" threeState x-model={() => s.three} />
      <output class="cb-three">{() => `value: ${String(s.three)}`}</output>
    </>
  );
}
```

A box above a list is indeterminate while only some items are checked. Its value is a function of the list, and clicking it checks or unchecks all items.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { CheckBox, Stack } from '@motifx-community/ui';

interface Topping {
  id: number;
  name: string;
  on: boolean;
}

/** A box over a list: indeterminate while only some are checked, and a click checks or unchecks them all. */
export default function SelectAll() {
  const toppings = reactive<Topping[]>([
    { id: 1, name: 'Cheese', on: true },
    { id: 2, name: 'Olives', on: false },
    { id: 3, name: 'Peppers', on: true },
  ]);

  const allToppings = (): boolean | null => {
    const on = toppings.filter((t) => t.on).length;
    return on === 0 ? false : on === toppings.length ? true : null;
  };

  return (
    <>
      <CheckBox
        label="All toppings"
        class="cb-all"
        value={allToppings}
        onValueChanged={(e) => {
          if (e.byUser) for (const t of toppings) t.on = e.value === true;
        }}
      />
      <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center" style="padding-inline-start: var(--mx-space-6)">
        {toppings.map((t) => (
          <CheckBox key={t.id} label={t.name} x-model={() => t.on} />
        ))}
      </Stack>
    </>
  );
}
```

## Caption

The label appears after the box, or before it with `labelPosition="start"`. With `stretch`, the field takes the full width, so a box after its label moves to the far end, as in a settings list. `labelMode="hidden"` keeps the label for screen readers only.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, CheckBox, Stack, type LabelPosition } from '@motifx-community/ui';

const POSITIONS: LabelPosition[] = ['end', 'start'];

/** The caption after or before the box, stretched to the far end, or kept for screen readers only. */
export default function Caption() {
  const s = reactive({ position: 'end' as LabelPosition });
  return (
    <>
      <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center" role="group" aria-label="Caption position">
        {POSITIONS.map((position) => (
          <Button
            key={position}
            text={position}
            size="sm"
            variant={() => (s.position === position ? 'solid' : 'ghost')}
            aria-pressed={() => s.position === position}
            onclick={() => (s.position = position)}
          />
        ))}
      </Stack>
      <CheckBox label="Show hidden files" labelPosition={() => s.position} />
      <div style="inline-size: 20rem">
        <CheckBox label="Wrap long lines" labelPosition={() => s.position} stretch value={true} />
      </div>
      <CheckBox label="Select row 3" labelMode="hidden" />
    </>
  );
}
```

## Sizes

```tsx
import { CheckBox, type ControlSize } from '@motifx-community/ui';

const SIZES: ControlSize[] = ['sm', 'md', 'lg'];

/** A checkbox in each size. */
export default function Sizes() {
  return (
    <>
      {SIZES.map((size) => (
        <CheckBox key={size} label={size} size={size} value={size !== 'sm'} />
      ))}
    </>

}
```

## Required check boxes

`required` means the box must be checked. It is validated with its group like any other field, and the first unchecked box receives focus.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, CheckBox, Stack, ValidationGroup } from '@motifx-community/ui';

/** Boxes that must be checked, checked with their group; the first one left unchecked gets focus. */
export default function Required() {
  const s = reactive({ terms: false, privacy: false, result: '' });
  const group = new ValidationGroup();

  const signUp = async () => {
    const result = await group.validate();
    s.result = result.valid ? 'Signed up.' : `${result.invalid.length} box(es) to check.`;
  };

  return (
    <>
      <CheckBox label="I accept the &terms" required validationGroup={group} x-model={() => s.terms} />
      <CheckBox label="I read the privacy notice" required validationGroup={group} x-model={() => s.privacy} />
      <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center">
        <Button text="Sign up" tone="accent" onclick={signUp} />
        <Button text="Reset" variant="ghost" onclick={() => group.reset()} />
        <output class="cb-save">{() => s.result}</output>
      </Stack>
    </>
  );
}
```

## Read-only and disabled

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, CheckBox } from '@motifx-community/ui';

/** Read-only and disabled, both following state. */
export default function ReadOnly() {
  const s = reactive({ editable: true, paid: true });
  return (
    <>
      <Button text="Toggle" variant="outline" onclick={() => (s.editable = !s.editable)} />
      <CheckBox label="Read-only" readOnly={() => !s.editable} x-model={() => s.paid} />
      <CheckBox label="Disabled" enabled={() => s.editable} x-model={() => s.paid} />
      <CheckBox label="Disabled, unchecked" enabled={() => s.editable} value={false} />
    </>
  );
}
```

## Keyboard

| Key | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `Space` | Toggles the check box, using the native key. |
| `Alt + key (`&Name`)` | Moves focus to the check box and toggles it (Control + Option + key on Apple platforms). |
| `Tab` | Each check box is one Tab stop. |

## Accessibility

| Topic | Details |
| --- | --- |
| `Element` | A native `<input type="checkbox">` drawn with `appearance: none`. Its label is a `<label for>`, so clicking the label toggles the box. |
| `Indeterminate` | The native `indeterminate` state, announced as "mixed". |
| `Read-only` | `aria-readonly="true"`. The field stays in the Tab order. |
| `Errors` | `aria-invalid="true"`. The text below the label is a polite live region and describes the box. |
| `Focus` | The design system focus ring, shown only during keyboard use. |

## Localization

A check box has no strings of its own. The `required` message comes from `uiLocale.strings`, and a message already on screen updates immediately.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, uiLocale } from '@motifx-community/ui';
import { kitTexts } from '../../../shared/kit-texts';

/** Switches the texts of every field on the page; a required message already shown follows too. */
export default function Localization() {
  const s = reactive({ lang: 'en' });
  const toggle = () => {
    s.lang = s.lang === 'en' ? 'tr' : 'en';
    void uiLocale.use(s.lang);
  };
  return (
    <>
      <Button text={() => (s.lang === 'en' ? 'Language: English' : 'Dil: Türkçe')} variant="outline" onclick={toggle} />
      <span>
        Required reads <output>{() => kitTexts.strings.required}</output>
      </span>
    </>
  );
}
```

## Styling

| Hook | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `.mx-check-box` | The field. `data-state` (`checked`, `unchecked`, `mixed`), `data-label-position`, `data-size`, `data-invalid`, `data-readonly`, `data-disabled`, `data-required`. |
| `.mx-toggle-field` | The layout shared by CheckBox and Switch: the box and its label side by side. |
| `.mx-check-box__input` | The native check box, which is the box itself. |
| `.mx-check-box__mark, .mx-check-box__check, .mx-check-box__dash` | The mark drawn over the box. |
| `.mx-field__label, .mx-field__message` | The label and the text below it. |

### Component tokens

| Token | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `checkbox.box` | Unit: the box, with every state (`checked`, `mixed` and `invalid`, each with `-hover`, `-pressed` and `-focus`, plus `disabled` and `checked-disabled`). |
| `checkbox.mark, checkbox.dash, checkbox.overlay` | Units: the check mark, the dash of a mixed box, and a layer over the box (`pressed`, `disabled`). |
| `checkbox.halo, checkbox.ring` | Units: a halo centered on the box (`checked`, `hover`, `focus`, `pressed`) and a ring around the box and label during keyboard use, where the design language includes them. |
| `checkbox.label, checkbox.control` | Units: the label (`disabled`) and the row it sits in. |
| `checkbox.size.*, checkbox.mark-size.*` | The box and its mark, per size. |
| `checkbox.height.*, checkbox.font-size.*` | Row height (density tokens) and label size. |
| `checkbox.gap, checkbox.press-offset, checkbox.focus-scope` | The space before the label, the distance the box moves when pressed, and what the keyboard ring surrounds (`box` or `item`). |

## API reference

### Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `Bind<boolean \| null>` | `false` | `true` is checked, `false` is unchecked, and `null` is indeterminate. `x-model` provides two-way binding. |
| `label` | `Bind<string>` | `''` | The label next to the box. Writing `&Name` makes Alt+N toggle it. This is the same property as `text`. |
| `labelPosition` | `Bind<'start' \| 'end'>` | `'end'` | Places the label after the box (`end`) or before it (`start`), following the reading direction. |
| `labelMode` | `Bind<FieldLabelMode>` | `'top'` | `hidden` keeps the label for screen readers only. Every other mode shows it next to the box. |
| `threeState` | `Bind<boolean>` | `false` | A click cycles through unchecked, checked and indeterminate. Without this prop, a click only checks and unchecks, although code can still set `null`. |
| `helpText` | `Bind<string>` | `''` | Help text shown below the label. An error message replaces it. |
| `hint` | `Bind<string>` | `''` | The tooltip text. |
| `readOnly` | `Bind<boolean>` | `false` | The box can receive focus and is announced, but a click or Space changes nothing. |
| `required` | `Bind<boolean>` | `false` | The box must be checked. Adds an indicator after the label, `aria-required` and a `required` rule. |
| `size` | `Bind<ControlSize>` | `'md'` | `sm`, `md`, `lg`; the row height follows the density tokens. |
| `stretch` | `Bind<boolean>` | `false` | Stretches to the full width of its container. With `labelPosition="start"`, the box moves to the far end. |
| `name` | `Bind<string>` | `''` | The name submitted with the form. |
| `rules, error, validateOn, validationGroup` | see Field |  | Validation works the same way as for all fields. |
| `enabled / disabled, visible, tabStop, tabIndex` | see Control |  | Properties shared by all controls. |

### Properties

| Property | Access | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `every prop above` | read/write, reactive | Accepts a value or a function, the same as the prop. |
| `isValid, validationMessage, validating` | read-only, reactive | The result of the last validation. |
| `inputElement` | read-only | The native `<input type="checkbox">`. |

### Methods

| Method | Returns | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `toggle()` | `void` | Changes the value as a click does (with `threeState`, to the next of the three states). |
| `validate()` | `Promise<boolean>` | Validates the value and displays the result. |
| `resetValidation()` | `void` | Clears the results of previous validation. |
| `focus()` | `boolean` | Sets focus on the box. |

### Events

| Event | When |
| --- | --- |
| `onValueChanged(e)` | Occurs when the value changes. `e`: `{ value, previousValue, byUser, source, event? }`. `null` stays `null`. |
| `onValidated(e)` | Occurs when validation finishes. `e`: `{ valid, message, source }`. |
| `onclick, onchange, onfocusin, onfocusout` | DOM events from the input bubble up to the field. |

`ToggleField`, the base class shared by CheckBox and Switch, provides a label next to a native check box, read-only behavior and the access key. It is exported for use in your own controls.

# Switch

> Choice · @motifx-community/ui 0.1.0-beta.5

An on/off switch with a label. It has a track with a sliding thumb, optional on/off text inside or next to the track, and read-only and required states. It is a native check box with the switch role.

## Import

```tsx
import { Switch } from '@motifx-community/ui';
```

## Declarative and programmatic

Every prop accepts a value or a function, and `x-model` provides two-way binding for the value. When you create the component with `new`, set the same properties programmatically.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, Stack, Switch } from '@motifx-community/ui';

/** A switch bound to state with x-model, and switches created with `new` and added programmatically. */
export default function Programmatic() {
  const s = reactive({ wifi: true, result: '' });
  let added = 0;
  let host: Stack | null = null;

  const addProgrammatic = () => {
    const sw = new Switch({ label: `Feature ${++added}`, onText: 'On', offText: 'Off' });
    sw.onValueChanged((e) => (s.result = `${sw.label}: ${e.value ? 'on' : 'off'}`));
    host?.controls.add(sw);
    sw.focus();
  };

  return (
    <>
      <Switch label="&Wi-Fi" x-model={() => s.wifi} helpText={() => (s.wifi ? 'Connected to Home.' : 'Not connected.')} />
      <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center">
        <Button text="Add a switch programmatically" variant="outline" onclick={addProgrammatic} />
        <output class="sw-result">{() => s.result}</output>
      </Stack>
      <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center" ref={(c: Stack) => (host = c)} />
    </>
  );
}
```

## On/off text

`onText` and `offText` appear inside the track, which grows to fit them, or next to it. The text is visual only, and the switch announces its own state.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, Stack, Switch, type SwitchStateText } from '@motifx-community/ui';

const PLACES: SwitchStateText[] = ['inside', 'beside', 'none'];

/** An on / off text in the track, next to it, or not shown. */
export default function StateText() {
  const s = reactive({ place: 'inside' as SwitchStateText, sync: false, dark: false });
  return (
    <>
      <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center" role="group" aria-label="Text position">
        {PLACES.map((place) => (
          <Button
            key={place}
            text={place}
            size="sm"
            variant={() => (s.place === place ? 'solid' : 'ghost')}
            aria-pressed={() => s.place === place}
            onclick={() => (s.place = place)}
          />
        ))}
      </Stack>
      <Switch label="&Sync" class="sw-sync" onText="On" offText="Off" showStateText={() => s.place} x-model={() => s.sync} />
      <Switch label="Dark mode" onText="Dark" offText="Light" showStateText={() => s.place} x-model={() => s.dark} />
    </>
  );
}
```

## Caption

The label appears after the track, or before it with `labelPosition="start"`. With `stretch`, the field takes the full width and the track moves to the far end, as in a settings list.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Switch } from '@motifx-community/ui';

/** Captions before the track, stretched so the tracks line up at the far end, as in a settings list. */
export default function Caption() {
  const s = reactive({ updates: true });
  return (
    <div style="inline-size: 22rem">
      <Switch label="Automatic updates" labelPosition="start" stretch x-model={() => s.updates} />
      <Switch label="Send usage data" labelPosition="start" stretch helpText="Anonymous, once a week." />
    </div>
  );
}
```

## Required, read-only, disabled

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, Stack, Switch, ValidationGroup } from '@motifx-community/ui';

/** A switch that must be on, checked with its group, and read-only and disabled ones following state. */
export default function States() {
  const s = reactive({ terms: false, editable: true, result: '' });
  const group = new ValidationGroup();

  const next = async () => {
    s.result = (await group.validate()).valid ? 'Thanks.' : 'Please agree first.';
  };

  return (
    <>
      <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center">
        <Switch label="I &agree to the terms" required validationGroup={group} x-model={() => s.terms} />
        <Button text="Continue" tone="accent" onclick={next} />
        <output>{() => s.result}</output>
      </Stack>
      <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center">
        <Button text="Toggle" variant="outline" onclick={() => (s.editable = !s.editable)} />
        <Switch label="Read-only" readOnly={() => !s.editable} value={true} />
        <Switch label="Disabled on" enabled={() => s.editable} value={true} />
        <Switch label="Disabled off" enabled={() => s.editable} />
      </Stack>
    </>
  );
}
```

## Keyboard

| Key | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `Space` | Toggles the switch, using the native key. |
| `Enter` | Also toggles the switch, as on a button. |
| `Alt + key (`&Name`)` | Moves focus to the switch and toggles it (Control + Option + key on Apple platforms). |

## Accessibility

| Topic | Details |
| --- | --- |
| `Element` | A native `<input type="checkbox" role="switch">`. Screen readers announce "switch, on" or "switch, off", and the browser provides Space, the form value, `:checked` and `:disabled`. Its label is a `<label for>`, so clicking the label toggles the switch. |
| `On/off text` | Decorative only (`aria-hidden`), because the switch announces its own state. |
| `Read-only` | `aria-readonly="true"`. The field stays in the Tab order. |
| `Motion` | The thumb animates with the motion tokens, and the animation is removed when the user prefers reduced motion. |
| `Focus` | The design system focus ring around the track, shown only during keyboard use. |

## Localization

A switch has no strings of its own. `onText` and `offText` are yours and can be functions of your language state. The `required` message comes from `uiLocale.strings`.

| Hook | Description |
| --- | --- |

# RadioGroup

> Choice · @motifx-community/ui 0.1.0-beta.5

A set of mutually exclusive options. Options can come from plain values, custom objects or a live list, and can be arranged vertically, horizontally or in columns. Individual options can be disabled, hidden or given help text. The group is a single Tab stop, and the arrow keys move between options.

## Import

```tsx
import { RadioGroup, type RadioItem } from '@motifx-community/ui';
```

## Declarative and programmatic

A plain value serves as its own text. `x-model` provides two-way binding for the selected value. When you create the component with `new`, set the same properties programmatically.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, RadioGroup, Stack } from '@motifx-community/ui';

/** A group of plain values bound with x-model, and a group created with `new` and added programmatically. */
export default function Programmatic() {
  const s = reactive({ size: 'M' as string | null, result: '' });
  let host: Stack | null = null;

  const addProgrammatic = () => {
    const wrap = new RadioGroup<string>({ label: 'Gift wrap', orientation: 'horizontal', items: ['None', 'Paper', 'Box'], value: 'None' });
    wrap.onValueChanged((e) => (s.result = `Gift wrap: ${e.value}`));
    host?.controls.add(wrap);
    wrap.focus();
  };

  return (
    <>
      <RadioGroup label="&Size" items={['S', 'M', 'L', 'XL']} x-model={() => s.size} helpText={() => `Chosen: ${s.size ?? 'nothing'}`} />
      <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center">
        <Button text="Add a group programmatically" variant="outline" onclick={addProgrammatic} />
        <output class="rg-result">{() => s.result}</output>
      </Stack>
      <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center" ref={(c: Stack) => (host = c)} />
    </>
  );
}
```

## Binding to data

Custom objects use `itemText` and `itemValue`, each a property name or a function. Items can be plain or reactive and are read as they are. After adding, removing or renaming items in place, call `refresh()` to update the display, which preserves focus and selection.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, RadioGroup, Stack } from '@motifx-community/ui';

interface Plan {
  id: number;
  name: string;
  price: number;
}

/** Options from a list of custom objects. After adding or changing some in place, `refresh()` shows them. */
export default function FromData() {
  const s = reactive({ plan: 2 as number | null });
  const plans = reactive<Plan[]>([
    { id: 1, name: 'Free', price: 0 },
    { id: 2, name: 'Pro', price: 12 },
    { id: 3, name: 'Team', price: 30 },
  ]);

  let group!: RadioGroup<number>;
  const addPlan = () => {
    plans.push({ id: plans.length + 1, name: `Plan ${plans.length + 1}`, price: plans.length * 20 });
    group.refresh();
  };
  const raisePrices = () => {
    for (const p of plans) p.price += 1;
    group.refresh();
  };

  return (
    <>
      <RadioGroup
        ref={(g: RadioGroup<number>) => (group = g)}
        label="&Plan"
        class="rg-plans"
        items={() => plans}
        itemText={(p) => `${(p as Plan).name} — ${(p as Plan).price} €`}
        itemValue="id"
        x-model={() => s.plan}
      />
      <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center">
        <Button text="Add a plan" variant="outline" enabled={() => plans.length < 6} onclick={addPlan} />
        <Button text="Raise prices" variant="outline" onclick={raisePrices} />
        <output class="rg-plan">{() => `value: ${String(s.plan)}`}</output>
      </Stack>
    </>
  );
}
```

## Disabled options, help text and hints

A `RadioItem` has its own `enabled`, `visible`, `hint` and `helpText`, each a value or a function. The arrow keys skip options that cannot be selected.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, RadioGroup, type RadioItem } from '@motifx-community/ui';

/** Options with their own help line and hint, and one that is enabled only while state allows it. */
export default function OptionDetails() {
  const s = reactive({ shipping: 'std' as string | null, expressOpen: false });
  const shipping: RadioItem<string>[] = [
    { value: 'std', text: 'Standard', helpText: '3–5 working days', hint: 'Free over 50 €' },
    { value: 'exp', text: 'Express', helpText: () => (s.expressOpen ? 'Tomorrow' : 'Not before the weekend'), enabled: () => s.expressOpen },
    { value: 'pick', text: 'Pick up in store', helpText: 'Ready in 2 hours' },
  ];

  return (
    <>
      <Button text={() => (s.expressOpen ? 'Close express' : 'Open express')} variant="outline" onclick={() => (s.expressOpen = !s.expressOpen)} />
      <RadioGroup label="S&hipping" class="rg-shipping" items={shipping} x-model={() => s.shipping} />
    </>
  );
}
```

## Orientation and columns

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, RadioGroup, Stack, type RadioGroupOrientation } from '@motifx-community/ui';

const ORIENTATIONS: RadioGroupOrientation[] = ['vertical', 'horizontal'];
const COLUMNS = [0, 2, 4];
const COLORS = ['red', 'orange', 'yellow', 'green', 'teal', 'blue', 'indigo', 'violet'];

/** Options one under the other or side by side, and in columns. */
export default function Layout() {
  const s = reactive({ orientation: 'vertical' as RadioGroupOrientation, columns: 0, color: 'teal' as string | null });
  return (
    <>
      <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center" role="group" aria-label="Layout">
        {ORIENTATIONS.map((o) => (
          <Button
            key={o}
            text={o}
            size="sm"
            variant={() => (s.orientation === o ? 'solid' : 'ghost')}
            aria-pressed={() => s.orientation === o}
            onclick={() => (s.orientation = o)}
          />
        ))}
        {COLUMNS.map((n) => (
          <Button
            key={`c${n}`}
            text={n ? `${n} columns` : 'no grid'}
            size="sm"
            variant={() => (s.columns === n ? 'solid' : 'ghost')}
            aria-pressed={() => s.columns === n}
            onclick={() => (s.columns = n)}
          />
        ))}
      </Stack>
      <RadioGroup label="&Color" class="rg-colors" items={COLORS} orientation={() => s.orientation} columns={() => s.columns} x-model={() => s.color} />
    </>
  );
}
```

## Sizes

```tsx
import { RadioGroup, type ControlSize } from '@motifx-community/ui';

const SIZES: ControlSize[] = ['sm', 'md', 'lg'];

/** A group in each size. */
export default function Sizes() {
  return (
    <>
      {SIZES.map((size) => (
        <RadioGroup key={size} label={size} size={size} items={['One', 'Two']} value="Two" />
      ))}
    </>
  );
}
```

## Required, read-only, disabled

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, RadioGroup, Stack, ValidationGroup } from '@motifx-community/ui';

/** A required choice validated with its group, and read-only and disabled groups that follow state. */
export default function States() {
  const s = reactive({ payment: null as string | null, editable: true, result: '' });
  const group = new ValidationGroup();

  const pay = async () => {
    s.result = (await group.validate()).valid ? 'Paid.' : 'Choose a payment.';
  };

  return (
    <>
      <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center">
        <RadioGroup label="Pa&yment" orientation="horizontal" required validationGroup={group} items={['Card', 'Transfer', 'Cash']} x-model={() => s.payment} />
        <Button text="Pay" tone="accent" onclick={pay} />
        <output>{() => s.result}</output>
      </Stack>
      <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center">
        <Button text="Toggle" variant="outline" onclick={() => (s.editable = !s.editable)} />
        <RadioGroup label="Read-only" readOnly={() => !s.editable} items={['Free', 'Pro']} value="Pro" />
        <RadioGroup label="Disabled" enabled={() => s.editable} items={['Free', 'Pro']} value="Pro" />
      </Stack>
    </>
  );
}
```

## Keyboard

| Key | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `Tab` | Moves focus into the group, on the selected option or the first available one. The next Tab leaves the group. |
| `↓ / →` | Moves to the next option and selects it, wrapping from last to first and skipping disabled and hidden options. |
| `↑ / ←` | Moves the same way, backward. On right-to-left pages, ← and → are swapped. |
| `Space` | Selects the focused option. |
| `Alt + key (`&Name`)` | Moves focus to the group (Control + Option + key on Apple platforms). |

## Accessibility

| Topic | Details |
| --- | --- |
| `Group` | `role="radiogroup"` named by the field label (`aria-labelledby`), with `aria-orientation`, `aria-required`, `aria-readonly`, `aria-invalid`, and `aria-describedby` for the help text. |
| `Options` | Native `<input type="radio">` elements sharing a name, each inside its own `<label>` and drawn with `appearance: none`. |
| `Help text` | An option's `helpText` sits outside its label and is linked with `aria-describedby`, so it is not part of the option's name. |
| `Disabled options` | Native `disabled`: skipped by the keyboard and announced as unavailable. |
| `Focus` | One Tab stop, with the design system focus ring shown only during keyboard use. |

## Localization

The group has no strings of its own. The option text is yours, and functions of your language state work. The `required` message comes from `uiLocale.strings`.

## Styling

| Hook | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `.mx-radio-group` | The field. `data-orientation`, `data-columns`, `data-size`, `data-invalid`, `data-readonly`, `data-disabled`, `data-required`. |
| `.mx-radio-group__list` | The `radiogroup` element. `columns` sets `--_columns` and `--_rows` on it. |
| `.mx-radio-group__item, .mx-radio-group__label` | An option, and the label that holds its radio and text. |
| `.mx-radio-group__input, .mx-radio-group__text, .mx-radio-group__help` | The radio, its text and its help text. |

### Component tokens

| Token | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `radiogroup.circle, radiogroup.dot` | Units: the circle in every state (`checked`, `invalid`, `hover`, `pressed`, `focus` and their combinations, `disabled`), and the dot of the selected option (`checked`, `pressed`, `disabled`). |
| `radiogroup.row, radiogroup.text, radiogroup.help` | Units: an option's row (`hover`, `checked`, `disabled`), its text and its help text. |
| `radiogroup.halo, radiogroup.ring` | Units: a halo centered on the circle and a ring around an option during keyboard use, where the design language includes them. |
| `radiogroup.options, radiogroup.floating-label` | Units: the options as a group, and the group label when it floats. |
| `radiogroup.size.*, radiogroup.dot-size.*, radiogroup.dot-size-hover.*, radiogroup.dot-size-pressed.*` | The circle and the dot, per size and state. |
| `radiogroup.height.*, radiogroup.font-size.*` | Row height (density tokens) and text size. |
| `radiogroup.gap, radiogroup.column-gap, radiogroup.help-gap` | The space before the text, between side-by-side options, and above an option's help text. |
| `radiogroup.press-offset, radiogroup.focus-scope` | The distance the circle moves when pressed, and what the keyboard ring surrounds. |

## API reference

### Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `Bind<T \| null>` | `null` | The value of the selected item, or `null` if none is selected. `x-model` provides two-way binding. |
| `items` | `Bind<readonly (RadioItem<T> \| T)[]>` | `[]` | The options. A function is tracked, so a new list appears immediately. Items changed in place appear after `refresh()`. |
| `itemText` | `string \| (item) => unknown` | `'text'` | Where a custom object stores its text. This is a reader, not a binding. |
| `itemValue` | `string \| (item) => T` | `'value'` | Where an item stores its value. An object without one serves as its own value. |
| `label` | `Bind<string>` | `''` | The group label. Writing `&Name` makes Alt+N move focus to the group. This is the same property as `text`. |
| `labelMode` | `Bind<FieldLabelMode>` | `'top'` | `top`, `side` (next to the options) or `hidden` (for screen readers only). |
| `orientation` | `Bind<RadioGroupOrientation>` | `'vertical'` | `vertical` stacks the options, and `horizontal` places them side by side and wraps. |
| `columns` | `Bind<number>` | `0` | Arranges the options in a grid with this many columns (down the columns when vertical, across when horizontal). |
| `helpText` | `Bind<string>` | `''` | Help text shown below the group. An error message replaces it. |
| `hint` | `Bind<string>` | `''` | A tooltip on the group. |
| `readOnly` | `Bind<boolean>` | `false` | The arrow keys move between options, but nothing can be selected. |
| `required` | `Bind<boolean>` | `false` | An option must be selected. |
| `size` | `Bind<ControlSize>` | `'md'` | `sm`, `md`, `lg`; the row height follows the density tokens. |
| `name` | `Bind<string>` | Generated | The name the radios submit with the form. |
| `rules, error, validateOn, validationGroup` | see Field |  | Validation works the same way as for all fields. |
| `enabled / disabled, visible, tabStop, tabIndex` | see Control |  | Properties shared by all controls. |

### RadioItem

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `T` | The value of `value` when this option is selected. |
| `text` | `Bind<string>` | Shown next to the circle. By default, this is the value as text. |
| `hint` | `Bind<string>` | The tooltip text. |
| `helpText` | `Bind<string>` | A smaller line below the text that describes the radio. |
| `enabled` | `Bind<boolean>` | `false` dims the option, and the arrow keys skip it. |
| `visible` | `Bind<boolean>` | `false` removes the option. |

### Properties

| Property | Access | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `every prop above` | read/write, reactive | Accepts a value or a function, the same as the prop. |
| `isValid, validationMessage, validating` | read-only, reactive | The result of the last validation. |
| `listElement` | read-only | The element with `role="radiogroup"`. |
| `inputs` | read-only | The native radios, in item order. |

### Methods

| Method | Returns | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `focus()` | `boolean` | Sets focus on the selected option, or on the first available one. |
| `validate()` | `Promise<boolean>` | Validates the value and displays the result. |
| `resetValidation()` | `void` | Clears the results of previous validation. |
| `refresh()` | `void` | Your items can be plain or reactive, and the group reads them as they are. After changing them in place, call `refresh()`. Their text, values and states are read again, and focus stays where it is. |

### Events

| Event | When |
| --- | --- |
| `onValueChanged(e)` | Occurs when the value changes. `e`: `{ value, previousValue, byUser, source, event? }`. |
| `onValidated(e)` | Occurs when validation finishes. `e`: `{ valid, message, source }`. |
| `onchange, onkeydown, onfocusin, onfocusout` | DOM events from the radios bubble up to the group. |
