# DropDown

> Choice · @motifx-community/ui 0.1.0-beta.5

Selects one item from a list. The field shows the selected item, and the list opens below it on click or from the keyboard. The list can be searched, grouped and customized, and it stays fast with thousands of items.

## Import

```tsx
import { DropDown, type DropDownItem } from '@motifx-community/ui';
```

## Declarative and programmatic

`items` can be plain values, and `x-model` binds the selected value. When you create the component with `new`, set the same properties programmatically.

```tsx
/** The cities the drop-downs of the examples show. */
export const cities = ['Ankara', 'Antalya', 'Bursa', 'İstanbul', 'İzmir', 'Konya', 'Trabzon'];
```

## Objects, groups, templates

Custom objects are read through `textField` and `valueField`, each a property name or a function. `groupField` places options under headers, `enabledField` disables specific options, and a template customizes how an option is drawn.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { DropDown } from '@motifx-community/ui';

interface Country {
  code: string;
  name: string;
  region: string;
  flag: string;
  member?: boolean;
}

const countries: Country[] = [
  { code: 'TR', name: 'Türkiye', region: 'Europe', flag: '🇹🇷', member: true },
  { code: 'DE', name: 'Germany', region: 'Europe', flag: '🇩🇪', member: true },
  { code: 'FR', name: 'France', region: 'Europe', flag: '🇫🇷', member: true },
  { code: 'NO', name: 'Norway', region: 'Europe', flag: '🇳🇴', member: false },
  { code: 'JP', name: 'Japan', region: 'Asia', flag: '🇯🇵', member: true },
  { code: 'KR', name: 'Korea', region: 'Asia', flag: '🇰🇷', member: true },
  { code: 'BR', name: 'Brazil', region: 'Americas', flag: '🇧🇷', member: true },
  { code: 'CA', name: 'Canada', region: 'Americas', flag: '🇨🇦', member: true },
];

/** Draws a country as its flag and its name, in the list and in the field. */
const drawCountry = (c: Country, host: HTMLElement) => {
  host.textContent = `${c.flag}  ${c.name}`;
};

/** Objects read through textField and valueField, under group headers, one that cannot be chosen, drawn with templates. */
export default function Countries() {
  const form = reactive({ country: 'TR' as string | null });
  return (
    <>
      <DropDown
        label="Country"
        items={countries}
        textField="name"
        valueField="code"
        groupField="region"
        enabledField={(c: Country) => c.member !== false}
        itemTemplate={drawCountry}
        fieldTemplate={drawCountry}
        x-model={() => form.country}
      />
      <output class="dd-country">{() => `code: ${form.country ?? '—'}`}</output>
    </>
  );
}
```

## Search and long lists

`searchEnabled` adds a search box at the top of the list. A long list renders only the visible rows. This example has 5,000 orders.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { DropDown } from '@motifx-community/ui';

const orders = Array.from({ length: 5000 }, (_, i) => ({ value: i + 1, text: `Order #${String(i + 1).padStart(5, '0')}` }));

/** 5,000 orders with a search box; the list draws only the rows in view. */
export default function LongList() {
  const form = reactive({ order: 1200 as number | null });
  return (
    <>
      <DropDown label="Order" items={orders} searchEnabled x-model={() => form.order} />
      <output class="dd-order">{() => `order: ${form.order ?? '—'}`}</output>
    </>
  );
}
```

## Dynamic items

When `items` is a function, it is tracked and a new list appears immediately. Your items can be plain or reactive, and the drop-down reads them as they are. After changing them in place, call `refresh()` to update the open list and the field.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, DropDown } from '@motifx-community/ui';

/** Items changed in place: the drop-down reads them again on `refresh()`. */
export default function LiveItems() {
  const model = reactive({ statuses: ['Draft', 'Review'], status: 'Draft' as string | null });
  let field!: DropDown<string, string>;
  const add = () => {
    model.statuses.push('Published');
    field.refresh();
  };
  return (
    <>
      <DropDown ref={(d: DropDown<string, string>) => (field = d)} label="Status" items={() => model.statuses} x-model={() => model.status} />
      <Button text="Add “Published”" variant="outline" enabled={() => !model.statuses.includes('Published')} onclick={add} />
    </>
  );
}
```

## Validation and states

```tsx
/** The cities the drop-downs of the examples show. */
export const cities = ['Ankara', 'Antalya', 'Bursa', 'İstanbul', 'İzmir', 'Konya', 'Trabzon'];
```

## Keyboard

| Key | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `Down, Up, Enter, Space, Alt + Down` | Opens the list on the selected option (Home and End open it on the first and last option). |
| `A letter` | Opens the list on the next option that starts with that letter. Letters typed quickly are combined into one search. |
| `In the list: Up, Down, Home, End, Page Up, Page Down` | Moves the highlight and skips options that cannot be selected. |
| `In the list: Enter, Space, Alt + Up` | Selects the highlighted option and closes the list. |
| `In the list: Tab` | Selects the highlighted option and moves to the next field. |
| `Escape` | Closes the list without selecting. With `clearButton` and the list closed, clears the value. |
| `Alt + key (`&City`)` | Moves focus to the field. |

## Accessibility

| Topic | Details |
| --- | --- |
| `Pattern` | The APG select-only combobox. The field has `role="combobox"` with `aria-haspopup="listbox"`, `aria-expanded` and `aria-controls`, and focus stays on it. |
| `Highlight` | `aria-activedescendant` identifies the highlighted option. Options have `role="option"` with `aria-selected`, and disabled options have `aria-disabled`. |
| `Groups` | Each group has `role="group"` and is labeled by its header. |
| `Long lists` | Only visible rows are rendered, and each option reports its position with `aria-posinset` and `aria-setsize`. |
| `Search` | The search box controls the list and identifies the highlighted option the same way. |
| `Waiting` | While the item for the value is being requested, the combobox has `aria-busy` and its text announces "Loading…". A key the data source does not have shows the reason in its title. |

## Localization

The search box, clear button, empty list text, loading text (`loading`) and missing key reasons (`notInList`, `loadFailed`) come from `uiLocale.strings`.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, DropDown, uiLocale } from '@motifx-community/ui';

/** Switches the texts of every drop-down on the page: the search box, the clear button, the empty list. */
export default function Localization() {
  const s = reactive({ lang: 'en' });
  const toggle = () => {
    s.lang = s.lang === 'en' ? 'tr' : 'en';
    void uiLocale.use(s.lang);
  };
  return (
    <>
      <Button text={() => (s.lang === 'en' ? 'Language: English' : 'Dil: Türkçe')} variant="outline" onclick={toggle} />
      <DropDown label="Empty" items={[]} placeholder="Open me" />
    </>
  );
}
```

## Styling

| Hook | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `.mx-drop-down` | Added to the field. `data-open` while the list is open and `data-loading` while the item for the value is requested, plus the TextBox field attributes. |
| `.mx-drop-down__display, .mx-drop-down__text, .mx-drop-down__chevron` | The combobox, the selected text (`data-placeholder` when empty, `data-missing` for a key the data source does not have), and the arrow. |
| `.mx-drop-down__spinner` | The spinner that replaces the arrow while the item for the value is requested. |
| `.mx-drop-down__popup, .mx-drop-down__search` | The popup and its search box. |
| `.mx-list, .mx-list__item, .mx-list__header` | The shared list, its options (`data-active`, `data-selected`) and group headers. |

### Component tokens

| Token | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `field.*` | The field, as in TextBox. |
| `drop-down.value, drop-down.chevron, drop-down.spinner, drop-down.spinner-shape` | Units: the selected text (`placeholder`, `missing`, `disabled`), the arrow (`open`, `disabled`), the loading ring and the shape a design language can draw instead (with the spinner's shapes and timing). |
| `list.item-height, list.item` | The options: row height and the item unit in each state (`hover`, `pressed`, `active`, `selected`, `selected-hover`, `selected-pressed`, `disabled`, `next`, `select-all`). |
| `list.indicator, list.check, list.mark, list.icon, list.text` | Units: the bar on the selected option (`multiple`), the check box and mark in a multi-select list, an icon and the text. |
| `list.container, list.group, list.header, list.select-all-divider, list.empty` | Units: the list (spacing and maximum height), a group, group headers, the separator below "Select all", and the empty text. |

## API reference

### Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `Bind<V \| null>` | `null` | The value of the selected item. `x-model` provides two-way binding. |
| `items` | `Bind<readonly T[]>` | `[]` | Plain values, `DropDownItem` objects (`{ value, text, icon?, group?, enabled? }`) or custom objects. A function is tracked, and items changed in place appear after `refresh()`. |
| `dataSource` | `Bind<DataSource<T> \| null>` | `null` | Items from the data layer, loaded as the list scrolls and searched using its `searchFields`. This takes precedence over `items`. A value that is not on a loaded page is requested by key, and the field waits in the meantime (see Lookup). |
| `valueText` | `Bind<string>` | `''` | The display text for the value while its item is requested from `dataSource`, shown immediately instead of waiting. Use it when a record already has the name: `valueText={() => order.customerName}`. |
| `searchDelay` | `Bind<number>` | `250` with a data source, otherwise `0` | The delay, in milliseconds, between the last keystroke in the search box and the search. |
| `textField / valueField` | `Bind<ItemField<T>>` | `'text'` / `'value'` | A property name or a function `(item) => …`. Without `valueField`, an object with a `value` property uses that value, and anything else is its own value. |
| `iconField, groupField, enabledField` | `Bind<ItemField<T>>` | — | An icon for each option. Options in the same group appear together under its name. `enabled` marks options that cannot be selected. |
| `placeholder` | `Bind<string>` | `''` | Displayed when no item is selected. |
| `searchEnabled` | `Bind<boolean>` | `false` | Adds a search box at the top of the list. |
| `searchMode` | `Bind<'contains' \| 'startswith'>` | `'contains'` | How the search matches option text. |
| `clearButton` | `Bind<boolean>` | `false` | Shows a button that clears the value. Escape does the same while the list is closed. |
| `itemTemplate / fieldTemplate` | `Bind<(item, host) => cleanup \| void>` | — | Customizes how an option or the selected item is drawn. |
| `matchWidth` | `Bind<boolean>` | `true` | The list is at least as wide as the field. |
| `label, labelMode, helpText, hint, prefix, icon, buttons, readOnly, required, size, variant, stretch, rules, error, validateOn, validationGroup` | see TextBox |  | Field props shared by all editors. |

A prop that accepts a function as its value (`textField`, a template) uses the function as is when it has parameters. A function without parameters is treated as a getter, as with every other prop.

### Properties

| Property | Access | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `every prop above` | read/write, reactive | Accepts a value or a function, the same as the prop. |
| `selectedItem` | read-only, reactive | The item whose value matches `value`. |
| `opened` | read/write, reactive | Indicates whether the list is open. Set it to open or close the list. |
| `isValid, validationMessage` | read-only, reactive | See TextBox. |

### Methods

| Method | Returns | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `open(search?)` | `boolean` | Opens the list, and `search` starts the search box with that text. Returns `false` when the control is disabled, read-only or waiting for the item of its value. |
| `close()` | `void` | Closes the list and returns focus to the field. |
| `clear()` | `void` | Clears the value. |
| `refresh()` | `void` | Your items can be plain or reactive, and the drop-down reads them as they are. After changing them in place, call `refresh()`. The field text and the open list update. |
| `validate(), resetValidation(), focus()` |  | See TextBox. |

### Events

| Event | When |
| --- | --- |
| `onValueChanged(e)` | `{ value, previousValue, byUser, source, event? }` |
| `onOpened()` | Occurs when the list opens. |
| `onClosed(reason)` | Occurs when the list closes. The reason is `'escape'`, `'outside'`, `'focus'` or `'code'` (also after a selection). |
| `onValidated(e)` | See TextBox. |

The list is a shared part, `OptionList`, exported for use in combo boxes, list boxes and your own controls.

## Example files

`Programmatic.tsx`

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, DropDown, Stack } from '@motifx-community/ui';
import { cities } from './cities';

/** Drop-downs bound with x-model, and drop-downs created with `new` and added programmatically. */
export default function Programmatic() {
  const form = reactive({ city: 'İzmir' as string | null, size: null as string | null, result: '' });
  let added = 0;
  let host: Stack | null = null;

  const addProgrammatic = () => {
    const size = new DropDown<string, string>({ label: `Size ${++added}`, items: ['S', 'M', 'L'], placeholder: 'Pick one' });
    size.onValueChanged((e) => (form.result = `${size.label}: ${e.value}`));
    host?.controls.add(size);
    size.focus();
  };

  return (
    <>
      <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center">
        <DropDown label="&City" items={cities} x-model={() => form.city} />
        <output class="dd-city">{() => `city: ${form.city ?? '—'}`}</output>
      </Stack>
      <DropDown label="Size" items={['S', 'M', 'L', 'XL']} placeholder="Pick one" x-model={() => form.size} clearButton />
      <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center">
        <Button text="Add a drop-down programmatically" variant="outline" onclick={addProgrammatic} />
        <output class="dd-made">{() => form.result}</output>
      </Stack>
      <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center" ref={(c: Stack) => (host = c)} />
    </>
  );
}
```

`cities.ts`

```tsx
/** The cities the drop-downs of the examples show. */
export const cities = ['Ankara', 'Antalya', 'Bursa', 'İstanbul', 'İzmir', 'Konya', 'Trabzon'];
```

`Validation.tsx`

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, DropDown, ValidationGroup } from '@motifx-community/ui';
import { cities } from './cities';

/** A required drop-down checked in a group, and the read-only and disabled states. */
export default function Validation() {
  const s = reactive({ priority: 'normal' as string | null, result: '' });
  const group = new ValidationGroup();

  const check = async () => {
    const result = await group.validate();
    s.result = result.valid ? 'Fine.' : 'Pick a priority.';
  };

  return (
    <>
      <DropDown label="Priority" items={['low', 'normal', 'high']} required clearButton validationGroup={group} x-model={() => s.priority} />
      <DropDown label="Read-only" items={cities} value="Bursa" readOnly />
      <DropDown label="Disabled" items={cities} value="Bursa" enabled={false} />
      <Button text="Check" variant="outline" onclick={check} />
      <output class="dd-check">{() => s.result}</output>
    </>
  );
}
```

# ComboBox and Autocomplete

> Choice · @motifx-community/ui 0.1.0-beta.5

A text input with a list that filters as the user types. Items can come from memory or from a data layer source that is searched on the server. `Autocomplete` is the free-text variant, where the value is the text itself.

## Import

```tsx
import { ComboBox, Autocomplete } from '@motifx-community/ui';
import { data } from '@motifx-community/data';
```

## Declarative and programmatic

```tsx
/** The cities the combo boxes of the examples suggest. */
export const cities = ['Adana', 'Ankara', 'Antalya', 'Bursa', 'Diyarbakır', 'Erzurum', 'Eskişehir', 'Gaziantep', 'İstanbul', 'İzmir', 'Kayseri', 'Konya', 'Mersin', 'Samsun', 'Trabzon'];
```

## From a data source

With `dataSource`, the search goes to the data source (using its `searchFields`) after `searchDelay`. In `'blocks'` mode, only the visible rows load, and a value that is not on a loaded page is looked up by key so the field can show its text immediately. This example has 10,000 products and responds after 300 ms.

```tsx
import { data } from '@motifx-community/data';

/** Rows in memory that answer a little later, the way a server does; for the examples. */
export class SlowAdapter<T extends object, K> extends data.ArrayAdapter<T, K> {
  constructor(
    options: data.ArrayAdapterOptions<T>,
    private readonly delayMs = 300,
  ) {
    super(options);
  }

  override async load(options: data.LoadOptions = {}): Promise<data.LoadResult<T>> {
    await new Promise((done) => setTimeout(done, this.delayMs));
    return super.load(options);
  }
}
```

## Custom values and Autocomplete

```tsx
/** The cities the combo boxes of the examples suggest. */
export const cities = ['Adana', 'Ankara', 'Antalya', 'Bursa', 'Diyarbakır', 'Erzurum', 'Eskişehir', 'Gaziantep', 'İstanbul', 'İzmir', 'Kayseri', 'Konya', 'Mersin', 'Samsun', 'Trabzon'];
```

## Keyboard

| Key | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `Typing` | Searches and opens the list, highlighting the first match. |
| `Down / Up, Alt + Down` | Opens the list with all items, or moves the highlight within it. |
| `Enter` | Accepts the highlighted item, or the text (see `acceptCustomValue`), and closes the list. |
| `Tab, leaving` | If an item's text matches the input, it is selected. Otherwise, the custom value is used or the selected item is restored. |
| `Escape` | Closes the list. When closed, it reverts the typing, and then clears the value with `clearButton`. |

## Accessibility

| Topic | Details |
| --- | --- |
| `Pattern` | The APG combobox with list autocomplete. The input has `role="combobox"`, `aria-autocomplete="list"`, `aria-expanded` and `aria-controls`. |
| `Highlight` | `aria-activedescendant` identifies the highlighted option while focus stays in the input. |
| `Loading` | Rows not loaded yet are options with `aria-busy`, which announce "Loading…" from `uiLocale`. |

## API reference

### Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `Bind<V \| null>` | `null` | The value of the selected item. `x-model` binds it. |
| `items / dataSource` | `Bind<readonly T[]>` / `Bind<DataSource \| null>` | — | An in-memory array, searched on the client, or a `@motifx-community/data` data source, searched on the server. |
| `textField, valueField, iconField, groupField, enabledField` | `Bind<ItemField<T>>` | — | Same as DropDown. Groups apply to in-memory items. |
| `searchMode` | `Bind<'contains' \| 'startswith'>` | `'contains'` | How in-memory items are matched. |
| `minSearchLength` | `Bind<number>` | `0` | The number of characters to type before the list opens. |
| `searchDelay` | `Bind<number>` | `0` / `250` | The delay, in milliseconds, between the last keystroke and the search (in memory / with a data source). |
| `acceptCustomValue` | `Bind<boolean>` | `false` | Text that matches no item becomes the value. Otherwise, the field reverts to the selected item. |
| `autoHighlight` | `Bind<boolean>` | `true` | Highlights the first match, so Enter accepts it. |
| `showDropDownButton, clearButton` | `Bind<boolean>` | `true`, `false` | The arrow that opens all items, and the button that clears the value. |
| `itemTemplate, matchWidth, placeholder` |  |  | Same as DropDown. |

### Properties, methods, events

| Member | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `selectedItem` | The item for the current value, when known. |
| `listItems` | The `DataItems` shown in the list, which are the results of the last search. |
| `opened, open(), close(), clear()` | The list and the value. |
| `refresh()` | Your items can be plain or reactive, and the box reads them as they are. After changing them in place, call `refresh()`. The open list and the value text update. Autocomplete has the same method. |
| `onValueChanged, onOpened, onClosed, onValidated` | Same as DropDown. |

The items logic is a shared part: `DataItems` supplies any list control from an array or a data source.

import { Button, ComboBox, Stack } from '@motifx-community/ui';

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { data } from '@motifx-community/data';
import { ComboBox } from '@motifx-community/ui';
import { SlowAdapter } from '../../../shared/slow-adapter';

interface Product {
  id: number;
  name: string;
  category: string;
}

const categories = ['Beverages', 'Condiments', 'Dairy', 'Grains', 'Produce', 'Seafood'];
const rows: Product[] = Array.from({ length: 10000 }, (_, i) => ({ id: i + 1, name: `${categories[i % 6]} item ${i + 1}`, category: categories[i % 6] }));

/** 10,000 products on a server that responds after 300 ms. The search goes to the data source, and the value's text is looked up by key. */
export default function Products() {
  const line = reactive({ product: 2500 as number | null });
  const products = new data.DataSource<Product, number>({
    adapter: new SlowAdapter<Product, number>({ data: rows, key: 'id' }, 300),
    loadMode: 'blocks',
    pageSize: 50,
    searchFields: ['name'],
  });

  return (
    <>
      <ComboBox label="Product" dataSource={products} textField="name" valueField="id" x-model={() => line.product} stretch />
      <output class="cb-product">{() => `product: ${line.product ?? '—'}`}</output>
    </>
  );
}
```

# Lookup

> Choice · @motifx-community/ui 0.1.0-beta.5

Selects one row from a table-style list, typically from a data source searched on the server, such as a customer by company, contact and city. The field shows the text of the selected row, and everything else works as in DropDown.

## Import

```tsx
import { Lookup, type LookupColumn } from '@motifx-community/ui';
```

## Columns from a data source

`columns` arranges every row on one grid under a header, and the search box searches the data source's `searchFields`. Rows load as the list scrolls.

```tsx
import { data } from '@motifx-community/data';

/** Rows in memory that answer a little later, the way a server does; for the examples. */
export class SlowAdapter<T extends object, K> extends data.ArrayAdapter<T, K> {
  constructor(
    options: data.ArrayAdapterOptions<T>,
    private readonly delayMs = 300,
  ) {
    super(options);
  }

  override async load(options: data.LoadOptions = {}): Promise<data.LoadResult<T>> {
    await new Promise((done) => setTimeout(done, this.delayMs));
    return super.load(options);
  }
}
```

## Values on unloaded pages

A value whose row is not loaded is requested by key, in one request together with the keys other fields and grids on the same source need at that moment. In the meantime, the field shows a spinner in place of the arrow, the list stays closed, and the key is never shown as text. A record that already has the name can provide it through `valueText`, and the field shows it immediately. A key the server does not have appears muted and underlined, with the reason in its title. If the request failed, opening the list tries again.

```tsx
import { data } from '@motifx-community/data';

/** Rows in memory that answer a little later, the way a server does; for the examples. */
export class SlowAdapter<T extends object, K> extends data.ArrayAdapter<T, K> {
  constructor(
    options: data.ArrayAdapterOptions<T>,
    private readonly delayMs = 300,
  ) {
    super(options);
  }

  override async load(options: data.LoadOptions = {}): Promise<data.LoadResult<T>> {
    await new Promise((done) => setTimeout(done, this.delayMs));
    return super.load(options);
  }
}
```

## API reference

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `columns` | `Bind<readonly LookupColumn[]>` | `[]` | `{ field, caption?, width?, align? }`: a field name or function, a header text, a CSS grid track and the alignment. |
| `showColumnHeaders` | `Bind<boolean>` | `true` | Shows a header above the rows. |
| `popupWidth` | `Bind<string>` | `lookup.popup-width` | The minimum width of the list. |
| `searchEnabled` | `Bind<boolean>` | `true` | Adds a search box above the list. DropDown has this off by default. |
| `everything of DropDown` |  |  | `items`, `dataSource`, `valueText`, `textField`, `valueField`, `searchDelay`, `clearButton`, validation, keyboard support and more. |
| `refresh()` |  |  | Your items and columns can be plain or reactive, and the lookup reads them as they are. After changing them in place, call `refresh()`. |

`Customers.tsx`

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { data } from '@motifx-community/data';
import { Lookup } from '@motifx-community/ui';
import { SlowAdapter } from '../../../shared/slow-adapter';

interface Customer {
  id: string;
  company: string;
  contact: string;
  city: string;
  phone: string;
}

const cities = ['Berlin', 'London', 'Madrid', 'México D.F.', 'Paris', 'São Paulo', 'İstanbul', 'Seattle'];
const people = ['Maria Anders', 'Ana Trujillo', 'Antonio Moreno', 'Thomas Hardy', 'Christina Berglund', 'Hanna Moos', 'Frédérique Citeaux', 'Martín Sommer'];
const rows: Customer[] = Array.from({ length: 2000 }, (_, i) => ({
  id: `C${String(i + 1).padStart(4, '0')}`,
  company: `${['Alfreds', 'Bon app', 'Ernst', 'Folk och fä', 'Hanari', 'Island', 'Lehmanns', 'Wartian'][i % 8]} ${['Futterkiste', 'Trading', 'Handel', 'HB', 'Carnes', 'Markt', 'Foods', 'Herkku'][(i >> 3) % 8]} ${i + 1}`,
  contact: people[i % 8],
  city: cities[(i * 3) % 8],
  phone: `0${(212 + (i % 9)).toString()} ${String(1000000 + i * 37).slice(0, 7)}`,
}));

/** 2,000 customers behind a server that answers after 250 ms, picked from columns and searched by company, contact and city. */
export default function Customers() {
  const order = reactive({ customer: 'C0042' as string | null });
  const customers = new data.DataSource<Customer, string>({
    adapter: new SlowAdapter<Customer, string>({ data: rows, key: 'id' }, 250),
    loadMode: 'blocks',
    pageSize: 50,
    searchFields: ['company', 'contact', 'city'],
  });

  return (
    <>
      <Lookup
        label="&Customer"
        dataSource={customers}
        textField="company"
        valueField="id"
        popupWidth="40rem"
        columns={[
          { field: 'company', caption: 'Company', width: '2fr' },
          { field: 'contact', caption: 'Contact' },
          { field: 'city', caption: 'City', width: '7rem' },
          { field: 'phone', caption: 'Phone', width: '8rem', align: 'end' },
        ]}
        clearButton
        x-model={() => order.customer}
        stretch
      />
      <output class="lk-customer">{() => `customer: ${order.customer ?? '—'}`}</output>
    </>
  );
}
```

`ByKey.tsx`

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { data } from '@motifx-community/data';
import { Button, Lookup } from '@motifx-community/ui';
import { SlowAdapter } from '../../../shared/slow-adapter';

interface Customer {
  id: number;
  company: string;
  city: string;
}

const companyOf = (id: number) => `${['Alfreds', 'Bon app', 'Ernst', 'Hanari', 'Island', 'Lehmanns'][id % 6]} ${['Trading', 'Handel', 'Markt', 'Foods'][id % 4]} ${id}`;
const rows: Customer[] = Array.from({ length: 2000 }, (_, i) => ({ id: i + 1, company: companyOf(i + 1), city: ['Berlin', 'Paris', 'İstanbul', 'Madrid'][i % 4] }));

/** Values on no loaded page of a server that answers after 1.2 s: one field waits for its row, one shows the name its record carries, one has a key the server does not have. */
export default function ByKey() {
  const customers = new data.DataSource<Customer, number>({
    adapter: new SlowAdapter<Customer, number>({ data: rows, key: 'id' }, 1200),
    loadMode: 'blocks',
    pageSize: 50,
    searchFields: ['company', 'city'],
  });
  const columns = [
    { field: 'company', caption: 'Company' },
    { field: 'city', caption: 'City', width: '7rem' },
  ];
  const waiting = reactive({ customer: 1500 as number | null });
  // A record as returned by the server: the customer's key and, beside it, the name.
  const order = reactive({ customer: 1500 as number | null, customerName: companyOf(1500) });

  const another = () => {
    const id = 100 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 1900);
    waiting.customer = id;
    order.customer = id;
    order.customerName = companyOf(id);
  };

  return (
    <>
      <Lookup class="lk-waits" label="Waits for its row" dataSource={customers} textField="company" valueField="id" columns={columns} x-model={() => waiting.customer} stretch />
      <Lookup
        class="lk-given"
        label="Shows the name it is given"
        dataSource={customers}
        textField="company"
        valueField="id"
        columns={columns}
        valueText={() => order.customerName}
        x-model={() => order.customer}
        stretch
      />
      <Lookup class="lk-missing" label="A key the server does not have" dataSource={customers} textField="company" valueField="id" columns={columns} value={9999} stretch />
      <Button class="lk-another" text="Another customer" variant="outline" onclick={another} />
    </>
  );
}
```

# ProgressBar and Spinner

> Feedback · @motifx-community/ui 0.1.0-beta.5

ProgressBar shows how far an operation has progressed, as a line or a circle, or indicates activity when the progress is unknown. Spinner shows that the system is busy. It is a rotating ring that can stand alone or cover a panel while it loads, and it can wait for a delay so that quick operations do not cause a flash.

## Import

```tsx
import { ProgressBar, Spinner, type ProgressTone } from '@motifx-community/ui';
```

## Declarative and programmatic

Every prop accepts a value or a function, and a function that reads a reactive object keeps the bar in sync with the operation. When you create the component with `new`, set the same properties programmatically.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, ProgressBar, Stack } from '@motifx-community/ui';

/** A bar that follows an upload, and bars created with `new` and added programmatically. */
export default function Programmatic() {
  const s = reactive({ upload: 0, uploading: false });
  let added = 0;
  let host: Stack | null = null;

  const upload = () => {
    if (s.uploading) return;
    s.uploading = true;
    s.upload = 0;
    const timer = setInterval(() => {
      s.upload = Math.min(100, s.upload + 7);
      if (s.upload < 100) return;
      clearInterval(timer);
      s.uploading = false;
    }, 120);
  };

  const addProgrammatic = () => {
    const bar = new ProgressBar({ label: `Task ${++added}`, showValue: true, tone: 'success' });
    bar.value = 25 * added;
    host?.controls.add(bar);
  };

  return (
    <>
      <ProgressBar label="Uploading" value={() => s.upload} showValue stretch />
      <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center">
        <Button text="Upload" tone="accent" enabled={() => !s.uploading} onclick={upload} />
        <Button text="Add a bar programmatically" variant="outline" onclick={addProgrammatic} />
      </Stack>
      <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center" ref={(c: Stack) => (host = c)} />
    </>
  );
}
```

## Indeterminate progress

Without a value (`null`), the bar shows continuous motion. Set a number once the operation can report its progress.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, ProgressBar } from '@motifx-community/ui';

/** A bar without a value, and one that runs until the work knows how much there is to do. */
export default function NotKnown() {
  const copy = reactive({ done: 0, total: 12, running: false });

  const start = () => {
    copy.running = true;
    copy.done = 0;
    copy.total = 0;
    // The files are counted first; until then there is no total.
    setTimeout(() => {
      copy.total = 12;
      const timer = setInterval(() => {
        copy.done++;
        if (copy.done < copy.total) return;
        clearInterval(timer);
        copy.running = false;
      }, 150);
    }, 1000);
  };

  return (
    <>
      <ProgressBar label="Preparing" value={null} />
      <ProgressBar label="Copying" value={() => (copy.total ? copy.done : null)} max={() => copy.total} />
      <Button text="Copy" variant="outline" enabled={() => !copy.running} onclick={start} />
    </>
  );
}
```

## Linear and circular

`shape="circle"` draws the progress as an arc that runs around a ring from the top, and without a value the arc rotates. The label can appear below it (`labelPosition="bottom"`, the default), above it or next to it, and `size` sets the size of the circle and its stroke. Where the design language includes a wave (Material), the line and arc animate as they grow, and they stay straight at the very beginning and end.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, ProgressBar, Stack, type ControlSize } from '@motifx-community/ui';

const VALUES = [5, 30, 70, 100, null];

const SIZES: ControlSize[] = ['sm', 'md', 'lg'];

/** The same values as a line and as a circle, a circle in each size, and one of each that follows some work. */
export default function Shapes() {
  const s = reactive({ done: 0, running: false });

  const run = () => {
    if (s.running) return;
    s.running = true;
    s.done = 0;
    const timer = setInterval(() => {
      s.done = Math.min(100, s.done + 4);
      if (s.done < 100) return;
      clearInterval(timer);
      s.running = false;
    }, 160);
  };

  return (
    <>
      {VALUES.map((value) => (
        <ProgressBar key={String(value)} label={value === null ? 'Not known' : 'Line'} value={value} showValue stretch />
      ))}
      <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="start">
        {VALUES.map((value) => (
          <ProgressBar key={String(value)} shape="circle" label={value === null ? 'Not known' : 'Circle'} value={value} showValue />
        ))}
      </Stack>
      <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center">
        {SIZES.map((size) => (
          <ProgressBar key={size} shape="circle" size={size} label={`Size ${size}`} labelPosition="side" value={60} />
        ))}
      </Stack>
      <ProgressBar label="Importing" value={() => s.done} showValue stretch />
      <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center">
        <ProgressBar shape="circle" label="Importing" labelPosition="side" value={() => s.done} showValue />
        <Button text="Import" variant="outline" enabled={() => !s.running} onclick={run} />
      </Stack>
    </>
  );
}
```

## Tones

```tsx
import { ProgressBar, type ProgressTone } from '@motifx-community/ui';

const TONES: ProgressTone[] = ['accent', 'neutral', 'success', 'caution', 'danger'];

/** A bar in every tone. */
export default function Tones() {
  return (
    <>
      {TONES.map((tone, i) => (
        <ProgressBar key={tone} label={tone} value={20 + i * 18} tone={tone} showValue />
      ))}
    </>
  );
}
```

## Sizes, side labels and custom text

`size` sets the thickness. `labelPosition="side"` places the label before the bar and the value after it. `valueText` provides a custom value format.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, ProgressBar, type ControlSize } from '@motifx-community/ui';

const SIZES: ControlSize[] = ['sm', 'md', 'lg'];

/** The three thicknesses, and a bar with its label beside it and the value in its own words. */
export default function Sizes() {
  const s = reactive({ files: 3 });
  return (
    <>
      {SIZES.map((size) => (
        <ProgressBar key={size} label={`Size ${size}`} size={size} value={60} />
      ))}
      <ProgressBar label="Files" labelPosition="side" max={12} value={() => s.files} showValue valueText={(v) => `${v} of 12`} stretch />
      <Button text="One more file" size="sm" variant="outline" onclick={() => (s.files = s.files >= 12 ? 0 : s.files + 1)} />
    </>
  );
}
```

## Spinner

```tsx
import { Spinner, type ControlSize, type ProgressTone } from '@motifx-community/ui';

const SIZES: ControlSize[] = ['sm', 'md', 'lg'];
const TONES: ProgressTone[] = ['neutral', 'success', 'caution', 'danger'];

/** Spinners in every size, with a label beside or under them, in a container of their own, and in the tones. */
export default function Spinners() {
  return (
    <>
      {SIZES.map((size) => (
        <Spinner key={size} size={size} />
      ))}
      <Spinner label="Loading orders" />
      <Spinner label="Saving" labelPosition="bottom" size="lg" />
      <Spinner label="Syncing" labelPosition="bottom" size="lg" contained />
      {TONES.map((tone) => (
        <Spinner key={tone} tone={tone} size="sm" label={tone} />
      ))}
    </>
  );
}
```

## Delay

A spinner with `delay` stays hidden for that long after it is created or shown again. Quick operations show nothing, and slow ones show the spinner.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, Spinner, Stack } from '@motifx-community/ui';

/** A spinner with a delay: quick work shows nothing, slow work shows it. */
export default function Delay() {
  const s = reactive({ busy: false, result: '' });

  const work = (ms: number) => {
    s.busy = true;
    s.result = '';
    setTimeout(() => {
      s.busy = false;
      s.result = `Done after ${ms} ms.`;
    }, ms);
  };

  return (
    <>
      <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center">
        <Button text="Quick work (200 ms)" variant="outline" onclick={() => work(200)} />
        <Button text="Slow work (2 s)" variant="outline" onclick={() => work(2000)} />
        <Spinner label="Working" delay={400} visible={() => s.busy} />
      </Stack>
      <output class="pr-result">{() => s.result}</output>
    </>
  );
}
```

## Covering a panel while it loads

`Spinner.cover(target)` places a spinner over a component or element and returns a function that removes it. The content underneath cannot be clicked or focused. If focus was inside, it moves to the spinner and returns afterward.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, Panel, Spinner, Stack, TextBox } from '@motifx-community/ui';

/** A spinner over a panel while its orders load. Focus waits on it and then returns. */
export default function Cover() {
  const s = reactive({ result: '' });
  let panel: Panel | null = null;

  // Simulates a server call.
  const loadOrders = () => new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 1500));

  const load = async () => {
    if (!panel) return;
    const done = Spinner.cover(panel, { label: 'Loading orders' });
    try {
      await loadOrders();
    } finally {
      done();
    }
    s.result = 'Orders loaded.';
  };

  return (
    <>
      <Panel class="pr-panel" variant="outline" padding="md" ref={(c: Panel) => (panel = c)}>
        <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center">
          <TextBox label="Customer" value="Ada" />
          <Button text="Load orders" tone="accent" onclick={load} />
        </Stack>
      </Panel>
      <output>{() => s.result}</output>
    </>
  );
}
```

## Accessibility

| Topic | Details |
| --- | --- |
| `ProgressBar` | `role="progressbar"` with `aria-valuenow`, `aria-valuemin`, `aria-valuemax` and `aria-valuetext` (the percentage or `valueText`). None of these are set while the progress is unknown. |
| `Spinner` | `role="progressbar"` without a value, which indicates unknown progress. It is not a `status` live region, because those interrupt the screen reader each time one appears, and a page with several would be noisy. |
| `Name` | Named by the label (`aria-labelledby`), or by `uiLocale.strings.loading` if there is none. |
| `Cover` | The container gets `aria-busy="true"`, and the content under the spinner is `inert`. Focus inside it moves to the spinner and returns when the spinner is removed. |
| `Motion` | With reduced motion, the bar rests as a tinted track, new values appear immediately, the wave stops, and the arcs, ring and shape are static. A wave is drawn only while the bar is visible. |

## Localization

A bar or spinner without a label is named `uiLocale.strings.loading`. The percentage uses `locale`, which defaults to the page `lang`.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, ProgressBar, uiLocale } from '@motifx-community/ui';
import { kitTexts } from '../../../shared/kit-texts';

/** Switches the name of unlabelled bars and spinners, and the language the percent is written in. */
export default function Localization() {
  const s = reactive({ lang: 'en' });
  const toggle = () => {
    s.lang = s.lang === 'en' ? 'tr' : 'en';
    void uiLocale.use(s.lang);
  };
  return (
    <>
      <Button text={() => (s.lang === 'en' ? 'Language: English' : 'Dil: Türkçe')} variant="outline" onclick={toggle} />
      <ProgressBar value={40} showValue locale={() => s.lang} />
      <span>
        Unlabelled ones are named <output class="pr-loading">{() => kitTexts.strings.loading}</output>
      </span>
    </>
  );
}
```

## Styling

| Hook | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `.mx-progress` | The bar. `data-state="determinate \| indeterminate"`, `data-complete`, `data-shape`, `data-wave` (a wave is drawn), `data-tone`, `data-size`, `data-label-position`, `data-stretch`, and `--_fraction` for the completed share from 0 to 1. |
| `.mx-progress__head, .mx-progress__label, .mx-progress__value` | The label row. |
| `.mx-progress__track, .mx-progress__bar` | The line: the track (`::before` for the remainder and `::after` for the stop dot) and the completed part (`::after` for the indeterminate runner). |
| `.mx-progress__wave` | The wave drawn over the track in place of the bar. |
| `.mx-progress__circle, .mx-progress__ring, .mx-progress__arc` | The circle: its drawing, the ring and the arc. |
| `.mx-spinner` | The spinner. `data-size`, `data-tone`, `data-label-position`, `data-contained`, `data-waiting`, `data-cover`. |
| `.mx-spinner__box` | The container of the rotating part. |
| `.mx-spinner__ring, .mx-spinner__shape, .mx-spinner__label` | The ring, the shape (the design language shows one of them) and the label. |
| `[data-mx-covered]` | A container under `Spinner.cover`. |

### Component tokens

| Token | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `progress.track, progress.bar, progress.rest, progress.stop, progress.runner, progress.wave` | Units of the line, each with its box: the band, the completed part, the remainder of the track, the stop dot, the runner and the wave color. States: `indeterminate`, `complete` and the tones. |
| `progress.ring, progress.arc, progress.label, progress.value` | Units of the circle and the label. |
| `progress.thickness.*, progress.rest-thickness.*, progress.active-gap, progress.dot-size, progress.stop-inset` | The line per size, the gap after the completed part, and the dot. |
| `progress.wave-amplitude, wave-length, wave-speed, wave-direction, wave-start, wave-end, wave-grow-duration` | The wave: its amplitude (0 for none), wavelength, speed and direction, the progress range where it animates, and how long it takes to appear. |
| `progress.ring-size.*, ring-thickness.*, ring-active-gap, ring-runner-length, ring-turn-duration, ring-wave-*` | The circle per size, its gaps, its rotating arc and its wave. |
| `progress.width, progress.gap, progress.head-gap, progress.accent … danger-subtle` | The width when not stretched, the label and the tones. |
| `spinner.size.*, spinner.ring-width.*, spinner.shape-size.*` | The ring and the shape, per size. |
| `spinner.box, spinner.ring, spinner.shape` | Units: the container (`contained`), the ring and the shape, each with its box. |
| `spinner.shape-1 … spinner.shape-7, spinner.morph-duration, spinner.morph-easing, spinner.spin-duration` | The sequence of shapes (names from the kit shapes), the cycle duration, the transition to each shape, and one rotation. |
| `spinner.gap` | The space between the ring and the label. |
| `spinner.cover-padding, spinner.cover-background` | The layer over a covered container. |

## API reference

### ProgressBar props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `Bind<number \| null>` | `null` | The progress. Use `null` or omit it when the progress is unknown: the bar shows continuous motion and a circle rotates. |
| `min / max` | `Bind<number>` | `0` / `100` | The limits of `value`. |
| `label` | `Bind<string>` | `''` | A label that names the bar. This is the same property as `text`. |
| `shape` | `Bind<'line' \| 'circle'>` | `'line'` | `line` shows a bar along a track, and `circle` shows an arc around a ring from the top. |
| `labelPosition` | `Bind<'top' \| 'bottom' \| 'side'>` | `'top'` (`'bottom'` for a circle) | `top` places the label and value above the bar, `bottom` places them below it, and `side` places the label before it and the value after it. |
| `showValue` | `Bind<boolean>` | `false` | Shows the percentage, rounded down to a whole number, or `valueText`. |
| `valueText` | `(value, fraction) => string` | — | The text shown and announced for a value (`3 of 12 files`). Because it is a function, it is stored as is and not bound. |
| `locale` | `Bind<string>` | The page `lang` | The locale of the percentage. |
| `tone` | `Bind<ProgressTone>` | `'accent'` | `accent`, `neutral`, `success`, `caution`, `danger`. |
| `size` | `Bind<ControlSize>` | `'md'` | The thickness, and the size of a circle: `sm`, `md` or `lg`. |
| `stretch` | `Bind<boolean>` | `false` | Stretches to the full width of its container. |
| `visible, enabled, …` | see Control |  | Properties shared by all controls. |

### Spinner props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | `Bind<string>` | `''` | Text next to the ring. This is the same property as `text`. |
| `labelPosition` | `Bind<'side' \| 'bottom'>` | `'side'` | Places the label after the ring or below it. |
| `size` | `Bind<ControlSize>` | `'md'` | `sm`, `md`, `lg`. |
| `tone` | `Bind<ProgressTone>` | `'accent'` | The color of the rotating part. |
| `contained` | `Bind<boolean>` | `false` | Places the spinner in its own container (a disc behind it), where the design language includes one. |
| `delay` | `Bind<number>` | `0` | The delay in milliseconds before it appears, counted from when it is created or shown again. Quick operations then show nothing. |
| `visible, …` | see Control |  | Showing it again with `visible` restarts the delay. |

### Properties and methods

| Member | Access / return value | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ProgressBar: every prop` | read/write, reactive | Accepts a value or a function, the same as the prop. |
| `ProgressBar: fraction` | read-only, reactive | The completed share from 0 to 1, or `null` while the progress is unknown. |
| `Spinner: every prop` | read/write, reactive | Accepts a value or a function, the same as the prop. |
| `Spinner: waiting` | read-only | Indicates that it is still within its delay. |
| `Spinner.cover(target, props?)` | `() => void` | Covers a component or element with a spinner. Call the returned function to remove it. See Covering a panel. |

# Tooltip

> Feedback · @motifx-community/ui 0.1.0-beta.5

A short description shown next to an element when the pointer rests on it, when it receives keyboard focus, or programmatically. Users can hover over the tooltip, Escape dismisses it, and only one is open at a time on the page.

## Import

```tsx
import { Tooltip, addTooltip, type TooltipShowOn } from '@motifx-community/ui';
```

## Declarative and programmatic

In JSX, place a tooltip anywhere and point it at its `target`. Its position in the markup does not matter. Programmatically, `new Tooltip({ target, text })` is all you need: it adds itself to the page the first time it appears and is removed along with its target component.

```tsx
import { Button, Tooltip } from '@motifx-community/ui';

/** A tooltip from JSX pointed at its target, and one created with `new` and opened programmatically. */
export default function Programmatic() {
  let save: Button | null = null;
  let target: Button | null = null;
  let tip: Tooltip | null = null;
  let opened = 0;

  const openProgrammatic = () => {
    if (!target) return;
    if (!tip) {
      tip = new Tooltip({ target });
      tip.placement = 'end';
    }
    tip.text = `Made programmatically, opened ${++opened} time(s)`;
    tip.open();
  };

  return (
    <>
      <Button ref={(b: Button) => (save = b)} text="Save" tone="accent" />
      <Tooltip target={() => save} text="Save the file (Ctrl+S)" />
      <Button ref={(b: Button) => (target = b)} text="Target" variant="outline" />
      <Button text="Open a tooltip programmatically" variant="outline" onclick={openProgrammatic} />
    </>
  );
}
```

## Icon-only buttons

A button with only an icon needs its own accessible name (`aria-label`). The tooltip displays that information and adds the shortcut as a description. Moving from one button to the next shows the next tooltip immediately.

```tsx
import { Button, Stack, Tooltip } from '@motifx-community/ui';

const BoldIcon = () => (
  <svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" aria-hidden="true">
    <path d="M4.5 2.5h4.25a2.75 2.75 0 0 1 0 5.5H4.5zM4.5 8h5a2.75 2.75 0 0 1 0 5.5h-5z" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linejoin="round" />
  </svg>
);

const ItalicIcon = () => (
  <svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" aria-hidden="true">
    <path d="M7 2.5h5M4 13.5h5M9.5 2.5l-3 11" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round" />
  </svg>
);

const LinkIcon = () => (
  <svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" aria-hidden="true">
    <path d="M6.5 9.5l3-3M7 4.5l1-1a2.83 2.83 0 0 1 4 4l-1 1M9 11.5l-1 1a2.83 2.83 0 0 1-4-4l1-1" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round" />
  </svg>
);

/** Icon-only buttons named with aria-label; the tooltips show the name and the shortcut. */
export default function IconButtons() {
  let bold: Button | null = null;
  let italic: Button | null = null;
  let link: Button | null = null;
  return (
    <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center" role="toolbar" aria-label="Text style">
      <Button ref={(b: Button) => (bold = b)} icon={() => <BoldIcon />} variant="ghost" aria-label="Bold" />
      <Button ref={(b: Button) => (italic = b)} icon={() => <ItalicIcon />} variant="ghost" aria-label="Italic" />
      <Button ref={(b: Button) => (link = b)} icon={() => <LinkIcon />} variant="ghost" aria-label="Link" />
      <Tooltip target={() => bold} text="Bold (Ctrl+B)" />
      <Tooltip target={() => italic} text="Italic (Ctrl+I)" />
      <Tooltip target={() => link} text="Insert a link (Ctrl+K)" />
    </Stack>
  );
}
```

## Tooltips on fields

On a TextBox, the whole field shows the tooltip on hover, and the input is described by it while it is visible, including on keyboard focus.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { TextBox, Tooltip } from '@motifx-community/ui';

/** A tooltip on a TextBox: the field shows it on hover, its input is described by it. */
export default function OnField() {
  const s = reactive({ email: '' });
  let email: TextBox | null = null;
  return (
    <>
      <TextBox ref={(b: TextBox) => (email = b)} label="Email" type="email" x-model={() => s.email} />
      <Tooltip target={() => email} text="We send the receipt here." placement="end" />
    </>
  );
}
```

## Placement

The default is `top`. The tooltip opens on the opposite side if there is no room, and `start` and `end` follow the reading direction. Try the RTL switch at the top of the page.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, Stack, Tooltip, type PopupPlacement } from '@motifx-community/ui';

const PLACEMENTS: PopupPlacement[] = ['top', 'bottom', 'start', 'end', 'top-start', 'bottom-end'];

/** The side the tooltip opens on, picked from the buttons. */
export default function Placement() {
  const s = reactive({ placement: 'top' as PopupPlacement });
  let target: Button | null = null;
  return (
    <>
      <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center" role="group" aria-label="Placement">
        {PLACEMENTS.map((placement) => (
          <Button
            key={placement}
            text={placement}
            size="sm"
            variant={() => (s.placement === placement ? 'solid' : 'ghost')}
            aria-pressed={() => s.placement === placement}
            onclick={() => (s.placement = placement)}
          />
        ))}
      </Stack>
      <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center">
        <Button ref={(b: Button) => (target = b)} text="Hover or focus me" variant="outline" />
        <Tooltip target={() => target} text={() => `Opens at ${s.placement}`} placement={() => s.placement} />
      </Stack>
    </>
  );
}
```

## Delay

The pointer must rest on the target for `delay` milliseconds (500 by default) before the tooltip appears, and `hideDelay` keeps it open briefly after the pointer leaves. Immediately after one closes, the next appears without a delay (`Tooltip.skipDelay`).

```tsx
import { Button, Tooltip } from '@motifx-community/ui';

const DELAYS = [0, 500, 1500];

/** Three tooltips that wait a different time before they show. */
export default function Delay() {
  const targets: Button[] = [];
  return (
    <>
      {DELAYS.map((delay, i) => (
        <span key={delay}>
          <Button ref={(b: Button) => (targets[i] = b)} text={`delay ${delay}`} variant="outline" />
          <Tooltip target={() => targets[i]} text={`Shown after ${delay} ms`} delay={delay} />
        </span>
      ))}
    </>
  );
}
```

## Rich content

JSX children or `content` (any component) appear after the text. Keep it short and never include buttons or links, because a tooltip cannot receive focus.

```tsx
import { Button, Tooltip } from '@motifx-community/ui';

/** A tooltip with markup after its text, given as JSX children. */
export default function RichContent() {
  let target: Button | null = null;
  return (
    <>
      <Button ref={(b: Button) => (target = b)} text="Rich tooltip" variant="outline" />
      <Tooltip target={() => target}>
        <strong>Bold</strong> makes the selection stand out. <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>B</kbd>
      </Tooltip>
    </>
  );
}
```

## Display triggers

`showOn` sets what displays the tooltip: `hover-focus` (the default), `focus` (keyboard focus only) or `manual` (only `open()` and `opened`). `enabled` turns a tooltip off.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, Tooltip } from '@motifx-community/ui';

/** A tooltip opened only programmatically, and one shown on keyboard focus while a toggle allows it. */
export default function ShowOn() {
  const s = reactive({ on: true });
  let help: Button | null = null;
  let tip: Tooltip | null = null;
  let keyboardOnly: Button | null = null;
  return (
    <>
      <Button ref={(b: Button) => (help = b)} text="Help" variant="outline" />
      <Tooltip ref={(t: Tooltip) => (tip = t)} target={() => help} text="Shown programmatically" showOn="manual" placement="bottom" />
      <Button text={() => (tip?.opened ? 'Hide it' : 'Show it')} onclick={() => tip && (tip.opened = !tip.opened)} />
      <Button text={() => (s.on ? 'Tooltips on' : 'Tooltips off')} toggle x-model={() => s.on} variant="ghost" />
      <Button ref={(b: Button) => (keyboardOnly = b)} text="Keyboard only" variant="outline" />
      <Tooltip target={() => keyboardOnly} text="Shown on keyboard focus, while the toggle is on" enabled={() => s.on} showOn="focus" />
    </>
  );
}
```

## Tooltips on many elements

`addTooltip(target, text)` gives an element a tooltip that is created only when first needed. All tooltips on the page share one set of document listeners, so hundreds of them have almost no cost. The function returns a remover.

```tsx
import { addTooltip, Button, Stack } from '@motifx-community/ui';

const SEATS = ['1', '2', '3', '4', '5', '6'].flatMap((row) =>
  ['A', 'B', 'C', 'D'].map((letter) => ({
    id: `${row}${letter}`,
    note: `Row ${row}, seat ${letter}: ${letter === 'A' || letter === 'D' ? 'window' : 'aisle'}${row === '1' ? ', extra legroom' : ''}`,
  })),
);

/** A tooltip on each of 24 seats, created only when first needed, and one that is removed programmatically. */
export default function ManyElements() {
  let removeGuideTip = () => {};
  return (
    <>
      <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center" role="group" aria-label="Seats">
        {SEATS.map((seat) => (
          <Button
            key={seat.id}
            ref={(b: Button) => {
              addTooltip(b, seat.note);
            }}
            text={seat.id}
            size="sm"
            variant="outline"
          />
        ))}
      </Stack>
      <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center">
        <Button
          ref={(b: Button) => (removeGuideTip = addTooltip(b, { text: 'Opens the guide', placement: 'end' }))}
          text="Guide"
          variant="outline"
        />
        <Button text="Remove the guide's tooltip" variant="ghost" onclick={() => removeGuideTip()} />
      </Stack>
    </>
  );
}
```

## Keyboard

| Key | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `Tab (focus on the target)` | Shows the tooltip immediately. Leaving the target hides it. |
| `Escape` | Hides the tooltip while focus stays in place. Only the tooltip closes, not the surrounding window. |

## Accessibility

| Topic | Details |
| --- | --- |
| `Role` | `role="tooltip"`, with one element per tooltip. |
| `Description` | While it is visible, the target or its focusable part, such as the input of a TextBox, has `aria-describedby` pointing to the tooltip, along with its own descriptions. |
| `Focus` | A tooltip never receives focus and contains nothing interactive. For buttons or links next to an element, open a drop-down (Button `dropDown`). |
| `WCAG 1.4.13` | Dismissible (Escape), hoverable (the pointer can move onto it) and persistent (it stays until the pointer or focus leaves). |
| `Pointer only?` | Tooltip content must also be available another way. An icon-only button still needs its own name (`aria-label`). |
| `Touch` | Touch does not show a tooltip, so provide the information another way for touch users. |

## Styling

| Hook | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `.mx-tooltip` | The tooltip. `data-side` reports the side it opened on (`top`, `bottom`, `start`, `end`). |
| `.mx-tooltip__text` | The text. |

### Component tokens

| Token | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `tooltip.offset, tooltip.enter-offset` | The gap to the target, and the distance it animates in from. |
| `tooltip.surface` | Unit: the tooltip and its box (`max-width` sets the width before wrapping, and `rich` applies with custom content). |
| `tooltip.arrow, tooltip.text` | Units: an optional arrow toward the target, and the text. |
| `tooltip.text-align` | The text alignment. |

## API reference

### Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `target` | `Bind<Element \| ComponentBase \| null>` | — | The element it describes. A function works for a component that appears later in the view (`() => this.save`). |
| `text` | `Bind<string>` | `''` | The tooltip text. |
| `content` | `Bind<ComponentBase \| null>` | — | Any content after the text, created the first time the tooltip appears. JSX children work too. Do not include interactive content. |
| `placement` | `Bind<PopupPlacement>` | `'top'` | `top`, `bottom`, `start` or `end`, each with `-start` or `-end`. It opens on the opposite side if there is no room, and start and end follow the reading direction. |
| `delay` | `Bind<number>` | `500` | The time in milliseconds the pointer must rest on the target before the tooltip appears. Keyboard focus shows it immediately. |
| `hideDelay` | `Bind<number>` | `150` | The time in milliseconds it stays after the pointer leaves, so the pointer can move onto it. |
| `showOn` | `Bind<TooltipShowOn>` | `'hover-focus'` | `hover-focus`, `focus` (keyboard focus only) or `manual` (only `open()`). |
| `enabled` | `Bind<boolean>` | `true` | `false` keeps the tooltip from appearing and closes it if it is open. |
| `onOpened, onClosed` | `() => void` | — | See Events. |

### Properties

| Property | Access | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `every prop above` | read/write, reactive | Accepts a value or a function, the same as the prop. |
| `opened` | read/write, reactive | Indicates whether it is visible. Set it to open or close the tooltip. |
| `Tooltip.skipDelay` | static, read/write | The time in milliseconds after a tooltip closes during which the next one appears immediately. The default is `300`, and `0` turns it off. |

### Methods

| Method | Returns | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `open()` | `boolean` | Shows the tooltip now, regardless of `showOn`. Returns `false` if there is no target on the page or the tooltip is disabled. |
| `close()` | `void` | Hides the tooltip. |
| `place()` | `void` | Repositions it relative to its target, for example after the target moves. |
| `addTooltip(target, text \| options)` | `() => void` | Adds a tooltip to one element, created on first use, and returns a function that removes it. For a component, it is removed along with the component. |

### Events

| Event | When |
| --- | --- |
| `onOpened` | Occurs after it is shown. |
| `onClosed` | Occurs after it is hidden. |

# Popover

> Feedback · @motifx-community/ui 0.1.0-beta.5

Displays content next to a related element, such as a title, a close button, a form or a card. It opens on click or on hover, follows its target, and points to it with an arrow where the design language includes one.

## Import

```tsx
import { Popover } from '@motifx-community/ui';
```

## Declarative and programmatic

JSX children are the content, and `target` specifies the element or component it opens next to. Programmatically, `content` sets the content, and `open()`, `close()` and `toggle()` control it. `value` and `x-model` report whether it is open.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, Popover, Stack, TextBox } from '@motifx-community/ui';

/** A popover with a title, a close button and a small form, and one created programmatically for a plain element. */
export default function Basic() {
    const s = reactive({ open: false, name: 'Ada', saved: '' });
    let button!: Button;
    let link!: HTMLElement;
    const coded = new Popover({ title: 'Programmatically', content: new Button({ text: 'OK', variant: 'outline', onclick: () => coded.close() }) });

    return (
        <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center">
            <Button ref={(b: Button) => (button = b)} text="Rename" variant="outline" />
            <Popover target={() => button} title="New name" showClose x-model={() => s.open}>
                <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center">
                    <TextBox label="Name" x-model={() => s.name} />
                    <Button text="Save" tone="accent" onclick={() => ((s.saved = s.name), (s.open = false))} />
                </Stack>
            </Popover>
            <output class="po-saved">{() => (s.saved ? `Saved: ${s.saved}` : s.open ? 'Open' : 'Closed')}</output>
            <a
                href="#from-code"
                class="po-link"
                ref={(c: { element: HTMLElement }) => (link = c.element)}
                onclick={(e: Event) => {
                    e.preventDefault();
                    coded.target = link;
                    coded.toggle();
                }}
            >
                A popover programmatically
            </a>
        </Stack>
    );
}
```

## Opening on hover

`showOn: 'hover'` opens the popover after `delay` while the pointer rests on the target, and when the target has keyboard focus. The pointer can move onto the popover, which closes `hideDelay` after the pointer leaves both.

```tsx
import { Avatar, Popover, Stack } from '@motifx-community/ui';

/** A card that opens while the pointer rests on a name, or when the name has keyboard focus. */
export default function Hover() {
    let name!: HTMLElement;
    return (
        <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center">
            <span>
                Reviewed by{' '}
                <a href="#ada" class="po-person" ref={(c: { element: HTMLElement }) => (name = c.element)} onclick={(e: Event) => e.preventDefault()}>
                    Ada Lovelace
                </a>
            </span>
            <Popover target={() => name} showOn="hover" placement="top" label="Ada Lovelace">
                <Stack orientation="horizontal" align="center">
                    <Avatar name="Ada Lovelace" size="lg" />
                    <Stack>
                        <strong>Ada Lovelace</strong>
                        <span>Analytical Engine, Programs</span>
                    </Stack>
                </Stack>
            </Popover>
        </Stack>
    );
}
```

## Placement, arrow and width

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, CheckBox, Popover, Stack, type PopupPlacement } from '@motifx-community/ui';

const PLACEMENTS: PopupPlacement[] = ['top-start', 'top', 'top-end', 'start', 'end', 'bottom-start', 'bottom', 'bottom-end'];

/** Every placement; the arrow where the language draws one, and a width of its own. */
export default function Placements() {
    const s = reactive({ arrow: true, placement: 'bottom' as PopupPlacement });
    let button!: Button;
    return (
        <Stack gap="md">
            <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center">
                {PLACEMENTS.map(placement => (
                    <Button key={placement} text={placement} variant={() => (s.placement === placement ? 'solid' : 'outline')} size="sm" onclick={() => (s.placement = placement)} />
                ))}
                <CheckBox label="Arrow" x-model={() => s.arrow} />
            </Stack>
            <div style="display: flex; justify-content: center; padding: 3rem 0">
                <Button ref={(b: Button) => (button = b)} text="Open" />
            </div>
            <Popover target={() => button} placement={() => s.placement} arrow={() => s.arrow} width="16rem" label="Placement">
                <p>{() => `Placed at ${s.placement}; it moves to the other side when there is no room.`}</p>
            </Popover>
        </Stack>
    );
}
```

## Keeping it open

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, Popover, Stack, TextArea } from '@motifx-community/ui';

/** A click outside does not close it, and onClosing keeps it open while there is unsaved text. Escape and the button close it. */
export default function Events() {
    const s = reactive({ note: '', told: '' });
    let button!: Button;
    let pop!: Popover;
    return (
        <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center">
            <Button ref={(b: Button) => (button = b)} text="Add a note" variant="outline" />
            <Popover
                ref={(p: Popover) => (pop = p)}
                target={() => button}
                title="Note"
                closeOnOutside={false}
                onClosing={e => {
                    if (e.reason === 'escape' && s.note.trim() !== '') {
                        e.cancel = true;
                        s.told = 'Save or clear the note first.';
                    }
                }}
                onClosed={reason => (s.told = `Closed: ${String(reason)}`)}
            >
                <Stack gap="sm">
                    <TextArea label="Text" x-model={() => s.note} rows={3} />
                    <Button text="Save" tone="accent" onclick={() => ((s.note = ''), pop.close())} />
                </Stack>
            </Popover>
            <output class="po-told">{() => s.told}</output>
        </Stack>
    );
}
```

## Behavior

| Topic | Details |
| --- | --- |
| `Opening` | The popover opens on target click, on hover (`hover`), or programmatically. It appears in the browser's top layer next to the target and follows it as the page scrolls. |
| `Focus` | When opened by a click or programmatically, focus moves to the first focusable element inside, or to the popover itself, and returns to the target when it closes. When opened by hover, focus stays where it is. |
| `Closing` | It closes on Escape, a click outside it and its target, focus leaving both (Tab), the close button, another click on the target, or the pointer leaving both (`hover`). `onClosing` can keep it open. |
| `Placement` | `placement` sets the side and alignment, as in the kit's other popups. If there is no room on that side, it opens on the opposite side. |
| `Where it lives` | When created programmatically, it is placed in the nearest container of its target that can hold it, so it stays in the target's window and landmark. |

## Accessibility

| Topic | Details |
| --- | --- |
| `Role` | `dialog`, named by its title or by `label`. Always provide one of them. |
| `Target` | `aria-controls` and `aria-expanded`, plus `aria-haspopup="dialog"` when a click opens it. |
| `Keyboard` | Tab moves through the content and out, which closes the popover. Escape closes it and returns focus. A `hover` popover also opens on keyboard focus. |
| `Arrow` | Decorative. |

## Styling

| Hook | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `.mx-popover` | The popover. `data-side` (`top`, `bottom`, `start`, `end`), `data-arrow`. |
| `.mx-popover__arrow` | The arrow. |
| `.mx-popover__header, .mx-popover__title, .mx-popover__close` | The header, its title and the close button. |
| `.mx-popover__body` | The content. |

### Component tokens

| Token | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `popover.surface, .arrow, .header, .title, .body` | Units: the surface (`focus`), the arrow (`display`, `size`, its fill and frame), the header, the title and the body. |
| `popover.close` | Place: the appearance of the close button (`variant`). |
| `popover.offset, .enter-offset, .header-gap` | The gap to the target, the distance it animates in from, and the space between the title and close button. |

## API reference

### Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `target` | `Bind<Element \| ComponentBase \| null>` | `null` | The element or component it opens next to. |
| `title` | `Bind<string>` | `''` | A title in the header. This is the same property as `text`. |
| `label` | `Bind<string>` | `''` | The accessible name when there is no title. |
| `content` | `Bind<ComponentBase \| null>` | `null` | Content set programmatically, shown after the JSX children. |
| `showOn` | `Bind<PopoverShowOn>` | `'click'` | `click` toggles it when the target is clicked, `hover` opens it on hover or keyboard focus, and `manual` leaves it to your code. |
| `placement` | `Bind<PopupPlacement>` | `'bottom'` | The side and alignment. It opens on the opposite side if there is no room. |
| `arrow` | `Bind<boolean>` | `true` | Shows an arrow toward the target, where the design language includes one. |
| `showClose` | `Bind<boolean>` | `false` | Shows a close button in the header. |
| `width` | `Bind<string \| number \| null>` | `null` | A custom width, as a CSS length or in pixels. |
| `closeOnOutside` | `Bind<boolean>` | `true` | Closes the popover on a click outside it and its target. |
| `delay, hideDelay` | `Bind<number>` | `300`, `200` | The time in milliseconds the pointer must rest on the target before it opens, and the time it stays after the pointer leaves both (`showOn: 'hover'`). |
| `value` | `Bind<boolean>` | `false` | Indicates whether it is open. `x-model` provides two-way binding. |

### Events, properties and methods

| Member | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `onOpened` | event | Occurs when it opens. |
| `onClosing` | event | Occurs before it closes (`reason`). Set `cancel = true` to keep it open. |
| `onClosed` | event | Occurs when it closes, with the reason: `escape`, `outside`, `focus`, `toggle`, `hover`, `close-button` or `code`. |
| `open(), close(reason?), toggle()` | `boolean` / `void` | Programmatic control. `open()` returns `false` if there is no target on the page or the popover is disabled. |
| `place()` | `void` | Repositions it relative to its target after its content changes size. |
| `isOpen` | read-only | Indicates whether it is currently open. |
| `closeButton, body` | read-only | The kit close button, and the part that holds the content. |
