# BottomNavigation

> Navigation · @motifx-community/ui 0.1.0-beta.5

The destinations of an application at the bottom of the screen, each an icon with a label. The bar is one Tab stop, marks the selected item for screen readers and keeps clear of the home indicator of a phone.

## Import

```tsx
import { BottomNavigation } from '@motifx-community/ui';
```

## Destinations

`items` defines the destinations, and `x-model` binds the selected one. `badge` shows a count on the icon, `dot` shows a dot, and `activeGlyph` changes the glyph while the item is selected.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { BottomNavigation, Stack } from '@motifx-community/ui';

/** Three destinations bound to a value, with a count on one of them. */
export default function Basic() {
    const s = reactive({ page: 'home', unread: 3 });
    return (
        <Stack gap="md" style="inline-size: 100%; max-inline-size: 420px">
            <BottomNavigation
                class="bn-basic"
                position="static"
                x-model={() => s.page}
                items={[
                    { value: 'home', text: 'Home', glyph: 'star', activeGlyph: 'star-filled' },
                    { value: 'inbox', text: 'Inbox', glyph: 'file', badge: () => s.unread },
                    { value: 'calendar', text: 'Calendar', glyph: 'calendar' },
                    { value: 'profile', text: 'Profile', glyph: 'person', dot: true }
                ]}
            />
            <output class="bn-told">{() => `Page: ${s.page}`}</output>
        </Stack>
    );
}
```

## Labels

`labelMode` shows the labels always, only on the selected item, or never. A label out of view stays as the accessible name of the item.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { BottomNavigation, ButtonGroup, Stack } from '@motifx-community/ui';

const ITEMS = [
    { value: 'home', text: 'Home', glyph: 'star' },
    { value: 'search', text: 'Search', glyph: 'search' },
    { value: 'alarms', text: 'Alarms', glyph: 'clock' },
    { value: 'locked', text: 'Locked', glyph: 'lock', enabled: false }
];

/** `labelMode`: a label out of view stays as the accessible name of the item. */
export default function Labels() {
    const s = reactive({ mode: 'active' as 'always' | 'active' | 'never', page: 'home' });
    return (
        <Stack gap="md" style="inline-size: 100%; max-inline-size: 420px">
            <ButtonGroup
                label="Label mode"
                x-model={() => s.mode}
                items={[
                    { value: 'always', text: 'Always' },
                    { value: 'active', text: 'Active' },
                    { value: 'never', text: 'Never' }
                ]}
            />
            <BottomNavigation class="bn-labels" label="Sections" position="static" labelMode={() => s.mode} x-model={() => s.page} items={ITEMS} />
        </Stack>
    );
}
```

## Refusing a change

`onSelecting` occurs before the selection changes, and setting `cancel` keeps the current item.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { BottomNavigation, Stack, Switch } from '@motifx-community/ui';

/** `onSelecting` keeps the page while there are unsaved changes. */
export default function Guarded() {
    const s = reactive({ page: 'edit', dirty: true, told: '' });
    return (
        <Stack gap="md" style="inline-size: 100%; max-inline-size: 420px">
            <Switch label="Unsaved changes" x-model={() => s.dirty} />
            <BottomNavigation
                class="bn-guarded"
                label="Document"
                position="static"
                x-model={() => s.page}
                onSelecting={e => {
                    e.cancel = s.dirty;
                    s.told = s.dirty ? 'Save your changes first.' : '';
                }}
                items={[
                    { value: 'edit', text: 'Edit', glyph: 'pencil' },
                    { value: 'files', text: 'Files', glyph: 'file' },
                    { value: 'share', text: 'Share', glyph: 'upload' }
                ]}
            />
            <output class="bn-guard-told">{() => s.told}</output>
        </Stack>
    );
}
```

## In a screen

By default, the bar is fixed to the bottom of the viewport. In a box that scrolls, use `position='sticky'`. `hideOnScroll` moves it away while scrolling down.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { AppBar, BottomNavigation } from '@motifx-community/ui';

const ROWS = Array.from({ length: 30 }, (_, i) => `Message ${i + 1}`);

/** A phone screen: the two bars around a box that scrolls. Scrolling down moves the bottom bar away. */
export default function Screen() {
    const s = reactive({ page: 'mail' });
    return (
        <div class="bn-screen" tabindex="0" style="position: relative; inline-size: min(100%, 390px); block-size: 420px; overflow: auto; border: 1px solid var(--mx-color-stroke-divider)">
            <AppBar title="Messages" navigation="menu" />
            {ROWS.map(row => (
                <p key={row} style="margin: 0; padding: 12px 16px">
                    {row}
                </p>
            ))}
            <BottomNavigation
                class="bn-scroll"
                label="Screens"
                position="sticky"
                hideOnScroll
                x-model={() => s.page}
                items={[
                    { value: 'mail', text: 'Messages', glyph: 'file' },
                    { value: 'calendar', text: 'Calendar', glyph: 'calendar' },
                    { value: 'profile', text: 'Profile', glyph: 'person' }
                ]}
            />
        </div>
    );
}
```

## Programmatic use

`new BottomNavigation(props)` creates the bar without JSX. Each prop is also a property.

```tsx
import { Component } from '@motifx/core';
import { BottomNavigation, Button, Stack } from '@motifx-community/ui';

/** A bar created programmatically. Each prop is also a property that can be set later. */
export default class Programmatic extends Component<HTMLDivElement> {
    constructor() {
        super('div');
        const bar = new BottomNavigation({
            label: 'Search pages',
            position: 'static',
            value: 'home',
            items: [
                { value: 'home', text: 'Home', glyph: 'star' },
                { value: 'search', text: 'Search', glyph: 'search' }
            ]
        });
        const go = new Button({ text: 'Go to Search', variant: 'outline', onclick: () => (bar.value = 'search') });
        const stack = new Stack({ gap: 'md' });
        stack.controls.add(bar, go);
        this.controls.add(stack);
    }
}
```

## API reference

### Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `items` | `Bind<readonly BottomNavigationItem[]>` | `[]` | The destinations. The bar is designed for three to five; use a `Drawer` for more. |
| `value` | `Bind<string \| number \| null>` | `null` | The `value` of the selected item. `x-model` provides two-way binding. |
| `label` | `Bind<string>` | The kit string “Navigation” | The accessible name of the bar. |
| `labelMode` | `Bind<'always' \| 'active' \| 'never'>` | `'always'` | When items show their labels. A label out of view stays as the accessible name of the item. |
| `position` | `Bind<'fixed' \| 'sticky' \| 'static'>` | `'fixed'` | How the bar stays on the page. |
| `hideOnScroll` | `Bind<boolean>` | `false` | Moves the bar away while scrolling down, and brings it back while scrolling up. |
| `scrollTarget` | `Bind<HTMLElement \| null>` | The nearest ancestor that scrolls | What `hideOnScroll` watches. Without a scrolling ancestor, it is the page. |

### Item fields

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `string \| number` | Its position | What `value` is when this item is selected. |
| `text` | `Bind<string>` | — | The label, which is also the accessible name. |
| `glyph, activeGlyph` | `Bind<string>` | `''` | The glyph, and the glyph while selected. |
| `icon, activeIcon` | `Bind<IconSource \| null>` | `null` | An image, an element or a component, used instead of a glyph. |
| `href, rel, target` | `Bind<string>` | `''` | Make the item a link. Use `rel: 'router'` for routed pages. |
| `badge` | `Bind<number \| null>` | `null` | A count in a badge on the icon. |
| `dot` | `Bind<boolean>` | `false` | A dot on the icon instead of a count. |
| `enabled, visible` | `Bind<boolean>` | `true` | A disabled item is dimmed and cannot be selected. A hidden item is removed. |
| `click` | `(e) => void` | — | Occurs when the item is pressed. |
| `data` | `unknown` | — | A custom application value for the item. |

### Properties and methods

| Member | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `selectedItem` | `BottomNavigationItem \| null` | The selected item. |
| `focus()` | `boolean` | Moves focus to the item Tab reaches. |

### Events

| Event | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `onSelecting` | `{ value, previous, item, previousItem, originalEvent, source, cancel }` | Occurs before the selection changes. Setting `cancel` keeps the current item, and a link is not followed. |
| `onSelectionChanged` | `{ value, previous, item, previousItem, originalEvent, source }` | Occurs after the selection changes. |
| `onItemClick` | `{ item, value, originalEvent, source }` | Occurs when an item is pressed, after its own `click`. |

### Keyboard

| Key | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `Tab` | Moves focus into the bar, to the selected item, and out of it. |
| `Left, Right` | Moves between the items, wrapping around at the ends. The direction follows the page. |
| `Home, End` | Moves to the first or the last item. |
| `Enter, Space` | Selects the focused item. |

### Accessibility

| Topic | Details |
| --- | --- |
| `Landmark` | The bar is a `<nav>` with an accessible name. |
| `Selected item` | `aria-current="page"` marks it for screen readers. |
| `Disabled item` | `aria-disabled="true"`; the arrow keys pass over it. |
| `Focus` | A bar moved away by `hideOnScroll` comes back when focus enters it. |

### Styling hooks

| Hook | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `.mx-bottom-navigation` | The bar. `data-label-mode`, `data-position` and `data-hidden` describe its state. |
| `.mx-bottom-navigation__list, .mx-bottom-navigation__item` | The row and an item. `data-selected` and `aria-disabled` describe an item. |
| `.mx-bottom-navigation__indicator, .mx-bottom-navigation__icon-host, .mx-bottom-navigation__glyph, .mx-bottom-navigation__icon, .mx-bottom-navigation__label, .mx-bottom-navigation__badge` | The mark of the selected item, the box of the icon, its glyph or icon, the label and the badge. |

### Design tokens

| Token | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `bottom-navigation.bar, .list, .item, .indicator, .icon-host, .label` | Units: the bar, the row, an item (`hover`, `pressed`, `focus`, `selected`, `disabled`), the mark (`selected`), the box of the icon and the label (`selected`). |

# Tabs

> Navigation · @motifx-community/ui 0.1.0-beta.5

Tabs display one panel at a time below a tab strip. You can define them in JSX or programmatically, and they support closable tabs, icons and badges, scroll buttons when tabs overflow, four placements, and panels that are created on first display.

## Import

```tsx
import { Tabs, Tab } from '@motifx-community/ui';
```

## Declarative and programmatic

The children of a `<Tab>` are its panel. `value` is the `key` of the selected tab, or its index, and `x-model` provides two-way binding. When you create the component with `new`, add, insert and remove tabs programmatically.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, Stack, Tab, Tabs, TextBox } from '@motifx-community/ui';

/** Tabs from JSX bound with x-model, and tabs created with `new` and added programmatically. */
export default function Programmatic() {
  const s = reactive({ page: 'general' as string | number, name: '', log: '' });
  let added = 0;

  const reports = new Tabs({ label: 'Reports', closable: true });
  reports.add(new Tab({ title: 'Summary', content: () => <p>The summary, built when it was first shown.</p> }));
  reports.onSelectionChanged((e) => (s.log = e.tab ? `Selected “${e.tab.title}”${e.byUser ? ' by the user' : ' programmatically'}.` : 'No tab left.'));

  const addReport = () => {
    const n = ++added;
    const tab = reports.add(new Tab({ title: `Report ${n}`, content: () => <p>Report {n}.</p> }));
    reports.select(tab);
  };

  return (
    <>
      <Tabs label="Settings" x-model={() => s.page}>
        <Tab key="general" title="&General">
          <TextBox label="Name" x-model={() => s.name} helpText="Its text stays while you switch tabs." />
        </Tab>
        <Tab key="advanced" title="&Advanced">
          <p>Advanced settings.</p>
        </Tab>
        <Tab key="about" title="A&bout">
          <p>Version 1.0.</p>
        </Tab>
      </Tabs>
      <output class="tabs-page">{() => `value: "${s.page}"`}</output>
      <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center">
        <Button text="Add a report programmatically" variant="outline" onclick={addReport} />
        <output class="tabs-log">{() => s.log}</output>
      </Stack>
      <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center" class="tabs-coded" style="inline-size: 100%" onBuilt={(c) => c.controls.add(reports)} />
    </>
  );
}
```

## Closable tabs

`closable` adds a close button to every tab, and a tab's own `closable` takes precedence. Delete or a middle-click closes the focused or hovered tab. `onClose` can cancel the action, for example to confirm unsaved changes.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, Tab, Tabs } from '@motifx-community/ui';

const HomeIcon = () => (
  <svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" aria-hidden="true">
    <path d="M2.5 7.5L8 3l5.5 4.5M4 6.5v6.5h8V6.5" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.3" stroke-linejoin="round" />
  </svg>
);

/** A close button on every tab but Home; onClose keeps the draft open while it is protected. */
export default function Closable() {
  const s = reactive({ keepDraft: true });
  return (
    <>
      <Button
        text={() => (s.keepDraft ? 'Draft is protected' : 'Draft can close')}
        variant="outline"
        size="sm"
        toggle
        x-model={() => s.keepDraft}
      />
      <Tabs
        label="Documents"
        closable
        onClose={(e) => {
          if (e.tab.key === 'draft' && s.keepDraft) e.cancel = true;
        }}
      >
        <Tab title="Home" icon={() => <HomeIcon />} closable={false}>
          <p>Home cannot be closed.</p>
        </Tab>
        <Tab key="draft" title="Draft">
          <p>Closing is cancelled while the draft is protected.</p>
        </Tab>
        <Tab title="Notes">
          <p>Notes.</p>
        </Tab>
        <Tab title="Ideas">
          <p>Ideas.</p>
        </Tab>
      </Tabs>
    </>
  );
}
```

## Overflow

When tabs do not fit, arrow buttons scroll the strip (`scrollButtons`, on by default). The selected tab and the focused tab scroll into view.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, Stack, Tab, Tabs } from '@motifx-community/ui';

const MONTHS = ['January', 'February', 'March', 'April', 'May', 'June', 'July', 'August', 'September', 'October', 'November', 'December'];

/** Twelve tabs in a narrow strip, with scroll buttons that can be turned off. */
export default function ManyTabs() {
  const s = reactive({ scrollButtons: true });

  const months = new Tabs({ label: 'Months', scrollButtons: () => s.scrollButtons });
  for (const month of MONTHS) months.add(new Tab({ title: month, content: () => <p>{month}: nothing planned yet.</p> }));

  return (
    <>
      <Button text="Scroll buttons" variant="outline" size="sm" toggle x-model={() => s.scrollButtons} />
      <Stack class="tabs-months" style="inline-size: 100%; max-inline-size: 28rem" onBuilt={(c) => c.controls.add(months)} />
    </>
  );
}
```

## Placement

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, Stack, Tab, Tabs, type TabsPlacement } from '@motifx-community/ui';

const PLACEMENTS: TabsPlacement[] = ['top', 'bottom', 'start', 'end'];

/** The strip above, below, or beside the panel. */
export default function Placement() {
  const s = reactive({ placement: 'top' as TabsPlacement });
  return (
    <>
      <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center" role="group" aria-label="Placement">
        {PLACEMENTS.map((placement) => (
          <Button
            key={placement}
            text={placement}
            size="sm"
            variant={() => (s.placement === placement ? 'solid' : 'ghost')}
            aria-pressed={() => s.placement === placement}
            onclick={() => (s.placement = placement)}
          />
        ))}
      </Stack>
      <Tabs label="Placement" class="tabs-placement" placement={() => s.placement}>
        <Tab title="Profile">
          <p>Profile.</p>
        </Tab>
        <Tab title="Security">
          <p>Security.</p>
        </Tab>
        <Tab title="Billing">
          <p>Billing.</p>
        </Tab>
      </Tabs>
    </>
  );
}
```

## Manual activation

By default, an arrow key selects the tab it moves to. With `activation="manual"`, it only moves focus, and Enter or Space selects the tab. This works better when a panel is slow to display.

```tsx
import { Tab, Tabs } from '@motifx-community/ui';

/** Arrow keys move focus only; Enter or Space selects. */
export default function ManualActivation() {
  return (
    <Tabs label="Manual" class="tabs-manual" activation="manual">
      <Tab title="One">
        <p>One.</p>
      </Tab>
      <Tab title="Two">
        <p>Two.</p>
      </Tab>
      <Tab title="Three">
        <p>Three.</p>
      </Tab>
    </Tabs>
  );
}
```

## Icons, badges and disabled tabs

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, Tab, Tabs } from '@motifx-community/ui';

const MailIcon = () => (
  <svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" aria-hidden="true">
    <path d="M2.5 4h11v8h-11zM2.5 4.5L8 8.5l5.5-4" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.3" stroke-linejoin="round" />
  </svg>
);

/** A tab with an icon, a count that follows state and a tooltip, and a disabled tab. */
export default function IconsAndBadges() {
  const s = reactive({ unread: 3 });
  return (
    <Tabs label="Mail">
      <Tab title="Inbox" icon={() => <MailIcon />} badge={() => (s.unread ? s.unread : null)} hint="Mail you have not read">
        <Button text="Read one" variant="outline" onclick={() => (s.unread = Math.max(0, s.unread - 1))} />
      </Tab>
      <Tab title="Sent">
        <p>Sent mail.</p>
      </Tab>
      <Tab title="Archive" enabled={false}>
        <p>Archive.</p>
      </Tab>
    </Tabs>
  );
}
```

## Variants and sizes

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, Stack, Tab, Tabs, type TabsVariant } from '@motifx-community/ui';

const VARIANTS: TabsVariant[] = ['line', 'pill'];

/** Both variants in the three sizes, stretched or not. */
export default function VariantsAndSizes() {
  const s = reactive({ variant: 'line' as TabsVariant, stretch: false });
  return (
    <>
      <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center">
        {VARIANTS.map((variant) => (
          <Button
            key={variant}
            text={variant}
            size="sm"
            variant={() => (s.variant === variant ? 'solid' : 'ghost')}
            aria-pressed={() => s.variant === variant}
            onclick={() => (s.variant = variant)}
          />
        ))}
        <Button text="Stretch" size="sm" variant="outline" toggle x-model={() => s.stretch} />
      </Stack>
      {(['sm', 'md', 'lg'] as const).map((size) => (
        <Tabs key={size} label={`Size ${size}`} size={size} variant={() => s.variant} stretch={() => s.stretch}>
          <Tab title="Day">
            <p>{`Size ${size}.`}</p>
          </Tab>
          <Tab title="Week">
            <p>Week.</p>
          </Tab>
          <Tab title="Month">
            <p>Month.</p>
          </Tab>
        </Tabs>
      ))}
    </>
  );
}
```

## Lazy panels

A panel is created the first time it is shown and then kept, so user input is preserved (`lazy`, on by default). `lazy={false}` creates every panel immediately. A tab with a `content` factory and `keepAlive={false}` has its content disposed while hidden and recreated when shown. JSX children are created once by the page, so they are always kept.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Stack, Tab, Tabs, TextBox } from '@motifx-community/ui';

/** Panels created when first shown: one is kept, and one is recreated each time it is shown. */
export default function LazyPanels() {
  const s = reactive({ builds: 0 });

  const tabs = new Tabs({ label: 'Lazy panels' });
  tabs.add(new Tab({ title: 'First', content: () => <p>Always here.</p> }));
  tabs.add(
    new Tab({
      title: 'Kept',
      content: () => {
        s.builds++;
        return <TextBox label="Type, switch tabs, come back" />;
      },
    }),
  );
  tabs.add(
    new Tab({
      title: 'Made each time',
      keepAlive: false,
      content: () => {
        s.builds++;
        return <TextBox label="This one starts empty each time" />;
      },
    }),
  );

  return (
    <>
      <Stack style="inline-size: 100%" onBuilt={(c) => c.controls.add(tabs)} />
      <output class="tabs-builds">{() => `Panels built: ${s.builds}`}</output>
    </>
  );
}
```

## Keyboard

| Key | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `Tab` | Moves focus to the selected tab, then into its panel. |
| `Left / Right` | Moves to the previous or next tab, wrapping at the ends (reversed for right-to-left text). With `start` and `end` placement, use Up and Down. |
| `Home / End` | Moves to the first or last tab. |
| `Enter / Space` | Selects the focused tab (with `activation="manual"`). |
| `Delete` | Closes the focused tab if it is closable. |
| `Alt + key (`&General`)` | Selects that tab and moves focus to it (Control + Option + key on Apple platforms). |

## Accessibility

| Topic | Details |
| --- | --- |
| `Roles` | `tablist`, `tab` (a `<button>`) and `tabpanel`, with `aria-orientation="vertical"` for `start` and `end` placement. |
| `State` | `aria-selected` on the tabs. `aria-controls` links a tab to its panel, and `aria-labelledby` names the panel after its tab. |
| `Focus` | The strip has one Tab stop, on the selected tab. A panel with no focusable content receives focus itself (`tabindex="0"`), so its text can be reached. |
| `Disabled tabs` | `aria-disabled="true"`. The arrow keys skip these tabs. |
| `Close button` | Not a Tab stop and hidden from screen readers, because a button inside a tab would be a control within a control. Delete closes the tab, and `aria-keyshortcuts="Delete"` announces it. Its tooltip comes from `uiLocale`. |
| `Scroll buttons` | These are for pointer use only and are hidden from screen readers. The arrow keys reach every tab and scroll it into view. |

## Localization

Tabs have one string of their own, the close button tooltip `uiLocale.strings.close`. Every tab updates immediately when it changes.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, uiLocale } from '@motifx-community/ui';
import { kitTexts } from '../../../shared/kit-texts';

/** Switches the texts of every component on the page, the tabs' close button included. */
export default function Localization() {
  const s = reactive({ lang: 'en' });
  const toggle = () => {
    s.lang = s.lang === 'en' ? 'tr' : 'en';
    void uiLocale.use(s.lang);
  };
  return (
    <>
      <Button text={() => (s.lang === 'en' ? 'Language: English' : 'Dil: Türkçe')} variant="outline" onclick={toggle} />
      <span>
        The close button reads <output class="tabs-close-name">{() => kitTexts.strings.close}</output>
      </span>
    </>
  );
}
```

## Styling

| Hook | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `.mx-tabs` | The root. `data-placement`, `data-variant`, `data-size`, `data-stretch`, `data-overflow`, `data-scroll-buttons`, `data-disabled`. |
| `.mx-tabs__strip, .mx-tabs__list` | The strip and its tab list, which is the scrolling box. |
| `.mx-tabs__tab` | A tab: `aria-selected`, `aria-disabled`, `data-closable`. |
| `.mx-tabs__icon, .mx-tabs__label, .mx-tabs__badge, .mx-tabs__close` | The parts of a tab. |
| `.mx-tabs__scroll` | A scroll button: `data-direction` (`back`, `forward`), and `data-end` when it cannot scroll further. |
| `.mx-tabs__panels, .mx-tabs__panel` | The panels and a panel (the tab's own element). |

### Component tokens

| Token | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `tabs.container, tabs.strip, tabs.list, tabs.scroll, tabs.scroll-icon` | Units: the root, the strip with its line along the panel (`bottom`, `start`, `end`; the pill tray: `pill`, `pill-bottom` …), the tab row, the scroll buttons and their glyph. |
| `tabs.tab, tabs.label, tabs.icon, tabs.badge, tabs.close, tabs.close-icon` | Units: a tab in each state (`hover`, `pressed`, `selected`, `disabled`, `focus`; in the pill variant `pill`, `pill-hover` …) and its parts. |
| `tabs.indicator, tabs.separator, tabs.panel` | Units: the line variant indicator (`vertical`, `hover`, `selected`, `selected-disabled`), a divider between tabs, and the panel (`pill`, `pill-across`, `focus`). |
| `tabs.height.*, tabs.pill-height.*, tabs.padding.*, tabs.font-size.*, tabs.line-height.*, tabs.indicator-inset.*` | Sizes per size class. |
| `tabs.pill-gap, tabs.tab-overlap, tabs.indicator-offset, tabs.indicator-inset-vertical, tabs.close-pull, tabs.vertical-width` | Layout measurements: the gap between pills, the offset over the strip line, the indicator, the close button, and the width of a vertical strip. |
| `tabs.curve-display, tabs.curve-size, tabs.curve-frame-width, tabs.curve-frame-color` | Outward curves at the corners of the selected tab on the panel side, in its fill color. |

## API reference

### Tabs props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `Bind<string \| number \| null>` | The first tab | The `key` of the selected tab, or its index. `x-model` provides two-way binding. |
| `selectedIndex` | `Bind<number>` | `0` | The index of the selected tab in `tabs`. |
| `label` | `Bind<string>` | `''` | The accessible name of the tab list (`aria-label`). This is the same property as `text`. |
| `activation` | `Bind<'auto' \| 'manual'>` | `'auto'` | With `auto`, an arrow key selects the tab it moves to. With `manual`, arrow keys only move focus, and Enter or Space selects. |
| `placement` | `Bind<TabsPlacement>` | `'top'` | `top`, `bottom`, `start` or `end`. `start` and `end` stack the tabs vertically. |
| `variant` | `Bind<TabsVariant>` | `'line'` | `line` shows a bar on the selected tab. `pill` places the tabs on a tray and raises the selected one. |
| `size` | `Bind<ControlSize>` | `'md'` | `sm`, `md`, `lg`, from the density tokens. |
| `stretch` | `Bind<boolean>` | `false` | Makes the tabs share the full width. |
| `scrollButtons` | `Bind<boolean>` | `true` | Shows arrow buttons at the ends of the strip when tabs do not fit. When off, a thin scrollbar appears. |
| `closable` | `Bind<boolean>` | `false` | Adds a close button to every tab. A tab's own `closable` takes precedence. |
| `lazy` | `Bind<boolean>` | `true` | Creates a panel the first time it is shown and then keeps it. A tab's own `lazy` takes precedence. |
| `keepAlive` | `Bind<boolean>` | `true` | With `false`, content created by a tab's `content` is disposed while hidden and recreated when shown. A tab's own `keepAlive` takes precedence. |
| `enabled / disabled, visible, tabStop, tabIndex` | see Control |  | Properties shared by all controls. `tabStop={false}` removes the tab strip from the Tab order. |

### Tab props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `title` | `Bind<string>` | `''` | The caption. `&General` makes Alt+G select the tab. This is the same property as `text`. |
| `key` | `Bind<string>` | `''` | Identifies the tab in `value`. The JSX `key` also works. |
| `icon` | `Bind<IconSource \| null>` | — | An icon before the title. |
| `badge` | `Bind<string \| number \| null>` | — | Short text after the title, such as a count. An empty value or `null` hides it. |
| `hint` | `Bind<string>` | `''` | The tooltip text. |
| `closable` | `Bind<boolean \| undefined>` | From Tabs | Shows a close button on this tab. |
| `lazy, keepAlive` | `Bind<boolean \| undefined>` | From Tabs | This tab's own setting. |
| `content` | `() => ComponentBase \| ComponentBase[]` | — | Creates the panel content when the panel is created, either instead of or after the JSX children. |
| `enabled` | `Bind<boolean>` | `true` | `false` means the tab cannot be selected and the arrow keys skip it. |
| `visible` | `Bind<boolean>` | `true` | `false` removes the tab. If it is selected, the selection moves to an adjacent tab. |

### Properties

| Property | Access | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `every prop above` | read/write, reactive | Accepts a value or a function, the same as the prop. |
| `tabs` | read-only, reactive | The tabs in strip order. |
| `selectedTab` | read-only, reactive | The selected `Tab`, or `null` if there is none. |
| `Tab.isSelected, Tab.isClosable` | read-only, reactive | Indicate whether the tab is selected and whether it shows a close button. |
| `Tab.contentBuilt` | read-only | Indicates whether its panel has been created. |
| `Tab.owner, Tab.headerElement` | read-only | Its `Tabs` and its button in the strip. A tab's own element is its panel. |

### Methods

| Method | Returns | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `add(tab)` | `Tab` | Adds a tab at the end. A tab from another `Tabs` moves here. |
| `insert(index, tab)` | `Tab` | Adds a tab at an index. |
| `remove(tab)` | `boolean` | Removes the tab and disposes it, without raising `onClose`. Selection and focus move to an adjacent tab. |
| `select(tab \| index)` | `boolean` | Selects a tab programmatically. Returns `false` if it is hidden or missing. |
| `close(tab)` | `boolean` | Closes a tab as its close button does, so `onClose` can cancel it. |
| `focus()` | `boolean` | Sets focus on the selected tab. |
| `Tab.select(), Tab.close(), Tab.focus()` | `boolean` | Same as the methods above, called on the tab. |

### Events

| Event | When |
| --- | --- |
| `onSelecting(e)` | Occurs before the user selects a tab. `e`: `{ tab, index, previousTab, previousIndex, cancel, source, event }`. Set `e.cancel = true` to keep the current tab. |
| `onSelectionChanged(e)` | Occurs after the selected tab changes. `e`: `{ tab, index, previousTab, previousIndex, byUser, source, event? }`. |
| `onClose(e)` | Occurs before a tab closes, from its button, Delete, a middle-click or `close()`. `e`: `{ tab, index, byUser, cancel, source, event? }`. |

# Breadcrumb

> Navigation · @motifx-community/ui 0.1.0-beta.5

Shows the path to the current page. Each step is a link or button, and the current page comes last. Steps that do not fit move into a menu after the first step.

## Import

```tsx
import { Breadcrumb } from '@motifx-community/ui';
```

## Links and buttons

A step with `href` is a link, and `rel='router'` lets the MotifJS router handle it. A step without `href` is a button, and `onItemClick` reports the click.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Breadcrumb, Stack } from '@motifx-community/ui';

/** Links handled by the router (`rel="router"`), a step that is a button, the current page last, and one created programmatically. */
export default function Programmatic() {
  const s = reactive({ last: '' });
  const coded = new Breadcrumb({ label: 'Settings path', items: ['Settings', 'Account', 'Security'] });

  // Several on one page: each gets a name of its own.
  return (
    <Stack gap="lg">
      <Breadcrumb
        label="Docs path"
        rel="router"
        items={[{ text: 'Docs', href: '/' }, { text: 'Components', href: '/button' }, 'Display', { text: 'Breadcrumb' }]}
        onItemClick={(e) => (s.last = String((e.item as { text?: string }).text ?? e.item))}
      />
      <span>{() => (s.last ? `Pressed: ${s.last}` : 'Press a step')}</span>
      <span onConfig={(c) => c.controls.add(coded)} />
    </Stack>
  );
}
```

## Overflow

```tsx
import { Breadcrumb, Stack } from '@motifx-community/ui';

const PATH = ['Workspace', 'Projects', 'Kit', 'Components', 'Navigation', 'Breadcrumb', 'Examples', 'Overflow'];

/** Steps that do not fit go into the menu after the first; drag the box's corner to see it. `maxItems` caps the count. */
export default function Overflow() {
  return (
    <Stack gap="lg">
      <div style="resize: horizontal; overflow: hidden; inline-size: 22rem; min-inline-size: 10rem; max-inline-size: 100%; padding-block: 0.25rem">
        <Breadcrumb label="Path that fits" items={PATH} />
      </div>
      <Breadcrumb label="Path of three" items={PATH} maxItems={3} />
    </Stack>
  );
}
```

## Sizes

```tsx
import { Breadcrumb, Stack, type ControlSize } from '@motifx-community/ui';

const SIZES: ControlSize[] = ['sm', 'md', 'lg'];

/** Each size, with a disabled step. */
export default function Sizes() {
  return (
    <Stack gap="lg">
      {SIZES.map((size) => (
        <Breadcrumb key={size} label={`Path ${size}`} size={size} items={['Home', { text: 'Archived', enabled: false }, 'Reports', `Size ${size}`]} />
      ))}
    </Stack>
  );
}
```

## Accessibility

| Topic | Details |
| --- | --- |
| `Landmark` | A `nav` named “Breadcrumb” in the kit language, containing an ordered list. If a page has several, give each one its own `label`. |
| `Current page` | `aria-current="page"`. The current page is not a link. |
| `Menu` | Steps that do not fit go into a menu behind a button named “More pages”. Choosing one activates the step itself. |
| `Disabled state` | `aria-disabled`. A disabled link loses its address. |

## Styling

| Hook | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `.mx-breadcrumb` | The breadcrumb. `data-size`. |
| `.mx-breadcrumb__list, .mx-breadcrumb__item` | The list and each step. |
| `.mx-breadcrumb__link, .mx-breadcrumb__current, .mx-breadcrumb__text` | A pressable step, the current page and the step text. |
| `.mx-breadcrumb__divider, .mx-breadcrumb__more` | The separator after a step, and the menu of overflow steps. |

### Component tokens

| Token | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `breadcrumb.link, .current, .divider` | Units: a step (`hover`, `pressed`, `focus`, `disabled`), the current page, and the separator (its shape is a chevron, or a slash in Material). |
| `breadcrumb.height.*, .padding.*, .font-size.*` | A step, per size. |
| `breadcrumb.gap, .divider-size` | The spacing around a separator, and its size. |

## API reference

### Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `items` | `Bind<readonly (BreadcrumbItem \| string)[]>` | `[]` | The steps, with the current page last: `BreadcrumbItem` objects (`text`, `href`, `icon`, `enabled`, `data`) or plain text. A step with `href` is a link, and one without is a button. |
| `rel` | `Bind<string>` | `''` | The `rel` of the links. `router` lets the MotifJS router handle them, including from the menu. |
| `maxItems` | `Bind<number \| null>` | As many as fit | The maximum number of steps shown. The first and last stay, and those in between move to the menu. |
| `lastIsCurrent` | `Bind<boolean>` | `true` | Makes the last step the current page, which cannot be pressed and has `aria-current="page"`. |
| `size` | `Bind<ControlSize>` | `'md'` | `sm`, `md`, `lg`. |
| `label` | `Bind<string>` | The kit string “Breadcrumb” | The accessible name. |

### Events and properties

| Member | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `onItemClick` | event | Occurs when a step is pressed, on the breadcrumb or in its menu (`item`, `index`). Set `cancel = true` to prevent following a link. |
| `collapsed` | read-only | The indexes of the steps currently in the menu. |

# Pagination

> Navigation · @motifx-community/ui 0.1.0-beta.5

Navigates through pages of items, with page size options, the current position, navigation buttons and a button for each nearby page. It switches to a compact layout when it does not fit, and it looks and works like the DataGrid pager.

## Import

```tsx
import { Pagination } from '@motifx-community/ui';
```

## Declarative and programmatic

`x-model` binds the page, and `onPageChanged` also reports the page size, so data can be loaded for both.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Pagination, Stack } from '@motifx-community/ui';

/** The page bound with `x-model`, the available sizes, and one created with `new` programmatically. */
export default function Programmatic() {
  const s = reactive({ page: 3, size: 25 });
  const coded = new Pagination({ label: 'Pages made in code', total: 40, pageSize: 10, mode: 'full', showInfo: false });

  return (
    <Stack gap="lg">
      <Pagination
        label="Orders"
        total={1234}
        pageSizes={[10, 25, 50, 0]}
        pageSize={() => s.size}
        x-model={() => s.page}
        onPageChanged={(e) => e.byUser && (s.size = e.pageSize)}
      />
      <span>{() => `Page ${s.page}, ${s.size || 'all'} per page`}</span>
      <span onConfig={(c) => c.controls.add(coded)} />
    </Stack>
  );
}
```

## Appearance

```tsx
import { Pagination, Stack } from '@motifx-community/ui';

/** The compact layout, adaptive in a narrow box (drag its corner), more neighbors, and page buttons only. */
export default function Looks() {
  return (
    <Stack gap="lg">
      <Pagination label="Compact" mode="compact" total={500} pageSizes={[20, 50]} pageSize={20} page={4} />
      <div style="resize: horizontal; overflow: hidden; inline-size: 26rem; min-inline-size: 22rem; max-inline-size: 100%">
        <Pagination label="Adaptive" total={500} pageSizes={[20, 50]} pageSize={20} page={4} showInfo={false} />
      </div>
      <Pagination label="Two each side" mode="full" neighbors={2} total={1000} page={10} showInfo={false} />
      <Pagination label="Pages only" mode="full" pageCount={7} page={2} showInfo={false} showNavigation={false} />
    </Stack>
  );
}
```

## Accessibility

| Topic | Details |
| --- | --- |
| `Landmark` | A `nav` named “Pages” in the kit language, or by its label. |
| `Paging` | Each page button is named “Page 5”, and the current one has `aria-current="page"`. |
| `Steps` | Named First page, Previous page, Next page and Last page, and disabled at the ends. |
| `Compact` | The page number box is named “Page number”, and the information stays available to screen readers while hidden. |

## Styling

| Hook | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `.mx-pagination` | The pagination. `data-look`: `full` or `compact`. |
| `.mx-pagination__sizes, __size, __size-list` | The page sizes, as buttons or a drop-down. |
| `.mx-pagination__info, __step, __pages, __page, __gap` | The information text, a navigation button (`data-step`), the page buttons and the gaps. |
| `.mx-pagination__jump, __number` | The page number box in the compact layout. |

### Component tokens

| Token | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `pagination.button-size, .step-variant, .page-variant, .page-tone, .current-variant, .current-tone` | The appearance of its buttons, which matches the DataGrid pager in each design language. |
| `pagination.info` | Unit: the information text. |
| `pagination.gap, .step-overlap, .number-width, .size-width` | The spacing between parts, the double arrows and the boxes in the compact layout. |

## API reference

### Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `page` | `Bind<number>` | `1` | The page number, starting from 1. |
| `value` | `Bind<number>` |  | Same as `page`. This is what `x-model` binds, with two-way binding. |
| `total` | `Bind<number>` | `0` | The total number of items. The page count is derived from this and `pageSize`. |
| `pageSize` | `Bind<number>` | `10` | The number of items per page. 0 shows all items on one page. |
| `pageCount` | `Bind<number \| null>` | `null` | The number of pages, when there is no `total`. |
| `pageSizes` | `Bind<readonly number[]>` | `[]` | The available page sizes (0 means all). Changing the size keeps the first item of the page in view. |
| `showInfo` | `Bind<boolean>` | `true` | “Page 3 of 12 (250 items)”. |
| `showNavigation` | `Bind<boolean>` | `true` | The first, previous, next and last buttons. |
| `neighbors` | `Bind<number>` | `1` | The number of page buttons on each side of the current page. |
| `mode` | `Bind<PaginationMode>` | `'adaptive'` | `full`, `compact` (a page number box and a drop-down of sizes), or `adaptive`, which is compact when the full layout does not fit. |
| `infoText` | `Bind<string>` | `''` | Custom information text. `{page}`, `{count}` and `{total}` are replaced with their values. |
| `label` | `Bind<string>` | The kit string “Pages” | The accessible name. If a page has several, each one needs its own. |

### Events, properties and methods

| Member | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `onPageChanged` | event | Occurs when the page or the page size changes (`page`, `pageSize`), either by the user or programmatically (`byUser`). |
| `goTo(page)` | method | Goes to a page, starting from 1, as a click would. |
| `pageCount` | Read-only | The current number of pages. |
| `compact` | read-only | Indicates whether the compact layout is currently shown. |

# Stepper

> Navigation · @motifx-community/ui 0.1.0-beta.5

Shows the steps of a longer task and the user's progress through them. Each step has an indicator and text, with a line between steps, and steps before the current one are marked complete. [Wizard](wizard.md) adds a page and navigation buttons to each step.

## Import

```tsx
import { Stepper } from '@motifx-community/ui';
```

## Declarative and programmatic

`value` is the current step, identified by its `key` or index, and `x-model` provides two-way binding. Programmatically, use `next()`, `previous()` and `goTo()`, and `onStepChanged` reports the change.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, Stack, Stepper } from '@motifx-community/ui';

/** A stepper bound with x-model, and one created programmatically and moved with its methods. */
export default function Programmatic() {
    const s = reactive({ step: 0 as string | number | null, at: 0, told: '' });
    const coded = new Stepper({
        label: 'Order',
        items: ['Cart', 'Address', 'Payment', 'Done'],
        linear: false,
        onStepChanged: e => {
            s.at = e.index;
            s.told = `Step ${e.index + 1}${e.byUser ? ', pressed' : ''}`;
        }
    });

    return (
        <Stack gap="lg" style="inline-size: 100%">
            <Stepper label="Sign up" items={['Account', 'Profile', 'Review']} x-model={() => s.step} />
            <output class="st-value">{() => `value: ${JSON.stringify(s.step)}`}</output>
            <span onConfig={c => c.controls.add(coded)} />
            <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center">
                <Button text="Back" variant="outline" enabled={() => s.at > 0} onclick={() => void coded.previous()} />
                <Button text="Next" variant="outline" enabled={() => s.at < 3} onclick={() => void coded.next()} />
                <output class="st-told">{() => s.told}</output>
            </Stack>
        </Stack>
    );
}
```

## Step status

Steps before the current one are completed automatically. An item can set `status: 'done'` or `'error'` regardless of the current step, be `optional` or disabled, or show an `icon` instead of its number. Its fields can be functions of your state.

| Status | Details |
| --- | --- |
| `pending` | A step not yet reached, with its number in the indicator. |
| `current` | The active step, with `aria-current="step"`. |
| `done` | Steps before the current one, and any step with `status: 'done'`. The indicator shows a check, and the line before it is filled. |
| `error` | A step with `status: 'error'`. The indicator shows a mark, the text uses the danger color, and it is announced as “Needs attention”. |
| `optional` | Shows “Optional” below the text. In linear mode, the step can be skipped. |
| `disabled` | An item with `enabled: false`, or a step that linear mode does not reach yet. It has `aria-disabled` and is outside the Tab order. |

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, Stack, Stepper } from '@motifx-community/ui';

const pencil = () => {
    const svg = document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg', 'svg');
    svg.setAttribute('viewBox', '0 0 16 16');
    svg.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
    svg.innerHTML = '<path d="M11.5 2.5l2 2L5 13H3v-2z" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linejoin="round"/>';
    return svg;
};

/** Completed and failed steps set by the items, an optional step, a disabled step, and an icon in place of the number. */
export default function Statuses() {
    const s = reactive({ paid: false });
    const items = [
        { text: 'Cart', status: 'done' as const },
        { text: 'Address', description: 'Checked', status: 'done' as const },
        { text: 'Payment', description: () => (s.paid ? 'Paid' : 'Card declined'), status: () => (s.paid ? 'done' : 'error') },
        { text: 'Gift note', optional: true, icon: pencil() },
        { text: 'Pick-up', enabled: false },
        { text: 'Done' }
    ];
    return (
        <Stack gap="md" style="inline-size: 100%">
            <Stepper label="Statuses" items={items} value={5} linear={false} />
            <Button text={() => (s.paid ? 'Decline the card' : 'Take the payment')} variant="outline" onclick={() => (s.paid = !s.paid)} />
        </Stack>
    );
}
```

## Linear and free navigation

`linear` (the default) lets the user reach only completed steps and the next one, while `linear={false}` allows any step. In both cases, `onStepChanging` is raised first. `cancel` keeps the current step, and `promise` waits for a validation or a server response.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { CheckBox, Stack, Stepper } from '@motifx-community/ui';

/** In linear order a step is reached only after the ones before it; `onStepChanging` refuses a step while the box is unchecked. */
export default function Linear() {
    const s = reactive({ step: 0 as string | number | null, agreed: false, note: '' });
    return (
        <Stack gap="md" style="inline-size: 100%">
            <Stepper
                label="In order"
                items={['Terms', 'Details', 'Confirm']}
                x-model={() => s.step}
                onStepChanging={e => {
                    if (e.to > 0 && !s.agreed) {
                        e.cancel = true;
                        s.note = 'Accept the terms first.';
                    } else {
                        s.note = '';
                    }
                }}
            />
            <CheckBox label="I accept the terms" x-model={() => s.agreed} />
            <output class="st-note">{() => s.note}</output>
        </Stack>
    );
}
```

## Orientation

```tsx
import { Stack, Stepper } from '@motifx-community/ui';

const STEPS = [
    { text: 'Details', description: 'Name and e-mail' },
    { text: 'Address', description: 'Where to send it' },
    { text: 'Payment', description: 'Card or transfer' },
    { text: 'Review' }
];

/** Horizontal with the texts under or after the indicators, and vertical. */
export default function Orientations() {
    return (
        <Stack gap="lg" style="inline-size: 100%">
            <Stepper label="Texts under" items={STEPS} value={1} linear={false} />
            <Stepper label="Texts after" items={STEPS.slice(0, 3)} value={1} labelPosition="end" linear={false} />
            <div style="inline-size: 18rem">
                <Stepper label="Standing" items={STEPS} value={1} orientation="vertical" linear={false} />
            </div>
        </Stack>
    );
}
```

## Sizes

```tsx
import { Stack, Stepper } from '@motifx-community/ui';

const STEPS = ['Plan', 'Build', 'Ship'];

/** Three sizes, and a stepper without numbers. */
export default function Sizes() {
    return (
        <Stack gap="lg" style="inline-size: 100%">
            <Stepper label="Small" items={STEPS} value={1} size="sm" linear={false} />
            <Stepper label="Medium" items={STEPS} value={1} linear={false} />
            <Stepper label="Large" items={STEPS} value={1} size="lg" linear={false} />
            <Stepper label="Dots" items={STEPS} value={1} showNumbers={false} size="sm" labelPosition="end" linear={false} />
        </Stack>
    );
}
```

## Keyboard

| Key | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `Tab` | One Tab stop: the step focused last, otherwise the current one, otherwise the first reachable step. |
| `Arrow keys` | Left and Right (Up and Down when vertical) move between reachable steps and wrap at the ends. Home and End move to the first and last. |
| `Enter, Space` | Selects the focused step, and `onStepChanging` can cancel it. |

## Accessibility

| Topic | Details |
| --- | --- |
| `Landmark` | A `nav` named “Steps” in the kit language, containing an ordered list. If a page has several, give each one its own `label`. |
| `A step` | A button whose name includes the position, text and status, such as “Step 2 of 4, Address, Where to send it, Completed”. |
| `Not clickable` | Plain elements with nothing to press. The current step still has `aria-current`. |
| `Lines and marks` | Decorative and hidden from screen readers. |

## Styling

| Hook | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `.mx-stepper` | The stepper. `data-orientation`, `data-labels`, `data-size`. |
| `.mx-stepper__list, .mx-stepper__item` | The list and each step with its connector. `data-status` is on the item. |
| `.mx-stepper__step` | The step, as a button or a div. `data-status`, `aria-current`, `aria-disabled`. |
| `.mx-stepper__indicator, .mx-stepper__number, .mx-stepper__mark, .mx-stepper__icon` | The circle, the number inside it, the check or error mark, and a custom icon. |
| `.mx-stepper__label, .mx-stepper__description, .mx-stepper__note` | The text. |
| `.mx-stepper__line` | The line to the next step. `data-status="done"` up to the current step. |

### Component tokens

| Token | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `stepper.step, .indicator, .mark, .label, .description, .note, .line` | Units: the step (`hover`, `pressed`, `focus`, `disabled`, `current`, `done`, `error`), its indicator, the mark (`icon` per state), the text and the line (`done`). In a vertical stepper, the line rotates 90 degrees. |
| `stepper.size.*, .font-size.*, .padding.*` | The indicator, the text and the space around a step, per size. |
| `stepper.description-font-size, .gap, .line-gap, .line-min-length` | The second line, the space between the indicator and text, and the margins and minimum length of the line. |

## API reference

### Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `items` | `Bind<readonly (StepperItem \| string)[]>` | `[]` | The steps in order: `StepperItem` objects (`text`, `description`, `key`, `icon`, `status`, `optional`, `enabled`, `data`) or plain text. |
| `value` | `Bind<string \| number \| null>` | `0` | The current step, identified by its `key` or index, or `null` for none. `x-model` provides two-way binding. |
| `linear` | `Bind<boolean>` | `true` | Lets the user reach a completed step or the one right after the last completed step. Optional steps can be skipped. |
| `orientation` | `Bind<StepperOrientation>` | `'horizontal'` | `horizontal` or `vertical`. |
| `labelPosition` | `Bind<StepperLabelPosition>` | `'bottom'` | In the horizontal orientation, places the text below the indicator (`bottom`) or after it (`end`). |
| `size` | `Bind<ControlSize>` | `'md'` | `sm`, `md`, `lg`. |
| `clickable` | `Bind<boolean>` | `true` | `false` makes the stepper display only, with no buttons or Tab stop. |
| `showNumbers` | `Bind<boolean>` | `true` | Shows the number in the indicator of an upcoming step. |
| `label` | `Bind<string>` | The kit string “Steps” | The accessible name. |

### Events, properties and methods

| Member | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `onStepChanging` | event | Occurs before the current step changes (`from`, `to`, `fromItem`, `toItem`, `byUser`). `cancel = true` keeps it. Setting `promise` to a `Promise<boolean>` waits, and the step changes when it resolves to `true`. |
| `onStepChanged` | event | Occurs after the current step changes (`index`, `item`, `previous`, `byUser`). |
| `selectedIndex` | read-only | The index of the current step, or -1 if there is none. |
| `count` | read-only | The number of steps. |
| `canGoNext, canGoPrevious` | read-only | Indicates whether there is an enabled step after or before the current one. |
| `next(), previous()` | `Promise<boolean>` | Moves to the next or previous enabled step. Returns `false` if there is none or the change was canceled. |
| `goTo(step)` | `Promise<boolean>` | Moves to a step by index or key, in any order. `onStepChanging` is raised first. |
| `statusOf(index)` | `StepperStatus` | `pending`, `current`, `done` or `error`, as displayed. |
| `canReach(index)` | `boolean` | Indicates whether the user can reach the step. |
| `refresh()` | `void` | Re-reads the items after they have been changed in place. |

# Wizard

> Navigation · @motifx-community/ui 0.1.0-beta.5

Guides the user through a multi-step task. It combines a [Stepper](stepper.md) above or next to one page per step with Back and Next buttons below. Next validates the page first, and on the last step it finishes the wizard.

## Import

```tsx
import { Wizard, WizardStep } from '@motifx-community/ui';
```

## Defining pages in JSX

Each `WizardStep` is a step and its page. Next validates the kit fields on the page and then runs the step's own `validate`. If validation fails, the wizard stays on the page, marks the step and focuses the first invalid field. On the last step, Next becomes Finish and raises `onFinished`.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { CheckBox, Stack, TextBox, Wizard, WizardStep } from '@motifx-community/ui';

/** Three pages with kit fields: Next validates the page first, and Finish notifies the application. */
export default function Basic() {
    const s = reactive({ name: '', email: '', city: '', agreed: false, result: '' });
    return (
        <Stack gap="md" style="inline-size: 100%">
            <Wizard label="Sign up" onFinished={() => (s.result = `Welcome, ${s.name}.`)}>
                <WizardStep title="Account" description="Who you are">
                    <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center">
                        <TextBox label="Name" x-model={() => s.name} required />
                        <TextBox label="E-mail" x-model={() => s.email} required rules={[{ type: 'email' }]} />
                    </Stack>
                </WizardStep>
                <WizardStep title="Address" description="Where you live">
                    <TextBox label="City" x-model={() => s.city} required />
                </WizardStep>
                <WizardStep title="Review" validate={() => s.agreed}>
                    <p>{() => `${s.name || '—'}, ${s.email || '—'}, ${s.city || '—'}`}</p>
                    <CheckBox label="Everything is right" x-model={() => s.agreed} />
                </WizardStep>
            </Wizard>
            <output class="wz-result">{() => s.result}</output>
        </Stack>
    );
}
```

## Programmatic use

`steps` creates steps from props, and each page is created from a `content` factory when first shown. `add`, `insert` and `remove` change the steps later, and `next()`, `previous()`, `goTo()` and `finish()` navigate.

```tsx
import { Component, reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, Stack, Wizard, WizardStep } from '@motifx-community/ui';

// A page created programmatically: any MotifJS component.
class Note extends Component<HTMLDivElement, { text: string }> {
    override view() {
        return <p>{this.props.text}</p>;
    }
}

/** A wizard created programmatically: its steps as props with content factories, moved with its methods, with a step added later. */
export default function Programmatic() {
    const s = reactive({ told: '' });
    const wizard = new Wizard({
        label: 'Setup',
        steps: [
            { title: 'Welcome', content: () => new Note({ text: 'A page made by a factory, built when first shown.' }) },
            { title: 'Options', description: 'Pick what you need', content: () => new Note({ text: 'The second page.' }) },
            { title: 'Done', content: () => new Note({ text: 'The last page; Next reads Finish here.' }) }
        ],
        onStepChanged: e => (s.told = `Step ${e.index + 1}: ${(e.item as { text: string }).text}`),
        onFinished: () => (s.told = 'Finished.')
    });
    const addStep = () => {
        wizard.insert(2, new WizardStep({ title: 'Extra', optional: true, content: () => new Note({ text: 'Added programmatically.' }) }));
    };
    return (
        <Stack gap="md" style="inline-size: 100%">
            <span onConfig={c => c.controls.add(wizard)} />
            <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center">
                <Button text="Go to Done" variant="outline" onclick={() => void wizard.goTo(wizard.steps.length - 1)} />
                <Button text="Add a step" variant="outline" onclick={addStep} />
                <output class="wz-told">{() => s.told}</output>
            </Stack>
        </Stack>
    );
}
```

## Vertical orientation

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { RadioGroup, Switch, TextArea, Wizard, WizardStep } from '@motifx-community/ui';

/** The stepper beside the pages, the texts after the indicators. */
export default function Vertical() {
    const s = reactive({ plan: 'Team', notify: true, note: '' });
    return (
        <Wizard label="Subscription" orientation="vertical" style="min-block-size: 16rem; inline-size: 100%">
            <WizardStep title="Plan" description="What you pay for">
                <RadioGroup label="Plan" items={['Solo', 'Team', 'Business']} x-model={() => s.plan} />
            </WizardStep>
            <WizardStep title="Alerts" description="How we reach you">
                <Switch label="Send me a monthly summary" x-model={() => s.notify} />
            </WizardStep>
            <WizardStep title="Notes" optional>
                <TextArea label="Anything else?" x-model={() => s.note} rows={3} />
            </WizardStep>
        </Wizard>
    );
}
```

## Custom buttons and asynchronous finish

`showNavigation={false}` removes the bar, so your own buttons can call the methods. `onFinishing` can set a `promise`, and the wizard finishes when it resolves to `true` and stays open otherwise.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, Stack, TextBox, Wizard, WizardStep } from '@motifx-community/ui';

/** No bar: custom buttons control it, and finishing waits for a promise (a server) and can be refused. */
export default function Custom() {
    const s = reactive({ code: '', busy: false, note: '' });
    let wizard!: Wizard;
    const finish = () => {
        s.note = '';
        void wizard.finish().then(ok => (s.note = ok ? 'Saved.' : s.note || 'Not finished.'));
    };
    return (
        <Stack gap="md" style="inline-size: 100%">
            <Wizard
                ref={(w: Wizard) => (wizard = w)}
                label="Redeem"
                showNavigation={false}
                labelPosition="end"
                onFinishing={e => {
                    s.busy = true;
                    e.promise = new Promise<boolean>(resolve => setTimeout(() => resolve(s.code.toUpperCase() === 'MOTIF'), 600)).then(ok => {
                        s.busy = false;
                        if (!ok) s.note = 'That code is not known.';
                        return ok;
                    });
                }}
            >
                <WizardStep title="Code">
                    <TextBox label="Gift code" x-model={() => s.code} required placeholder="MOTIF" />
                </WizardStep>
                <WizardStep title="Confirm">
                    <p>{() => `Redeem “${s.code}”?`}</p>
                </WizardStep>
            </Wizard>
            <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center">
                <Button text="Back" variant="outline" onclick={() => void wizard.previous()} />
                <Button text="Next" variant="outline" onclick={() => void wizard.next()} />
                <Button text="Redeem" busy={() => s.busy} onclick={finish} />
                <output class="wz-note">{() => s.note}</output>
            </Stack>
        </Stack>
    );
}
```

## Accessibility

| Topic | Details |
| --- | --- |
| `Stepper` | A `nav` of steps, as on the [Stepper](stepper.md) page. Each step is a button with its position and status in its name, and there is one Tab stop. |
| `Page` | A `group` named after its step. Hidden pages are removed from the accessibility tree. |
| `Validation` | When validation fails, focus stays on the first invalid field with its message, and the step is announced as “Needs attention”. |
| `Buttons` | Kit buttons named “Back”, “Next” and “Finish” in the kit language. |

## Styling

| Hook | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `.mx-wizard` | The wizard. `data-orientation`. |
| `.mx-wizard__stepper` | The stepper (also `.mx-stepper`). |
| `.mx-wizard__pages, .mx-wizard__page` | The pages and each page. A hidden page has `hidden`. |
| `.mx-wizard__bar, .mx-wizard__previous, .mx-wizard__next` | The bar and its buttons. |

### Component tokens

| Token | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `wizard.frame, .page, .bar` | Units: the root, a page and the bar (a divider above it and its padding). |
| `wizard.previous, wizard.next` | Places: the appearance of the buttons in the bar (`variant`). |
| `wizard.gap, .bar-gap, .rail-width` | The spacing between the stepper, pages and bar, and between the buttons, plus the stepper width when it is next to the pages. |

## API reference

### Wizard props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `steps` | `readonly WizardStepProps[]` | `[]` | Steps created programmatically, each as `WizardStep` props. JSX `WizardStep` children come first. |
| `value` | `Bind<string \| number \| null>` | `0` | The current step, identified by its `key` or index. `x-model` provides two-way binding. |
| `linear` | `Bind<boolean>` | `true` | A step can be reached only after the previous ones, and optional steps can be skipped. |
| `orientation` | `Bind<StepperOrientation>` | `'horizontal'` | `horizontal` places the stepper above the pages, and `vertical` places it next to them. |
| `labelPosition` | `Bind<StepperLabelPosition>` | `'bottom'` | The position of the stepper text, in the horizontal orientation only. |
| `size` | `Bind<ControlSize>` | `'md'` | The size of the stepper. |
| `showStepper, showNavigation` | `Bind<boolean>` | `true` | Shows the stepper, and the bar with the Back and Next buttons. |
| `clickable` | `Bind<boolean>` | `true` | Lets the user press the stepper steps. |
| `lazy` | `Bind<boolean>` | `true` | Creates a page when first shown and then keeps it. A step's own `lazy` takes precedence. |
| `keepAlive` | `Bind<boolean>` | `true` | With `false`, content created by a step's `content` is disposed while hidden and recreated when shown. A step's own `keepAlive` takes precedence. |
| `previousText, nextText, finishText` | `Bind<string>` | The kit strings “Back”, “Next” and “Finish” | The button text. |
| `label` | `Bind<string>` | The kit string “Steps” | The accessible name of the stepper. |

### WizardStep props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `title` | `Bind<string>` | `''` | The step text in the stepper. This is the same property as `text`. |
| `description` | `Bind<string>` | `''` | A second line below the title. |
| `key` | `Bind<string>` | The index | Identifies the step in `value`. The JSX `key` also works. |
| `icon` | `Bind<IconSource \| null>` | `null` | Displayed in the indicator instead of the number. |
| `optional` | `Bind<boolean>` | `false` | Marks the step as optional, which appears below the title. |
| `enabled` | `Bind<boolean>` | `true` | `false` prevents the step from being reached. |
| `error` | `Bind<boolean>` | `false` | Shows the step with an error. The wizard sets it when the page fails validation and clears it when the page passes. |
| `validateFields` | `Bind<boolean>` | `true` | The kit fields on the page are validated before the wizard moves on, and the first invalid field receives focus. |
| `validate` | `() => boolean \| Promise<boolean>` | — | Runs after the fields are validated. `false` keeps the page and marks the step. |
| `lazy, keepAlive` | `Bind<boolean \| undefined>` | From the wizard | See the wizard prop. |
| `content` | `() => ComponentBase \| ComponentBase[]` | — | Creates the page programmatically when the page is created. |

### Events, properties and methods

| Member | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `onStepChanging, onStepChanged` | event | The stepper events. `onStepChanging` (`cancel`, `promise`) runs before the page is validated. |
| `onFinishing` | event | Occurs when the last page is valid and the wizard is about to finish. `cancel = true` keeps it open, and `promise` waits and finishes on `true`. |
| `onFinished` | event | Occurs when the wizard finishes. Every step is shown as complete. |
| `next(), previous(), goTo(step)` | `Promise<boolean>` | Next validates the page and finishes on the last step. Back does not validate. `goTo` validates when moving forward. |
| `finish()` | `Promise<boolean>` | Validates the page, raises `onFinishing`, and then finishes. |
| `leaveCheck()` | `Promise<boolean>` | Validates the current page as Next does, without moving. |
| `add(step), insert(index, step), remove(step)` | `WizardStep` / `boolean` | Manage steps programmatically. A step from another wizard moves here. |
| `stepper, steps, currentStep, selectedIndex` | read-only | The `Stepper`, the `WizardStep` objects in order, the current step and its index. |
| `isLast, isFinished` | read-only | Indicate whether the current step is the last reachable one (Next finishes), and whether the wizard has finished. |
| `previousButton, nextButton` | read-only | The kit buttons in the bar, for a custom icon or appearance. |
