# Accordion

> Navigation · @motifx-community/ui 0.1.0-beta.5

An accordion expands and collapses sections under their headers. It supports one or several open sections, sections that stay open, icons, three appearances and sections that are created when first opened.

## Import

```tsx
import { Accordion, AccordionItem } from '@motifx-community/ui';
```

## Declarative and programmatic

The children of an `<AccordionItem>` are its section. `value` lists the keys of the open items, and `x-model` provides two-way binding. When you create the component with `new`, add and remove items programmatically.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Accordion, AccordionItem, Button, Stack, TextBox } from '@motifx-community/ui';

const TruckIcon = () => (
  <svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" aria-hidden="true">
    <path d="M1.5 4.5h8v6h-8zM9.5 6.5h3l2 2v2h-5M4 12.5a1 1 0 1 0 0-.01M12 12.5a1 1 0 1 0 0-.01" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.2" stroke-linejoin="round" />
  </svg>
);

const FAQ = [
  { q: 'Can I pay later?', a: 'Yes, within 30 days of the invoice.' },
  { q: 'Do you ship abroad?', a: 'To most countries in Europe.' },
  { q: 'How do I return an item?', a: 'Send it back within 14 days with the slip in the box.' },
];

/** An accordion from JSX bound with x-model, and one created with `new` that gets items programmatically. */
export default function Programmatic() {
  const s = reactive({ open: ['shipping'] as (string | number)[], address: '', log: '' });
  let added = 0;

  const faq = new Accordion({ variant: 'separated', multiple: true });
  for (const entry of FAQ) faq.add(new AccordionItem({ title: entry.q, content: () => <p>{entry.a}</p> }));
  faq.onExpanded((e) => (s.log = `Opened “${e.item.title}”${e.byUser ? ' by the user' : ' programmatically'}.`));

  const addQuestion = () => {
    const n = ++added;
    const item = faq.add(new AccordionItem({ title: `Question ${n}`, content: () => <p>Answer {n}.</p> }));
    item.expanded = true;
  };

  return (
    <>
      <Accordion class="acc-ways" x-model={() => s.open}>
        <AccordionItem key="shipping" title="&Shipping" icon={() => <TruckIcon />}>
          <TextBox label="Address" x-model={() => s.address} />
        </AccordionItem>
        <AccordionItem key="payment" title="&Payment">
          <p>Card or bank transfer.</p>
        </AccordionItem>
        <AccordionItem key="review" title="&Review">
          <p>{() => `Ship to: ${s.address || '—'}`}</p>
        </AccordionItem>
      </Accordion>
      <output class="acc-value">{() => `value: [${s.open.map((k) => JSON.stringify(k)).join(', ')}]`}</output>
      <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center">
        <Button text="Add a question programmatically" variant="outline" onclick={addQuestion} />
        <output class="acc-log">{() => s.log}</output>
      </Stack>
      <Stack style="inline-size: 100%" onBuilt={(c) => c.controls.add(faq)} />
    </>
  );
}
```

## Single and multiple expansion

By default, one item is open at a time. With `multiple`, several can be open. `collapsible={false}` keeps one open, so its header cannot close it.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Accordion, AccordionItem, Button, Stack } from '@motifx-community/ui';

/** One item open at a time or several, kept open or not, with a disabled item. */
export default function OneOrSeveral() {
  const s = reactive({ multiple: false, collapsible: true });
  return (
    <>
      <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center">
        <Button text="Multiple" size="sm" variant="outline" toggle x-model={() => s.multiple} />
        <Button text="Collapsible" size="sm" variant="outline" toggle x-model={() => s.collapsible} />
      </Stack>
      <Accordion class="acc-multiple" multiple={() => s.multiple} collapsible={() => s.collapsible}>
        <AccordionItem title="Monday">
          <p>Monday.</p>
        </AccordionItem>
        <AccordionItem title="Tuesday">
          <p>Tuesday.</p>
        </AccordionItem>
        <AccordionItem title="Wednesday" enabled={false}>
          <p>Wednesday.</p>
        </AccordionItem>
        <AccordionItem title="Thursday">
          <p>Thursday.</p>
        </AccordionItem>
      </Accordion>
    </>
  );
}
```

## Lazy sections

A section is created when first opened and then kept (`lazy`, on by default). An item with a `content` factory and `keepAlive={false}` has its content disposed when it closes and recreated when it opens.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Accordion, AccordionItem, TextBox } from '@motifx-community/ui';

/** Sections created when first opened: one is kept, and one is recreated each time it opens. */
export default function LazySections() {
  const s = reactive({ builds: 0 });
  return (
    <>
      <Accordion class="acc-lazy" multiple>
        <AccordionItem
          title="Kept"
          content={() => {
            s.builds++;
            return <TextBox label="Type, close, open again" />;
          }}
        />
        <AccordionItem
          title="Made each time"
          keepAlive={false}
          content={() => {
            s.builds++;
            return <TextBox label="Starts empty each time" />;
          }}
        />
      </Accordion>
      <output class="acc-builds">{() => `Sections built: ${s.builds}`}</output>
    </>
  );
}
```

## Variants and sizes

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Accordion, AccordionItem, Button, Stack, type AccordionChevron, type AccordionVariant } from '@motifx-community/ui';

const VARIANTS: AccordionVariant[] = ['list', 'separated', 'flush'];
const CHEVRONS: AccordionChevron[] = ['end', 'start', 'none'];

/** The three variants in the three sizes, with the chevron at either side or none. */
export default function VariantsAndSizes() {
  const s = reactive({ variant: 'list' as AccordionVariant, chevron: 'end' as AccordionChevron });
  return (
    <>
      <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center" role="group" aria-label="Variant">
        {VARIANTS.map((variant) => (
          <Button
            key={variant}
            text={variant}
            size="sm"
            variant={() => (s.variant === variant ? 'solid' : 'ghost')}
            aria-pressed={() => s.variant === variant}
            onclick={() => (s.variant = variant)}
          />
        ))}
      </Stack>
      <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center" role="group" aria-label="Chevron">
        {CHEVRONS.map((chevron) => (
          <Button
            key={chevron}
            text={`chevron ${chevron}`}
            size="sm"
            variant={() => (s.chevron === chevron ? 'solid' : 'ghost')}
            aria-pressed={() => s.chevron === chevron}
            onclick={() => (s.chevron = chevron)}
          />
        ))}
      </Stack>
      {(['sm', 'md', 'lg'] as const).map((size) => (
        <Accordion key={size} class="acc-look" size={size} variant={() => s.variant} chevron={() => s.chevron}>
          <AccordionItem title={`Size ${size}`} expanded>
            <p>The section of a {size} accordion.</p>
          </AccordionItem>
          <AccordionItem title="Another">
            <p>Another section.</p>
          </AccordionItem>
        </Accordion>
      ))}
    </>
  );
}
```

## Keyboard

| Key | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `Tab` | Moves from header to header, and into an open section. |
| `Enter / Space` | Expands or collapses the focused item. |
| `Down / Up` | Moves to the next or previous header, wrapping at the ends (with `arrowKeys`). |
| `Home / End` | Moves to the first or last header (with `arrowKeys`). |
| `Alt + key (`&Shipping`)` | Moves focus to that header and toggles it (Control + Option + key on Apple platforms). |

## Accessibility

| Topic | Details |
| --- | --- |
| `Header` | A `<button>` with `aria-expanded` and `aria-controls`, inside an element with `role="heading"` and `aria-level` (`headingLevel`). |
| `Section` | `role="region"` named by its header (`aria-labelledby`) when there are six items or fewer, as the APG recommends. `regions` controls this. |
| `Closed sections` | `visibility: hidden` once closed, which removes it from the Tab order and the accessibility tree. |
| `Kept open` | With `collapsible` off, the header of an item that cannot close has `aria-disabled="true"`. |
| `Motion` | The height animates using the motion tokens, and reduced motion turns it off. |

## Styling

| Hook | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `.mx-accordion` | The root. `data-variant`, `data-size`, `data-chevron`, `data-disabled`. |
| `.mx-accordion__item` | An item: `data-expanded`, `data-disabled`. |
| `.mx-accordion__heading, .mx-accordion__header` | The heading and its button. |
| `.mx-accordion__icon, .mx-accordion__label, .mx-accordion__chevron` | The parts of a header. |
| `.mx-accordion__region, .mx-accordion__body` | The section (animated) and its content. |

### Component tokens

| Token | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `accordion.height.*, accordion.padding.*, accordion.font-size.*` | Header sizes, from the density tokens. |
| `accordion.container, accordion.item` | Units: the accordion and its items per variant (`list`, `list-next`, `separated`, `flush`; `expanded`). |
| `accordion.header, accordion.icon, accordion.chevron, accordion.plate, accordion.body` | Units: a header (`expanded`, `hover`, `pressed`, `disabled`, `focus`), its icon, the chevron (`open`) and the plate behind it, and the open section. |
| `accordion.chevron-size, accordion.chevron-plate-size, accordion.content-padding` | The sizes of the chevron and plate, and the spacing above and below the section content. |

## API reference

### Accordion props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `Bind<(string \| number)[]>` | `[]` | The keys of the open items (an item without a key uses its index). `x-model` provides two-way binding. |
| `multiple` | `Bind<boolean>` | `false` | Allows several items to be open. Otherwise, opening one closes the other. |
| `collapsible` | `Bind<boolean>` | `true` | With `false`, one item stays open, and its header has `aria-disabled` while it cannot close. |
| `headingLevel` | `Bind<number>` | `3` | The `aria-level` of the headers (1 to 6). Match it to the surrounding headings. |
| `arrowKeys` | `Bind<boolean>` | `true` | Up, Down, Home and End move between headers. |
| `regions` | `Bind<boolean \| 'auto'>` | `'auto'` | Makes sections `role="region"` landmarks. `auto` applies when there are six items or fewer. |
| `variant` | `Bind<AccordionVariant>` | `'list'` | `list` (one bordered box), `separated` (a card per item) or `flush` (dividers only). |
| `size` | `Bind<ControlSize>` | `'md'` | `sm`, `md`, `lg`, from the density tokens. |
| `chevron` | `Bind<AccordionChevron>` | `'end'` | The position of the chevron: `end`, `start` or `none`. |
| `lazy` | `Bind<boolean>` | `true` | Creates a section when first opened and then keeps it. An item's own `lazy` takes precedence. |
| `keepAlive` | `Bind<boolean>` | `true` | With `false`, content created by an item's `content` is disposed when it closes and recreated when it opens. An item's own `keepAlive` takes precedence. |
| `enabled / disabled, visible, tabStop, tabIndex` | see Control |  | Properties shared by all controls. |

### AccordionItem props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `title` | `Bind<string>` | `''` | The header text. `&Shipping` makes Alt+S toggle the item. This is the same property as `text`. |
| `key` | `Bind<string>` | `''` | Identifies the item in `value`. The JSX `key` also works. |
| `expanded` | `Bind<boolean>` | `false` | Indicates whether the section is open. |
| `icon` | `Bind<IconSource \| null>` | — | An icon before the title. |
| `hint` | `Bind<string>` | `''` | A tooltip on the header. |
| `lazy, keepAlive` | `Bind<boolean \| undefined>` | From Accordion | This item's own setting. |
| `content` | `() => ComponentBase \| ComponentBase[]` | — | Creates the section content when it is created, either instead of or after the JSX children. |
| `enabled, visible` | `Bind<boolean>` | `true` | A disabled item cannot be opened or closed, and a hidden item is removed. |

### Properties

| Property | Access | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `every prop above` | read/write, reactive | Accepts a value or a function, the same as the prop. |
| `items` | read-only, reactive | The items in order. |
| `expandedItems` | read-only, reactive | The open items. |
| `AccordionItem.contentBuilt` | read-only | Indicates whether its section has been created. |
| `AccordionItem.owner, headerElement, regionElement` | read-only | Its `Accordion`, its header button and its region. |

### Methods

| Method | Returns | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `add(item), insert(index, item)` | `AccordionItem` | Adds an item. An item from another `Accordion` moves here. |
| `remove(item)` | `boolean` | Removes the item and disposes it. Focus inside moves to an adjacent item. |
| `expandAll(), collapseAll()` | `void` | Programmatic control. `expandAll` requires `multiple`, and with `collapsible` off one item stays open. |
| `AccordionItem.expand(), collapse()` | `boolean` | Toggles as a click would, so the cancelable events run. `item.expanded = true` sets the state programmatically. |
| `focus()` | `boolean` | Sets focus on the item's header. |

### Events

| Event | When |
| --- | --- |
| `onExpanding(e), onCollapsing(e)` | Occurs before the user opens or closes an item. `e`: `{ item, index, cancel, source, event? }`. Set `e.cancel = true` to keep the current state. |
| `onExpanded(e), onCollapsed(e)` | Occurs after an item opens or closes. `e`: `{ item, index, byUser, source }`. |

The accordion has no strings of its own, so it adds nothing to `uiLocale`.

# MultiView

> Navigation · @motifx-community/ui 0.1.0-beta.5

Displays one page at a time from a horizontal set. Users move between pages with a swipe or drag, and you can navigate with `next()`, `previous()` and `goTo()`, or with [Tabs](tabs.md), a [Stepper](stepper.md) or buttons bound to the same value. It works like the panels of a tab control without the tab strip.

## Import

```tsx
import { MultiView, View } from '@motifx-community/ui';
```

## Using MultiView with a Stepper

The `View` children are the pages. `value` is the visible view, identified by its `key` or index, and `x-model` provides two-way binding. In this example, a `Stepper` shares the value, so pressing a step and swiping a page both update it. A page is created when it first becomes visible (`lazy`).

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { CheckBox, MultiView, Stack, Stepper, TextBox, View } from '@motifx-community/ui';

/** A stepper and a multi-view bound to the same value: clicking a step or swiping a page updates both. */
export default function Pages() {
    const s = reactive({ page: 0 as string | number | null });
    return (
        <Stack gap="md" style="inline-size: 100%">
            <Stepper class="mv-steps" label="Order" linear={false} items={['Address', 'Delivery', 'Payment']} x-model={() => s.page} />
            <MultiView class="mv-order" label="Order" x-model={() => s.page}>
                <View title="Address">
                    <Stack gap="sm">
                        <TextBox label="Street" />
                        <TextBox label="Town" />
                    </Stack>
                </View>
                <View title="Delivery">
                    <Stack gap="sm">
                        <CheckBox text="Leave it at the door" />
                        <CheckBox text="Send a message before" />
                    </Stack>
                </View>
                <View title="Payment">
                    <Stack gap="sm">
                        <TextBox label="Card number" />
                        <TextBox label="Name on the card" />
                    </Stack>
                </View>
            </MultiView>
            <output class="mv-order-page">{() => `page: ${s.page}`}</output>
        </Stack>
    );
}
```

## Lazy creation and keeping views alive

`lazy`, the default, creates a view when it first becomes visible and then keeps it. `keepAlive={false}` disposes what a view's `content` created while it is hidden and recreates it next time. JSX children are always kept, as in `Tabs`.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, MultiView, Stack, View } from '@motifx-community/ui';

/** Each page is created when first visible. With `keepAlive` off, the output of `content` is disposed while hidden and recreated. */
export default function Lazy() {
    const s = reactive({ made: 0, keep: true });
    let views!: MultiView;
    const report = (name: string) => () => {
        s.made++;
        return <p class="mv-lazy-page">{`${name}, made as number ${s.made}`}</p>;
    };
    return (
        <Stack gap="sm" style="inline-size: 100%">
            <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center">
                <Button text="Previous" variant="outline" onclick={() => void views.previous()} />
                <Button text="Next" variant="outline" onclick={() => void views.next()} />
                <Button text="Keep alive" variant="outline" toggle x-model={() => s.keep} />
                <output class="mv-lazy-made">{() => `made ${s.made} times`}</output>
            </Stack>
            <MultiView ref={(m: MultiView) => (views = m)} class="mv-lazy" label="Reports" keepAlive={() => s.keep}>
                <View title="Sales" content={report('Sales')} />
                <View title="Stock" content={report('Stock')} />
                <View title="Staff" content={report('Staff')} />
            </MultiView>
        </Stack>
    );
}
```

## Programmatic use

Create the component with `new`, add views with `add()` and `insert()`, and remove them with `remove()`. `loop` wraps around at the ends, and `animated={false}` shows the next view immediately.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, MultiView, Stack, View } from '@motifx-community/ui';

/** A looping multi-view created programmatically: views added, inserted and removed, and navigation through its methods. */
export default function Programmatic() {
    const s = reactive({ told: '', count: 0 });
    let number = 0;
    const page = () => {
        number++;
        const n = number;
        return new View({ title: `Note ${n}`, content: () => <p class="mv-coded-note">{`Note ${n}`}</p> });
    };
    const coded = new MultiView({
        label: 'Notes',
        loop: true,
        onSelectionChanged: e => (s.told = `in sight: ${e.view?.title ?? 'none'}${e.byUser ? ', by a swipe' : ''}`)
    });
    const count = () => (s.count = coded.count);
    coded.add(page());
    coded.add(page());
    count();
    return (
        <Stack gap="sm" style="inline-size: 100%">
            <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center">
                <Button text="Previous" variant="outline" onclick={() => void coded.previous()} />
                <Button text="Next" variant="outline" onclick={() => void coded.next()} />
                <Button
                    text="Add a note"
                    variant="outline"
                    onclick={() => {
                        void coded.goTo(coded.add(page()));
                        count();
                    }}
                />
                <Button
                    text="Remove this note"
                    variant="outline"
                    enabled={() => s.count > 1}
                    onclick={() => {
                        if (coded.selectedView) coded.remove(coded.selectedView);
                        count();
                    }}
                />
                <output class="mv-coded-told">{() => `${s.count} notes${s.told ? `, ${s.told}` : ''}`}</output>
            </Stack>
            <span class="mv-coded" onConfig={c => c.controls.add(coded)} />
        </Stack>
    );
}
```

## Accessibility

| Topic | Details |
| --- | --- |
| `Group` | A `group` named “Pages” in the kit language. If a page has several, give each one its own `label`. |
| `A view` | A `group` named by its `title`, or “Page 2 of 3”. Views out of sight are hidden from assistive technology and the keyboard (`inert`), so Tab moves only within the visible view. |
| `Moving` | Swiping requires a finger or a mouse, so also provide keyboard access through `Tabs`, a `Stepper` or buttons bound to the same `value`, as the examples do. |

## Styling

| Hook | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `.mx-multi-view` | The multi-view. `data-swipe` when dragging is enabled, `data-dragging` during a drag, and `data-still` with `animated` off. |
| `.mx-multi-view__viewport, .mx-multi-view__track` | The frame that clips the views and the track that moves inside it (`data-dragging`, `data-no-motion`). |
| `.mx-multi-view__view` | A view (`aria-hidden` and `inert` when hidden). |

### Component tokens

| Token | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `multi-view.frame, .view` | Units: the frame (`swipeable`, `dragging`) and a view. |
| `multi-view.gap` | The gap between views, visible during a drag. |

## API reference

### MultiView props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `Bind<string \| number \| null>` | `0` | The visible view, identified by its `key` or index. `x-model` provides two-way binding. |
| `loop` | `Bind<boolean>` | `false` | The first view follows the last, and the transition wraps around instead of running back across the views in between. |
| `swipeEnabled` | `Bind<boolean>` | `true` | Lets a finger or pointer drag the views. A drag that is far or fast enough moves to the next view. |
| `animated` | `Bind<boolean>` | `true` | Animates the transition between views. `false` shows the next view immediately. |
| `lazy` | `Bind<boolean>` | `true` | Creates a view when it first becomes visible and then keeps it. A view's own `lazy` takes precedence. |
| `keepAlive` | `Bind<boolean>` | `true` | With `false`, disposes what a view's `content` created while the view is hidden. A view's own `keepAlive` takes precedence. |
| `label` | `Bind<string>` | The kit string “Pages” | The accessible name. |

### View props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `title` | `Bind<string>` | “Page 2 of 3” | The accessible name of the view. |
| `key` | `Bind<string>` | `''` | Identifies the view in `value`. The JSX `key` is also read. |
| `content` | `() => ComponentBase \| ComponentBase[]` | — | Content created when the view first becomes visible, in addition to the JSX children. |
| `lazy, keepAlive` | `Bind<boolean \| undefined>` | `undefined` | The view's own settings. `undefined` inherits from the multi-view. |
| `visible, enabled` | `Bind<boolean>` | `true` | A hidden view takes no space and is skipped. A disabled view is skipped by `next()` and `previous()`, and `goTo()` rejects it. |

### Events, properties and methods

| Member | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `onSelecting` | event | Occurs before the visible view changes (`from`, `to`, `fromView`, `toView`, `byUser`). Set `cancel = true` to keep the current view. |
| `onSelectionChanged` | event | Occurs after the visible view changes (`index`, `view`, `previous`, and `byUser` for a swipe, as opposed to code). |
| `views` | read-only | The views in order, including hidden ones. |
| `selectedView, selectedIndex` | read-only | The visible view and its index, or `null` and -1 if there is none. |
| `count` | read-only | The number of views. |
| `next(), previous()` | `Promise<boolean>` | Moves to the next or previous view that is visible and enabled. Returns `false` at an end without `loop`, or if the change was canceled. |
| `goTo(view)` | `Promise<boolean>` | Moves to a view by index, key or `View` object. `onSelecting` is raised first. A view's own `select()` does the same. |
| `add(view), insert(index, view)` | `View` | Adds a view at the end or at an index. A view from another multi-view moves here. |
| `remove(view)` | `boolean` | Removes a view and disposes it. The display moves to an adjacent view. |

# Window and dialog

> Navigation · @motifx-community/ui 0.1.0-beta.5

A window or dialog built on the native `<dialog>` element. A single form can be shown as modeless or modal, depending on how you open it. It has a title bar, can be moved, resized, minimized and maximized, and Enter and Escape activate its buttons. Forms can open other forms, and `messageBox` and `confirm` cover common prompts.

## Import

```tsx
import { MxForm, messageBox, confirm, type FormResult } from '@motifx-community/ui';
```

## Declarative and programmatic

In JSX, `x-model` shows the form while the value is true and writes `false` when the user closes it. The form is hidden rather than disposed, and it lives with its parent. Programmatically, a form, usually a class with a `view()` method, opens with `show(host)` or `showDialog(host)`. It is added to the host and disposed when it closes.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, MxForm, Stack, TextBox } from '@motifx-community/ui';

/** A form written as a class: its content comes from `view()`, and its buttons from the footer. */
export class RenameForm extends MxForm {
  private readonly data = reactive({ name: 'Report.docx' });

  constructor() {
    super({ title: 'Rename', width: '24rem' });
    const ok = new Button({ text: 'Rename', tone: 'accent' });
    ok.element.addEventListener('click', () => this.close('ok'));
    const cancel = new Button({ text: 'Cancel' });
    cancel.element.addEventListener('click', () => this.close('cancel'));
    const buttons = new Stack({ orientation: 'horizontal', wrap: true, justify: 'end' });
    buttons.controls.add(ok, cancel);
    this.footer = buttons;
    this.acceptButton = ok;
    this.cancelButton = cancel;
  }

  get name(): string {
    return this.data.name;
  }

  override view() {
    return <TextBox label="&New name" x-model={() => this.data.name} stretch />;
  }
}
```

## Modal and modeless

`show()` keeps the page usable. Several modeless windows can stack, and clicking one brings it to the front. `showDialog()` blocks everything else until it closes, and a modal form opened from another modal form blocks that form too.

```tsx
import type { Component } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, MxForm, Stack } from '@motifx-community/ui';

/** Modeless windows that stack and minimize to a strip, and a modal form that opens another. */
export default function ModalAndModeless() {
  let host: Component<HTMLDivElement> | null = null;
  let dock: Stack | null = null;
  let windows = 0;

  const openWindow = () => {
    const n = ++windows;
    const form = new MxForm({
      title: `Window ${n}`,
      showMinimize: true,
      showMaximize: true,
      startPosition: 'manual',
      left: 80 + n * 28,
      top: 120 + n * 28,
      width: '18rem',
      minimizeTarget: dock,
      content: <p>{`A modeless window, number ${n}.`}</p>,
    });
    form.show(host!);
  };

  const openNested = () => {
    const outer = new MxForm({ title: 'Level 1', width: '22rem' });
    const openInner = () => {
      const inner = new MxForm({ title: 'Level 2', content: <p>The form below is blocked until this one closes.</p> });
      void inner.showDialog(outer);
    };
    outer.content = (
      <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center">
        <p>A modal form.</p>
        <Button text="Open level 2" onclick={openInner} />
      </Stack>
    );
    void outer.showDialog(host!);
  };

  return (
    <>
      <Button text="Open a window" variant="outline" onclick={openWindow} />
      <Button text="Open nested modal forms" variant="outline" onclick={openNested} />
      <Stack
        orientation="horizontal"
        wrap
        align="center"
        ref={(c: Stack) => (dock = c)}
        aria-label="Minimized windows"
        role="group"
        style="inline-size: 100%; min-block-size: var(--mx-control-height-md); padding: var(--mx-space-2); border: var(--mx-border-width-1) dashed var(--mx-color-stroke-card); border-radius: var(--mx-radius-md)"
      />
      <div ref={(c: Component<HTMLDivElement>) => (host = c)} />
    </>
  );
}
```

## Title bar and frame

The title bar shows the icon, the title and the buttons you enable. The form moves by its title bar and stays inside the viewport. It resizes from its edges and corners, down to the `window.min-*` tokens. Each of these features has its own setting.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, MxForm, Stack } from '@motifx-community/ui';

const NoteIcon = () => (
  <svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" aria-hidden="true">
    <path d="M3.5 2.5h9v11h-9zM5.5 5.5h5M5.5 8h5M5.5 10.5h3" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.3" stroke-linejoin="round" />
  </svg>
);

const SWITCHES = ['showMinimize', 'showMaximize', 'resizable', 'movable', 'useDock'] as const;

/** A form with an icon, minimize and maximize, that moves and resizes; every part has its switch. */
export default function Frame() {
  const s = reactive({ notes: false, showMinimize: true, showMaximize: true, resizable: true, movable: true, useDock: true });
  let dock: Stack | null = null;

  return (
    <>
      <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center" role="group" aria-label="Frame switches">
        {SWITCHES.map((key) => (
          <Button key={key} text={key === 'useDock' ? 'minimize to the strip' : key} size="sm" toggle x-model={() => s[key]} />
        ))}
      </Stack>
      <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center">
        <Button text="Open notes" variant="outline" onclick={() => (s.notes = true)} />
      </Stack>
      <Stack
        class="win-dock"
        orientation="horizontal"
        wrap
        align="center"
        ref={(c: Stack) => (dock = c)}
        aria-label="Minimized windows"
        role="group"
        style="inline-size: 100%; min-block-size: var(--mx-control-height-md); padding: var(--mx-space-2); border: var(--mx-border-width-1) dashed var(--mx-color-stroke-card); border-radius: var(--mx-radius-md)"
      />
      <MxForm
        class="win-notes"
        title="Notes"
        icon={() => <NoteIcon />}
        width="22rem"
        showMinimize={() => s.showMinimize}
        showMaximize={() => s.showMaximize}
        resizable={() => s.resizable}
        movable={() => s.movable}
        x-model={() => s.notes}
        onLoaded={(e) => (e.source.minimizeTarget = () => (s.useDock ? dock : null))}
      >
        <p>Drag the title bar, pull an edge, double-click the title bar.</p>
      </MxForm>
    </>
  );
}
```

## Default and cancel buttons

Enter in a single-line field clicks `acceptButton`, and Escape clicks `cancelButton`. Without a cancel button, `closeOnEscape` decides. It is on for modal forms and off for modeless ones.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, MxForm, Stack, TextBox } from '@motifx-community/ui';

/** A form written as a class: its content comes from `view()`, and its buttons from the footer. */
export class RenameForm extends MxForm {
  private readonly data = reactive({ name: 'Report.docx' });

  constructor() {
    super({ title: 'Rename', width: '24rem' });
    const ok = new Button({ text: 'Rename', tone: 'accent' });
    ok.element.addEventListener('click', () => this.close('ok'));
    const cancel = new Button({ text: 'Cancel' });
    cancel.element.addEventListener('click', () => this.close('cancel'));
    const buttons = new Stack({ orientation: 'horizontal', wrap: true, justify: 'end' });
    buttons.controls.add(ok, cancel);
    this.footer = buttons;
    this.acceptButton = ok;
    this.cancelButton = cancel;
  }

  get name(): string {
    return this.data.name;
  }

  override view() {
    return <TextBox label="&New name" x-model={() => this.data.name} stretch />;
  }
}
```

## Events

`onClosing` can keep the form open, in this case while it has unsaved changes. `reason` distinguishes a user action (close button, Escape) from a programmatic close and from the owner being disposed.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, MxForm, Stack } from '@motifx-community/ui';

/** The events of a form in order; onClosing keeps it open while it has changes. */
export default function Events() {
  const s = reactive({ open: false, dirty: false, log: [] as string[] });

  const log = (line: string) => {
    s.log.push(line);
    if (s.log.length > 6) s.log.shift();
  };

  return (
    <>
      <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center">
        <Button text="Open" variant="outline" onclick={() => (s.open = true)} />
        <output class="win-log">{() => s.log.join(' · ')}</output>
      </Stack>
      <MxForm
        class="win-events"
        title="Events"
        x-model={() => s.open}
        onLoaded={() => log('loaded')}
        onShown={() => log('shown')}
        onActivate={() => log('activate')}
        onDeactivate={() => log('deactivate')}
        onClosing={(e) => {
          log(`closing (${e.reason})`);
          if (s.dirty && e.reason === 'user') e.cancel = true;
        }}
        onClosed={(e) => log(`closed: ${e.result}`)}
      >
        <Button text={() => (s.dirty ? 'Has changes: close is kept' : 'No changes')} toggle x-model={() => s.dirty} />
      </MxForm>
    </>
  );
}
```

## Message boxes

`messageBox` shows a modal message with buttons and resolves with the result of the button pressed. `confirm` asks OK or Cancel and resolves to `true` or `false`. Caution and danger boxes are alert dialogs, and a danger box starts on its safe button.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, confirm, messageBox } from '@motifx-community/ui';

/** A message, a question with three answers, a confirmation, and custom buttons. */
export default function MessageBoxes() {
  const answer = reactive({ text: '' });

  const info = async () => {
    const result = await messageBox({ title: 'Saved', text: 'The file was saved.', tone: 'success' });
    answer.text = `Answer: ${result}`;
  };

  const yesNoCancel = async () => {
    const result = await messageBox({ title: 'Unsaved changes', text: 'Save the changes before closing?', buttons: ['yes', 'no', 'cancel'], tone: 'caution' });
    answer.text = `Answer: ${result}`;
  };

  const confirmDelete = async () => {
    const ok = await confirm('Delete “Report.docx”? This cannot be undone.', { title: 'Delete file', tone: 'danger' });
    answer.text = `Answer: ${ok}`;
  };

  const ownButtons = async () => {
    const result = await messageBox({
      title: 'Update',
      text: 'A new version is ready.',
      buttons: [
        { text: 'Restart now', result: 'restart' },
        { text: 'Later', result: 'later' },
      ],
      tone: 'info',
    });
    answer.text = `Answer: ${result}`;
  };

  return (
    <>
      <Button text="Info" variant="outline" onclick={info} />
      <Button text="Yes / No / Cancel" variant="outline" onclick={yesNoCancel} />
      <Button text="Confirm delete" variant="outline" onclick={confirmDelete} />
      <Button text="Own buttons" variant="outline" onclick={ownButtons} />
      <output class="win-answer">{() => answer.text}</output>
    </>
  );
}
```

## Keyboard

| Key | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `Tab / Shift + Tab` | Inside a modal form, Tab cycles within it. From a modeless form, it continues to the page. |
| `Escape` | Clicks `cancelButton`. Otherwise, it closes the form when `closeOnEscape` is on, which is the default for modal forms. |
| `Enter` | In a single-line field, clicks `acceptButton`. This does not apply in a text area or on a button. |
| `Alt + key (`&Name`)` | Access keys work inside the front window. While a modal form is open, they work only inside it. |
| `Moving, resizing` | Moved and resized with the pointer. There are no built-in keys, but an application can add them with `form.addShortcut(...)` and the `left`, `top`, `width` and `height` properties. |

## Accessibility

| Topic | Details |
| --- | --- |
| `Element` | A native `<dialog>`, using `showModal()` for a modal form, which makes the page inert, and `show()` for a modeless one. |
| `Role and name` | `role="dialog"` (`alertdialog` with `alert`), `aria-modal="true"` when modal, and named by its title through `aria-labelledby`. |
| `Description` | A message box is described by its text (`aria-describedby`). |
| `Focus` | On open, focus goes to `[autofocus]`, the first field, the accept button or the first control. On close, it returns to where it was. It never falls to `<body>`. |
| `Title bar buttons` | Named from `uiLocale` (Minimize, Maximize, Restore, Close). |
| `Motion` | A short fade using the motion tokens, removed when the user prefers reduced motion. |

## Localization

The title bar buttons and the `ok`, `cancel`, `yes` and `no` buttons of a message box get their names from `uiLocale.strings`.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, messageBox, uiLocale } from '@motifx-community/ui';

/** Switches the names of the title bar buttons and of the message box buttons. */
export default function Localization() {
  const s = reactive({ lang: 'en' });

  const toggle = () => {
    s.lang = s.lang === 'en' ? 'tr' : 'en';
    void uiLocale.use(s.lang);
  };

  const ask = () =>
    messageBox({ title: 'Unsaved changes', text: 'Save the changes before closing?', buttons: ['yes', 'no', 'cancel'], tone: 'caution' });

  return (
    <>
      <Button text={() => (s.lang === 'en' ? 'Language: English' : 'Dil: Türkçe')} variant="outline" onclick={toggle} />
      <Button text="Ask" variant="outline" onclick={ask} />
    </>
  );
}
```

## Styling

| Hook | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `.mx-form` | The `<dialog>`. `data-state` (`normal`, `minimized`, `maximized`), `data-modal`, `data-active`, `data-placed`, `data-docked`, `data-resizable`, `data-movable`, `data-dragging`. |
| `.mx-form__bar, .mx-form__icon, .mx-form__title, .mx-form__tools` | The title bar and its parts. |
| `.mx-form__content, .mx-form__footer` | The content area and the button row. |
| `.mx-form__frame, .mx-form__resize[data-edge]` | The resize handles. |
| `.mx-form-chip` | The chip a minimized form leaves in its `minimizeTarget`. |
| `.mx-message-box, .mx-message-box__icon, .mx-message-box__text` | The content of a message box, with `data-tone`. |
| `--_mx-w, --_mx-h, --_mx-x, --_mx-y` | The size and position the form sets on itself. |

### Component tokens

| Token | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `window.scrim, window.surface` | Units: the backdrop of a modal form, and the surface (`active`, `dialog` for a modal form, `maximized`). |
| `window.bar, window.icon, window.title, window.tools` | Units: the title bar (`active`, `dialog`), its icon, the title (`dialog`) and its buttons. |
| `window.body, window.footer, window.grip` | Units: the content area, the button row and the resize grips (`corner`). |
| `window.bar-height, window.title-align, window.tools-order` | The title bar height (from the design system `bar.*` tokens), and the position of the title and its buttons. |
| `window.min-width, window.min-height, window.viewport-margin` | The minimum size and the margin kept around the form. |
| `window.resize-edge, window.enter-offset` | The resize handles, and the distance it animates in from. |
| `window.message, window.message-icon, window.message-width` | Message boxes: units for the content and its tone glyph (per tone), and their width. |

## API reference

### Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `Bind<boolean>` | `false` | Indicates whether it is open. `x-model` provides two-way binding, so `false` is written when the user closes it. |
| `modal` | `Bind<boolean>` | `false` | Opened through `value`, the form is modal. |
| `title` | `Bind<string>` | `''` | The title in the title bar, which also names the form. This is the same property as `text`. |
| `content` | `Bind<ComponentBase \| null>` | — | Content for the content area, in addition to JSX children and `view()`. |
| `footer` | `Bind<ComponentBase \| null>` | — | A non-scrolling row below the content, for buttons. |
| `icon` | `Bind<IconSource \| null>` | — | An icon at the start of the title bar. |
| `showClose` | `Bind<boolean>` | `true` | Shows the close button. |
| `showMinimize` | `Bind<boolean>` | `false` | Shows the minimize button, on modeless forms only. |
| `showMaximize` | `Bind<boolean>` | `false` | Shows the maximize button. Double-clicking the title bar does the same. |
| `resizable` | `Bind<boolean>` | `true` | Allows resizing from the edges and corners. |
| `movable` | `Bind<boolean>` | `true` | Allows moving by dragging the title bar, within the viewport. |
| `closeOnEscape` | `Bind<boolean>` | `true` for modal forms, `false` for modeless forms | Closes the form with `cancel` on Escape when there is no `cancelButton`. |
| `acceptButton` | `Bind<Control \| null>` | — | The button Enter clicks from a single-line field. |
| `cancelButton` | `Bind<Control \| null>` | — | The button Escape clicks. |
| `minimizeTarget` | `Bind<HTMLElement \| ComponentBase \| null>` | — | Where a minimized form leaves a chip that restores it. Without it, the form collapses to its title bar. |
| `windowState` | `Bind<FormWindowState>` | `'normal'` | `normal`, `minimized`, `maximized`. |
| `startPosition` | `Bind<FormStartPosition>` | `'center'` | `center`, or `manual` at `left` and `top`. |
| `left / top` | `Bind<number \| string>` | — | With `manual`, the position from the start edge (the right edge in RTL) and the top. A number is in pixels. |
| `width / height` | `Bind<number \| string>` | Content size | A CSS length. A number is in pixels. |
| `alert` | `Bind<boolean>` | `false` | `role="alertdialog"`, for urgent content. |
| `disposeOnClose` | `Bind<boolean>` | see text | By default, a form added to the host by `show` or `showDialog` is disposed, and a JSX form is hidden. |
| `enabled / disabled, visible` | see Control |  | Properties shared by all controls. |

### Properties

| Property | Access | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `every prop above` | read/write, reactive | Accepts a value or a function, the same as the prop. `left`, `top`, `width` and `height` track moving and resizing by the user. |
| `result` | read/write, reactive | How the form closed, or will close. `close()` without an argument uses this value. It is `cancel` on open. |
| `isOpen, isModal, isActive` | read-only, reactive | Indicate whether the form is open, whether it is modal, and whether it is the front window of the page. |
| `activeControl` | read-only, reactive | The child control that has focus, or last had it. |
| `contentElement` | read-only | The content area element. |

### Methods

| Method | Returns | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `show(host, disposeRef?)` | `void` | Shows the form as modeless in `host` (a component or the application). It is disposed with `disposeRef`, or with the host. |
| `showDialog(host, disposeRef?)` | `Promise<FormResult>` | Shows the form as modal and resolves with the result when it closes. |
| `close(result?)` | `boolean` | Closes it. Returns `false` if `onClosing` canceled the close. |
| `activate()` | `void` | Brings it to the front with focus on its last active control. |
| `minimize(), maximize(), restore()` | `void` | These set `windowState`. |
| `center()` | `void` | Centers it in the viewport. |
| `restoreFocus()` | `boolean` | Returns focus to its last active control. |

### Events

| Event | When |
| --- | --- |
| `onLoaded(e)` | Runs before the first show, and is where to populate the form. |
| `onShown(e)` | Occurs after it is shown. |
| `onActivate(e) / onDeactivate(e)` | Occur when it becomes the front window and when another window takes over. |
| `onClosing(e)` | Occurs before it closes. `e`: `{ result, reason, source, cancel }`. Set `cancel = true` to keep it open, unless its owner is being disposed. |
| `onClosed(e)` | Occurs after it closes. `e`: `{ result, reason, source }`, where `reason` is `user` (close button, Escape), `code` or `owner`. |

### Helper functions

| Function | Returns | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `messageBox(options)` | `Promise<FormResult>` | Shows a modal message: `title`, `text`, `buttons` (`ok`, `cancel`, `yes`, `no` or `{ text, result, tone }`), `tone` (`info`, `success`, `caution`, `danger`), `defaultButton` and `host`. |
| `confirm(text, options?)` | `Promise<boolean>` | Shows OK and Cancel, and resolves to `true` for OK. |

## Example files

`JsxAndCode.tsx`

```tsx
import { reactive, type Component } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, MxForm, Stack, TextBox, type FormResult } from '@motifx-community/ui';
import { RenameForm } from './RenameForm';

/** A modeless form in JSX shown through x-model, and a form class shown modal programmatically. */
export default function JsxAndCode() {
  const s = reactive({ find: false, query: '', found: '', renamed: '' });
  let host: Component<HTMLDivElement> | null = null;
  let findForm: MxForm | null = null;

  const findOk = new Button({ text: 'Find', tone: 'accent' });
  findOk.element.addEventListener('click', () => findForm?.close('ok'));
  const findClose = new Button({ text: 'Close' });
  findClose.element.addEventListener('click', () => (s.find = false));
  const findButtons = new Stack({ orientation: 'horizontal', wrap: true, justify: 'end' });
  findButtons.controls.add(findOk, findClose);

  const rename = async () => {
    const form = new RenameForm();
    const result: FormResult = await form.showDialog(host!);
    s.renamed = result === 'ok' ? `Renamed to “${form.name}”.` : 'Kept the old name.';
  };

  return (
    <>
      <Button text="Find…" variant="outline" onclick={() => (s.find = true)} />
      <MxForm
        class="win-find"
        title="Find"
        x-model={() => s.find}
        footer={findButtons}
        acceptButton={findOk}
        cancelButton={findClose}
        ref={(f: MxForm) => (findForm = f)}
        onClosed={(e) => e.result === 'ok' && (s.found = `Searched for “${s.query}”.`)}
      >
        <TextBox label="&Find what" x-model={() => s.query} />
      </MxForm>
      <output class="win-found">{() => s.found}</output>
      <Button text="Rename… (class, modal)" variant="outline" onclick={rename} />
      <output class="win-renamed">{() => s.renamed}</output>
      <div ref={(c: Component<HTMLDivElement>) => (host = c)} />
    </>
  );
}
```

`RenameForm.tsx`

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, MxForm, Stack, TextBox } from '@motifx-community/ui';

/** A form written as a class: its content comes from `view()`, and its buttons from the footer. */
export class RenameForm extends MxForm {
  private readonly data = reactive({ name: 'Report.docx' });

  constructor() {
    super({ title: 'Rename', width: '24rem' });
    const ok = new Button({ text: 'Rename', tone: 'accent' });
    ok.element.addEventListener('click', () => this.close('ok'));
    const cancel = new Button({ text: 'Cancel' });
    cancel.element.addEventListener('click', () => this.close('cancel'));
    const buttons = new Stack({ orientation: 'horizontal', wrap: true, justify: 'end' });
    buttons.controls.add(ok, cancel);
    this.footer = buttons;
    this.acceptButton = ok;
    this.cancelButton = cancel;
  }

  get name(): string {
    return this.data.name;
  }

  override view() {
    return <TextBox label="&New name" x-model={() => this.data.name} stretch />;
  }
}
```

```tsx
import { reactive, type Component } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button } from '@motifx-community/ui';
import { RenameForm } from './RenameForm';

/** Enter clicks the form's accept button, Escape its cancel button; see RenameForm.tsx. */
export default function DefaultButtons() {

  let host: Component<HTMLDivElement> | null = null;

  const rename = async () => {
    const form = new RenameForm();

    s.renamed = result === 'ok' ? `Renamed to “${form.name}”.` : 'Kept the old name.';
  };

  return (
    <>
      <Button text="Rename…" variant="outline" onclick={rename} />
      <output>{() => s.renamed}</output>
      <div ref={(c: Component<HTMLDivElement>) => (host = c)} />
    </>
  );
}
```

# BottomSheet

> Navigation · @motifx-community/ui 0.1.0-beta.5

A panel that slides up from the bottom of the page or a container and stops at set heights: peek, half, full, the height of its content, or custom values. Users can drag it by its handle and title, flick it, and swipe down to close it. It can be modal or non-modal, and the back button closes it on phones.

## Import

```tsx
import { BottomSheet, type BottomSheetDetent } from '@motifx-community/ui';
```

## Declarative and programmatic

In JSX, `x-model` opens and closes it based on state. Programmatically, `show(host)` adds it to a component and disposes it on close, and `open()` and `close()` work on a sheet that stays in place. Without a `container`, it opens over the whole page in the browser's top layer.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { BottomSheet, Button, Stack, TextBox } from '@motifx-community/ui';

/** A sheet declared in JSX and bound to state, and one created programmatically, both over the whole page. */
export default function JsxAndCode() {
  const s = reactive({ open: false, name: 'Ada', said: '' });

  const share = () => {
    const sheet = new BottomSheet({
      title: 'Share',
      detent: 'fit',
      detents: ['fit', 'full'],
      content: (
        <Stack gap="sm">
          <p>Anyone with the link can see the report.</p>
          <Button text="Copy the link" variant="outline" onclick={() => sheet.close()} />
        </Stack>
      ),
      onClosed: (e) => (s.said = `The code sheet closed (${e.reason}).`),
    });
    // show() puts it in the page and disposes it when it closes.
    sheet.show(host);
  };
  let host!: Stack;

  return (
    <Stack ref={(c: Stack) => (host = c)} gap="sm">
      <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center">
        <Button text="Edit the name" variant="outline" onclick={() => (s.open = true)} />
        <Button text="Share (programmatically)" variant="outline" onclick={share} />
        <output>{() => s.said || `Name: ${s.name}`}</output>
      </Stack>
      <BottomSheet title="Your name" showClose detents={['half', 'full']} x-model={() => s.open}>
        <TextBox label="Name" x-model={() => s.name} />
      </BottomSheet>
    </Stack>
  );
}
```

## Heights, dragging and options

`detents` lists the heights it stops at, and `detent` is the current one. The handle and title follow the finger or mouse, and scrolling content can drag the sheet from its top. This example opens over a frame (`container`) and is not modal, so the page underneath stays usable. Every behavior is a setting that can be changed live.

```tsx
import { reactive, type Component } from '@motifx/core';
import { BottomSheet, Button, RadioGroup, Stack, Switch, type BottomSheetDetent } from '@motifx-community/ui';

const ROWS = Array.from({ length: 30 }, (_, i) => ({ id: i + 1, text: `Place ${i + 1}` }));

/** A sheet over a frame, at peek, half or full height. Drag the handle or title, flick, or use the arrow keys on the handle. Every behavior is a setting. */
export default function Detents() {
  const s = reactive({
    open: true,
    detent: 'peek' as BottomSheetDetent,
    modal: false,
    handle: true,
    draggable: true,
    content: true,
    swipe: true,
    back: true,
  });
  let frame!: Component<HTMLDivElement>;

  return (
    <>
      <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center" gap="lg">
        <Switch label="Modal" x-model={() => s.modal} />
        <Switch label="Handle" x-model={() => s.handle} />
        <Switch label="Draggable" x-model={() => s.draggable} />
        <Switch label="Content drags it" x-model={() => s.content} />
        <Switch label="Swipe down closes" x-model={() => s.swipe} />
        <Switch label="Back button closes" x-model={() => s.back} />
      </Stack>
      <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center">
        <RadioGroup
          label="Height"
          orientation="horizontal"
          items={[
            { value: 'peek', text: 'Peek' },
            { value: 'half', text: 'Half' },
            { value: 'full', text: 'Full' },
          ]}
          itemText="text"
          itemValue="value"
          x-model={() => s.detent}
        />
        <Button text="Open" variant="outline" enabled={() => !s.open} onclick={() => (s.open = true)} />
      </Stack>
      <div ref={(c: Component<HTMLDivElement>) => (frame = c)} class="sheet-frame" style="position: relative; block-size: 28rem; overflow: hidden; border: var(--mx-border-width-1) solid var(--mx-color-stroke-card); border-radius: var(--mx-radius-lg); background: var(--mx-color-bg-layer)">
        <p style="padding: var(--mx-space-4)">The page under the sheet. Non-modal, it stays usable.</p>
      </div>
      <BottomSheet
        title="Nearby"
        label="Nearby places"
        container={() => frame}
        detents={['peek', 'half', 'full']}
        x-model={() => s.open}
        detent={() => s.detent}
        onDetentChanged={(e) => (s.detent = e.to)}
        modal={() => s.modal}
        showHandle={() => s.handle}
        draggable={() => s.draggable}
        dragContent={() => s.content}
        swipeToClose={() => s.swipe}
        closeOnBack={() => s.back}
      >
        <ul style="margin: 0; padding: 0; list-style: none">
          {ROWS.map((row) => (
            <li key={row.id} style="padding-block: var(--mx-space-2); border-block-end: var(--mx-border-width-1) solid var(--mx-color-stroke-divider)">
              {row.text}
            </li>
          ))}
        </ul>
      </BottomSheet>
    </>
  );
}
```

## Events

Each open, close and height change raises an event before and after. `onClosing` provides the reason (`reason`) and can keep the sheet open, and `onDetentChanging` can reject a height or choose another one.

```tsx
import { reactive, type Component } from '@motifx/core';
import { BottomSheet, Button, Stack, Switch } from '@motifx-community/ui';

/** The events in order. While "Keep it open" is on, onClosing refuses every closing but by code; "Not full" refuses the tallest height. */
export default function Events() {
  const s = reactive({ open: false, keep: false, notFull: false, log: [] as string[] });
  let frame!: Component<HTMLDivElement>;

  const log = (line: string) => {
    s.log.push(line);
    if (s.log.length > 6) s.log.shift();
  };

  return (
    <>
      <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center" gap="lg">
        <Button text="Open" variant="outline" enabled={() => !s.open} onclick={() => (s.open = true)} />
        <Switch label="Keep it open" x-model={() => s.keep} />
        <Switch label="Not full" x-model={() => s.notFull} />
      </Stack>
      <output>{() => s.log.join(' · ') || 'No events yet.'}</output>
      <div ref={(c: Component<HTMLDivElement>) => (frame = c)} style="position: relative; block-size: 28rem; overflow: hidden; border: var(--mx-border-width-1) solid var(--mx-color-stroke-card); border-radius: var(--mx-radius-lg); background: var(--mx-color-bg-layer)" />
      <BottomSheet
        title="Events"
        showClose
        container={() => frame}
        detents={['half', 'full']}
        x-model={() => s.open}
        onOpening={() => log('opening')}
        onOpened={() => log('opened')}
        onDetentChanging={(e) => {
          log(`detentChanging ${e.from} → ${e.to}`);
          if (s.notFull && e.to === 'full') e.cancel = true;
        }}
        onDetentChanged={(e) => log(`detentChanged ${e.to}`)}
        onClosing={(e) => {
          log(`closing (${e.reason})`);
          if (s.keep && e.reason !== 'code') e.cancel = true;
        }}
        onClosed={(e) => log(`closed (${e.reason})`)}
      >
        <p>Drag it, press Escape, the scrim, its close button or the browser's back.</p>
        <Button text="Close by code" variant="outline" onclick={() => (s.open = false)} />
      </BottomSheet>
    </>
  );
}
```

## Keyboard

| Key | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `Escape` | Closes the sheet (`closeOnEscape`). |
| `Tab, Shift+Tab` | Moves through its controls. In a modal, focus cycles within it. |
| `Up, Right, Page Up (on the handle)` | Moves to the next taller height. |
| `Down, Left, Page Down (on the handle)` | Moves to the next shorter height without closing the sheet. |
| `Home, End (on the handle)` | Moves to the lowest or tallest height. |

## Touch and mouse

| Gesture | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `Drag the handle or the title` | The sheet follows the finger or mouse and settles at the nearest height on release. It stretches slightly beyond the tallest height. |
| `Flick` | Moving faster than `flickSpeed` jumps to the next height in that direction, regardless of distance. |
| `Drag or flick down past the lowest height` | The sheet closes (`swipeToClose`), with `reason: 'swipe'`. |
| `Drag the content` | Dragging down from the top, or up while the sheet is not at its tallest, moves the sheet. Otherwise, the content scrolls. A horizontal swipe goes to the content. |
| `Tap the handle` | Moves to the next height, wrapping to the lowest. |

## Accessibility

| Topic | Details |
| --- | --- |
| `Dialog` | The panel has `role="dialog"`, is named by its title, `label` or "Sheet", and has `aria-modal` when modal. The surrounding content is `inert`, so screen readers and the keyboard stay inside. |
| `Handle` | A vertical `role="slider"` named "Sheet height". Its value is the share of the full height, announced as the name of the height ("Half height"). |
| `Focus` | Moves in when the sheet opens (modal by default) and returns to where it was when the sheet closes. |
| `Motion` | Slides in using the motion tokens. When the user prefers reduced motion, it appears without animation. |
| `Safe areas` | The panel stays clear of rounded screen corners and system bars (`env(safe-area-inset-*)`). |

## Localization

The handle and height names, the default name and the close button come from `uiLocale.strings` (`sheetHandle`, `sheetPeek`, `sheetHalf`, `sheetFull`, `sheetFit`, `sheetHeight`, `sheetLabel`, `close`).

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { BottomSheet, Button, uiLocale } from '@motifx-community/ui';

/** The handle name, height names and close button name come from uiLocale. */
export default function Localization() {
  const s = reactive({ open: false, lang: 'en' });

  const toggle = () => {
    s.lang = s.lang === 'en' ? 'tr' : 'en';
    void uiLocale.use(s.lang);
  };

  return (
    <>
      <Button text={() => (s.lang === 'en' ? 'Language: English' : 'Dil: Türkçe')} variant="outline" onclick={toggle} />
      <Button text="Open" variant="outline" onclick={() => (s.open = true)} />
      <BottomSheet showClose detents={['peek', 'half', 'full']} detent="half" x-model={() => s.open}>
        <p>Focus the handle: a screen reader reads its name and the height it is at.</p>
      </BottomSheet>
    </>
  );
}
```

## Styling

| Hook | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `.mx-bottom-sheet` | The layer over the page or container. `data-open`, `data-modal`, `data-scrim`, `data-contained`, `data-dragging`. |
| `.mx-bottom-sheet__scrim` | The dimmed layer. |
| `.mx-bottom-sheet__panel` | The dialog. `--_size` is its height, and `--_drop` is how far it is pulled below its lowest height. |
| `.mx-bottom-sheet__handle, .mx-bottom-sheet__grip` | The handle (the slider) and the line drawn in it. |
| `.mx-bottom-sheet__header, __title, __tools, __close` | The title row and its close button. |
| `.mx-bottom-sheet__body, .mx-bottom-sheet__footer` | The scrolling content and the row below it. |

### Component tokens

| Token | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `sheet.scrim, sheet.panel` | Units: the dimmed layer, and the surface (`max-width` limits its width on large screens, and `full` sets its top corners when it reaches the top). |
| `sheet.handle, sheet.grip` | Units: the handle (`focus` for keyboard use) and its grip. |
| `sheet.header, sheet.title, sheet.tools, sheet.body, sheet.footer` | Units: the content area (`body.focus`: a focus ring inside the content). |
| `sheet.top-gap, sheet.peek-height, sheet.inset` | The gap at the top at full height, the peek height, and the margin around the panel. |
| `sheet.handle-area, sheet.font-family` | The grab area of the handle, and the font family. |

## API reference

### Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `Bind<boolean>` | `false` | Indicates whether it is open. `x-model` provides two-way binding, so `false` is written when the user closes it. |
| `title` | `Bind<string>` | `''` | A title at the top, which also names the dialog. This is the same property as `text`. |
| `label` | `Bind<string>` | `''` | The accessible name when there is no title. The default is "Sheet", from `uiLocale`. |
| `detents` | `Bind<readonly BottomSheetDetent[]>` | `['half', 'full']` | The heights it stops at: `'peek'` (`sheet.peek-height`), `'half'`, `'full'` (the available space minus `sheet.top-gap`), `'fit'` (the height of its content), pixels, or a percentage such as `'40%'`. |
| `detent` | `Bind<BottomSheetDetent>` | The first of `detents` | The height it opens at and its current height. User changes write to it, and setting it moves the sheet. |
| `modal` | `Bind<boolean>` | `true` | Blocks everything around it, within its container or on the whole page. Tab stays inside. |
| `scrim` | `Bind<boolean>` | When modal | Shows a dimmed layer behind it. |
| `container` | `Bind<HTMLElement \| ComponentBase \| null>` | `null` | Opens over this element, which is made `relative` while open if it is static. `null` opens over the page, in the top layer. |
| `content, footer` | `Bind<ComponentBase \| null>` | — | Content in addition to JSX children, and a non-scrolling row below it. |
| `showClose` | `Bind<boolean>` | `false` | Shows a close button next to the title. |
| `showHandle` | `Bind<boolean>` | `true` | Shows the handle at the top, which is a grip for touch and mouse, and a slider for the keyboard. |
| `draggable` | `Bind<boolean>` | `true` | Lets touch and mouse move the sheet between heights using the handle and title. |
| `dragContent` | `Bind<boolean>` | `true` | Lets a finger on the content drag the sheet when the content cannot scroll in that direction: down from its top, or up while the sheet is not at its tallest. |
| `swipeToClose` | `Bind<boolean>` | `true` | Closes the sheet when it is dragged or flicked below its lowest height. |
| `flickSpeed` | `Bind<number>` | `0.4` | The speed at which a flick moves to the next height, in pixels per millisecond. |
| `closeOnEscape, closeOnScrim` | `Bind<boolean>` | `true` | Closes the sheet on Escape and on a click on the scrim. |
| `closeOnBack` | `Bind<boolean>` | `true` | Closes the sheet with the browser's back action (the Android back button or back gesture). It adds one history entry while open and removes it when closed another way, so no entry is left behind. |
| `focusOnOpen` | `Bind<boolean>` | When modal | Moves focus in on open: to `[autofocus]`, the first field, the first control, or the panel. |
| `returnFocus` | `Bind<boolean>` | `true` | Returns focus to where it was on close. |
| `disposeOnClose` | `Bind<boolean>` | see text | Disposes the sheet on close. By default, this applies when `show` added it to its host. |
| `enabled, visible` | see Control |  | Properties shared by all controls. |

### Members and events

| Member | Returns | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `open()` | `boolean` | Opens at `detent`. Returns `false` if `onOpening` canceled it. If it is not in the page, it opens from the end of the page or in its container. |
| `close(reason?)` | `boolean` | Closes it. Returns `false` if `onClosing` canceled the close. |
| `toggle()` | `boolean` | Opens or closes the sheet. |
| `show(host, disposeRef?)` | `boolean` | Adds it to `host` (a component or the application) if needed and opens it. It is disposed on close. |
| `snapTo(detent)` | `boolean` | Moves it to a height, and opens it there if closed. |
| `expand(), collapse()` | `boolean` | Moves to the next taller or shorter height. Returns `false` at the end. |
| `isOpen, height` | read-only | Indicates whether it is open (reactive), and its current height in pixels. |
| `panelElement, contentElement` | read-only | The surface with `role="dialog"`, and the scrolling area. |
| `onOpening / onOpened` | events | `{ cancel, source }` and `{ source }`. `opened` occurs after the slide-in animation. |
| `onClosing / onClosed` | events | `{ cancel, reason, source }` and `{ reason, source }`, with `'code'`, `'escape'`, `'scrim'`, `'swipe'`, `'back'`, `'button'` or `'owner'`. A close caused by the owner being disposed cannot be canceled. |
| `onDetentChanging / onDetentChanged` | events | `{ from, to, byUser, cancel, source }`. `to` can be changed, and if canceled the sheet returns to where it was. |

Every prop is also a property that accepts a value or a function. The shared parts (the panel, scrim, modality, focus handling and back button) come from `OverlayPanel`, which `Drawer` and `ActionSheet` also use.

# Drawer

> Navigation · @motifx-community/ui 0.1.0-beta.5

A panel that slides in from an edge of the page or a container, either over the content or pushing it aside. Users can swipe it in from the edge and back out, and Escape, the scrim and the browser's back action close it.

## Import

```tsx
import { Drawer, type DrawerSide, type DrawerMode } from '@motifx-community/ui';
```

## Page-level drawer

Bind it with `x-model`, or open it with `open()` and `show(host)` as with a bottom sheet. Over the page, it opens in the top layer as a modal with a scrim.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, Drawer, ListBox } from '@motifx-community/ui';

const PLACES = [
  { id: 'inbox', text: 'Inbox' },
  { id: 'starred', text: 'Starred' },
  { id: 'sent', text: 'Sent' },
  { id: 'drafts', text: 'Drafts' },
];

/** A drawer over the whole page from the start edge, bound with x-model; a finger can swipe it back to close it. */
export default function Navigation() {
  const s = reactive({ open: false, place: 'inbox' });

  return (
    <>
      <Button text="Menu" variant="outline" onclick={() => (s.open = true)} />
      <output>{() => `Showing: ${PLACES.find((p) => p.id === s.place)?.text}`}</output>
      <Drawer title="Mail" showClose x-model={() => s.open}>
        <ListBox label="Folders" items={PLACES} itemText="text" itemValue="id" x-model={() => s.place} onclick={() => (s.open = false)} />
      </Drawer>
    </>
  );
}
```

## Edges, push mode and swipe gestures

This example opens over a frame (`container`) from any edge. `push` moves the frame's content aside (`pushTarget`) and is not modal unless requested. With `edgeSwipe`, a finger on a touch screen opens it from the edge. Every option can be changed live.

```tsx
import { reactive, type Component } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, Drawer, RadioGroup, Stack, Switch, type DrawerMode, type DrawerSide } from '@motifx-community/ui';

/** A drawer over a frame: its edge, over or pushing the content, a swipe in from the edge, modal or not. Every option is live. */
export default function Options() {
  const s = reactive({ open: false, side: 'start' as DrawerSide, mode: 'over' as DrawerMode, edge: true, modal: true, swipe: true, back: true });
  let frame!: Component<HTMLDivElement>;
  let content!: Component<HTMLDivElement>;

  return (
    <>
      <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center" gap="lg">
        <Switch label="Swipe in from the edge" x-model={() => s.edge} />
        <Switch label="Modal" x-model={() => s.modal} />
        <Switch label="Swipe back closes" x-model={() => s.swipe} />
        <Switch label="Back button closes" x-model={() => s.back} />
      </Stack>
      <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center" gap="lg">
        <RadioGroup
          label="Edge"
          orientation="horizontal"
          items={[
            { value: 'start', text: 'Start' },
            { value: 'end', text: 'End' },
            { value: 'top', text: 'Top' },
            { value: 'bottom', text: 'Bottom' },
          ]}
          itemText="text"
          itemValue="value"
          x-model={() => s.side}
        />
        <RadioGroup
          label="Mode"
          orientation="horizontal"
          items={[
            { value: 'over', text: 'Over' },
            { value: 'push', text: 'Push' },
          ]}
          itemText="text"
          itemValue="value"
          x-model={() => s.mode}
        />
        <Button text="Open" variant="outline" onclick={() => (s.open = true)} />
      </Stack>
      <div ref={(c: Component<HTMLDivElement>) => (frame = c)} style="position: relative; block-size: 28rem; overflow: hidden; border: var(--mx-border-width-1) solid var(--mx-color-stroke-card); border-radius: var(--mx-radius-lg); background: var(--mx-color-bg-layer)">
        <div ref={(c: Component<HTMLDivElement>) => (content = c)} style="block-size: 100%; padding: var(--mx-space-4); box-sizing: border-box">
          <p>The content of the frame. On a touch screen, swipe in from its edge.</p>
        </div>
      </div>
      <Drawer
        title="Filters"
        showClose
        container={() => frame}
        side={() => s.side}
        mode={() => s.mode}
        pushTarget={() => content}
        edgeSwipe={() => s.edge}
        modal={() => s.modal}
        swipeToClose={() => s.swipe}
        closeOnBack={() => s.back}
        size={() => (s.side === 'top' || s.side === 'bottom' ? '12rem' : null)}
        x-model={() => s.open}
      >
        <Stack gap="sm">
          <Switch label="Only unread" />
          <Switch label="With attachments" />
          <Button text="Apply" onclick={() => (s.open = false)} />
        </Stack>
      </Drawer>
    </>
  );
}
```

## Events

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, Drawer, Stack, Switch } from '@motifx-community/ui';

/** The events of a drawer in order; "Keep it open" refuses every closing but by code. */
export default function Events() {
  const s = reactive({ open: false, keep: false, log: [] as string[] });

  const log = (line: string) => {
    s.log.push(line);
    if (s.log.length > 6) s.log.shift();
  };

  return (
    <>
      <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center" gap="lg">
        <Button text="Open" variant="outline" onclick={() => (s.open = true)} />
        <Switch label="Keep it open" x-model={() => s.keep} />
      </Stack>
      <output>{() => s.log.join(' · ') || 'No events yet.'}</output>
      <Drawer
        side="end"
        title="Events"
        showClose
        x-model={() => s.open}
        onOpening={() => log('opening')}
        onOpened={() => log('opened')}
        onClosing={(e) => {
          log(`closing (${e.reason})`);
          if (s.keep && e.reason !== 'code') e.cancel = true;
        }}
        onClosed={(e) => log(`closed (${e.reason})`)}
      >
        <Button text="Close by code" variant="outline" onclick={() => (s.open = false)} />
      </Drawer>
    </>
  );
}
```

## Touch and keyboard

| Gesture or key | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `Swipe in from the edge (`edgeSwipe`)` | The drawer follows the finger. Releasing past half its size, or flicking it, leaves it open. Otherwise, it slides back. |
| `Swipe it back towards its edge` | It follows the finger. Releasing past halfway, or flicking it, closes it. A swipe on content that scrolls horizontally goes to that content. |
| `A press on the scrim, Escape, the back button` | It closes, and each of these has an option. |
| `Escape` | Closes it. |
| `Tab, Shift+Tab` | Moves through its controls. In a modal, focus cycles within it. |

## Accessibility

| Topic | Details |
| --- | --- |
| `Dialog` | The panel has `role="dialog"` and is named by its title, `label` or "Side panel". It has `aria-modal` when modal, and the surrounding content is `inert`. |
| `Focus` | Moves in when it opens as a modal, and returns to where it was when it closes. |
| `Reading direction` | `start` is the left edge in left-to-right pages and the right edge in right-to-left pages, and the animation follows. |
| `Motion` | Slides in using the motion tokens. When the user prefers reduced motion, it appears without animation. |

## Localization

Its default name and the close button come from `uiLocale.strings` (`drawerLabel`, `close`).

## Styling

| Hook | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `.mx-drawer` | The layer. `data-side` (`start`, `end`, `top`, `bottom`), `data-mode`, `data-open`, `data-modal`, `data-scrim`, `data-contained`, `data-dragging`. |
| `.mx-drawer__panel` | The dialog. `--_size`, plus `--_shift-x` and `--_shift-y` during a drag. |
| `.mx-drawer__scrim, __header, __title, __tools, __close, __body, __footer` | The parts of the component. |
| `[data-mx-drawer-push]` | The element a push drawer moves aside, using `--_mx-push`. |

### Component tokens

| Token | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `drawer.scrim, drawer.panel` | Units: the dimmed layer, the surface at each edge (`start`, `end`, `top`, `bottom`, which differ in the sides facing the content and the available space), and the surface when pushing content (`push`). |
| `drawer.header, drawer.title, drawer.tools, drawer.body, drawer.footer` | Units: the content area (`body.focus`: a focus ring inside the content). |
| `drawer.size, drawer.max-size, drawer.inset, drawer.font-family` | The opening size, the maximum share of the available space, the margin around it, and the font family. |

## API reference

### Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `Bind<boolean>` | `false` | Indicates whether it is open. `x-model` provides two-way binding. |
| `side` | `Bind<'start' \| 'end' \| 'left' \| 'right' \| 'top' \| 'bottom'>` | `'start'` | The edge it slides in from. `start` and `end` follow the reading direction, and `left` and `right` do not. |
| `mode` | `Bind<'over' \| 'push'>` | `'over'` | Over the content, or pushing `pushTarget` aside by its size. |
| `pushTarget` | `Bind<HTMLElement \| ComponentBase \| null>` | — | The element `push` moves aside. Without it, `push` behaves like `over`. |
| `size` | `Bind<number \| string \| null>` | `null` | Its width, or its height from the top or bottom, in pixels or as a CSS length. `null` uses `drawer.size`. It never exceeds 85% of the available space. |
| `edgeSwipe` | `Bind<boolean>` | `false` | A finger swiping in from the edge of the container or page opens it, and it follows the finger. |
| `edgeSize` | `Bind<number>` | `24` | The distance from the edge, in pixels, where that swipe can start. |
| `swipeToClose` | `Bind<boolean>` | `true` | A finger swiping it back toward its edge closes it. |
| `flickSpeed` | `Bind<number>` | `0.4` | A flick faster than this, in pixels per millisecond, opens or closes it regardless of distance. |
| `modal` | `Bind<boolean>` | `true` for over, `false` for push | Blocks everything around it, and Tab stays inside. |
| `title, label, container, content, footer, showClose, scrim, closeOnEscape, closeOnScrim, closeOnBack, focusOnOpen, returnFocus, disposeOnClose` | see BottomSheet |  | Props shared by all overlay panels, as listed on the [BottomSheet page](bottomsheet.md#api). |

### Members and events

| Member | Returns | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `open(), close(reason?), toggle(), show(host)` | `boolean` | Same as on a bottom sheet. |
| `isOpen` | read-only, reactive | Indicates whether it is open. |
| `onOpening / onOpened / onClosing / onClosed` | events | Same as on a bottom sheet. A swipe back closes it with `reason: 'swipe'`, and an edge swipe canceled by `onOpening` does not move it. |
