# Sortable

> Navigation · @motifx-community/ui 0.1.0-beta.5

Lets users reorder items by dragging them with the pointer or a finger, or with the keyboard. Lists in the same group can exchange items. A drop moves the element and reports the indexes, while your data stays under your control.

## Import

```tsx
import { Sortable } from '@motifx-community/ui';
```

## Using children as items

JSX children are the items. Drag one, or focus it and press Ctrl + Down. `onReorder` reports the old and new positions, and the application reorders its own data.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Panel, Sortable, Stack } from '@motifx-community/ui';

/** Rows reordered by dragging, or with Ctrl + arrow key on the focused row. The application reorders its data in the event. */
export default function Basic() {
    const s = reactive({ steps: ['Collect the order', 'Pack it', 'Print the label', 'Hand it over'], told: '' });
    return (
        <Stack gap="md" style="inline-size: 100%">
            <Sortable
                label="Steps"
                class="so-steps"
                onReorder={e => {
                    const next = s.steps.slice();
                    next.splice(e.toIndex, 0, ...next.splice(e.fromIndex, 1));
                    s.steps = next;
                    s.told = `"${next[e.toIndex]}" is step ${e.toIndex + 1} now`;
                }}
            >
                <Panel variant="outline" padding="sm">
                    Collect the order
                </Panel>
                <Panel variant="outline" padding="sm">
                    Pack it
                </Panel>
                <Panel variant="outline" padding="sm">
                    Print the label
                </Panel>
                <Panel variant="outline" padding="sm">
                    Hand it over
                </Panel>
            </Sortable>
            <output class="so-told">{() => s.told || `Order: ${s.steps.join(' → ')}`}</output>
        </Stack>
    );
}
```

## Binding to data and moving between lists

`items` with an `itemTemplate` renders rows from your data and keeps each row when the order changes. Two sortables in the same `group` can exchange items. `onRemove` and `onAdd` notify both sides, and each list redraws its array.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Panel, Sortable, Stack } from '@motifx-community/ui';

interface Task {
    id: number;
    title: string;
}

// A task as a row.
const row = (task: Task) => {
    const panel = new Panel({ variant: 'outline', padding: 'sm' });
    panel.element.textContent = task.title;
    return panel;
};

/** Two lists in one group exchange items. Each list draws its own data, and the application moves the task between arrays in the events. */
export default function Groups() {
    const s = reactive({
        todo: [{ id: 1, title: 'Write the brief' }, { id: 2, title: 'Book the room' }, { id: 3, title: 'Send the invites' }] as Task[],
        done: [{ id: 4, title: 'Pick the date' }] as Task[]
    });
    const reorder = (key: 'todo' | 'done') => (e: { fromIndex: number; toIndex: number }) => {
        const next = s[key].slice();
        next.splice(e.toIndex, 0, ...next.splice(e.fromIndex, 1));
        s[key] = next;
    };
    // The item leaves one array when removed and joins the other when added, and the lists redraw.
    const remove = (key: 'todo' | 'done') => (e: { fromIndex: number }) => (s[key] = s[key].filter((_, i) => i !== e.fromIndex));
    const add = (key: 'todo' | 'done') => (e: { item: Task; toIndex: number }) => {
        const next = s[key].slice();
        next.splice(e.toIndex, 0, e.item);
        s[key] = next;
    };
    return (
        <Stack orientation="horizontal" gap="lg" style="inline-size: 100%">
            <Stack gap="sm" grow>
                <strong>To do</strong>
                <Sortable<Task> label="To do" class="so-todo" group="tasks" items={() => s.todo} itemTemplate={row} onReorder={reorder('todo')} onRemove={remove('todo')} onAdd={add('todo')} style="min-block-size: 8rem" />
            </Stack>
            <Stack gap="sm" grow>
                <strong>Done</strong>
                <Sortable<Task> label="Done" class="so-done" group="tasks" items={() => s.done} itemTemplate={row} onReorder={reorder('done')} onRemove={remove('done')} onAdd={add('done')} style="min-block-size: 8rem" />
            </Stack>
        </Stack>
    );
}
```

## Drag handles, horizontal lists and canceling a drag

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Chip, Sortable, Stack } from '@motifx-community/ui';

/** Chips side by side, moved by their handle only (the dots), with Ctrl + Left / Right on the handle; a drag may be refused. */
export default function Handle() {
    const s = reactive({ tags: ['Design', 'Build', 'Test', 'Ship', 'Locked'], told: '' });
    return (
        <Stack gap="md" style="inline-size: 100%">
            <Sortable
                label="Tags"
                class="so-tags"
                orientation="horizontal"
                handle=".so-grip"
                items={() => s.tags}
                itemTemplate={tag => {
                    const chip = new Chip({ text: tag });
                    const grip = document.createElement('span');
                    grip.className = 'mx-glyph so-grip';
                    grip.dataset.icon = 'drag-dots';
                    grip.setAttribute('aria-label', `Move ${tag}`);
                    chip.element.prepend(grip);
                    return chip;
                }}
                onDragStarting={e => {
                    if (e.item === 'Locked') {
                        e.cancel = true;
                        s.told = 'Locked stays where it is.';
                    }
                }}
                onReorder={e => {
                    const next = s.tags.slice();
                    next.splice(e.toIndex, 0, ...next.splice(e.fromIndex, 1));
                    s.tags = next;
                    s.told = next.join(', ');
                }}
            />
            <output class="so-tags-told">{() => s.told}</output>
        </Stack>
    );
}
```

## Behavior

| Topic | Details |
| --- | --- |
| `Dragging` | A drag starts after a few pixels with the pointer, or after a long press with a finger (a finger that moves first scrolls). A copy follows the pointer, the item stays faded in place, and a line shows the drop position. The list scrolls near its edges. |
| `Dropping` | The item's element moves there immediately, and `onReorder` reports the old and new positions. Your code reorders the data. Between sortables in a group, `onRemove` and `onAdd` report the same to both sides. |
| `Binding to data` | With `items`, each item keeps its component when the order changes, because rows are keyed by item. Reordering your array moves the rows without recreating them. |
| `Keys` | The focused item, or its handle if it has one, responds to Ctrl + Up and Down (Left and Right when horizontal) and Ctrl + Home and End. Each move is reported to `onReorder` and announced. |
| `Escape` | Cancels a drag, and nothing moves. |

## Accessibility

| Topic | Details |
| --- | --- |
| `List` | A `group` named by `label`. The items are whatever you put in it. |
| `Items` | One Tab stop that moves between items with the keyboard. An item with its own focusable element keeps it. A handle is a button that you name. |
| `Moves` | Each keyboard move is announced: “Moved to 2 of 5”. |

## Styling

| Hook | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `.mx-sortable` | The list. `data-orientation`, `data-sortable`, and `data-drop-target` while a dragged item can land here. |
| `.mx-sortable__item` | Each item. `data-dragging` on the item being dragged. |
| `.mx-sortable__line` | The drop indicator line. |
| `.mx-sortable__ghost` | The copy that follows the pointer. |

### Component tokens

| Token | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `sortable.container, .item, .line, .ghost` | Units: the list (`target`), an item (`sortable`, `dragging`, `focus`), the line (its thickness and color, vertical in a horizontal list), and the copy. |
| `sortable.gap` | The gap between items. |

## API reference

### Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `items` | `Bind<readonly T[]>` | — | The items, each drawn with `itemTemplate`. Without them, the JSX children are the items. |
| `itemTemplate` | `(item, index) => ComponentBase` | The item text | Creates the component for an item. Because it is a function, it is not bound like the other props. |
| `handle` | `Bind<string \| null>` | `null` | A selector inside an item for the part that handles dragging and the keyboard. Without it, the whole item does. |
| `group` | `Bind<string \| null>` | `null` | Sortables in the same group can exchange items. |
| `allowReordering` | `Bind<boolean>` | `true` | Allows items to be moved. `false` keeps them in place. |
| `orientation` | `Bind<SortableOrientation>` | `'vertical'` | `vertical` or `horizontal`. The drop line and the move keys follow it. |
| `label` | `Bind<string>` | `''` | The accessible name of the list. |

### Events, properties and methods

| Member | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `onDragStarting` | event | Occurs before a drag or keyboard move starts (`item`, `fromIndex`). Set `cancel = true` to prevent it. |
| `onDragChanging` | event | Occurs when the drop position changes (`to`, `toIndex`). Set `cancel = true` to reject that position. |
| `onDragEnding` | event | Occurs before the drop. Set `cancel = true` to leave everything unchanged. |
| `onReorder` | event | Occurs when an item moves within this sortable (`fromIndex`, `toIndex`, `item`), by a drop or the keyboard. Reorder your data here. |
| `onRemove, onAdd` | event | Occur when an item leaves for another sortable in the group and when it arrives, with `from`, `to`, the indexes and the item. Move the data between your arrays here. |
| `move(fromIndex, toIndex)` | `boolean` | Moves an item programmatically as a drop would, and raises `onReorder`. |
| `elements` | read-only | The item elements, in order. |
| `isDragging` | read-only | Indicates that an item is being dragged. |
| `refresh()` | `void` | Re-reads the items after they have been changed in place. |

# FormLayout

> Navigation · @motifx-community/ui 0.1.0-beta.5

Arranges the fields of a data object on a grid. Each field gets an editor, chosen by name or by the type of its value, with two-way binding to the object. Groups, column spans and buttons organize the layout, and submitting the form validates every field first.

## Import

```tsx
import { FormLayout, type FormItem } from '@motifx-community/ui';
```

## Form bound to an object

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { FormLayout, type FormItem } from '@motifx-community/ui';

const countries = [
  { value: 'TR', text: 'Türkiye' },
  { value: 'DE', text: 'Germany' },
  { value: 'FR', text: 'France' },
];

/** The fields of a customer on two columns: editors by name or by value, a group, a field shown on a condition, a Save button that checks first. */
export default function CustomerForm() {
  const customer = reactive({
    name: 'Ada Lovelace',
    email: '',
    phone: '',
    birthday: null as Date | null,
    country: 'TR' as string | null,
    city: 'İstanbul',
    vip: false,
    credit: 1000,
    note: '',
  });
  const s = reactive({ result: '' });

  const items: FormItem[] = [
    { field: 'name', label: '&Name', required: true },
    { field: 'email', label: 'Email', editor: 'email', required: true },
    { field: 'phone', label: 'Phone', editorProps: { mask: '(000) 000 00 00', type: 'tel' } },
    { field: 'birthday', label: 'Birthday', editor: 'date', editorProps: { max: new Date() } },
    {
      group: 'Address',
      columns: 2,
      items: [
        { field: 'country', label: 'Country', editor: 'dropdown', editorProps: { items: countries } },
        { field: 'city', label: 'City' },
      ],
    },
    { field: 'vip', label: 'VIP customer', editor: 'switch' },
    { field: 'credit', label: 'Credit limit', editorProps: { format: { style: 'currency', currency: 'TRY' }, min: 0 }, visible: () => customer.vip },
    { field: 'note', label: 'Note', editor: 'textarea', colSpan: 'all' },
    { button: { text: 'Save', tone: 'accent', submit: true } },
  ];

  return (
    <>
      <FormLayout
        data={customer}
        columns={2}
        items={items}
        onValidSubmit={() => (s.result = `Saved ${customer.name}.`)}
        onInvalidSubmit={(e) => (s.result = `${e.invalid.length} field(s) to fix.`)}
      />
      <output class="fl-result">{() => s.result}</output>
      <output class="fl-data">{() => `${customer.name} · ${customer.email || '—'} · ${customer.city} · vip: ${customer.vip}`}</output>
    </>
  );
}
```

## Editors

Editors by name: `text`, `password`, `email`, `textarea`, `number`, `date`, `datetime`, `time`, `checkbox`, `switch`, `dropdown`, `combobox`, `lookup`, `radio` and `slider`. If you omit the name, the value determines the editor: a number uses NumberBox, a boolean uses CheckBox, a Date uses DateBox, and anything else uses TextBox. `editorProps` are passed to the editor. Register custom editors once:

```tsx
FormLayout.editors.set('color', (props) => new ColorPicker(props));
{ field: 'tint', label: 'Tint', editor: 'color' }
```

## API reference

### Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `data` | `Bind<T \| null>` | — | The object the editors display and change. |
| `items` | `Bind<readonly FormItem[]>` | `[]` | The form items. A function is tracked. |
| `columns` | `Bind<number>` | `1` | The number of grid columns. |
| `minColumnWidth` | `Bind<string>` | — | As many columns as fit, each at least this wide. |
| `labelMode` | `Bind<FieldLabelMode>` | `'top'` | Passed to every editor. |
| `readOnly` | `Bind<boolean>` | `false` | Makes every editor read-only. |
| `onValidSubmit(e) / onInvalidSubmit(e)` |  |  | Occurs when the form is submitted and valid (`{ data, event }`) or submitted and invalid (`{ valid, invalid }`). |

### FormItem

| Field | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `field, label, editor, editorProps` | The property, its label, its editor and the editor's props. |
| `required, rules, helpText, enabled, readOnly, visible` | Passed to the editor, each as a value or a function. `visible` hides the item. |
| `colSpan` | The number of columns it spans. Use `'all'` for the whole row. |
| `group, items, columns` | A labeled group with its own columns. |
| `button` | Button props. `submit: true` submits the form. |
| `template` | Any component created for this item. |

### Members

| Member | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `validate(), resetValidation(), submit()` | Validates every field, clears the results, and submits the form. |
| `editorOf(field)` | The editor of a field. |
| `refresh()` | Your data object and items can be plain or reactive, and the form reads them as they are. After changing them in place, call `refresh()`. Every editor re-reads its value, items re-read their text and states, and added or removed items redraw the form. |
| `refreshField(field)` | Re-reads one field of the data object after it has been changed in place. |
| `validationGroup, isValid` | The validation group of the fields. |
| `FormLayout.editors` | The editors registered by name. |

# TreeView

> Data · @motifx-community/ui 0.1.0-beta.5

Displays items in a hierarchy. Rows can be expanded and collapsed, selected individually or in groups, and searched. Check boxes can roll up to parent rows, and children can load on demand when a row is first expanded. Large trees render only the visible rows.

## Import

```tsx
import { TreeView } from '@motifx-community/ui';
```

## Declarative and programmatic

Items are objects with a `children` array, or with a `parentId` as described below. `value` is the key of the selected row, and `x-model` provides two-way binding. When you create the tree with `new`, fill and control it programmatically. Plain or reactive items changed in place appear after `refresh()`, or `refreshItem(key)` for a single row.

```tsx
/** A row of the trees on this page. */
export interface Entry {
  id: string;
  text: string;
  folder?: boolean;
  hasChildren?: boolean;
  children?: Entry[];
  enabled?: boolean;
  expanded?: boolean;
  count?: number;
}
```

## File explorer with on-demand loading

`loadChildren` loads the children of a row the first time it expands, and `hasChildren: false` marks a row with nothing to load. The row shows a busy state while loading. If loading fails, the row reports the error and offers a retry (“Shared” fails once in this example). `iconField` provides the icons, and here it is a function.

```tsx
/** A row of the trees on this page. */
export interface Entry {
  id: string;
  text: string;
  folder?: boolean;
  hasChildren?: boolean;
  children?: Entry[];
  enabled?: boolean;
  expanded?: boolean;
  count?: number;
}
```

## Selection

`selectionMode` is `single` (the default), `multiple` or `none`. With `multiple`, Ctrl (⌘) + click adds or removes a row, Shift + click selects a range, and the keyboard follows the APG multi-select tree pattern.

```tsx
/** A row of the trees on this page. */
export interface Entry {
  id: string;
  text: string;
  folder?: boolean;
  hasChildren?: boolean;
  children?: Entry[];
  enabled?: boolean;
  expanded?: boolean;
  count?: number;
}
```

## Check boxes in a permissions tree

`showCheckBoxes` adds a check box to every row. Checking a parent checks its children, and a parent shows an indeterminate state while only some are checked (`checkRecursive`, on by default). `checkedKeys` sets and reports the checked rows, and Space toggles the focused one.

```tsx
/** A row of the trees on this page. */
export interface Entry {
  id: string;
  text: string;
  folder?: boolean;
  hasChildren?: boolean;
  children?: Entry[];
  enabled?: boolean;
  expanded?: boolean;
  count?: number;
}
```

## Search and filtering

`searchEnabled` adds a search box. Matches appear with their parents expanded, and clearing the search restores the previous state. `searchValue` or `filter(text)` filters programmatically, and `searchMode` is `contains` or `startswith`.

```tsx
/** A row of the trees on this page. */
export interface Entry {
  id: string;
  text: string;
  folder?: boolean;
  hasChildren?: boolean;
  children?: Entry[];
  enabled?: boolean;
  expanded?: boolean;
  count?: number;
}
```

## Flat data, fields and templates

Flat rows reference their parent through `parentField`, which defaults to `parentId`. Any field can be a property name or a function. `itemTemplate` customizes a row's content, and `enabledField` and `expandedField` apply per row.

```tsx
/** A row of the trees on this page. */
export interface Entry {
  id: string;
  text: string;
  folder?: boolean;
  hasChildren?: boolean;
  children?: Entry[];
  enabled?: boolean;
  expanded?: boolean;
  count?: number;
}
```

## Large trees

Only expanded rows are rendered, and when more than `virtualFrom` (500) rows are on screen, only the visible ones are rendered. This example has 50 departments of 200 people, for 10,050 rows when fully expanded. Give the tree a height so that it scrolls internally.

```tsx
/** A row of the trees on this page. */
export interface Entry {
  id: string;
  text: string;
  folder?: boolean;
  hasChildren?: boolean;
  children?: Entry[];
  enabled?: boolean;
  expanded?: boolean;
  count?: number;
}
```

## Sizes, connector lines and expand behavior

```tsx
/** A row of the trees on this page. */
export interface Entry {
  id: string;
  text: string;
  folder?: boolean;
  hasChildren?: boolean;
  children?: Entry[];
  enabled?: boolean;
  expanded?: boolean;
  count?: number;
}
```

## Keyboard

| Key | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `Tab` | Moves focus into the tree, to the focused row, the selected row or the first row, and out again. The tree is one Tab stop. |
| `Down / Up` | Moves to the next or previous visible row. |
| `Right` | Expands a collapsed row, or moves to the first child of an expanded row. On right-to-left pages, use Left. |
| `Left` | Collapses an expanded row, or moves to the parent of a collapsed row. On right-to-left pages, use Right. |
| `Home / End, Page Up / Page Down` | Moves to the first or last row, or up or down by one page. |
| `*` | Expands all siblings of the row. |
| `A letter` | Moves to the next row whose text starts with that character. Type quickly to match a longer prefix. |
| `Enter` | Selects the row, and with `multiple` selects only that row. |
| `Space` | Toggles the check box if shown. Otherwise, it selects the row, or toggles it with `multiple`. |
| `Shift + Down / Up` | With `multiple`, moves and toggles the next row. |
| `Shift + Space, Ctrl + Shift + Home / End, Ctrl + A` | With `multiple`, selects from the last selected row to the current row, up to the first or last row, or everything. |
| `Down in the search box` | Moves focus into the tree. |

## Accessibility

| Topic | Details |
| --- | --- |
| `Tree` | `role="tree"`, named by `label`, or by `aria-label` or `aria-labelledby` on the tag, with `aria-multiselectable` for `multiple`. |
| `Rows` | `role="treeitem"` with `aria-level`, `aria-setsize`, `aria-posinset`, `aria-expanded` on parents, `aria-selected` (unless `none`), `aria-checked` (`true`, `false`, `mixed`) with check boxes, and `aria-disabled`. |
| `Children` | An expanded row contains a `role="group"` with its children. A large tree renders its rows flat, with the same levels and positions. |
| `Loading` | A row loading its children has `aria-busy="true"`, and a failed load is described by its message (`aria-describedby`). |
| `Focus` | Roving `tabindex`, so one row is in the Tab order. The focus ring appears only during keyboard use. |

## Localization

The tree has four strings, all from `uiLocale.strings`: `noItems` (empty tree), `loadFailed` and `retry` (failed load), and `search` (the search box).

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, uiLocale } from '@motifx-community/ui';
import { kitTexts } from '../../../shared/kit-texts';

/** Switches the texts of the kit; the trees on the page follow at once. */
export default function Localization() {
  const s = reactive({ lang: 'en' });
  const toggle = () => {
    s.lang = s.lang === 'en' ? 'tr' : 'en';
    void uiLocale.use(s.lang);
  };
  return (
    <>
      <Button text={() => (s.lang === 'en' ? 'Language: English' : 'Dil: Türkçe')} variant="outline" onclick={toggle} />
      <span>
        A failed load reads <output class="tv-failed">{() => `${kitTexts.strings.loadFailed} ${kitTexts.strings.retry}`}</output>
      </span>
    </>
  );
}
```

## Styling

| Hook | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `.mx-tree-view` | The root. `data-size`, `data-lines`, `data-checkboxes`, `data-windowed`, `data-empty`, `data-disabled`. |
| `.mx-tree-view__search, .mx-tree-view__body, .mx-tree-view__empty` | The search box, the tree and the empty text. |
| `.mx-tree-view__item` | A row and its children: `data-selected`, `data-expanded`, `data-branch`, `data-state`, `data-loading`, `data-error`, `data-disabled` and `--_level`. |
| `.mx-tree-view__row` | The visible row. |
| `.mx-tree-view__expander, __check, __icon, __text` | The parts of a row. |
| `.mx-tree-view__group` | The children of an expanded row. |
| `.mx-tree-view__error, .mx-tree-view__retry` | A failed load and its retry button. |

### Component tokens

| Token | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `treeview.row, treeview.indicator, treeview.expander, treeview.expander-icon, treeview.spinner` | Units: a row in each state (`hover`, `pressed`, `selected`, `selected-hover`, `focus`, `disabled`), the selection indicator, the expander and its plate, and the loading ring. |
| `treeview.check, treeview.mark, treeview.icon, treeview.text, treeview.error, treeview.retry, treeview.empty, treeview.container, treeview.body` | Units: the check box (`hover`, `checked`, `checked-hover`, `disabled`, `checked-disabled`) and the other parts. |
| `treeview.row-height.*, treeview.padding.*, treeview.font-size.*, treeview.line-height.*, treeview.indent.*` | Sizes per size class, and the indent of each level. |
| `treeview.row-spacing, treeview.expander-plate` | The space between two rows, and the expander plate the connector lines are centered under. |
| `treeview.line-width, treeview.line-color, treeview.elbow-length, treeview.elbow-color` | The connector lines (`showLines`). |

## API reference

### Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `items` | `Bind<readonly T[]>` | `[]` | Nested items with a `children` array, or flat items with a `parentId`. A function is tracked, and items changed in place appear after `refresh()`. |
| `textField, keyField, childrenField, parentField` | `Bind<ItemField<T>>` | `'text'`, `'id'`, `'children'`, `'parentId'` | A property name or a function `(item) => …`. An item without a key serves as its own key. `parentField`, or items with a `parentId`, makes the list flat. |
| `iconField, enabledField, expandedField, hasChildrenField` | `Bind<ItemField<T>>` | `'icon'`, `'enabled'`, `'expanded'`, `'hasChildren'` | Per item: an icon, whether the row can be selected or checked, whether it starts expanded (changing this expands or collapses it), and whether it has children to load. |
| `loadChildren` | `Bind<(item) => Promise<T[]>>` | — | Loads the children of a row when it is first expanded. The row shows a busy state meanwhile, and offers a retry if loading fails. |
| `selectionMode` | `Bind<'none' \| 'single' \| 'multiple'>` | `'single'` | How many rows can be selected. |
| `value` | `Bind<unknown>` | `null` | The selected key (`single`) or keys (`multiple`). `x-model` provides two-way binding. |
| `expandedKeys` | `Bind<unknown[]>` | `[]` | The expanded rows. `onExpanded` and `onCollapsed` report changes made by the user. |
| `showCheckBoxes` | `Bind<boolean>` | `false` | Adds a check box to every row. |
| `checkRecursive` | `Bind<boolean>` | `true` | Checking a parent checks its children, and a parent is indeterminate when only some are checked. |
| `checkedKeys` | `Bind<unknown[]>` | `[]` | The checked rows. A parent is included when all its children are checked. `onCheckChanged` reports changes. |
| `searchEnabled` | `Bind<boolean>` | `false` | Adds a search box at the top. |
| `searchMode` | `Bind<'contains' \| 'startswith'>` | `'contains'` | How the search matches row text. |
| `searchValue` | `Bind<string>` | `''` | The text used to filter rows. Matches appear with their parents expanded. |
| `expandOn` | `Bind<'expander' \| 'click' \| 'dblclick'>` | `'expander'` | What expands a branch, in addition to its expander and the keyboard. |
| `showLines` | `Bind<boolean>` | `false` | Draws connector lines from each parent to its children. |
| `size` | `Bind<ControlSize>` | `'md'` | `sm`, `md`, `lg`, from the density tokens. |
| `label` | `Bind<string>` | `''` | The accessible name of the tree. `aria-label` and `aria-labelledby` on the tag also work. |
| `virtualFrom` | `Bind<number>` | `500` | When more rows than this are on screen, only the visible rows are rendered. |
| `itemTemplate` | `Bind<(item, host) => cleanup \| void>` | — | Customizes the content of a row. |
| `enabled / disabled, visible, tabStop, tabIndex` | see Control |  | Properties shared by all controls. |

### Properties

| Property | Access | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `every prop above` | read/write, reactive | Accepts a value or a function, the same as the prop. |
| `selectedItems, checkedItems` | read-only, reactive | The selected or checked items, in tree order. |
| `treeElement` | read-only | The element with `role="tree"`. |

### Methods

| Method | Returns | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `expand(key), collapse(key)` | `boolean` | Expands or collapses a row, loading its children first if needed. The cancelable events run. |
| `expandAll(), collapseAll()` | `void` | Applies to every row whose children are known, with no event per row. |
| `select(key), unselect(key), selectAll(), clearSelection()` | `void` | Programmatic control. `select` adds to the selection with `multiple`. |
| `check(key, checked?), uncheck(key), checkAll(), uncheckAll()` | `void` | Programmatic control. |
| `filter(text)` | `void` | Sets `searchValue`. |
| `scrollTo(key), focusNode(key)` | `boolean` | Expands the row's parents, scrolls it into view and sets focus on it. |
| `reload(key?)` | `void` | Reloads a row's children, or all loaded children when no key is given. |
| `refresh()` | `void` | Your items can be plain or reactive, and the tree reads them as they are. After changing them in place, call `refresh()`. The items, their children, text and states are read again, and loaded children are kept. |
| `refreshItem(key)` | `void` | Redraws one row after its item changes in place, including its text, icon and state. Use `refresh()` for its children. |
| `itemOf(key)` | `T \| undefined` | The item with that key. |
| `focus()` | `boolean` | Sets focus on the row that Tab reaches. |

### Events

| Event | When |
| --- | --- |
| `onExpanding(e), onCollapsing(e)` | Occurs before a row expands or collapses. `e`: `{ item, key, byUser, cancel, source, event? }`. Set `e.cancel = true` to keep the current state. |
| `onExpanded(e), onCollapsed(e)` | Occurs after a row expands or collapses. `e`: `{ item, key, byUser, source }`. |
| `onSelectionChanged(e)` | `{ value, items, byUser, source, event? }` |
| `onCheckChanged(e)` | `{ item, key, state, keys, byUser, source }`. `item` is `null` when several rows changed at once. |
| `onItemClick(e)` | Occurs when a row is clicked, or when Enter is pressed on it. `{ item, key, source, event }` |

## Example files

`Programmatic.tsx`

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, Panel, Stack, TreeView } from '@motifx-community/ui';
import type { Entry } from './entry';
import { project } from './project';

const BOX = 'inline-size: 100%; max-inline-size: 26rem; background: var(--mx-color-bg-card)';

/** A tree bound with x-model, and a tree created with `new` whose items change in place and are re-read on `refresh()`. */
export default function Programmatic() {
  const s = reactive({ file: 'tree' as unknown, clicked: '' });
  const menu = reactive<Entry[]>([
    { id: 'home', text: 'Home' },
    { id: 'products', text: 'Products', children: [{ id: 'new', text: 'New' }] },
  ]);
  let added = 0;

  const tree = new TreeView<Entry>({ items: menu, label: 'Menu', selectionMode: 'none' });
  tree.onItemClick((e) => (s.clicked = `Pressed “${e.item.text}”.`));

  const addProduct = () => {
    added++;
    menu[1].children!.push({ id: `p${added}`, text: `Product ${added}` });
    tree.refresh();
    tree.expand('products');
  };

  return (
    <>
      <Panel variant="outline" padding="xxs" style={BOX}>
        <TreeView class="tv-ways" label="Project files" items={project()} expandedKeys={['src', 'components']} x-model={() => s.file} />
      </Panel>
      <output class="tv-value">{() => `value: ${JSON.stringify(s.file)}`}</output>
      <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center">
        <Button text="Add a product programmatically" variant="outline" onclick={addProduct} />
        <Button text="Expand all" variant="ghost" onclick={() => tree.expandAll()} />
        <Button text="Collapse all" variant="ghost" onclick={() => tree.collapseAll()} />
        <output class="tv-clicked">{() => s.clicked}</output>
      </Stack>
      <Panel variant="outline" padding="xxs" style={BOX} ref={(p: Panel) => p.controls.add(tree)} />
    </>
  );
}
```

`FileExplorer.tsx`

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Panel, TreeView } from '@motifx-community/ui';
import type { Entry } from './entry';
import { FILE, FOLDER, icon } from './icon';

const BOX = 'inline-size: 100%; max-inline-size: 26rem; background: var(--mx-color-bg-card)';

/** A sample disk: the entries of each folder. */
const DISK: Record<string, string[]> = {
  '/': ['Documents/', 'Pictures/', 'Shared/', 'notes.txt'],
  '/Documents/': ['Invoices/', 'Letters/', 'plan.docx'],
  '/Documents/Invoices/': ['2025/', '2026/'],
  '/Documents/Invoices/2025/': ['january.pdf', 'february.pdf'],
  '/Documents/Invoices/2026/': ['march.pdf'],
  '/Documents/Letters/': [],
  '/Pictures/': ['holiday.jpg', 'cat.png'],
  '/Shared/': ['team.xlsx'],
};

function entriesOf(path: string): Entry[] {
  return (DISK[path] ?? []).map((name) => {
    const folder = name.endsWith('/');
    return { id: path + name, text: folder ? name.slice(0, -1) : name, folder, hasChildren: folder };
  });
}

/** Children loaded when a folder first opens, with a load that fails once (Shared) and a retry. */
export default function FileExplorer() {
  const s = reactive({ opened: '', loads: 0 });
  let failed = false;

  const loadChildren = (entry: Entry) =>
    new Promise<Entry[]>((resolve, reject) => {
      s.loads++;
      setTimeout(() => {
        if (entry.id === '/Shared/' && !failed) {
          failed = true;
          reject(new Error('The share is offline.'));
        } else {
          resolve(entriesOf(entry.id));
        }
      }, 500);
    });

  return (
    <>
      <Panel variant="outline" padding="xxs" style={BOX}>
        <TreeView
          class="tv-lazy"
          label="Disk"
          items={[{ id: '/', text: 'My disk', folder: true }]}
          loadChildren={loadChildren}
          iconField={(entry: Entry) => icon(entry.folder ? FOLDER : FILE)}
          expandOn="dblclick"
          onExpanded={(e) => (s.opened = `Opened ${e.item.text}.`)}
        />
      </Panel>
      <output class="tv-loads">{() => `Loads: ${s.loads}. ${s.opened}`}</output>
    </>
  );
}
```

`icon.ts`

```tsx
const SVG = 'http://www.w3.org/2000/svg';

export const FOLDER = 'M1.5 3.5h5l1.5 1.5h6.5v8h-13z';
export const FILE = 'M3.5 1.5h6l3 3v10h-9zM9.5 1.5v3h3';

/** A small outline icon, a new element for each row. */
export function icon(path: string): SVGSVGElement {
  const svg = document.createElementNS(SVG, 'svg');
  svg.setAttribute('viewBox', '0 0 16 16');
  const line = svg.appendChild(document.createElementNS(SVG, 'path'));
  line.setAttribute('d', path);
  line.setAttribute('fill', 'none');
  line.setAttribute('stroke', 'currentColor');
  line.setAttribute('stroke-width', '1.2');
  line.setAttribute('stroke-linejoin', 'round');
  return svg;
}
```

`Selection.tsx`

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, Panel, Stack, TreeView, type TreeViewSelectionMode } from '@motifx-community/ui';
import { world } from './world';

const BOX = 'inline-size: 100%; max-inline-size: 26rem; background: var(--mx-color-bg-card)';

/** Single, multiple or no selection, the selected keys bound with x-model. */
export default function Selection() {
  const s = reactive({ mode: 'multiple' as TreeViewSelectionMode, picked: [] as unknown[] });
  return (
    <>
      <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center" role="group" aria-label="Selection mode">
        {(['single', 'multiple', 'none'] as const).map((mode) => (
          <Button
            key={mode}
            text={mode}
            size="sm"
            variant={() => (s.mode === mode ? 'solid' : 'ghost')}
            aria-pressed={() => s.mode === mode}
            onclick={() => (s.mode = mode)}
          />
        ))}
      </Stack>
      <Panel variant="outline" padding="xxs" style={BOX}>
        <TreeView class="tv-select" label="Places" items={world()} expandedKeys={['europe', 'tr']} selectionMode={() => s.mode} x-model={() => s.picked} />
      </Panel>
      <output class="tv-picked">{() => `value: ${JSON.stringify(s.picked)}`}</output>
    </>
  );
}
```

```tsx
const PERMISSIONS = (): Entry[] => [

    text: 'Content',

    children: [
      { id: 'articles', text: 'Articles', children: [{ id: 'articles.read', text: 'Read' }, { id: 'articles.write', text: 'Write' }, { id: 'articles.publish', text: 'Publish' }] },
      { id: 'media', text: 'Media', children: [{ id: 'media.upload', text: 'Upload' }, { id: 'media.delete', text: 'Delete' }] },
    ],

    </>
  );
```

`FlatData.tsx`

```tsx
import { Panel, TreeView } from '@motifx-community/ui';
import type { Entry } from './entry';

const BOX = 'inline-size: 100%; max-inline-size: 26rem; background: var(--mx-color-bg-card)';

const FLAT = [
  { id: 1, name: 'Company', parent: null },
  { id: 2, name: 'Sales', parent: 1 },
  { id: 3, name: 'Engineering', parent: 1 },
  { id: 4, name: 'Web', parent: 3 },
  { id: 5, name: 'Mobile', parent: 3 },
];

const MAIL: Entry[] = [
  { id: 'inbox', text: 'Inbox', count: 12, expanded: true, children: [{ id: 'work', text: 'Work', count: 3 }, { id: 'family', text: 'Family' }] },
  { id: 'sent', text: 'Sent' },
  { id: 'spam', text: 'Spam', count: 99, enabled: false },
];

/** Flat rows that name their parent, a text field given as a function, and rows drawn by a template. */
export default function FlatData() {
  const withCount = (item: Entry, host: HTMLElement) => {
    host.append(item.text);
    if (item.count) {
      const badge = document.createElement('strong');
      badge.textContent = ` · ${item.count}`;
      host.append(badge);
    }
  };
  return (
    <>
      <Panel variant="outline" padding="xxs" style={BOX}>
        <TreeView class="tv-flat" label="Company" items={FLAT} parentField="parent" textField={(row: (typeof FLAT)[number]) => row.name} expandedKeys={[1, 3]} />
      </Panel>
      <Panel variant="outline" padding="xxs" style={BOX}>
        <TreeView class="tv-template" label="Mail" items={MAIL} itemTemplate={withCount} />
      </Panel>
    </>
  );
}
```

`SizesAndLines.tsx`

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, Panel, Stack, TreeView } from '@motifx-community/ui';
import type { Entry } from './entry';
import { FILE, FOLDER, icon } from './icon';
import { project } from './project';

const BOX = 'inline-size: 100%; max-inline-size: 26rem; background: var(--mx-color-bg-card)';

/** Row sizes, lines under the parents, and what opens a row. */
export default function SizesAndLines() {
  const s = reactive({ size: 'md' as 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg', lines: true, expandOn: 'expander' as 'expander' | 'click' | 'dblclick' });
  return (
    <>
      <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center" role="group" aria-label="Size">
        {(['sm', 'md', 'lg'] as const).map((size) => (
          <Button
            key={size}
            text={size}
            size="sm"
            variant={() => (s.size === size ? 'solid' : 'ghost')}
            aria-pressed={() => s.size === size}
            onclick={() => (s.size = size)}
          />
        ))}
        <Button text="Lines" size="sm" variant="outline" toggle x-model={() => s.lines} />
      </Stack>
      <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center" role="group" aria-label="Opens on">
        {(['expander', 'click', 'dblclick'] as const).map((how) => (
          <Button
            key={how}
            text={`expandOn ${how}`}
            size="sm"
            variant={() => (s.expandOn === how ? 'solid' : 'ghost')}
            aria-pressed={() => s.expandOn === how}
            onclick={() => (s.expandOn = how)}
          />
        ))}
      </Stack>
      <Panel variant="outline" padding="xxs" style={BOX}>
        <TreeView
          class="tv-look"
          label="Look"
          items={project()}
          expandedKeys={['src', 'components', 'docs']}
          size={() => s.size}
          showLines={() => s.lines}
          expandOn={() => s.expandOn}
          iconField={(entry: Entry) => icon(entry.folder ? FOLDER : FILE)}
        />
      </Panel>
    </>
  );
}
```


---

# ListBox

> Data · @motifx-community/ui 0.1.0-beta.5

A list displayed directly on the page. Users select one or more items with the keyboard or pointer. Items can come from memory or a data source, can be searched and grouped, and long lists render only the visible rows.

## Import

```tsx
import { ListBox } from '@motifx-community/ui';
import { data } from '@motifx-community/data';
```

## Declarative and programmatic

`items` can be plain values, and `x-model` binds the selected value. When you create the component with `new`, set the same properties programmatically.

```tsx
/** The cities the lists of the examples show. */
export const cities = ['Ankara', 'Antalya', 'Bursa', 'İstanbul', 'İzmir', 'Konya', 'Trabzon'];
```

## Multiple selection

When `selectionMode` is `'multiple'`, the value is an array and every change writes a new one. Each option below is a prop you can bind.

```tsx
/** The cities the lists of the examples show. */
export const cities = ['Ankara', 'Antalya', 'Bursa', 'İstanbul', 'İzmir', 'Konya', 'Trabzon'];
```

## Objects, groups, templates

Custom objects are read through `textField` and `valueField`. `groupField` places items under headers, `enabledField` disables specific items, and `itemTemplate` customizes how an item is drawn.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { ListBox } from '@motifx-community/ui';

interface Country {
  code: string;
  name: string;
  region: string;
  flag: string;
  member?: boolean;
}

const countries: Country[] = [
  { code: 'TR', name: 'Türkiye', region: 'Europe', flag: '🇹🇷' },
  { code: 'DE', name: 'Germany', region: 'Europe', flag: '🇩🇪' },
  { code: 'FR', name: 'France', region: 'Europe', flag: '🇫🇷' },
  { code: 'NO', name: 'Norway', region: 'Europe', flag: '🇳🇴', member: false },
  { code: 'JP', name: 'Japan', region: 'Asia', flag: '🇯🇵' },
  { code: 'KR', name: 'Korea', region: 'Asia', flag: '🇰🇷' },
  { code: 'BR', name: 'Brazil', region: 'Americas', flag: '🇧🇷' },
  { code: 'CA', name: 'Canada', region: 'Americas', flag: '🇨🇦' },
];

/** Objects read through textField and valueField, under group headers, one that cannot be chosen, drawn with a template. */
export default function Countries() {
  const form = reactive({ country: 'JP' as string | null });
  return (
    <>
      <ListBox
        label="Country"
        items={countries}
        textField="name"
        valueField="code"
        groupField="region"
        enabledField={(c: Country) => c.member !== false}
        itemTemplate={(c: Country, host: HTMLElement) => {
          host.textContent = `${c.flag}  ${c.name}`;
        }}
        height={8}
        x-model={() => form.country}
      />
      <output class="lb-country">{() => `code: ${form.country ?? '—'}`}</output>
    </>
  );
}
```

## From a data source

With `dataSource`, the list reads a `DataSource` from the data layer, and the search runs there (using its `searchFields`). In `'blocks'` mode, only the visible rows load as the list scrolls. Selected values on unloaded rows stay selected, and “Select all” loads the values of every matching row. This example has 5,000 orders.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { data } from '@motifx-community/data';
import { ListBox } from '@motifx-community/ui';

interface Order {
  id: number;
  name: string;
}

const rows: Order[] = Array.from({ length: 5000 }, (_, i) => ({ id: i + 1, name: `Order #${String(i + 1).padStart(5, '0')}` }));

/** 5,000 orders from a data source, loaded in blocks while the list scrolls and searched where they live. */
export default function Orders() {
  const form = reactive({ orders: [42, 4321] as number[] });
  const orders = new data.DataSource<Order, number>({
    adapter: new data.ArrayAdapter({ data: rows, key: 'id' }),
    loadMode: 'blocks',
    pageSize: 50,
    searchFields: ['name'],
  });

  return (
    <>
      <ListBox
        label="Orders"
        dataSource={orders}
        textField="name"
        valueField="id"
        selectionMode="multiple"
        selectAll
        searchEnabled
        height={10}
        x-model={() => form.orders}
      />
      <output class="lb-orders">{() => `${form.orders.length} chosen${form.orders.length && form.orders.length < 6 ? `: ${form.orders.join(', ')}` : ''}`}</output>
    </>
  );
}
```

## Validation and states

```tsx
/** The cities the lists of the examples show. */
export const cities = ['Ankara', 'Antalya', 'Bursa', 'İstanbul', 'İzmir', 'Konya', 'Trabzon'];
```

## Keyboard

| Key | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `Tab` | The list is one Tab stop. The search box, when enabled, is another. |
| `Down, Up, Home, End, Page Down, Page Up` | Moves the highlight and skips items that cannot be selected. In single selection, the item is also selected. |
| `A letter` | Moves to the next item that starts with that letter. Letters typed quickly are combined into one search. |
| `Space, Enter` | In single selection, selects the highlighted item. In multiple selection, selects or deselects it. |
| `Shift + Down / Up` | In multiple selection, moves and selects or deselects the next item. |
| `Shift + Space` | In multiple selection, selects every item from the last selected item to the highlighted one. |
| `Control + Shift + Home / End` | In multiple selection, selects every item from the highlighted one to the first or last item. |
| `Control + A` | In multiple selection, selects every item, or clears the selection if all are selected. |
| `Down in the search box` | Moves focus to the list. |
| `Control + click, Shift + click` | In multiple selection, adds or removes one item, or selects the items in between. |

## Accessibility

| Topic | Details |
| --- | --- |
| `Pattern` | The APG listbox. The list has `role="listbox"` and holds focus itself, and `aria-activedescendant` identifies the highlighted option. |
| `Options` | `role="option"` with `aria-selected`, and `aria-disabled` on disabled items. Multi-select lists have `aria-multiselectable`. |
| `Name` | The label names the list (`aria-labelledby`), help and error text describe it, and `aria-invalid` and `aria-required` report its state. |
| `Groups` | Each group has `role="group"` and is labeled by its header. |
| `Long lists` | Only visible rows are rendered. Each option reports its position with `aria-posinset` and `aria-setsize`, and loading rows have `aria-busy`. |
| `Focus` | The highlight appears while the list is in use, and it also gets the focus ring during keyboard use. |

## Localization

“Select all”, the search box, “No items” and “Loading…” come from `uiLocale.strings` (`selectAll`, `search`, `noItems`, `loading`).

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, ListBox, uiLocale } from '@motifx-community/ui';

/** Switches the texts of every list on the page: “Select all”, the search box, “No items”. */
export default function Localization() {
  const s = reactive({ lang: 'en' });
  const toggle = () => {
    s.lang = s.lang === 'en' ? 'tr' : 'en';
    void uiLocale.use(s.lang);
  };
  return (
    <>
      <Button text={() => (s.lang === 'en' ? 'Language: English' : 'Dil: Türkçe')} variant="outline" onclick={toggle} />
      <ListBox label="Fruit" items={['Apple', 'Cherry', 'Pear']} selectionMode="multiple" selectAll searchEnabled />
      <ListBox label="Empty" items={[]} height={3} />
    </>
  );
}
```

## Styling

| Hook | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `.mx-list-box` | Added to the field. `data-selection-mode` and `data-check-boxes`, plus the TextBox field attributes. |
| `.mx-list-box__search` | The search box. |
| `.mx-list, .mx-list__item, .mx-list__header, .mx-list__check` | The shared list, its options (`data-active`, `data-selected`), group headers and check boxes. |
| `.mx-list__item[data-select-all]` | The "Select all" row, with `data-mixed` when only some items are selected. |

### Component tokens

| Token | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `listbox.container, listbox.box` | Units: the spacing around the list box, and around and between its search box and list. |
| `listbox.check` | Unit: the check box of a row in a multi-select list (`checked`, `disabled`, `checked-disabled`). |
| `listbox.keys, listbox.idle` | Units: the ring around the row with keyboard focus (`selected`), and that row while the list is not in use. |
| `listbox.field, listbox.search, listbox.list` | Places: the field, search box and list inside a list box, which are the list and field units as they appear here. |
| `list.*` | The rows, as in DropDown: height, padding, highlight, selected item, headers and "Select all". |

## API reference

### Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `Bind<V \| V[] \| null>` | `null` / `[]` | The selected value (single) or values (multiple). `x-model` binds it, and a change writes a new array. |
| `items / dataSource` | `Bind<readonly T[]>` / `Bind<DataSource \| null>` | — | An in-memory array, searched on the client, or a `@motifx-community/data` data source, searched on the server. A data source takes precedence. |
| `textField, valueField` | `Bind<ItemField<T>>` | `'text'`, `'value'` | A property name or a function `(item) => …`. Plain values serve as their own text and value. |
| `iconField, groupField, enabledField` | `Bind<ItemField<T>>` | — | An icon for each item, headers between groups (in-memory items), and items that cannot be selected. |
| `selectionMode` | `Bind<'single' \| 'multiple'>` | `'single'` | A single value, or an array of values. |
| `showCheckBoxes` | `Bind<boolean>` | `true` | In multiple selection, shows check boxes in front of the items. `false` draws a check mark instead, and a plain click selects only that item. |
| `selectAll` | `Bind<boolean>` | `false` | In multiple selection, adds a "Select all" row that can be checked, empty or indeterminate. |
| `selectionFollowsFocus` | `Bind<boolean>` | `true` | In single selection, the arrow keys select as they move. When off, they only move, and Space or Enter selects. |
| `searchEnabled` | `Bind<boolean>` | `false` | Adds a search box above the list. |
| `searchMode` | `Bind<'contains' \| 'startswith'>` | `'contains'` | How the search matches in-memory items. |
| `searchDelay` | `Bind<number>` | `0` / `250` | The delay, in milliseconds, between the last keystroke and the search (in memory / with a data source). |
| `height` | `Bind<number \| string \| null>` | — | The height, in rows (`8`) or a CSS length (`"12rem"`). Without it, the list is as tall as its items, up to the `max-height` of the list (`list.container`). |
| `itemTemplate` | `Bind<(item, host) => cleanup \| void>` | — | Customizes how an item is drawn. |
| `noItemsText` | `Bind<string>` | — | The text for an empty list, which replaces the `uiLocale` “No items” string. |
| `label, labelMode, helpText, hint, readOnly, required, size, variant, stretch, rules, error, validateOn, validationGroup` | see TextBox |  | Field props shared by all editors. |

A prop that accepts a function as its value (`textField`, a template) uses the function as is when it has parameters. A function without parameters is treated as a getter, as with every other prop.

### Properties

| Property | Access | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `every prop above` | read/write, reactive | Accepts a value or a function, the same as the prop. |
| `selectedItems, selectedItem` | read-only, reactive | The known items for the selected values. With a data source, the others are requested by key and added. |
| `listItems` | read-only | The `DataItems` shown in the list, which are the results of the last search. |
| `searchBox` | read-only | The search `TextBox` while `searchEnabled` is on. |
| `isValid, validationMessage` | read-only, reactive | See TextBox. |

### Methods

| Method | Returns | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `selectAllItems()` | `Promise<void>` | In multiple selection, selects every item the list shows (with a data source, after their values load). |
| `clear()` | `void` | Clears the selection. |
| `scrollToItem(item)` | `void` | Scrolls an item into view and highlights it. |
| `refresh()` | `void` | Your items can be plain or reactive, and the list reads them as they are. After changing them in place, call `refresh()`. It re-reads the items, their text and values, and the selection. |
| `validate(), resetValidation(), focus()` |  | See TextBox. |

### Events

| Event | When |
| --- | --- |
| `onValueChanged(e)` | `{ value, previousValue, byUser, source, event? }` |
| `onValidated(e)` | See TextBox. |

## Example files

`Programmatic.tsx`

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, ListBox, Stack } from '@motifx-community/ui';
import { cities } from './cities';

/** A list bound with x-model, and lists created with `new` and added programmatically. */
export default function Programmatic() {
  const form = reactive({ city: 'İzmir' as string | null, result: '' });
  let added = 0;
  let host: Stack | null = null;

  const addProgrammatic = () => {
    const list = new ListBox<string, string>({ label: `Size ${++added}`, items: ['S', 'M', 'L', 'XL'], height: 4 });
    list.onValueChanged((e) => (form.result = `${list.label}: ${e.value}`));
    host?.controls.add(list);
    list.focus();
  };

  return (
    <>
      <ListBox label="&City" items={cities} x-model={() => form.city} />
      <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center">
        <output class="lb-city">{() => `city: ${form.city ?? '—'}`}</output>
        <Button text="Add a list programmatically" variant="outline" onclick={addProgrammatic} />
        <output class="lb-made">{() => form.result}</output>
      </Stack>
      <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center" ref={(c: Stack) => (host = c)} />
    </>
  );
}
```

`SeveralItems.tsx`

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { ListBox, Stack, Switch } from '@motifx-community/ui';
import { cities } from './cities';

/** One list switched between one value and several, with check boxes, “Select all”, and a search box. */
export default function SeveralItems() {
  const s = reactive({ picked: ['Bursa', 'Konya'] as string[], multiple: true, checkBoxes: true, selectAll: true, follows: true, search: false });
  return (
    <>
      <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center">
        <Switch label="Multiple" x-model={() => s.multiple} />
        <Switch label="Check boxes" x-model={() => s.checkBoxes} />
        <Switch label="Select all" x-model={() => s.selectAll} />
        <Switch label="Selection follows focus" x-model={() => s.follows} />
        <Switch label="Search" x-model={() => s.search} />
      </Stack>
      <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center">
        <ListBox
          label="Cities"
          items={cities}
          selectionMode={() => (s.multiple ? 'multiple' : 'single')}
          showCheckBoxes={() => s.checkBoxes}
          selectAll={() => s.selectAll}
          selectionFollowsFocus={() => s.follows}
          searchEnabled={() => s.search}
          value={() => (s.multiple ? s.picked : (s.picked[0] ?? null))}
          onValueChanged={(e) => (s.picked = Array.isArray(e.value) ? (e.value as string[]) : e.value === null ? [] : [e.value as string])}
        />
        <output class="lb-picked">{() => `value: ${JSON.stringify(s.multiple ? s.picked : (s.picked[0] ?? null))}`}</output>
      </Stack>
    </>
  );
}
```

`Validation.tsx`

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, ListBox, Stack, ValidationGroup } from '@motifx-community/ui';
import { cities } from './cities';

/** A required list checked in a group, and the read-only and disabled states. */
export default function Validation() {
  const s = reactive({ sizes: [] as string[], result: '' });
  const group = new ValidationGroup();

  const check = async () => {
    const result = await group.validate();
    s.result = result.valid ? 'Fine.' : 'Pick a size.';
  };

  return (
    <>
      <ListBox
        label="Sizes"
        items={['S', 'M', 'L', 'XL']}
        selectionMode="multiple"
        required
        helpText="Pick one or more."
        validationGroup={group}
        x-model={() => s.sizes}
      />
      <ListBox label="Read-only" items={cities} value="Bursa" readOnly height={4} />
      <ListBox label="Disabled" items={cities} value="Bursa" enabled={false} height={4} />
      <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center">
        <Button text="Check" variant="outline" onclick={check} />
        <output class="lb-check">{() => s.result}</output>
      </Stack>
    </>
  );
}
```

# TagBox

> Data · @motifx-community/ui 0.1.0-beta.5

Selects multiple items. Selected items appear as tags in the field, followed by a text input that searches the list. Items can come from memory or from a data source, and typed text can become a custom tag.

## Import

```tsx
import { TagBox } from '@motifx-community/ui';
import { data } from '@motifx-community/data';
```

## Declarative and programmatic

`x-model` binds an array, and every change writes a new one. When you create the component with `new`, set the same properties programmatically.

```tsx
/** The skills the tag boxes of the examples pick from. */
export const skills = ['CSS', 'Go', 'HTML', 'Java', 'JavaScript', 'Kotlin', 'Python', 'Rust', 'SQL', 'Swift', 'TypeScript'];
```

## List options

The list stays open during selection, shows selected items as checked, and can include a “Select all” row. Each option is a prop you can bind.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Stack, Switch, TagBox } from '@motifx-community/ui';

interface Person {
  id: number;
  name: string;
  team: string;
  initials: string;
  away?: boolean;
}

const people: Person[] = [
  { id: 1, name: 'Ada Lovelace', team: 'Design', initials: 'AL' },
  { id: 2, name: 'Grace Hopper', team: 'Design', initials: 'GH' },
  { id: 3, name: 'Alan Turing', team: 'Engineering', initials: 'AT' },
  { id: 4, name: 'Barbara Liskov', team: 'Engineering', initials: 'BL', away: true },
  { id: 5, name: 'Edsger Dijkstra', team: 'Engineering', initials: 'ED' },
  { id: 6, name: 'Margaret Hamilton', team: 'Research', initials: 'MH' },
  { id: 7, name: 'Donald Knuth', team: 'Research', initials: 'DK' },
];

/** Draws a person as initials and a name. */
const drawPerson = (p: Person, el: HTMLElement) => {
  const badge = el.appendChild(document.createElement('span'));
  badge.style.color = 'var(--mx-color-accent-fg)';
  badge.style.fontWeight = 'var(--mx-font-weight-semibold)';
  badge.textContent = p.initials;
  el.append(` ${p.name}`);
};

/** Objects in groups, items that cannot be chosen, a template, and the switches of the list. */
export default function TeamList() {
  const s = reactive({ team: [1, 3] as number[], closeOnSelect: false, hideSelected: false, selectAll: false, limit: false });
  return (
    <>
      <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center">
        <Switch label="Close on select" x-model={() => s.closeOnSelect} />
        <Switch label="Hide chosen" x-model={() => s.hideSelected} />
        <Switch label="Select all" x-model={() => s.selectAll} />
        <Switch label="At most 3" x-model={() => s.limit} />
      </Stack>
      <TagBox
        label="Team"
        items={people}
        textField="name"
        valueField="id"
        groupField="team"
        enabledField={(p: Person) => !p.away}
        itemTemplate={drawPerson}
        closeOnSelect={() => s.closeOnSelect}
        hideSelected={() => s.hideSelected}
        selectAll={() => s.selectAll}
        maxSelected={() => (s.limit ? 3 : 0)}
        placeholder="Add people"
        stretch
        x-model={() => s.team}
      />
      <output class="tg-team">{() => `ids: ${JSON.stringify(s.team)}`}</output>
    </>
  );
}
```

## From a data source

With `dataSource`, typed text searches the data source (using its `searchFields`). In `'blocks'` mode, only the visible rows load, and tags for values on unloaded pages are looked up by key. `maxTags` keeps the field compact. This example has 5,000 customers.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { data } from '@motifx-community/data';
import { TagBox } from '@motifx-community/ui';

interface Customer {
  id: number;
  name: string;
}

const rows: Customer[] = Array.from({ length: 5000 }, (_, i) => ({ id: i + 1, name: `Customer ${String(i + 1).padStart(4, '0')}` }));

/** 5,000 customers from a data source, loaded in blocks while the list scrolls; the tags of values not loaded yet are found by key. */
export default function Customers() {
  const mail = reactive({ to: [12, 4321] as number[] });
  const customers = new data.DataSource<Customer, number>({
    adapter: new data.ArrayAdapter({ data: rows, key: 'id' }),
    loadMode: 'blocks',
    pageSize: 50,
    searchFields: ['name'],
  });

  return (
    <>
      <TagBox label="Customers" dataSource={customers} textField="name" valueField="id" maxTags={3} selectAll clearButton stretch x-model={() => mail.to} />
      <output class="tg-customers">{() => `${mail.to.length} chosen${mail.to.length && mail.to.length < 6 ? `: ${mail.to.join(', ')}` : ''}`}</output>
    </>
  );
}
```

## Custom tags

With `acceptCustomValue`, pressing Enter adds text that matches no item as a tag. `customValue` transforms or rejects it, and `tagTemplate` customizes how a tag is drawn.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { TagBox } from '@motifx-community/ui';

/** Typed text that matches no item becomes a tag; `customValue` shapes it or turns it down. */
export default function CustomTags() {
  const issue = reactive({ labels: ['bug'] as string[] });
  return (
    <>
      <TagBox
        label="Labels"
        items={['bug', 'docs', 'feature', 'question']}
        acceptCustomValue
        customValue={(text: string) => (text.length > 1 ? text.toLowerCase() : null)}
        helpText="Type a new label and press Enter."
        x-model={() => issue.labels}
      />
      <output class="tg-labels">{() => `labels: ${JSON.stringify(issue.labels)}`}</output>
    </>
  );
}
```

## Validation and states

```tsx
/** The skills the tag boxes of the examples pick from. */
export const skills = ['CSS', 'Go', 'HTML', 'Java', 'JavaScript', 'Kotlin', 'Python', 'Rust', 'SQL', 'Swift', 'TypeScript'];
```

## Keyboard

| Key | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `Typing` | Searches and opens the list, highlighting the first match. |
| `Down / Up, Alt + Down` | Opens the list with all items, or moves the highlight within it. |
| `Enter` | Selects or deselects the highlighted item and keeps the list open. With `acceptCustomValue`, text that matches no item becomes a tag. |
| `Backspace in an empty input` | Removes the last tag. |
| `Left at the start of the input` | Moves to the last tag. |
| `On a tag: Left, Right, Home, End` | Moves between the tags. Right on the last tag, or End, returns to the input. |
| `On a tag: Delete, Backspace` | Removes the tag. |
| `Escape` | Closes the list. When closed, it clears the text, and then removes all tags with `clearButton`. |
| `Alt + Up, Tab` | Closes the list. |

## Accessibility

| Topic | Details |
| --- | --- |
| `Pattern` | The APG combobox with a multi-select listbox. The input has `role="combobox"`, `aria-autocomplete="list"`, `aria-expanded` and `aria-controls`, and the list has `aria-multiselectable`. |
| `Highlight` | `aria-activedescendant` identifies the highlighted option while focus stays in the input. |
| `Tags` | A `role="list"` of `role="listitem"` elements. Each has a remove button named “Remove …” from `uiLocale`, and the “+3” tag lists the rest in its title. |
| `Name` | The label names the input, and help and error text describe it. |

## Localization

The remove buttons (`removeItem`, “Remove {text}”), the “+3” tag (`moreItems`), “Select all”, the buttons and the list text come from `uiLocale.strings`.

```tsx
/** The skills the tag boxes of the examples pick from. */
export const skills = ['CSS', 'Go', 'HTML', 'Java', 'JavaScript', 'Kotlin', 'Python', 'Rust', 'SQL', 'Swift', 'TypeScript'];
```

## Styling

| Hook | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `.mx-tag-box` | Added to the field. `data-open`, and `data-text` while text is typed, plus the TextBox field attributes. |
| `.mx-tag-box__tags, .mx-tag-box__tag, .mx-tag-box__tag-text, .mx-tag-box__remove` | The tags, a tag (`data-loading` while its item is requested), its text and its remove button. |
| `.mx-tag-box__more` | The “+3” tag. |
| `.mx-tag-box__input, .mx-tag-box__arrow, .mx-tag-box__clear` | The text input and the buttons. |
| `.mx-tag-box__popup, .mx-list…` | The popup and the shared list. |

### Component tokens

| Token | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `tagbox.tag, tagbox.tag-text` | Units: a tag (`more`: the "+N" tag, `loading`, `focus`, `hover`, `fixed`, `disabled`) and its text. |
| `tagbox.remove, tagbox.remove-glyph` | Units: a tag's remove button (`hover`, `pressed`) and its glyph. |
| `tagbox.box, tagbox.tags, tagbox.arrow, tagbox.arrow-glyph` | Units: the spacing around the tags in the box, the tag group, and the arrow that opens the list (`open`). |
| `tagbox.inset, tagbox.input-min-width` | The space between the tags and the field edge, and the minimum width of the input before it wraps to the next line. |
| `list.*, listbox.*, field.*` | The list, the list box and the field. |

## API reference

### Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `Bind<V[]>` | `[]` | The values of the selected items. `x-model` binds them, and every change writes a new array. |
| `items / dataSource` | `Bind<readonly T[]>` / `Bind<DataSource \| null>` | — | An in-memory array, searched on the client, or a `@motifx-community/data` data source, searched on the server. |
| `textField, valueField, iconField, groupField, enabledField` | `Bind<ItemField<T>>` | — | Same as ListBox. Groups apply to in-memory items. |
| `placeholder` | `Bind<string>` | `''` | Displayed when no item is selected. |
| `searchMode, minSearchLength, searchDelay` |  | `'contains'`, `0`, `0` / `250` | How and when typed text searches, as in ComboBox. |
| `acceptCustomValue` | `Bind<boolean>` | `false` | Pressing Enter adds text that matches no item as a custom tag. |
| `customValue` | `Bind<(text) => V \| null>` | The text | Creates the value for typed text. Returning `null` rejects it. |
| `autoHighlight` | `Bind<boolean>` | `true` (`false` with `acceptCustomValue`) | Highlights the first match while typing, so Enter accepts it. |
| `closeOnSelect` | `Bind<boolean>` | `false` | Closes the list when an item is selected. |
| `maxTags` | `Bind<number>` | `0` | The number of tags shown. The rest are counted in a “+3” tag. `0` shows all. |
| `maxSelected` | `Bind<number>` | `0` | The maximum number of selectable items. At the limit, the others cannot be selected. `0` means no limit. |
| `selectAll` | `Bind<boolean>` | `false` | Adds a "Select all" row before the items. |
| `hideSelected` | `Bind<boolean>` | `false` | Removes selected items from the list (in-memory items only). |
| `openOnFieldClick` | `Bind<boolean>` | `true` | Clicking the field opens the list. |
| `showDropDownButton, clearButton` | `Bind<boolean>` | `true`, `false` | The arrow that opens all items, and the button that removes all tags. |
| `itemTemplate, tagTemplate` | `Bind<(item, host) => cleanup \| void>` | — | Customizes how a list item or a tag is drawn. |
| `matchWidth` | `Bind<boolean>` | `true` | The list is at least as wide as the field. |
| `label, labelMode, helpText, hint, prefix, icon, readOnly, required, size, variant, stretch, rules, error, validateOn, validationGroup` | see TextBox |  | Field props shared by all editors. |

### Properties

| Property | Access | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `every prop above` | read/write, reactive | Accepts a value or a function, the same as the prop. |
| `selectedItems` | read-only, reactive | The known items for the selected values. With a data source, the others are looked up by key. |
| `listItems` | read-only | The `DataItems` shown in the list, which are the results of the last search. |
| `opened` | read/write, reactive | Indicates whether the list is open. Set it to open or close the list. |
| `inputElement` | read-only | The text input. |

### Methods

| Method | Returns | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `open(), close()` | `boolean`, `void` | Opens the list (returns `false` when disabled or read-only), or closes it. |
| `clear()` | `void` | Removes all tags. |
| `selectAllItems()` | `Promise<void>` | Selects every item the list shows, up to `maxSelected` (with a data source, after their values load). |
| `refresh()` | `void` | Your items can be plain or reactive, and the box reads them as they are. After changing them in place, call `refresh()`. The tags, the open list and `selectedItems` update. |
| `validate(), resetValidation(), focus()` |  | See TextBox. |

### Events

| Event | When |
| --- | --- |
| `onValueChanged(e)` | `{ value, previousValue, byUser, source, event? }` |
| `onOpened()` | Occurs when the list opens. |
| `onClosed(reason)` | Occurs when the list closes. The reason is `'escape'`, `'outside'`, `'focus'` or `'code'`. |
| `onValidated(e)` | See TextBox. |

## Example files

`Programmatic.tsx`

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, Stack, TagBox } from '@motifx-community/ui';
import { skills } from './skills';

/** A tag box bound to an array with x-model, and tag boxes created with `new` and added programmatically. */
export default function Programmatic() {
  const form = reactive({ skills: ['TypeScript', 'CSS'] as string[], result: '' });
  let added = 0;
  let host: Stack | null = null;

  const addProgrammatic = () => {
    const tags = new TagBox<string, string>({ label: `Skills ${++added}`, items: skills, placeholder: 'Pick some' });
    tags.onValueChanged((e) => (form.result = `${tags.label}: ${e.value.join(', ')}`));
    host?.controls.add(tags);
    tags.focus();
  };

  return (
    <>
      <TagBox label="&Skills" items={skills} x-model={() => form.skills} stretch />
      <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center">
        <output class="tg-skills">{() => `skills: ${JSON.stringify(form.skills)}`}</output>
        <Button text="Add a tag box programmatically" variant="outline" onclick={addProgrammatic} />
        <output class="tg-made">{() => form.result}</output>
      </Stack>
      <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center" ref={(c: Stack) => (host = c)} />
    </>
  );
}
```
