```tsx
docs.onClosing((e) => {
  // Ask only when the last copy closes.
  if (e.document.dirty && e.lastCopy) e.promise = confirm('Close without saving?');
});
```

## Accessibility

| Topic | Details |
| --- | --- |
| `Preview and pinned tabs` | A tab announces “preview” or “pinned” after its title. The pin icon is for pointer use. From the keyboard, use the menu (Shift+F10) or Ctrl+K Shift+Enter to pin and unpin, and Ctrl+K Enter to keep a preview. |
| `Compact pinned tabs` | Show their icon or first letter. The title and description stay in the tab for screen readers. |
| `Scroll buttons` | For pointer use only. The arrow keys reach every tab and scroll it into view. |
| `Badges and tones` | A badge's text is part of the tab's name. A dot and a tone are color only, so make sure their meaning also appears in the title, the tooltip or the badge text. |
| `Announcements` | Pinned, unpinned and kept open are announced politely, like opened and closed. |

## API

### Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `previewTabs` | `Bind<boolean>` | `true` | Documents opened with `preview` replace the group's preview tab. With `false`, every document opens as a regular tab. |
| `pinnedTabSize` | `Bind<'normal' \| 'compact' \| 'shrink'>` | `'normal'` | Pinned tabs can look like other tabs, show only their icon (or first letter, with the title kept for screen readers), or shrink to `tabMinWidth`. |
| `pinnedTabsOnSeparateRow` | `Bind<boolean>` | `false` | Places pinned tabs on their own row, above the others. |
| `closeButtonOnPinned` | `Bind<boolean>` | `false` | Shows a close button next to the pin icon on pinned tabs. |
| `keepPinned` | `Bind<boolean>` | `true` | Keeps pinned tabs open with Close All, Close Others, Close to the Right or Left, and Close Saved. |
| `tabSize` | `Bind<'fit' \| 'shrink' \| 'fixed'>` | `'fit'` | As wide as their text, shrinking down to `tabMinWidth` before the strip scrolls, or `tabFixedWidth` wide, shrinking down to `tabMinWidth`. |
| `tabMinWidth, tabMaxWidth, tabFixedWidth` | `Bind<number>` | `80`, `0`, `160` | In pixels. `tabMaxWidth` limits `fit` and `shrink` tabs, and 0 leaves only the title's own limit. |
| `wrapTabs` | `Bind<boolean>` | `false` | Tabs that do not fit continue on more rows instead of scrolling. |
| `scrollButtons` | `Bind<boolean>` | `true` | Buttons at the ends of a strip that does not fit. The mouse wheel scrolls it sideways in any case. |
| `showDescription` | `Bind<'always' \| 'duplicates' \| 'never'>` | `'duplicates'` | Whether a tab always shows its document's description, shows it only when another open document has the same title, or never shows it. |
| `allowDuplicate` | `Bind<boolean>` | `false` | Allows the same document to be open in several groups. A document's own `allowDuplicate` takes precedence. |
| `splitCopies` | `Bind<boolean>` | `true` | When splitting with a document that can be open twice, opens a copy in the new group. Otherwise, the document moves there. |

### TabDocument

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `preview` | `Bind<boolean>` | An italic preview tab, which the next preview opened in its group replaces. It stays after a double-click, an edit (`dirty`), `keep`, the menu or a move. |
| `pinned` | `Bind<boolean>` | Pinned tabs come first, in the order they were pinned, and have a pin icon that unpins them. Use `pin` and `unpin` so that events are raised. |
| `badge` | `Bind<string \| number \| boolean \| null>` | A count or short text after the title. `true` shows a dot. |
| `tone` | `Bind<'warning' \| 'danger' \| 'success' \| 'accent' \| null>` | Colors the title and the badge. |
| `description` | `Bind<string>` | Displayed as set by `showDescription`, and in the document lists. |
| `allowDuplicate` | `Bind<boolean \| undefined>` | Overrides the manager's setting for this document. `undefined` inherits the manager's value. |
| `clone` | `(copy) => ComponentBase \| null` | Creates the content of a copy in another group. Without it, a `content` function is called again, or the manager's `factory` creates it. A component provided directly cannot be copied. |
| `original` | read-only | For a copy, the document it was copied from, or `null` for the document itself. A copy has the same `id` and `type`, and shares every field except `pinned`, `preview` and `contentLifetime`. |

### Methods

| Method | Returns | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `open(doc, { preview?, pinned?, … })` | `TabDocument \| null` | Opens as a preview, replacing the group's preview tab, or as a pinned tab. A document open in another group is copied there if it can be open twice. |
| `keep(doc)` | `boolean` | Keeps a preview tab open. |
| `pin(doc), unpin(doc)` | `boolean` | Pins to the end of the pinned tabs, or unpins to the first position after them. |
| `closeOthers(doc), closeToRight(doc), closeToLeft(doc), closeSaved(group?)` | `Promise<boolean>` | Closes several documents, each raising `onClosing`. Pinned tabs stay while `keepPinned` is on. |
| `closeAll(group?, pinned?)` | `Promise<boolean>` | Pinned tabs stay while `keepPinned` is on, unless `pinned` is `true`. |
| `split(group, direction, doc?)` | `TabGroup \| null` | Copies `doc` into the new group if it can be open twice and `splitCopies` is on. Otherwise, it moves. |

### Events

| Event | Contents |
| --- | --- |
| `onKeeping(e), onKept(e)` | `{ document, group, byUser }`. `keeping` is cancelable. |
| `onPinning(e), onPinned(e), onUnpinning(e), onUnpinned(e)` | `{ document, group, byUser }`. The `…ing` events are cancelable. |
| `onClosing(e)` | Also includes `lastCopy`, which is true when no other copy of the document remains open, so prompt about unsaved changes only then. A preview replaced by the next one also closes through this event. If it cancels or sets a promise, the old preview stays open as a regular tab. |
| `onSplitting(e), onSplit(e)` | Also includes `copy`: whether the document is copied (`splitting`), and the copy created (`split`). |

See the [overview](tabdocs.md#api) for the rest of the API, and [Menus and keys](tabdocs-menus.md) for menus, lists and keys.

## Example files

`Preview.tsx`

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, ListBox, Stack, Switch, TabDocumentManager } from '@motifx-community/ui';
import { FILES, fileDocument } from './files';

/**
 * Choosing a file opens it as a preview (in italics): the next one chosen takes its place. A double
 * click on the tab, an edit, "Keep open" or moving it makes it stay.
 */
export default function Preview() {
  const s = reactive({ previewTabs: true, kept: [] as string[] });
  // Narrow beside its log, it still shows as on a desktop (see the Tablet and phone page).
  const docs = new TabDocumentManager({ label: 'Files in preview', previewTabs: () => s.previewTabs, presentation: 'desktop' });
  docs.element.style.cssText = 'block-size: 28rem; flex: 1 1 0px; min-inline-size: 0';
  docs.onKept((e) => s.kept.unshift(e.document.title));

  const show = (path: string | null) => {
    if (path) docs.open(docs.findDocument(path) ?? fileDocument(path), { preview: true });
  };

  return (
    <>
      <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center">
        <Switch label="Preview tabs" x-model={() => s.previewTabs} />
        <Button text="Keep open" variant="outline" enabled={() => !!docs.activeDocument?.preview} onclick={() => docs.keep(docs.activeDocument!)} />
        <output class="td-state">{() => `preview: ${docs.activeGroup?.previewDocument?.title ?? 'none'}; kept: ${s.kept.join(', ') || 'none'}`}</output>
      </Stack>
      <div style="display: flex; gap: var(--mx-space-3); inline-size: 100%">
        <ListBox
          label="Files"
          items={FILES}
          textField="path"
          valueField="path"
          height="28rem"
          style="inline-size: 14rem; flex: none"
          onValueChanged={(e) => show(e.value as string | null)}
        />
        {docs}
      </div>
    </>
  );
}
```

`files.tsx`

```tsx
import type { ComponentBase } from '@motifx/core';
import { TabDocument, type TabDocumentOptions } from '@motifx-community/ui';

/** A page with a folded corner: a file. */
export const FileIcon = () => (
  <svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" aria-hidden="true">
    <path d="M4 1.75h5l3 3v9.5H4zM9 1.75v3h3" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.3" stroke-linejoin="round" />
  </svg>
);

/** A few files of a sample project. */
export const FILES = [
  { path: 'src/index.ts', text: "export { App } from './app';\nexport { router } from './router';" },
  { path: 'src/app.ts', text: "import { Application } from '@motifx/core';\n\nexport const App = Application.CreateBuilder().build();" },
  { path: 'src/router.ts', text: "export const router = { mode: 'history', routes: [] };" },
  { path: 'src/orders/index.ts', text: "export * from './orders';" },
  { path: 'src/orders/orders.ts', text: 'export interface Order {\n  id: number;\n  amount: number;\n}' },
  { path: 'README.md', text: '# Shop\n\nA small shop written with MotifJS.' },
  { path: 'package.json', text: '{\n  "name": "shop",\n  "private": true\n}' },
  { path: 'vite.config.ts', text: "import { defineConfig } from 'vite';\n\nexport default defineConfig({});" },
];

/** A file's text, as a document's content. */
export function source(text: string): ComponentBase {
  // The panel scrolls (and takes focus for it): the text itself does not.
  return <pre style="margin: 0; padding: var(--mx-space-4); overflow: visible; font: var(--mx-font-size-body) / var(--mx-font-line-body) var(--mx-font-family-mono)">{text}</pre>;
}

/** A document for a file: its name as the title, its folder as the description. */
export function fileDocument(path: string, extra: TabDocumentOptions = {}): TabDocument {
  const file = FILES.find((f) => f.path === path);
  const at = path.lastIndexOf('/');
  return new TabDocument({
    id: path,
    type: 'file',
    title: path.slice(at + 1),
    description: at > 0 ? path.slice(0, at) : '',
    icon: () => <FileIcon />,
    content: () => source(file?.text ?? ''),
    ...extra,
  });
}
```

`Pinning.tsx`

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, RadioGroup, Stack, Switch, TabDocumentManager, type PinnedTabSize } from '@motifx-community/ui';
import { FILES, fileDocument } from './files';

/** Pinned tabs stay first, in the order they were pinned. Their pin mark unpins them; the menu and Ctrl+K Shift+Enter do too. */
export default function Pinning() {
  const s = reactive({ size: 'normal' as PinnedTabSize, separateRow: false, closeButton: false, keepPinned: true });
  const docs = new TabDocumentManager({
    label: 'Files with pinned tabs',
    pinnedTabSize: () => s.size,
    pinnedTabsOnSeparateRow: () => s.separateRow,
    closeButtonOnPinned: () => s.closeButton,
    keepPinned: () => s.keepPinned,
  });
  docs.element.style.cssText = 'block-size: 28rem; inline-size: 100%';
  for (const file of FILES) docs.open(fileDocument(file.path), { index: 99, pinned: file.path === 'README.md' || file.path === 'package.json' });

  const toggle = () => {
    const doc = docs.activeDocument;
    if (doc) (doc.pinned ? docs.unpin(doc) : docs.pin(doc));
  };

  return (
    <>
      <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center" gap="lg">
        <RadioGroup
          label="Pinned tab size"
          orientation="horizontal"
          items={[
            { value: 'normal', text: 'Normal' },
            { value: 'compact', text: 'Compact' },
            { value: 'shrink', text: 'Shrink' },
          ]}
          itemText="text"
          itemValue="value"
          x-model={() => s.size}
        />
        <Switch label="Row of their own" x-model={() => s.separateRow} />
        <Switch label="Close button" x-model={() => s.closeButton} />
        <Switch label="Close all keeps them" x-model={() => s.keepPinned} />
      </Stack>
      <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center">
        <Button text={() => (docs.activeDocument?.pinned ? 'Unpin active' : 'Pin active')} variant="outline" onclick={toggle} />
        <Button text="Close all" variant="outline" onclick={() => docs.closeAll()} />
        <Button text="Open the files again" variant="ghost" onclick={() => FILES.forEach((f) => docs.findDocument(f.path) || docs.open(fileDocument(f.path), { index: 99 }))} />
      </Stack>
      {docs}
    </>
  );
}
```

`Sizing.tsx`

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { RadioGroup, Stack, Switch, TabDocumentManager, type TabSize } from '@motifx-community/ui';
import { notes } from './contents';

/** More tabs than fit: they scroll (wheel or buttons), shrink, take one width, or go on to more rows. */
export default function Sizing() {
  const s = reactive({ size: 'fit' as TabSize, wrap: false, buttons: true });
  const docs = new TabDocumentManager({
    label: 'Tab sizes',
    tabSize: () => s.size,
    wrapTabs: () => s.wrap,
    scrollButtons: () => s.buttons,
    tabMinWidth: 72,
    tabFixedWidth: 140,
  });
  docs.element.style.cssText = 'block-size: 28rem; inline-size: 100%';
  const names = ['Overview', 'Customers', 'Orders', 'Invoices', 'Payments', 'Shipping', 'Returns', 'Products', 'Stock', 'Suppliers', 'Reports', 'Settings'];
  for (const name of names) docs.open({ id: name, title: name, content: () => notes(name) }, { index: 99 });

  return (
    <>
      <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center" gap="lg">
        <RadioGroup
          label="Tab size"
          orientation="horizontal"
          items={[
            { value: 'fit', text: 'Fit' },
            { value: 'shrink', text: 'Shrink' },
            { value: 'fixed', text: 'Fixed' },
          ]}
          itemText="text"
          itemValue="value"
          x-model={() => s.size}
        />
        <Switch label="More rows" x-model={() => s.wrap} />
        <Switch label="Scroll buttons" x-model={() => s.buttons} />
      </Stack>
      {docs}
    </>
  );
}
```

```tsx
    <div style="padding: var(--mx-space-4); max-inline-size: 40rem">
      <h3 style="margin-block-start: 0">{title}</h3>
      <p>Any component can be a document: a form, a grid, a chart or plain text like this.</p>
      <p>Drag the line between two groups, or focus it with Tab and use the arrow keys. A double click on it gives the groups the same size.</p>
    </div>
  );
}

const CITIES = ['İstanbul', 'Ankara', 'İzmir', 'London', 'New York'];

/** A customer card: text fields and a city drop-down over a reactive customer, and a button that opens a dialog. */
export function customerCard(customer: Customer): ComponentBase {
  const items: FormItem[] = [
    { field: 'name', label: 'Name', required: true },
    { field: 'email', label: 'Email', editor: 'email' },
    { field: 'city', label: 'City', editor: 'dropdown', editorProps: { items: CITIES } },
  ];
  let card: ComponentBase | null = null;
  // The dialog opens where the card is: in a new window, there.
  const clear = async () => {
    if (await confirm('Clear the customer card?', { title: 'Clear', host: card! })) Object.assign(customer, { name: '', email: '', city: '' });
  };
  return (
    <div ref={(c: ComponentBase) => (card = c)} style="padding: var(--mx-space-4); max-inline-size: 32rem">
      <FormLayout data={customer} items={items} />
      <Button text="Clear…" variant="outline" onclick={clear} />
    </div>
  );
}
```

`Look.tsx`

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, RadioGroup, Stack, TabDocument, TabDocumentManager, type TabShowDescription } from '@motifx-community/ui';
import { notes } from './contents';
import { fileDocument } from './files';

/** A count or a dot on the tab, a color for what the document needs, and a description only where two titles are the same. */
export default function Look() {
  const s = reactive({ unread: 3, errors: 1, description: 'duplicates' as TabShowDescription });
  const docs = new TabDocumentManager({ label: 'Badges and tones', showDescription: () => s.description });
  docs.element.style.cssText = 'block-size: 28rem; inline-size: 100%';
  docs.open(new TabDocument({ id: 'inbox', title: 'Inbox', badge: () => s.unread || null, tone: () => (s.unread ? 'accent' : null), content: () => notes('Inbox') }));
  docs.open(new TabDocument({ id: 'build', title: 'Build', badge: () => s.errors || null, tone: () => (s.errors ? 'danger' : 'success'), content: () => notes('Build') }), { index: 99 });
  docs.open(new TabDocument({ id: 'quota', title: 'Quota', badge: true, tone: 'warning', content: () => notes('Quota') }), { index: 99 });
  docs.open(fileDocument('src/index.ts'), { index: 99 });
  docs.open(fileDocument('src/orders/index.ts'), { index: 99 });

  return (
    <>
      <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center" gap="lg">
        <Button text="New mail" variant="outline" onclick={() => s.unread++} />
        <Button text="Read all" variant="outline" onclick={() => (s.unread = 0)} />
        <Button text={() => (s.errors ? 'Fix the build' : 'Break the build')} variant="outline" onclick={() => (s.errors = s.errors ? 0 : 2)} />
        <RadioGroup
          label="Description"
          orientation="horizontal"
          items={[
            { value: 'duplicates', text: 'Same titles' },
            { value: 'always', text: 'Always' },
            { value: 'never', text: 'Never' },
          ]}
          itemText="text"
          itemValue="value"
          x-model={() => s.description}
        />
      </Stack>
      {docs}
    </>
  );
}
```

`Duplicates.tsx`

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, Stack, Switch, TabDocument, TabDocumentManager } from '@motifx-community/ui';
import { customerForm } from './contents';

/**
 * One customer open in two groups: each copy has a form of its own over the same data, and both
 * tabs follow the title and the unsaved changes. Splitting copies the document; turned off, it moves.
 */
export default function Duplicates() {
  const s = reactive({ allow: true });
  const saved = reactive({ name: 'Ada Lovelace', email: 'ada@example.com', city: 'London' });
  const ada = reactive({ ...saved });
  const docs = new TabDocumentManager({ label: 'Two copies', allowDuplicate: () => s.allow });
  docs.element.style.cssText = 'block-size: 28rem; inline-size: 100%';
  const doc = docs.open(
    new TabDocument({
      id: 'ada',
      type: 'customer',
      title: () => ada.name || 'New customer',
      dirty: () => ada.name !== saved.name || ada.email !== saved.email || ada.city !== saved.city,
      content: () => customerForm(ada),
    }),
  )!;
  docs.split(docs.groups[0], 'right', doc);

  return (
    <>
      <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center">
        <Switch label="Allow two copies" x-model={() => s.allow} />
        <Button text="Split the active group" variant="outline" onclick={() => docs.activeGroup && docs.split(docs.activeGroup, 'down', docs.activeDocument ?? undefined)} />
        <Button text="Save" variant="outline" enabled={() => doc.dirty} onclick={() => Object.assign(saved, { ...ada })} />
        <output class="td-state">{() => `${docs.documents.length} tab(s) for ${new Set(docs.documents.map((d) => d.id)).size} document(s)`}</output>
      </Stack>
      {docs}
    </>
  );
}
```

# TabDocumentManager: Menus and keys

> TabDocumentManager · @motifx-community/ui 0.1.0-beta.5

The commands around tabs: context menus on tabs and on the empty strip, a searchable list of a group's documents, application toolbar buttons, the recently used list, back and forward, reopening closed documents, locked groups, and keyboard shortcuts for all of them.

## Context menus

Each tab offers the commands for its document, and the empty strip offers the commands for its group. `menuItems` hides built-in items, and `onContextMenuOpening` changes the list for each document or cancels it. `newDocument` creates a document when the empty strip is double-clicked.

```tsx
import type { ComponentBase } from '@motifx/core';
import { TabDocument, type TabDocumentOptions } from '@motifx-community/ui';

/** A page with a folded corner: a file. */
export const FileIcon = () => (
  <svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" aria-hidden="true">
    <path d="M4 1.75h5l3 3v9.5H4zM9 1.75v3h3" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.3" stroke-linejoin="round" />
  </svg>
);

/** A few files of a sample project. */
export const FILES = [
  { path: 'src/index.ts', text: "export { App } from './app';\nexport { router } from './router';" },
  { path: 'src/app.ts', text: "import { Application } from '@motifx/core';\n\nexport const App = Application.CreateBuilder().build();" },
  { path: 'src/router.ts', text: "export const router = { mode: 'history', routes: [] };" },
  { path: 'src/orders/index.ts', text: "export * from './orders';" },
  { path: 'src/orders/orders.ts', text: 'export interface Order {\n  id: number;\n  amount: number;\n}' },
  { path: 'README.md', text: '# Shop\n\nA small shop written with MotifJS.' },
  { path: 'package.json', text: '{\n  "name": "shop",\n  "private": true\n}' },
  { path: 'vite.config.ts', text: "import { defineConfig } from 'vite';\n\nexport default defineConfig({});" },
];

/** A file's text, as a document's content. */
export function source(text: string): ComponentBase {
  // The panel scrolls (and takes focus for it): the text itself does not.
  return <pre style="margin: 0; padding: var(--mx-space-4); overflow: visible; font: var(--mx-font-size-body) / var(--mx-font-line-body) var(--mx-font-family-mono)">{text}</pre>;
}

/** A document for a file: its name as the title, its folder as the description. */
export function fileDocument(path: string, extra: TabDocumentOptions = {}): TabDocument {
  const file = FILES.find((f) => f.path === path);
  const at = path.lastIndexOf('/');
  return new TabDocument({
    id: path,
    type: 'file',
    title: path.slice(at + 1),
    description: at > 0 ? path.slice(0, at) : '',
    icon: () => <FileIcon />,
    content: () => source(file?.text ?? ''),
    ...extra,
  });
}
```

| Command | Item | Note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `close` | Close | Closes the tab. Its key is shown next to it. |
| `closeOthers, closeRight, closeLeft, closeSaved, closeAll` | Close others / to the right / to the left / saved / all | Pinned tabs stay while `keepPinned` is on. |
| `copyTitle` | Copy the title | Copies it to the clipboard. |
| `keepOpen` | Keep open | Available only on a preview tab. |
| `pin, unpin` | Pin / Unpin | Shows whichever applies. |
| `splitUp, splitDown, splitLeft, splitRight` | Split up / down / left / right | Creates a new group on that side with the document, or a copy (see `splitCopies`). |
| `moveNext, movePrevious` | Move to the next / previous group | Splits if no group exists in that direction. |
| `moveTo` | Move to… | Chooses the destination with the keyboard ([Drag and drop](tabdocs-drag.md#keys)). |
| `moveGroupTo` | Move group to… (empty strip) | The same for the whole group. |
| `newDocument` | New document (empty strip) | Available only with `newDocument`. |
| `reopenClosed` | Reopen closed (empty strip) | Disabled when nothing can be reopened. |
| `lock, unlock` | Lock group / Unlock group (empty strip) |  |

## The open documents list and toolbar buttons

The “…” button (or Ctrl+K Ctrl+P) lists the group's documents, or the documents of every group with `openListScope: 'all'`. Type to search, and press Enter to open. `toolbarItems` adds application buttons to every group, and a document's `actions` appear while it is active.

```tsx
import type { ComponentBase } from '@motifx/core';
import { TabDocument, type TabDocumentOptions } from '@motifx-community/ui';

/** A page with a folded corner: a file. */
export const FileIcon = () => (

  </svg>
);

  { path: 'src/index.ts', text: "export { App } from './app';\nexport { router } from './router';" },
  { path: 'src/app.ts', text: "import { Application } from '@motifx/core';\n\nexport const App = Application.CreateBuilder().build();" },
  { path: 'src/router.ts', text: "export const router = { mode: 'history', routes: [] };" },
  { path: 'src/orders/index.ts', text: "export * from './orders';" },
  { path: 'src/orders/orders.ts', text: 'export interface Order {\n  id: number;\n  amount: number;\n}' },
  { path: 'README.md', text: '# Shop\n\nA small shop written with MotifJS.' },
  { path: 'package.json', text: '{\n  "name": "shop",\n  "private": true\n}' },
  { path: 'vite.config.ts', text: "import { defineConfig } from 'vite';\n\nexport default defineConfig({});" },
];

/** A file's text, as a document's content. */

  // The panel scrolls (and takes focus for it): the text itself does not.

}

/** A document for a file: its name as the title, its folder as the description. */
```

## Recently used, back and forward, and reopen

The recently used list switches between documents in the same way as Ctrl+Tab in code editors. `goBack` and `goForward` follow the documents activated in every group, and `reopenClosed` opens the most recently closed document in its original place.

```tsx
import type { ComponentBase } from '@motifx/core';
import { TabDocument, type TabDocumentOptions } from '@motifx-community/ui';

/** A page with a folded corner: a file. */
export const FileIcon = () => (
  <svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" aria-hidden="true">
    <path d="M4 1.75h5l3 3v9.5H4zM9 1.75v3h3" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.3" stroke-linejoin="round" />
  </svg>
);

/** A few files of a sample project. */
export const FILES = [
  { path: 'src/index.ts', text: "export { App } from './app';\nexport { router } from './router';" },
  { path: 'src/app.ts', text: "import { Application } from '@motifx/core';\n\nexport const App = Application.CreateBuilder().build();" },
  { path: 'src/router.ts', text: "export const router = { mode: 'history', routes: [] };" },
  { path: 'src/orders/index.ts', text: "export * from './orders';" },
  { path: 'src/orders/orders.ts', text: 'export interface Order {\n  id: number;\n  amount: number;\n}' },
  { path: 'README.md', text: '# Shop\n\nA small shop written with MotifJS.' },

  // The panel scrolls (and takes focus for it): the text itself does not.

/** A document for a file: its name as the title, its folder as the description. */

  const file = FILES.find((f) => f.path === path);
  const at = path.lastIndexOf('/');
```

## Locked groups

`lock(group)` reserves a group for its current contents. `open` without a group uses another group, or a new group beside it when all are locked (a single group still accepts it). The lock is saved with the layout.

```tsx
import type { ComponentBase } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, confirm, DataGrid, FormLayout, type FormItem, type GridColumn } from '@motifx-community/ui';
import { makeOrders, type Order } from './orders';

const columns: GridColumn<Order>[] = [
  { field: 'id', title: 'No', type: 'number', width: 70 },
  { field: 'customer', title: 'Customer', width: 160 },
  { field: 'city', title: 'City', width: 110 },
  { field: 'amount', title: 'Amount', type: 'number', width: 100 },
];

/** A grid of orders that fills its tab. */
export function ordersGrid(count = 60): ComponentBase {
  return <DataGrid rows={makeOrders(count)} rowKey="id" columns={columns} label="Orders" style="block-size: 100%" />;
}

/** The fields a customer is edited with. */
export interface Customer {
  name: string;
  email: string;
  city: string;
}

/** The forms open over each customer: a copy of a document has a form of its own over the same object. */
const formsOf = new WeakMap<Customer, Set<FormLayout<Customer>>>();

/**
 * A form over a customer: what is typed goes straight into it. The form reads the object as it is, so the other forms
 * over the same customer are told to read the field again.
 */
export function customerForm(customer: Customer): ComponentBase {
  const items: FormItem[] = [
    { field: 'name', label: 'Name', required: true },
    { field: 'email', label: 'Email', editor: 'email' },
    { field: 'city', label: 'City' },
  ];
  const forms = formsOf.get(customer) ?? new Set<FormLayout<Customer>>();
  formsOf.set(customer, forms);
  return (
    <div style="padding: var(--mx-space-4); max-inline-size: 32rem">
      <FormLayout<Customer>
        data={customer}
        items={items}
        ref={(form: FormLayout<Customer>) => {
          forms.add(form);
          form.motif.setDisposable(() => forms.delete(form));
        }}
        onFieldChanged={(e) => {
          for (const other of forms) if (other.data === e.data && !other.isDisposed) other.refreshField(e.field);
        }}
      />
    </div>
  );
}

/** A few paragraphs of plain text. */
export function notes(title: string): ComponentBase {
  return (
    <div style="padding: var(--mx-space-4); max-inline-size: 40rem">
      <h3 style="margin-block-start: 0">{title}</h3>
      <p>Any component can be a document: a form, a grid, a chart or plain text like this.</p>
      <p>Drag the line between two groups, or focus it with Tab and use the arrow keys. A double click on it gives the groups the same size.</p>
    </div>
  );
}

const CITIES = ['İstanbul', 'Ankara', 'İzmir', 'London', 'New York'];

/** A customer card: text fields and a city drop-down over a reactive customer, and a button that opens a dialog. */
export function customerCard(customer: Customer): ComponentBase {
  const items: FormItem[] = [
    { field: 'name', label: 'Name', required: true },
    { field: 'email', label: 'Email', editor: 'email' },
    { field: 'city', label: 'City', editor: 'dropdown', editorProps: { items: CITIES } },
  ];
  let card: ComponentBase | null = null;
  // The dialog opens where the card is: in a new window, there.
  const clear = async () => {
    if (await confirm('Clear the customer card?', { title: 'Clear', host: card! })) Object.assign(customer, { name: '', email: '', city: '' });
  };
  return (
    <div ref={(c: ComponentBase) => (card = c)} style="padding: var(--mx-space-4); max-inline-size: 32rem">
      <FormLayout data={customer} items={items} />
      <Button text="Clear…" variant="outline" onclick={clear} />
    </div>
  );
}
```

## Keyboard

A page in a browser tab never receives Ctrl+W, Ctrl+Tab, Ctrl+Shift+T, Ctrl+Page Up/Down and often Ctrl+1…9, because the browser reserves them. A manager therefore starts with keys that reach it, in the same way as the web version of a code editor (Ctrl+Alt in place of a reserved Ctrl, and Ctrl+E, the Quick Open key, for the recent list), and keeps the desktop key as a second option. An installed app (standalone display mode) receives every key, and there `keyPreset: 'auto'` uses `TabDocumentManager.desktopKeys`. `keys` changes any of them, and an empty list disables one.

| Browser tab | Installed app | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Ctrl + Alt + W` | Ctrl + W, Ctrl + F4 | Closes the active document (`closeTab`). |
| `Alt + Page Down / Page Up` | Ctrl + Page Down / Page Up | Moves to the next or previous tab (`nextTab`, `previousTab`). |
| `Ctrl + Alt + 1 … 9` | Ctrl + 1 … 9 | Sets focus on a group (`focusGroup`). |
| `Ctrl + E, Ctrl + Shift + E` | Ctrl + Tab, Ctrl + Shift + Tab | Opens the recently used list and moves through it while Ctrl is held. Releasing Ctrl opens the highlighted document (`recentNext`, `recentPrevious`). |
| `Alt + Left / Right` | Same | Moves back and forward (`goBack`, `goForward`). |
| `Ctrl + Alt + Shift + T` | Ctrl + Shift + T | Reopens the most recently closed document (`reopenClosed`). |
| `Ctrl + K, then W / U` | Same | Closes the group's documents, or its saved documents (`closeAllTabs`, `closeSavedTabs`). |
| `Ctrl + K, then Enter` | Same | Keeps a preview tab open (`keepOpen`). |
| `Ctrl + K, then Shift + Enter` | Same | Pins or unpins the active document (`togglePin`). |
| `Ctrl + K, then Ctrl + P` | Same | Opens the "…" list (`showOpenList`). |
| `Ctrl + \` | Same | Splits to the right (`splitRight`). |
| `Shift + F10, the Menu key` | Same | Opens the context menu of the focused tab. |

```tsx
// The desktop keys everywhere, and Ctrl+Q to close.
new TabDocumentManager({ keyPreset: 'desktop', keys: { closeTab: ['Ctrl+Q'] } });
```

## Accessibility

| Topic | Details |
| --- | --- |
| `Context menus` | The kit's `ContextMenu`: a `menu` opened by a right-click, Shift+F10 or the Menu key on a tab, and named after the document (or after the group, on the strip). Focus returns to the tab when it closes. |
| `The "…" list` | A single menu with a search field, the documents as a `menu` named “Open documents” (`menuitemradio` items with the displayed document checked, and each announcing its description, group and unsaved changes), and a `menu` of commands. Up and Down move from the search through the documents and commands, typing on a document returns to the search, Tab moves between parts, Enter opens, and Escape closes. |
| `The recently used list` | The same document menu, named “Recently used documents”, with focus on the highlighted document so that it is announced as it moves. It also works without holding a key: the arrow keys move, a letter jumps to a title, Enter opens, and Escape closes. |
| `Locked groups` | A locked group is named “Group 1, locked”, and its toolbar has an “Unlock group” button. |
| `Announcements` | Locked and unlocked are announced politely, like the other changes. |

## API

### Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `contextMenu` | `Bind<boolean>` | `true` | The context menus of tabs and of the empty strip. |
| `menuItems` | `Bind<Partial<Record<TabMenuCommand, boolean>>>` | `{}` | `false` hides a built-in item: `{ copyTitle: false }`. |
| `openList` | `Bind<boolean>` | `true` | The "…" button in each group's toolbar. |
| `openListScope, recentListScope` | `Bind<'group' \| 'all'>` | `'group'` | Whether the "…" list and the recently used list show the group's documents or those of every group. |
| `toolbarItems` | `(group) => ToolbarItem[]` |  | Application buttons in every group's toolbar, created once per group (text, `icon`, `hint`, `tone`, `visible`, `enabled`, `click` …). |
| `newDocument` | `(group) => TabDocument \| TabDocumentOptions \| null` |  | Creates a new document when the empty strip is double-clicked, and for the strip menu. |
| `historySize` | `Bind<number>` | `50` | The number of activated documents `goBack` remembers. 0 disables the history. |
| `closedHistorySize` | `Bind<number>` | `10` | The number of closed documents `reopenClosed` remembers. 0 disables it. Only documents whose content can be recreated (a `content` function, the `factory` or a copy) are kept. |
| `keyPreset` | `Bind<'auto' \| 'browser' \| 'desktop'>` | `'auto'` | The default keys (see Keyboard). `auto` uses the desktop keys when the page runs as an installed app. |
| `groupActions` | `Bind<boolean>` | `true` | The split, maximize and "…" buttons. |

### TabDocument

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `actions` | `Bind<readonly ToolbarItem[]>` | Buttons in the group's toolbar while this document is active, placed before the built-in buttons. |

### Methods and properties

| Member | Returns | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `showOpenList(group?)` | `boolean` | Opens a group's "…" list, to search and open documents, close all, close saved, and lock or unlock. |
| `showRecentList(by?)` | `boolean` | Opens the recently used list, with the next document (or the last, with `-1`) highlighted. |
| `goBack(), goForward()` | `boolean` | Activates the previous or next document in the history, in any group. `canGoBack` and `canGoForward` indicate whether one exists (reactive). |
| `reopenClosed()` | `TabDocument \| null` | Reopens the most recently closed document, in its original group and position. `closedDocuments` lists them (reactive). |
| `lock(group), unlock(group)` | `boolean` | Also available as `group.lock()` and `group.unlock()`. `group.locked` reads the state. |
| `openNew(group?)` | `TabDocument \| null` | Creates a document with `newDocument` and opens it. |
| `moveToGroup(doc, which)` | `boolean` | `'next'`, `'previous'`, or the group on a side (`'left'`, `'right'`, `'up'`, `'down'`). Splits if no group exists in that direction. |
| `copyTitle(doc)` | `Promise<boolean>` | Writes the title to the clipboard. |
| `recentDocuments` | read-only, reactive | The open documents of every group, most recently activated first. |

### Events

| Event | Contents |
| --- | --- |
| `onContextMenuOpening(e)` | `{ document, group, items, byKeyboard }`, cancelable. `document` is `null` for the empty strip. Change `items` (each built-in item has its command in `data`) or add your own. |
| `onLocking(e), onLocked(e), onUnlocking(e), onUnlocked(e)` | `{ group, byUser }`. The `…ing` events are cancelable. |

See the [overview](tabdocs.md#api) for the rest of the API, and [Tabs](tabdocs-tabs.md) for preview and pinned tabs, sizes and copies.

## Example files

`ContextMenus.tsx`

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Stack, Switch, TabDocumentManager } from '@motifx-community/ui';
import { FILES, fileDocument, source } from './files';

/**
 * Right-click a tab (or press Shift+F10 on it) for its menu, and the empty strip for the group's.
 * `onContextMenuOpening` adds an item for files, and a double-click on the empty strip creates a new file.
 */
export default function ContextMenus() {
  const s = reactive({ menus: true, copy: true, split: true, made: 0, said: '' });
  const docs = new TabDocumentManager({
    label: 'Files with menus',
    contextMenu: () => s.menus,
    menuItems: () => ({ copyTitle: s.copy, splitUp: s.split, splitDown: s.split, splitLeft: s.split, splitRight: s.split }),
    newDocument: () => {
      const n = ++s.made;
      return { id: `untitled-${n}`, title: `Untitled-${n}`, content: () => source('') };
    },
  });
  docs.element.style.cssText = 'block-size: 28rem; inline-size: 100%';
  docs.onContextMenuOpening((e) => {
    const doc = e.document;
    if (doc?.type !== 'file') return;
    e.items.push({ text: 'Show the path', beginGroup: true, click: () => (s.said = String(doc.id)) });
  });
  for (const file of FILES.slice(0, 4)) docs.open(fileDocument(file.path), { index: 99 });

  return (
    <>
      <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center" gap="lg">
        <Switch label="Context menus" x-model={() => s.menus} />
        <Switch label="Copy the title" x-model={() => s.copy} />
        <Switch label="Split items" x-model={() => s.split} />
        <output class="td-state">{() => (s.said ? `path: ${s.said}` : 'Right-click a tab, or the strip after the tabs')}</output>
      </Stack>
      {docs}
    </>
  );
}
```

`OpenList.tsx`

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { RadioGroup, Stack, TabDocumentManager, type TabListScope } from '@motifx-community/ui';
import { FILES, fileDocument } from './files';

const FormatIcon = () => (
  <svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" aria-hidden="true">
    <path d="M3 4h10M3 8h6M3 12h8" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.3" stroke-linecap="round" />
  </svg>
);

const RunIcon = () => (
  <svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" aria-hidden="true">
    <path d="M5 3.5v9l7-4.5z" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.3" stroke-linejoin="round" />
  </svg>
);

/**
 * The "…" button lists the group's documents to search and open, with close all, close saved and
 * lock under them. The app adds its own buttons: "Run" for every group, "Format" while a file of code is active.
 */
export default function OpenList() {
  const s = reactive({ scope: 'group' as TabListScope, runs: 0, formatted: '' });
  const docs = new TabDocumentManager({
    label: 'Open documents',
    openListScope: () => s.scope,
    toolbarItems: (group) => [{ icon: () => <RunIcon />, hint: () => `Run group ${group.index + 1}`, tone: 'accent', click: () => s.runs++ }],
  });
  docs.element.style.cssText = 'block-size: 28rem; inline-size: 100%';
  for (const file of FILES) {
    const code = file.path.endsWith('.ts');
    const doc = fileDocument(file.path, code ? { actions: [{ icon: () => <FormatIcon />, hint: 'Format', click: () => (s.formatted = file.path) }] } : {});
    docs.open(doc, { index: 99, group: file.path.startsWith('src/') ? docs.groups[0] : (docs.groups[1] ?? docs.split(docs.groups[0], 'right')!) });
  }
  docs.findDocument('src/app.ts')!.dirty = true;

  return (
    <>
      <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center" gap="lg">
        <RadioGroup
          label="The list shows"
          orientation="horizontal"
          items={[
            { value: 'group', text: "The group's documents" },
            { value: 'all', text: 'Every group' },
          ]}
          itemText="text"
          itemValue="value"
          x-model={() => s.scope}
        />
        <output class="td-state">{() => `runs: ${s.runs}${s.formatted ? `; formatted ${s.formatted}` : ''}`}</output>
      </Stack>
      {docs}
    </>
  );
}
```

`Recent.tsx`

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, RadioGroup, Stack, TabDocumentManager, type TabKeyPreset, type TabListScope } from '@motifx-community/ui';
import { FILES, fileDocument } from './files';

/**
 * Hold Ctrl and press E (Ctrl+Tab in an installed app) for the documents used last: E again walks
 * the list, Shift walks back, letting go of Ctrl opens one. Back and forward go over the documents
 * activated in every group; a closed document opens again where it was.
 */
export default function Recent() {
  const s = reactive({ scope: 'group' as TabListScope, preset: 'auto' as TabKeyPreset });
  const docs = new TabDocumentManager({ label: 'Recently used', recentListScope: () => s.scope, keyPreset: () => s.preset });
  docs.element.style.cssText = 'block-size: 28rem; inline-size: 100%';
  for (const file of FILES.slice(0, 5)) docs.open(fileDocument(file.path), { index: 99 });
  docs.split(docs.groups[0], 'right', docs.findDocument('README.md') ?? undefined);
  docs.open(fileDocument('package.json'), { group: docs.groups[1] });

  return (
    <>
      <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center" gap="lg">
        <RadioGroup
          label="Recent list"
          orientation="horizontal"
          items={[
            { value: 'group', text: 'This group' },
            { value: 'all', text: 'Every group' },
          ]}
          itemText="text"
          itemValue="value"
          x-model={() => s.scope}
        />
        <RadioGroup
          label="Keys"
          orientation="horizontal"
          items={[
            { value: 'auto', text: 'Auto' },
            { value: 'browser', text: 'Browser tab' },
            { value: 'desktop', text: 'Installed app' },
          ]}
          itemText="text"
          itemValue="value"
          x-model={() => s.preset}
        />
      </Stack>
      <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center">
        <Button text="Recent list" variant="outline" onclick={() => docs.showRecentList()} />
        <Button text="Back" variant="outline" enabled={() => docs.canGoBack} onclick={() => docs.goBack()} />
        <Button text="Forward" variant="outline" enabled={() => docs.canGoForward} onclick={() => docs.goForward()} />
        <Button text="Reopen closed" variant="outline" enabled={() => docs.closedDocuments.length > 0} onclick={() => docs.reopenClosed()} />
        <output class="td-state">{() => `keys: ${docs.keys.recentNext.join(' or ')}, ${docs.keys.goBack[0]}, ${docs.keys.reopenClosed[0]}`}</output>
      </Stack>
      {docs}
    </>
  );
}
```

`Locked.tsx`

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, Stack, TabDocumentManager } from '@motifx-community/ui';
import { notes } from './contents';

/** A locked group keeps what it has: documents opened without naming a group go elsewhere, into a new group when every one is locked. */
export default function Locked() {
  const s = reactive({ opened: 0, log: [] as { id: number; text: string }[] });
  const docs = new TabDocumentManager({ label: 'Notes and a terminal' });
  docs.element.style.cssText = 'block-size: 28rem; inline-size: 100%';
  const write = (text: string) => s.log.unshift({ id: s.log.length, text });
  docs.onLocked((e) => write(`group ${e.group.index + 1} locked`));
  docs.onUnlocked((e) => write(`group ${e.group.index + 1} unlocked`));
  docs.onOpened((e) => write(`${e.document.title} opened in group ${e.group.index + 1}`));
  docs.open({ id: 'terminal', title: 'Terminal', content: () => notes('Terminal') });
  docs.lock(docs.groups[0]);
  docs.split(docs.groups[0], 'right');

  const open = () => {
    const n = ++s.opened;
    docs.open({ id: `note-${n}`, title: `Note ${n}`, content: () => notes(`Note ${n}`) });
  };
  const toggle = (index: number) => {
    const group = docs.groups[index];
    if (group) (group.locked ? docs.unlock(group) : docs.lock(group));
  };

  return (
    <>
      <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center">
        <Button text="Open a note" variant="outline" onclick={open} />
        <Button text={() => (docs.groups[0]?.locked ? 'Unlock group 1' : 'Lock group 1')} variant="outline" onclick={() => toggle(0)} />
        <Button text={() => (docs.groups[1]?.locked ? 'Unlock group 2' : 'Lock group 2')} variant="outline" enabled={() => docs.groups.length > 1} onclick={() => toggle(1)} />
        <output class="td-state">{() => s.log.slice(0, 3).map((l) => l.text).join('; ')}</output>
      </Stack>
      {docs}
    </>
  );
}
```

`contents.tsx`

```tsx
import type { ComponentBase } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, confirm, DataGrid, FormLayout, type FormItem, type GridColumn } from '@motifx-community/ui';
import { makeOrders, type Order } from './orders';

const columns: GridColumn<Order>[] = [
  { field: 'id', title: 'No', type: 'number', width: 70 },
  { field: 'customer', title: 'Customer', width: 160 },
  { field: 'city', title: 'City', width: 110 },
  { field: 'amount', title: 'Amount', type: 'number', width: 100 },
];

/** A grid of orders that fills its tab. */
export function ordersGrid(count = 60): ComponentBase {
  return <DataGrid rows={makeOrders(count)} rowKey="id" columns={columns} label="Orders" style="block-size: 100%" />;
}

/** The fields a customer is edited with. */
export interface Customer {
  name: string;
  email: string;
  city: string;
}

/** The forms open over each customer: a copy of a document has a form of its own over the same object. */
const formsOf = new WeakMap<Customer, Set<FormLayout<Customer>>>();

/**
 * A form over a customer: what is typed goes straight into it. The form reads the object as it is, so the other forms
 * over the same customer are told to read the field again.
 */
export function customerForm(customer: Customer): ComponentBase {
  const items: FormItem[] = [
    { field: 'name', label: 'Name', required: true },
    { field: 'email', label: 'Email', editor: 'email' },
    { field: 'city', label: 'City' },
  ];
  const forms = formsOf.get(customer) ?? new Set<FormLayout<Customer>>();
  formsOf.set(customer, forms);
  return (
    <div style="padding: var(--mx-space-4); max-inline-size: 32rem">
      <FormLayout<Customer>
        data={customer}
        items={items}
        ref={(form: FormLayout<Customer>) => {
          forms.add(form);
          form.motif.setDisposable(() => forms.delete(form));
        }}
        onFieldChanged={(e) => {
          for (const other of forms) if (other.data === e.data && !other.isDisposed) other.refreshField(e.field);
        }}
      />
    </div>
  );
}

/** A few paragraphs of plain text. */
export function notes(title: string): ComponentBase {
  return (
    <div style="padding: var(--mx-space-4); max-inline-size: 40rem">
      <h3 style="margin-block-start: 0">{title}</h3>
      <p>Any component can be a document: a form, a grid, a chart or plain text like this.</p>
      <p>Drag the line between two groups, or focus it with Tab and use the arrow keys. A double click on it gives the groups the same size.</p>
    </div>
  );
}

const CITIES = ['İstanbul', 'Ankara', 'İzmir', 'London', 'New York'];

/** A customer card: text fields and a city drop-down over a reactive customer, and a button that opens a dialog. */
export function customerCard(customer: Customer): ComponentBase {
  const items: FormItem[] = [
    { field: 'name', label: 'Name', required: true },
    { field: 'email', label: 'Email', editor: 'email' },
    { field: 'city', label: 'City', editor: 'dropdown', editorProps: { items: CITIES } },
  ];
  let card: ComponentBase | null = null;
  // The dialog opens where the card is: in a new window, there.
  const clear = async () => {
    if (await confirm('Clear the customer card?', { title: 'Clear', host: card! })) Object.assign(customer, { name: '', email: '', city: '' });
  };
  return (
    <div ref={(c: ComponentBase) => (card = c)} style="padding: var(--mx-space-4); max-inline-size: 32rem">
      <FormLayout data={customer} items={items} />
      <Button text="Clear…" variant="outline" onclick={clear} />
    </div>
  );
}
```


---

# TabDocumentManager: Drag and drop

> TabDocumentManager · @motifx-community/ui 0.1.0-beta.5

Drag tabs and whole groups as you would in a code editor: along a strip, to another group, beside a group, along an edge of the layout, or between two managers. The same moves are available from the keyboard, and every drop goes through the methods and events of the action it performs.

## Dragging tabs and groups

A copy of the tab follows the pointer. A marker shows the position among tabs, and a translucent area shows which half of a group (or all of it) a drop would take. Pausing on a tab of another group activates it, and the strip scrolls near its ends. The content is moved, never recreated.

```tsx
import type { ComponentBase } from '@motifx/core';
import { TabDocument, type TabDocumentOptions } from '@motifx-community/ui';

/** A page with a folded corner: a file. */
export const FileIcon = () => (
  <svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" aria-hidden="true">
    <path d="M4 1.75h5l3 3v9.5H4zM9 1.75v3h3" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.3" stroke-linejoin="round" />
  </svg>
);

/** A few files of a sample project. */
export const FILES = [
  { path: 'src/index.ts', text: "export { App } from './app';\nexport { router } from './router';" },
  { path: 'src/app.ts', text: "import { Application } from '@motifx/core';\n\nexport const App = Application.CreateBuilder().build();" },
  { path: 'src/router.ts', text: "export const router = { mode: 'history', routes: [] };" },
  { path: 'src/orders/index.ts', text: "export * from './orders';" },
  { path: 'src/orders/orders.ts', text: 'export interface Order {\n  id: number;\n  amount: number;\n}' },
  { path: 'README.md', text: '# Shop\n\nA small shop written with MotifJS.' },
  { path: 'package.json', text: '{\n  "name": "shop",\n  "private": true\n}' },
  { path: 'vite.config.ts', text: "import { defineConfig } from 'vite';\n\nexport default defineConfig({});" },
];

/** A file's text, as a document's content. */
export function source(text: string): ComponentBase {
  // The panel scrolls (and takes focus for it): the text itself does not.
  return <pre style="margin: 0; padding: var(--mx-space-4); overflow: visible; font: var(--mx-font-size-body) / var(--mx-font-line-body) var(--mx-font-family-mono)">{text}</pre>;
}

/** A document for a file: its name as the title, its folder as the description. */
export function fileDocument(path: string, extra: TabDocumentOptions = {}): TabDocument {
  const file = FILES.find((f) => f.path === path);
  const at = path.lastIndexOf('/');
  return new TabDocument({
    id: path,
    type: 'file',
    title: path.slice(at + 1),
    description: at > 0 ? path.slice(0, at) : '',
    icon: () => <FileIcon />,
    content: () => source(file?.text ?? ''),
    ...extra,
  });
}
```

| Drop target | Result |
| --- | --- |
| `Along the strip` | Reorders the tab. A tab dropped among the pinned tabs becomes pinned, and a tab dropped among the others becomes unpinned (`pinOnDrag`). |
| `On another strip` | Moves the tab to the position under the pointer, or to the end when dropped on the empty part of a strip. |
| `The middle of a group` | Moves the tab into that group, after its active tab (`openPosition`). |
| `An edge of a group` | Splits that group and places the tab in a new group on that side. The edge zones are `dropEdgeSize` deep. |
| `An edge of the layout` | A thin band along the sides of the manager (`layoutEdgeSize`). Creates a new group along that whole side (`layoutEdgeDrop`). |
| `Ctrl held (Option on a Mac)` | Opens a copy there instead, if the document can be open twice (`allowDuplicate`, `copyModifier`). |
| `A group, by the empty part of its bar or its handle` | Moves the group with all its tabs beside another group or along an edge of the layout. When dropped into another group or its strip, its tabs join that group. |
| `Outside the manager` | Floats in its own window (see [Dock and floating windows](tabdocs-dock.md)). Where floating is not allowed (`allowFloat`), or over a manager outside its `dragGroup`, the drop is refused (`target: 'outside'`). |

## Settings

Every part of drag and drop is a setting that can change at runtime. A document's own `allowDrag`, and a group's own `allowDrop` and `dropSides`, take precedence over the manager's.

```tsx
import type { ComponentBase } from '@motifx/core';

/** A page with a folded corner: a file. */

    <path d="M4 1.75h5l3 3v9.5H4zM9 1.75v3h3" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.3" stroke-linejoin="round" />
  </svg>
);

/** A few files of a sample project. */

  { path: 'src/router.ts', text: "export const router = { mode: 'history', routes: [] };" },
```

## Between two managers

Managers that share a `dragGroup` accept each other's tabs and groups. The tab, its panel and its content all move, and the other manager raises its own `onOpening` after `onMoving` in the first.

```tsx
import type { ComponentBase } from '@motifx/core';
import { TabDocument, type TabDocumentOptions } from '@motifx-community/ui';

/** A page with a folded corner: a file. */
export const FileIcon = () => (

    <path d="M4 1.75h5l3 3v9.5H4zM9 1.75v3h3" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.3" stroke-linejoin="round" />
  </svg>
);

/** A few files of a sample project. */
export const FILES = [
  { path: 'src/index.ts', text: "export { App } from './app';\nexport { router } from './router';" },
  { path: 'src/app.ts', text: "import { Application } from '@motifx/core';\n\nexport const App = Application.CreateBuilder().build();" },
  { path: 'src/router.ts', text: "export const router = { mode: 'history', routes: [] };" },
  { path: 'src/orders/index.ts', text: "export * from './orders';" },
  { path: 'src/orders/orders.ts', text: 'export interface Order {\n  id: number;\n  amount: number;\n}' },

];

  // The panel scrolls (and takes focus for it): the text itself does not.

}

/** A document for a file: its name as the title, its folder as the description. */

  const file = FILES.find((f) => f.path === path);
  const at = path.lastIndexOf('/');

```

## From the keyboard

Keys move the active tab along its strip or to another group. “Move to…” (in the tab menu, the strip menu for a whole group, Ctrl+K M or `showMoveTo`) reaches every position a drag can reach, shows the same areas and announces each position.

```tsx
import type { ComponentBase } from '@motifx/core';
import { TabDocument, type TabDocumentOptions } from '@motifx-community/ui';

/** A page with a folded corner: a file. */
export const FileIcon = () => (
  <svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" aria-hidden="true">
    <path d="M4 1.75h5l3 3v9.5H4zM9 1.75v3h3" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.3" stroke-linejoin="round" />
  </svg>
);

/** A few files of a sample project. */
export const FILES = [
  { path: 'src/index.ts', text: "export { App } from './app';\nexport { router } from './router';" },
  { path: 'src/app.ts', text: "import { Application } from '@motifx/core';\n\nexport const App = Application.CreateBuilder().build();" },
  { path: 'src/router.ts', text: "export const router = { mode: 'history', routes: [] };" },
  { path: 'src/orders/index.ts', text: "export * from './orders';" },
  { path: 'src/orders/orders.ts', text: 'export interface Order {\n  id: number;\n  amount: number;\n}' },
  { path: 'README.md', text: '# Shop\n\nA small shop written with MotifJS.' },
  { path: 'package.json', text: '{\n  "name": "shop",\n  "private": true\n}' },
  { path: 'vite.config.ts', text: "import { defineConfig } from 'vite';\n\nexport default defineConfig({});" },
];

/** A file's text, as a document's content. */
export function source(text: string): ComponentBase {
  // The panel scrolls (and takes focus for it): the text itself does not.
  return <pre style="margin: 0; padding: var(--mx-space-4); overflow: visible; font: var(--mx-font-size-body) / var(--mx-font-line-body) var(--mx-font-family-mono)">{text}</pre>;
}

/** A document for a file: its name as the title, its folder as the description. */
export function fileDocument(path: string, extra: TabDocumentOptions = {}): TabDocument {
  const file = FILES.find((f) => f.path === path);
  const at = path.lastIndexOf('/');
  return new TabDocument({
    id: path,
    type: 'file',
    title: path.slice(at + 1),
    description: at > 0 ? path.slice(0, at) : '',
    icon: () => <FileIcon />,
    content: () => source(file?.text ?? ''),
    ...extra,
  });
}
```

| Browser | Installed app (desktop keys) | Action |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Alt + Shift + Page Up / Page Down` | Ctrl + Shift + Page Up / Page Down | Moves the active tab one position along its strip (`moveTabLeft`, `moveTabRight`). |
| `Ctrl + Alt + Right / Left` | Same | Moves the active document to the next or previous group (`moveToNextGroup`, `moveToPreviousGroup`). |
| `Ctrl + K, then Shift + an arrow` | Same | Moves to the group on that side, or to a new group there (`moveToGroupLeft`, `…Right`, `…Up`, `…Down`). |
| `Ctrl + K, then M` | Same | Opens "Move to…" for the active document (`moveTo`). It is also in the tab menu and the strip menu. |

### In “Move to…”

| Key | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `Arrows` | Chooses a side of the group. Pressing the same direction again moves to the next group in that direction or to the edge of the layout, and the opposite direction returns to the middle (`targetLeft`, `targetRight`, `targetUp`, `targetDown`). |
| `Tab, Shift + Tab` | Moves to the middle of the next or previous group (`targetNextGroup`, `targetPreviousGroup`). |
| `Enter` | Moves it there (`targetDrop`). |
| `Escape` | Cancels and leaves everything in place (`targetCancel`). Clicking anywhere does the same. |

## Changing or refusing a drop

`onDragOver` sees each position and can change or refuse it, and `onDropping` can still stop the drop. The events of the action then occur (`onMoved`, `onSplit` …), followed by `onDropped`.

```tsx
docs.onDragOver((e) => {
  // Reports stay in their own group: no drop anywhere else.
  if (e.document?.type === 'report' && e.group !== e.from) e.cancel = true;
});
docs.onDropping((e) => {
  // A drop on the right edge of a group opens the new group below it instead.
  if (e.target === 'group' && e.side === 'right') e.side = 'down';
});
```

## Accessibility

| Topic | Details |
| --- | --- |
| `Every drag has keys` | "Move to…" reaches every position a pointer can: each side of each group, the edges of the layout, and other managers in the same `dragGroup`. |
| `Announcements` | Each position "Move to…" highlights is announced ("New group to the right of group 2", or "cannot go here"), followed by the result: moved, copied, split or canceled. |
| `Touch and pen` | A long press starts the drag, so a swipe still scrolls the strip. Holding still and releasing opens the tab menu. |
| `Escape` | Also cancels a pointer drag, and restores anything activated by pausing on tabs and any strip scrolling. |

## API

### Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `allowDrag` | `Bind<boolean>` | `true` | Allows tabs to be dragged. A document's own `allowDrag` takes precedence. |
| `allowDragGroups` | `Bind<boolean>` | `true` | Allows groups to be dragged by the empty part of their bar. |
| `groupDragHandle` | `Bind<boolean>` | `false` | Adds a handle at the start of each group's toolbar for dragging the group, even when its tabs fill the bar. Clicking it, or pressing Enter, starts “Move group to…”. |
| `dropSides` | `Bind<readonly ('center' \| 'left' \| 'right' \| 'up' \| 'down')[]>` | all five | The positions a drop on a group's content can take. A group's own `dropSides` takes precedence. |
| `dropEdgeSize` | `Bind<number \| string>` | `'33%'` | The depth of the edge zones of a group's content, in pixels or as a share. |
| `layoutEdgeDrop, layoutEdgeSize` | `Bind<boolean>`, `Bind<number>` | `true`, `16` | Allows drops along the edges of the whole layout, and sets the depth of that band in pixels. |
| `dragThreshold` | `Bind<number>` | `5` | The distance in pixels the pointer must move before a press becomes a drag. |
| `longPressDelay` | `Bind<number>` | `500` | How long, in milliseconds, a finger or pen must rest on a tab before dragging it. A swipe before that scrolls the strip. |
| `dragHoverActivate, dragHoverDelay` | `Bind<boolean>`, `Bind<number>` | `true`, `750` | Pausing on a tab of another group while dragging activates it after this many milliseconds. |
| `pinOnDrag` | `Bind<boolean>` | `true` | Dragging across the boundary between pinned and other tabs pins or unpins them. `false` keeps each tab on its side. |
| `copyModifier` | `Bind<'auto' \| 'ctrl' \| 'alt' \| 'shift' \| 'meta' \| 'none'>` | `'auto'` | The key that makes a drop a copy: Ctrl, or Option on Apple platforms. |
| `dragGroup` | `Bind<string \| null>` | `null` | Managers with the same name accept each other's tabs and groups. |
| `dragGhost, dragAutoScroll` | `Bind<boolean>` | `true` | The copy of the tab under the pointer, and the strip scrolling near its ends. |

### TabGroup

| Property | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `allowDrop` | `Bind<boolean>` | `true` | Allows drops into and beside the group. Use `false` for a group that accepts nothing. Saved with the layout. |
| `dropSides` | `Bind<readonly TabDropSide[] \| null>` | `null` | The group's own drop sides. `null` uses the manager's setting. Saved with the layout. |

### TabDocument

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `allowDrag` | `Bind<boolean \| undefined>` | Overrides the manager's setting for this document. `undefined` inherits the manager's value. |

### Methods

| Method | Returns | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `move(doc, group, index?)` | `boolean` | What a drop on a strip or into a group performs. |
| `split(group \| null, direction, doc?)` | `TabGroup \| null` | What a drop on an edge performs. `null` splits the whole layout along that edge. |
| `moveGroup(group, target \| null, side)` | `boolean` | Moves a whole group beside `target` (`'left'`, `'right'`, `'up'`, `'down'`), into it (`'center'`), or along an edge of the layout (`target` is `null`). |
| `moveInGroup(doc, by)` | `boolean` | Moves one position along the strip (`-1` toward the start), without passing the boundary between pinned and other tabs. |
| `moveToGroup(doc, which)` | `boolean` | `'next'`, `'previous'`, or the group on that side (`'left'`, `'right'`, `'up'`, `'down'`). Creates a new group if there is none. |
| `showMoveTo(doc \| group)` | `boolean` | Starts "Move to…" from the keyboard (see below). |
| `cancelDrag()` | `boolean` | Stops a drag or "Move to…" and restores everything. |
| `addDropTarget(target, index?)` | `() => void` | A custom target, checked before the built-in one: `placeAt(x, y, drag)`, `marks(place, drag)`, `drop(place, drag)`. Returns a function that removes it. |
| `dragging` | read-only, reactive | `{ document, group, manager, copy }` during a drag, otherwise `null`. |
| `dropTargets` | read-only | The targets in the order they are checked. |

### Events

| Event | Contents |
| --- | --- |
| `onDragStarting(e)` | `{ document, group, pointerType, byKeyboard }`, cancelable. `document` is `null` for a group. |
| `onDragOver(e)` | `{ document, from, target, manager, group, index, side, copy, byKeyboard }`. Change the position, or set `cancel` to refuse it. `target` is `'strip'`, `'group'`, `'edge'`, `'float'`, `'dock-guide'`, `'dock-area'` or `'outside'` (refused). |
| `onDropping(e)` | The same, raised just before the drop. Canceling leaves everything in place. |
| `onDropped(e)` | The result: `group` is the new group of a split, and `document` is the copy when one was opened. |
| `onDragEnded(e)` | `{ document, from, dropped, byKeyboard }`, raised whether or not it was dropped. |
| `onMoving / onMoved, onSplitting / onSplit, onOpening / onOpened, onPinning…` | Still occur for the action the drop performs, so the model changes in only one way. A tab from another manager arrives through `onOpening` there, after `onMoving` here. |

### Styling hooks

| Selector or token | Item |
| --- | --- |
| `.mx-tabdocs[data-dragging]` | During a drag: `move`, `copy` or `none`, which is what a drop would do now. The cursor follows it. |
| `.mx-tabdocs__tab[data-dragging], .mx-tabdocs__group[data-dragging]` | The tab or group being dragged. |
| `.mx-tabdocs__ghost` | The copy under the pointer, with `data-kind` (`tab`, `group`) and `data-target` (`move`, `copy`, `none`). |
| `.mx-tabdocs__drop` | The translucent area a drop would take. It glides between positions, using the motion tokens (no motion with reduced motion). |
| `.mx-tabdocs__insert` | The marker between two tabs. |
| `.mx-tabdocs__grip` | The group's handle (`groupDragHandle`), a button in the group's toolbar. |
| `tabdocs.drop, drop-fill, insert, ghost` | Their units (the drag image: `copy`, `refused`; a dragged tab: the `dragging` state of the `tab` unit). |

See the [overview](tabdocs.md#api), [Tabs](tabdocs-tabs.md) and [Menus and keys](tabdocs-menus.md) for the rest of the API.

## Example files

`DragDrop.tsx`

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { TabDocumentManager, type TabDroppedEventArgs } from '@motifx-community/ui';
import { FILES, fileDocument } from './files';

/** What a drop did, in a few words. */
function describe(e: TabDroppedEventArgs): string {
  const what = e.document?.title ?? 'a group';
  const where = e.target === 'strip' ? `place ${e.index + 1} of a strip` : e.target === 'edge' ? `the ${e.side} edge` : e.side === 'center' ? 'a group' : `the ${e.side} of a group`;
  return `${what} ${e.copy ? 'copied' : 'moved'} to ${where}`;
}

/**
 * Drag a tab along its strip, onto another strip, into a group (the middle of its content) or
 * beside it (an edge), or along an edge of the whole layout. Drag a group by the empty part of its
 * bar or by its handle. Hold Ctrl (Option on a Mac) while dropping for a copy; Escape puts everything back.
 */
export default function DragDrop() {
  const s = reactive({ last: 'Drag a tab, or a group by its handle.' });
  // Narrow groups, for the narrow column of this page; a handle drags a group whose tabs fill its bar.
  const docs = new TabDocumentManager({ label: 'Files to drag', allowDuplicate: true, minGroupWidth: 100, groupDragHandle: true });
  docs.element.style.cssText = 'block-size: 28rem; inline-size: 100%';
  for (const file of FILES.slice(0, 4)) docs.open(fileDocument(file.path), { index: 99 });
  const right = docs.split(docs.activeGroup!, 'right')!;
  for (const file of FILES.slice(4, 6)) right.open(fileDocument(file.path), { index: 99 });
  const below = docs.split(right, 'down')!;
  for (const file of FILES.slice(6)) below.open(fileDocument(file.path), { index: 99 });
  docs.onDropped((e) => (s.last = describe(e)));
  docs.onDragEnded((e) => {
    if (!e.dropped) s.last = 'Nothing moved.';
  });

  return (
    <>
      {docs}
      <output class="td-state">{() => s.last}</output>
    </>
  );
}
```

`DragOptions.tsx`

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { RadioGroup, Stack, Switch, TabDocumentManager, type TabDropSide } from '@motifx-community/ui';
import { FILES, fileDocument } from './files';

const SIDES: Record<string, readonly TabDropSide[]> = {
  all: ['center', 'left', 'right', 'up', 'down'],
  sides: ['left', 'right'],
  center: ['center'],
};

/** Every part of drag and drop is a setting, live; a group can take no drops at all. */
export default function DragOptions() {
  const s = reactive({ allowDrag: true, allowDragGroups: true, pinOnDrag: true, layoutEdgeDrop: true, hover: true, ghost: true, sides: 'all', closed: false });
  const docs = new TabDocumentManager({
    label: 'Files with drag settings',
    allowDrag: () => s.allowDrag,
    allowDragGroups: () => s.allowDragGroups,
    pinOnDrag: () => s.pinOnDrag,
    layoutEdgeDrop: () => s.layoutEdgeDrop,
    dragHoverActivate: () => s.hover,
    dragGhost: () => s.ghost,
    dropSides: () => SIDES[s.sides],
  });
  docs.element.style.cssText = 'block-size: 28rem; inline-size: 100%';
  FILES.slice(0, 5).forEach((file, i) => docs.open(fileDocument(file.path), { index: 99, pinned: i < 2 }));
  const second = docs.split(docs.activeGroup!, 'right')!;
  for (const file of FILES.slice(5)) second.open(fileDocument(file.path), { index: 99 });
  second.allowDrop = () => !s.closed;

  return (
    <>
      <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center" gap="lg">
        <Switch label="Drag tabs" x-model={() => s.allowDrag} />
        <Switch label="Drag groups" x-model={() => s.allowDragGroups} />
        <Switch label="Pin across the border" x-model={() => s.pinOnDrag} />
        <Switch label="Layout edges" x-model={() => s.layoutEdgeDrop} />
        <Switch label="Activate on hover" x-model={() => s.hover} />
        <Switch label="Copy under the pointer" x-model={() => s.ghost} />
        <Switch label="Group 2 takes nothing" x-model={() => s.closed} />
      </Stack>
      <RadioGroup
        label="Drops on a group"
        orientation="horizontal"
        items={[
          { value: 'all', text: 'Centre and edges' },
          { value: 'sides', text: 'Left and right only' },
          { value: 'center', text: 'Centre only' },
        ]}
        itemText="text"
        itemValue="value"
        x-model={() => s.sides}
      />
      {docs}
    </>
  );
}
```

`BetweenManagers.tsx`

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { TabDocumentManager } from '@motifx-community/ui';
import { FILES, fileDocument } from './files';

/**
 * Two managers with the same `dragGroup` take each other's tabs and groups. The content moves with
 * its tab, it is not recreated, so an edit in a moved tab is preserved.
 */
export default function BetweenManagers() {
  const s = reactive({ last: 'Drag a tab from one manager to the other.' });
  const style = 'block-size: 28rem; flex: 1 1 0px; min-inline-size: 0';
  // Narrow side by side, they still show as on a desktop (see the Tablet and phone page).
  const left = new TabDocumentManager({ label: 'Project files', dragGroup: 'files', presentation: 'desktop' });
  const right = new TabDocumentManager({ label: 'Pinned files', dragGroup: 'files', presentation: 'desktop' });
  left.element.style.cssText = style;
  right.element.style.cssText = style;
  for (const file of FILES.slice(0, 5)) left.open(fileDocument(file.path), { index: 99 });
  for (const file of FILES.slice(5)) right.open(fileDocument(file.path), { index: 99 });
  for (const docs of [left, right]) {
    docs.onOpened((e) => {
      if (e.byUser) s.last = `${e.document.title} came into ${docs.label}`;
    });
  }

  return (
    <>
      <div style="display: flex; gap: var(--mx-space-3); inline-size: 100%">
        {left}
        {right}
      </div>
      <output class="td-state">{() => s.last}</output>
    </>
  );
}
```

`MoveWithKeys.tsx`

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, Stack, TabDocumentManager } from '@motifx-community/ui';
import { FILES, fileDocument } from './files';

/**
 * "Move to…" (the tab's menu, Ctrl+K M, or these buttons): the arrow keys choose a side of a group,
 * an arrow towards it again goes on to the next group, Tab picks the next group, Enter moves,
 * Escape leaves it. The same areas as a drag show where it goes.
 */
export default function MoveWithKeys() {
  const s = reactive({ place: 'Press a button, or Ctrl+K M on a tab.' });
  const docs = new TabDocumentManager({ label: 'Files to move with keys' });
  docs.element.style.cssText = 'block-size: 28rem; inline-size: 100%';
  for (const file of FILES.slice(0, 4)) docs.open(fileDocument(file.path), { index: 99 });
  const right = docs.split(docs.activeGroup!, 'right')!;
  for (const file of FILES.slice(4)) right.open(fileDocument(file.path), { index: 99 });
  docs.onDragOver((e) => {
    if (e.byKeyboard) s.place = e.target === 'edge' ? `the ${e.side} edge of the layout` : `group ${(e.group?.index ?? 0) + 1}, ${e.side}`;
  });
  docs.onDragEnded((e) => (s.place = e.dropped ? 'Moved.' : 'Left where it was.'));

  return (
    <>
      <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center">
        <Button text="Move to…" variant="outline" enabled={() => !!docs.activeDocument} onclick={() => docs.showMoveTo(docs.activeDocument!)} />
        <Button text="Move group to…" variant="outline" enabled={() => docs.groups.length > 1} onclick={() => docs.showMoveTo(docs.activeGroup!)} />
        <output class="td-state">{() => s.place}</output>
      </Stack>
      {docs}
    </>
  );
}
```
