`SeriesQuestion.tsx`

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { data } from '@motifx-community/data';
import { RadioGroup, Scheduler, type SeriesEditMode } from '@motifx-community/ui';
import { SlowAdapter } from '../../../shared/slow-adapter';
import { recurringAppointments, type Booking } from './recurring-appointments';

/**
 * The series come from a data source, as from a server. Drag an occurrence, change it in its form or
 * delete it: the scheduler asks what the change reaches, unless the setting answers, and writes
 * it through the adapter (an occurrence changed apart is a row of its own).
 */
export default function SeriesQuestion() {
  const s = reactive({ mode: 'ask' as SeriesEditMode, log: [] as string[] });
  let next = 100;
  const adapter = new SlowAdapter<Booking, number>({ data: recurringAppointments(), key: 'id', createKey: () => next++ }, 200);
  const source = new data.DataSource<Booking, number>({ adapter, loadMode: 'all' });
  const say = (text: string) => {
    s.log.unshift(text);
    if (s.log.length > 6) s.log.pop();
  };
  return (
    <div class="sched-demo" onDisposing={() => source.dispose()}>
      <RadioGroup
        label="A change to an occurrence reaches"
        orientation="horizontal"
        items={[
          { value: 'ask', text: 'Ask' },
          { value: 'occurrence', text: 'This one' },
          { value: 'following', text: 'This and following' },
          { value: 'series', text: 'The whole series' },
        ]}
        x-model={() => s.mode}
      />
      <Scheduler<Booking>
        dataSource={source}
        startDayHour={8}
        endDayHour={18}
        seriesEdit={() => s.mode}
        onSeriesAnswered={(e) => say(`Asked about ${e.appointment.text} (${e.action}): ${e.scope ?? 'cancelled'}`)}
        onAppointmentUpdated={(e) => say(`Saved ${e.appointment.text}${e.scope ? `, ${e.scope}` : ''}`)}
        onAppointmentDeleted={(e) => say(`Deleted ${e.appointment.text}${e.scope ? `, ${e.scope}` : ''}`)}
        onDataError={(e) => say(`Not saved: ${String(e.error)}${e.undone ? '' : ' (part of it was)'}`)}
      />
      <ol class="sched-events" aria-label="What happened">
        {s.log.map((line, i) => (
          <li key={`${i}-${line}`}>{line}</li>
        ))}
      </ol>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
  }
```

# Scheduler: Resources and groups

> Scheduler · @motifx-community/ui 0.1.0-beta.5

Resources such as rooms, people and equipment can color appointments, divide columns into groups (nested or under each date), and define when each resource is available and when time is blocked.

## Resources

`resources` lists the resource types. An appointment holds an item's value in the type's `field`, or a list with `allowMultiple` (one meeting with two people). The type marked `useColorAsDefault` colors the appointments, otherwise the first type with an item color does, and an appointment's own `color` takes precedence. The tooltip lists the items, and the form has a picker for each type.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';

export interface Booking {
  id: number;
  text: string;
  startDate: Date;
```

## Groups

`groups` divides the columns by each item of the first type, then each item of the next under it (`parentExpr` keeps a person under their own room). The day, week, work week and month views show a header per level. `groupByDate` reverses this, showing each day with the groups under it. Dragging to another group, or pressing Alt + Shift + arrow, changes the resource. In a list, only the value for that group changes.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';

  id: number;
  text: string;
  startDate: Date;
  endDate: Date;
  allDay?: boolean;

  ownerIds?: number[];
  color?: string;
  description?: string;
}

  id: number;
  text: string;
  color: string;

  workEndHour?: number;
}

  roomId: number;
  workDays?: number[];
}
```

## Custom group headers

`resourceHeaderTemplate` customizes a group header. It can return any MotifJS component, and it is created for each header with the item, its name, color and level, and the date when grouping by date.

## Availability

An item's own work hours and days (`workStartHour`, `workEndHour`, `workDays`) shade its columns. `blockedTimes` blocks a time, once or with a rule, for every resource or for specific ones. `allowOffHours: false` keeps what the user moves or saves within work hours, and `allowOverlap: false` prevents overlap with another appointment in the group. A function there makes the whole decision. A box being moved shows where it cannot go, and the form explains why it cannot save.

## From a data source

A type's `items` can be a data source, which is loaded once and then tracked for changes such as a filter or an added room. Appointments from a data source group the same way. With `remoteFiltering`, when grouping by a single-value field, the visible resources are also requested from the source (`rangeFilter` with `resources`).

```tsx
import { data } from '@motifx-community/data';

/** Rows in memory that answer a little later, the way a server does; for the examples. */
export class SlowAdapter<T extends object, K> extends data.ArrayAdapter<T, K> {
  constructor(
    options: data.ArrayAdapterOptions<T>,
    private readonly delayMs = 300,
  ) {
    super(options);
  }

  override async load(options: data.LoadOptions = {}): Promise<data.LoadResult<T>> {
    await new Promise((done) => setTimeout(done, this.delayMs));
    return super.load(options);
  }
}
```

```tsx
// The same filter for a request of your own:
source.setFilter(rangeFilter(scheduler.visibleRange, scheduler.fields, { resources: { roomId: [1, 2] } }));
```

## Keyboard

| Key | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `Alt + Shift + Left / Right (on an appointment)` | Moves it to the previous or next group. Enter saves, and Escape reverts. These keys are mirrored on right-to-left pages. |
| `Arrows on the cells` | Above every column, showing the days of each group, or the groups of each day when grouping by date. |

## Accessibility

| Topic | Details |
| --- | --- |
| `Cells` | A cell announces its group before its time ("Atlas, Ana Silva, Monday 26 October, 09:00") and any blocked time after it ("not available: Lunch"). |
| `Heads` | Group headers are decorative (`aria-hidden`), because every cell names its group. |
| `Moving` | Moving with the keyboard announces the destination, its group and whether it is free. |

## Styling

| Hook | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `scheduler.group-header (`inner`, `month`), group-swatch` | Units: a group header at each level, and the item color before the name. |
| `scheduler.group-divider (`inner`, `head`)` | Unit: the line between groups (or between days when grouping by date), across the headers and cells. |
| `scheduler.cell `blocked`, scheduler.unavailable` | A cell in a blocked time, and a hatched layer over it. |
| `scheduler.drop-mark` | Unit: the indicator on a box where it cannot go (with the `invalid` state of the `appointment` unit). |
| `scheduler.resource-swatch (`tooltip`), tooltip-resource-label, tooltip-resource-item` | Units: an item color in the form pickers and tooltip, and the tooltip resource lines. |
| `.mx-scheduler__group-head` | `data-level`, `data-edge`. Cells have `data-edge` and `data-blocked`. |

## API reference

### Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `resources` | `Bind<SchedulerResource[]>` | `[]` | The resource types the appointments use. Each one can color them, group the columns and add a picker to the form. |
| `groups` | `Bind<string[]>` | `[]` | The resource fields the columns are grouped by, outer first (`['roomId', 'ownerIds']`). A view's own `groups` takes precedence, and `[]` there means none. |
| `groupByDate` | `Bind<boolean>` | `false` | Places the groups under each date, instead of the dates under each group. A view's own value takes precedence. |
| `resourceHeaderTemplate` | `Bind<((context: ResourceHeaderContext) => ComponentBase) \\| null>` | `null` | Customizes a group header in place of its name. |
| `blockedTimes` | `Bind<SchedulerBlockedTime[]>` | `[]` | Times when nothing can be scheduled: `{ start, end, text?, allDay?, recurrenceRule?, resources? }`. They are shaded on the visible days, and with `resources` only for those resources. |
| `allowOverlap` | `Bind<boolean \\| ((check: SchedulerTimeCheck) => boolean)>` | `true` | Whether what the user moves, resizes or saves can overlap another appointment in its group, or any appointment without groups. A function makes the whole decision and returns `true` when the time is free. |
| `allowOffHours` | `Bind<boolean>` | `true` | Whether the user can place an appointment outside the work hours of its resources, or of the scheduler. |
| `keys.previousGroup / nextGroup` | `string[]` | `Alt+Shift+ArrowLeft` / `…Right` | On a focused appointment in a grouped view, moves it to the previous or next group. |

### SchedulerResource

| Member | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `field` | `string` | — | The appointment field that holds the item value (`roomId`) or a list of values (`ownerIds`). |
| `label` | `Bind<string>` | The field | The form label, and the name of the type in cells and tooltips. |
| `items` | `Bind<R[] \\| DataSource<R> \\| null>` | `[]` | The items, in memory or from a data source (loaded once and then tracked). Your data can be plain or reactive, and the component reads it as it is. After changing it in place, call `refreshResources()` or `refresh()`. |
| `valueExpr, displayExpr, colorExpr` | `string` | `'id'`, `'text'`, `'color'` | The item fields for its value, name and color. |
| `allowMultiple` | `Bind<boolean>` | `false` | Allows several per appointment. The field holds a list, and the form uses a tag box. |
| `useColorAsDefault` | `Bind<boolean>` | `false` | Colors appointments by this type, otherwise by the first type with an item color. An appointment's own `color` takes precedence. |
| `parentExpr` | `string` | — | The item field that references its parent item in the type above it in `groups`. When nested, a group shows only its own children. |
| `workStartHourExpr, workEndHourExpr, workDaysExpr` | `string` | `'workStartHour'`, `'workEndHour'`, `'workDays'` | An item's own work hours and days, which override the scheduler's. In nested groups, the innermost item applies. |

### Methods

| Method | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `checkTime(appointment, start, end, options?)` | Whether it can be there (`free`) and what conflicts: `overlapping`, `blocked`, `offHours`. `options` accepts `allDay` and `resources`, the values it would have. |
| `resourcesOf(appointment)` | Its items by type: `{ field, label, items: { value, text, color, item }[] }[]`. |
| `refreshResources()` | Re-reads the items after they have been changed in place. |
| `rangeFilter(range, fields, { resources })` | The data layer filter for a range, now also for the visible resources (`{ roomId: [1, 2] }`, for single-value fields). |

### Events

| Event | Arguments |
| --- | --- |
| `onMoving / onResizing` | These also include `resources`, the values its resource fields would get in another group. `cancel` starts as `true` where the time is not free, and `false` allows the move. |
| `onMoveStart / onMoveEnd …` | This also includes `resources`. |
| `onAppointmentClick / DblClick` | `group` provides the resource values of the clicked group. |
| `onCellClick / DblClick` | `cell.resources` provides the group of the cell, and a new appointment there receives these values. |

## Example files

`Resources.tsx`

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { RadioGroup, Scheduler } from '@motifx-community/ui';
import { bookings, people, rooms, type Booking } from './resource-data';

/**
 * Two kinds of resources: a booking has one room and one or more people. Their colours paint the
 * bookings; the choice says which kind does (`useColorAsDefault`, a function, so it follows).
 * Click a booking: the tooltip names its room and its people.
 */
export default function Resources() {
  const s = reactive({ by: 'room' });
  const resources = [
    { field: 'roomId', label: 'Room', items: rooms, useColorAsDefault: () => s.by === 'room' },
    { field: 'ownerIds', label: 'People', items: people, allowMultiple: true, useColorAsDefault: () => s.by === 'people' },
  ];
  return (
    <div class="sched-demo">
      <RadioGroup
        label="Colour by"
        orientation="horizontal"
        items={[
          { value: 'room', text: 'Room' },
          { value: 'people', text: 'People' },
        ]}
        itemText="text"
        itemValue="value"
        x-model={() => s.by}
      />
      <Scheduler<Booking> appointments={bookings()} resources={resources} currentView="week" startDayHour={8} endDayHour={18} />
    </div>
  );
}
```

`Grouped.tsx`

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Scheduler, Switch } from '@motifx-community/ui';
import { bookings, people, rooms, type Booking } from './resource-data';

/**
 * Columns grouped by room, then by the people of each room (`parentExpr`: a person's room). Drag a
 * booking to another person: only that person changes, the others stay on it. "Group by date" puts
 * the people under each day.
 */
export default function Grouped() {
  const s = reactive({ byDate: false });
  const resources = [
    { field: 'roomId', label: 'Room', items: rooms },
    { field: 'ownerIds', label: 'People', items: people, allowMultiple: true, parentExpr: 'roomId', useColorAsDefault: true },
  ];
  return (
    <div class="sched-demo">
      <Switch label="Group by date" x-model={() => s.byDate} />
      <Scheduler<Booking>
        appointments={bookings()}
        resources={resources}
        groups={['roomId', 'ownerIds']}
        groupByDate={() => s.byDate}
        views={['day', { type: 'workWeek', name: 'workWeek' }, 'month']}
        currentView="day"
        startDayHour={8}
        endDayHour={18}
      />
    </div>
  );
}
```

`HeaderTemplate.tsx`

```tsx
import { Scheduler, type ResourceHeaderContext } from '@motifx-community/ui';
import { bookings, people, rooms, type Booking, type Person } from './resource-data';

/** A person's header drawn by a template: their initials in their color, their name and their room. */
function PersonHead(context: ResourceHeaderContext) {
  const person = context.item as Person;
  const initials = context.text
    .split(' ')
    .map((part) => part[0])
    .join('');
  const room = rooms.find((r) => r.id === person.roomId)?.text ?? '';
  return (
    <div class="sched-person">
      <span class="sched-person__avatar" style={{ '--person-color': context.color }} aria-hidden="true">
        {initials}
      </span>
      <span class="sched-person__name">
        <strong>{context.text}</strong>
        <small>{room}</small>
      </span>
    </div>
  );
}

/** Grouped by person, with each header created by `resourceHeaderTemplate`. */
export default function HeaderTemplate() {
  const resources = [{ field: 'ownerIds', label: 'People', items: people, allowMultiple: true, useColorAsDefault: true }];
  return (
    <div class="sched-demo">
      <Scheduler<Booking>
        appointments={bookings()}
        resources={resources}
        groups={['ownerIds']}
        currentView="day"
        startDayHour={8}
        endDayHour={18}
        resourceHeaderTemplate={(context: ResourceHeaderContext) => PersonHead(context)}
      />
    </div>
  );
}
```

`Availability.tsx`

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { RadioGroup, Scheduler, type SchedulerBlockedTime, type SchedulerTimeCheck } from '@motifx-community/ui';
import { bookings, rooms, type Booking } from './resource-data';

/**
 * When a booking may go: Bosphorus is open 10 to 18 (its own work hours), lunch is blocked every
 * weekday, Cappadocia is closed tomorrow. Outside the hours nothing goes (`allowOffHours`); the
 * choice says whether bookings in a room may overlap, or a rule of its own lets two at once.
 */
export default function Availability() {
  const s = reactive({ overlap: 'no', said: '' });
  const today = new Date();
  const day = (offset: number, hour = 0) => new Date(today.getFullYear(), today.getMonth(), today.getDate() + offset, hour);
  const blocked: SchedulerBlockedTime[] = [
    { start: day(0, 12), end: day(0, 13), text: 'Lunch', recurrenceRule: 'FREQ=WEEKLY;BYDAY=MO,TU,WE,TH,FR' },
    { start: day(1), end: day(1), allDay: true, text: 'Closed for cleaning', resources: { roomId: 3 } },
  ];
  /** Two at once fit in a room, but never over a blocked time or out of its hours. */
  const twoAtOnce = (check: SchedulerTimeCheck<Booking>) => !check.blocked.length && !check.offHours && check.overlapping.length < 2;
  return (
    <div class="sched-demo">
      <RadioGroup
        label="Bookings in a room"
        orientation="horizontal"
        items={[
          { value: 'no', text: 'May not overlap' },
          { value: 'two', text: 'Two at once (a rule)' },
          { value: 'yes', text: 'May overlap' },
        ]}
        itemText="text"
        itemValue="value"
        x-model={() => s.overlap}
      />
      <Scheduler<Booking>
        appointments={bookings()}
        resources={[{ field: 'roomId', label: 'Room', items: rooms }]}
        groups={['roomId']}
        currentView="day"
        views={[{ type: 'day', intervalCount: 2 }]}
        startDayHour={8}
        endDayHour={19}
        blockedTimes={blocked}
        allowOffHours={false}
        allowOverlap={() => (s.overlap === 'two' ? twoAtOnce : s.overlap === 'yes')}
        onMoving={(e) => (s.said = e.cancel ? 'Not free there.' : '')}
        onMoveEnd={() => (s.said = '')}
      />
      <p class="sched-log">{() => s.said}</p>
    </div>
  );
}
```

`ResourcesFromSource.tsx`

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { data } from '@motifx-community/data';
import { CheckBox, Scheduler } from '@motifx-community/ui';
import { SlowAdapter } from '../../../shared/slow-adapter';
import { bookings, rooms, type Booking, type Room } from './resource-data';

/**
 * The rooms and the bookings both come from data sources that answer late. The rooms load once and
 * are followed: filter them and the groups change. Grouped by room, the bookings are asked for the
 * days and the rooms shown only.
 */
export default function ResourcesFromSource() {
  const s = reactive({ two: false, asked: '' });
  const roomSource = new data.DataSource<Room, number>({ adapter: new SlowAdapter<Room, number>({ data: rooms, key: 'id' }, 400), loadMode: 'all' });
  const source = new data.DataSource<Booking, number>({ adapter: new SlowAdapter<Booking, number>({ data: bookings(), key: 'id' }, 600), loadMode: 'all' });
  source.onChanged((e) => {
    if (e.reason !== 'loading') return;
    const rooms = JSON.stringify((source.filter as { and?: unknown[] } | null)?.and?.slice(2) ?? []);
    s.asked = `Asked for the rooms: ${rooms}`;
  });
  const onlyTwo = (on: boolean) => void roomSource.setFilter(on ? { field: 'id', op: 'in', value: [1, 2] } : null);
  return (
    <div
      class="sched-demo"
      onDisposing={() => {
        source.dispose();
        roomSource.dispose();
      }}
    >
      <CheckBox
        label="Only Atlas and Bosphorus"
        x-model={() => s.two}
        onValueChanged={(e: { value: boolean | null }) => onlyTwo(!!e.value)}
      />
      <Scheduler<Booking>
        dataSource={source}
        resources={[{ field: 'roomId', label: 'Room', items: roomSource }]}
        groups={['roomId']}
        currentView="workWeek"
        startDayHour={8}
        endDayHour={18}
      />
      <p class="sched-log">{() => s.asked}</p>
    </div>
  );
}
```

`slow-adapter.ts`

```tsx
import { data } from '@motifx-community/data';

/** Rows in memory that answer a little later, the way a server does; for the examples. */
export class SlowAdapter<T extends object, K> extends data.ArrayAdapter<T, K> {
  constructor(
    options: data.ArrayAdapterOptions<T>,
    private readonly delayMs = 300,
  ) {
    super(options);
  }

  override async load(options: data.LoadOptions = {}): Promise<data.LoadResult<T>> {
    await new Promise((done) => setTimeout(done, this.delayMs));
    return super.load(options);
  }
}
```

# Scheduler: The appointment form

> Scheduler · @motifx-community/ui 0.1.0-beta.5

Configure the appointment form without handling events. You can choose its fields and their order, arrange them in groups and tabs, use custom editors, add validation per field, and show or lock fields for specific appointments. You can also replace the form with your own.

## Items, groups and tabs

`editing.form.items` lists the contents of the form. Built-in items and resources are referenced by their fields, and an item with the same `field` modifies that item (here, the title's label and a rule). The time zone row (`timeZone`) and the recurrence editor (`recurrenceRule`) are regular items that you can move or omit. `tabs` and groups contain items specified the same way.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';

export interface Booking {
  id: number;
  text: string;
  startDate: Date;
  endDate: Date;
  allDay?: boolean;
  roomId?: number;
  ownerIds?: number[];
  color?: string;
  description?: string;
}

export interface Room {
  id: number;
  text: string;
  color: string;
  workStartHour?: number;
  workEndHour?: number;
}

export interface Person {
  id: number;
  text: string;
  color: string;
  /** The room the person works in. */
  roomId: number;
  workDays?: number[];
}

export const rooms: Room[] = [
  { id: 1, text: 'Atlas', color: '#1565c0' },
  // Open from 10 to 18.
  { id: 2, text: 'Bosphorus', color: '#2e7d32', workStartHour: 10, workEndHour: 18 },
  { id: 3, text: 'Cappadocia', color: '#6a1b9a' },
];

export const people: Person[] = [
  { id: 1, text: 'Ana Silva', color: '#ad1457', roomId: 1 },
  { id: 2, text: 'Ben Okafor', color: '#ef6c00', roomId: 1 },
  // Works Monday to Thursday.
  { id: 3, text: 'Cem Yılmaz', color: '#00838f', roomId: 2, workDays: [1, 2, 3, 4] },
  { id: 4, text: 'Dana Ivanova', color: '#455a64', roomId: 3 },
];

/** A week of bookings around today: each in a room, with one or more people. */
export function bookings(): Booking[] {
  const today = new Date();
  const day = (offset: number, hour: number, minute = 0) => new Date(today.getFullYear(), today.getMonth(), today.getDate() + offset, hour, minute);
  return reactive([
    { id: 1, text: 'Team standup', startDate: day(0, 9), endDate: day(0, 9, 30), roomId: 1, ownerIds: [1, 2] },
    { id: 2, text: 'Design review', startDate: day(0, 10), endDate: day(0, 11, 30), roomId: 1, ownerIds: [1] },
    { id: 3, text: 'Supplier call', startDate: day(0, 14), endDate: day(0, 15), roomId: 2, ownerIds: [3] },
    { id: 4, text: 'Hiring panel', startDate: day(1, 13), endDate: day(1, 15), roomId: 3, ownerIds: [4, 2] },
    { id: 5, text: 'Budget', startDate: day(1, 10), endDate: day(1, 11), roomId: 2, ownerIds: [3] },
    { id: 6, text: 'Workshop', startDate: day(2, 9), endDate: day(2, 12), roomId: 3, ownerIds: [4] },
    { id: 7, text: 'One-on-one', startDate: day(2, 15), endDate: day(2, 15, 30), roomId: 1, ownerIds: [2] },
    { id: 8, text: 'Offsite', startDate: day(3, 0), endDate: day(5, 0), allDay: true, roomId: 3, ownerIds: [1, 4] },
    { id: 9, text: 'Retro', startDate: day(-1, 16), endDate: day(-1, 17), roomId: 1, ownerIds: [1, 2] },
    { id: 10, text: 'Customer visit', startDate: day(-2, 11), endDate: day(-2, 12, 30), roomId: 2, ownerIds: [3, 1] },
  ]) as Booking[];
}
```

## Custom editors

`editor` can be a function. It receives the same props as a named editor (`label`, `value`, `onValueChanged`, `validationGroup`, `rules` …), so any component that accepts them is validated with the form. `template` places any MotifJS component, and receives the form (with its reactive `data`) and its place (`field`, `validationGroup`). `rules` are kit validation rules, and are added to any rules of a built-in item.

## Fields for specific appointments

`visible`, `readOnly`, `enabled`, `required`, `label` and `helpText` can be functions of the form: `(form) => form.data.roomId === 3`. They read the form's current data, so a field can appear when another field changes.

## Replacing the form

`onFormOpening` receives the items built from `editing.form` and can still change them. Set `cancel` to keep the scheduler's form closed, open your own form, and then save with `addAppointment` or `updateAppointment`. The events and validation run the same way as for the scheduler's form.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';

export interface Booking {
  id: number;
  text: string;
  startDate: Date;
  endDate: Date;
  allDay?: boolean;
  roomId?: number;
  ownerIds?: number[];
  color?: string;
  description?: string;
}

export interface Room {
  id: number;
  text: string;
  color: string;
  workStartHour?: number;
  workEndHour?: number;
}

export interface Person {
  id: number;
  text: string;
  color: string;
  /** The room the person works in. */
  roomId: number;
  workDays?: number[];
}

export const rooms: Room[] = [
  { id: 1, text: 'Atlas', color: '#1565c0' },
  // Open from 10 to 18.
  { id: 2, text: 'Bosphorus', color: '#2e7d32', workStartHour: 10, workEndHour: 18 },
  { id: 3, text: 'Cappadocia', color: '#6a1b9a' },
];

export const people: Person[] = [
  { id: 1, text: 'Ana Silva', color: '#ad1457', roomId: 1 },
  { id: 2, text: 'Ben Okafor', color: '#ef6c00', roomId: 1 },
  // Works Monday to Thursday.
  { id: 3, text: 'Cem Yılmaz', color: '#00838f', roomId: 2, workDays: [1, 2, 3, 4] },
  { id: 4, text: 'Dana Ivanova', color: '#455a64', roomId: 3 },
];

/** A week of bookings around today: each in a room, with one or more people. */
export function bookings(): Booking[] {
  const today = new Date();
  const day = (offset: number, hour: number, minute = 0) => new Date(today.getFullYear(), today.getMonth(), today.getDate() + offset, hour, minute);
  return reactive([
    { id: 1, text: 'Team standup', startDate: day(0, 9), endDate: day(0, 9, 30), roomId: 1, ownerIds: [1, 2] },
    { id: 2, text: 'Design review', startDate: day(0, 10), endDate: day(0, 11, 30), roomId: 1, ownerIds: [1] },
    { id: 3, text: 'Supplier call', startDate: day(0, 14), endDate: day(0, 15), roomId: 2, ownerIds: [3] },
    { id: 4, text: 'Hiring panel', startDate: day(1, 13), endDate: day(1, 15), roomId: 3, ownerIds: [4, 2] },

    { id: 9, text: 'Retro', startDate: day(-1, 16), endDate: day(-1, 17), roomId: 1, ownerIds: [1, 2] },
```

## API reference

### editing.form

| Member | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `items` | `(string \\| SchedulerFormItem)[]` | The built-in items, with resources after All day | The contents of the form, in order: a built-in item by its field, a resource by its field, or a custom item. Unknown names are ignored. |
| `columns` | `number` | `2` | The number of columns in the form. A group or tab can set its own. |
| `minColumnWidth` | `string` | — | Fits as many columns as possible, each at least this wide. `columns` sets the maximum. |
| `labelMode` | `Bind<FieldLabelMode>` | Set by the design language | Label placement. |
| `title` | `FormBind<string>` | New / Edit appointment | The form's title. A function of the form can set it per appointment. |
| `width` | `string` | Set by the design language | The form's width, as a CSS length. |

### Built-in items

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `text, description` | The title (required) and the description. |
| `start, end` | Each provides two items: a date and time, and a date for all-day appointments. The end validates that it is after the start and that the time is free. |
| `allDay` | The all-day switch. |
| `timeZone` | The time zone row, made up of `startTimeZone`, `separateEndZone` and `endTimeZone` (requires `editing.allowTimeZones`). Each can also be listed individually. |
| `recurrenceRule` | The recurrence editor (requires `editing.allowRecurrence`). |
| `a resource’s field` | The resource's picker: a drop-down, or a tag box for a type that allows several. Each item shows its color. |

### SchedulerFormItem

| Member | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `field, label, editor, editorProps, colSpan` | The same as a kit form item. `editor` can be a name, or a function that creates the editor from the props a named editor receives. |
| `visible, enabled, readOnly, required, label, helpText, group` | A value, a tracked function, or a function of the form, `(form) => …`, with `appointment`, `data` and `isNew`. Use it to show or lock a field for specific appointments. |
| `rules` | Kit validation rules, or a function of the form that returns them. They are added to any rules of a built-in item. |
| `items, group, columns` | A group with a caption. Its items are specified the same way. |
| `tabs` | `[{ title, items, columns?, visible? }]`. Every tab is validated when the form is saved, and the tab containing the first invalid field is shown. |
| `template` | `(form, place) => ComponentBase`: any MotifJS component for this place. `place` provides the `field` and the `validationGroup` used to validate it with the other fields. |
| `button` | A form button. |

### How the settings combine

| Case | Result |
| --- | --- |
| `A built-in or a resource named by `field`` | The item's settings take precedence, `rules` are added, `visible` and `enabled` apply when both allow it, `readOnly` applies when either sets it, and `editorProps` are merged. |
| ``onFormOpening`` | Still occurs, with the items as `editing.form` defines them. It can change them, or cancel to open a custom form. |

### FormLayout

| Member | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `FormItem.tabs` | Tabs of items in any `FormLayout`. Validation shows the tab containing the first invalid field. |
| `FormItem.editor (a function)` | Creates the editor from the props a named editor receives. |
| `FormItem.template(context)` | Receives `{ data, field, validationGroup }`. |
| `editor: 'tagbox'` | A tag box specified by name. |

`DeclaredForm.tsx`

```tsx
import { Scheduler, type SchedulerForm } from '@motifx-community/ui';
import { bookings, people, rooms, type Booking } from './resource-data';

/**
 * The form set up by `editing.form` alone: the title on top with a rule of its own, then three tabs.
 * Built-in items and resources are named by their fields; the time zone row (`timeZone`) and the
 * recurrence editor are items like the others. Double-click a booking.
 */
export default function DeclaredForm() {
  const form: SchedulerForm<Booking> = {
    columns: 2,
    items: [
      { field: 'text', label: 'Subject', rules: [{ type: 'length', min: 3, message: 'At least three letters.' }] },
      {
        tabs: [
          { title: 'When', items: ['start', 'end', 'timeZone', 'allDay', 'recurrenceRule'] },
          { title: 'Where and who', columns: 1, items: ['roomId', 'ownerIds'] },
          { title: 'Notes', columns: 1, items: [{ field: 'description', label: 'Agenda' }] },
        ],
      },
    ],
  };
  return (
    <div class="sched-demo">
      <Scheduler<Booking>
        appointments={bookings()}
        resources={[
          { field: 'roomId', label: 'Room', items: rooms, useColorAsDefault: true },
          { field: 'ownerIds', label: 'People', items: people, allowMultiple: true },
        ]}
        currentView="workWeek"
        startDayHour={8}
        endDayHour={18}
        editing={{ allowTimeZones: true, form }}
      />
    </div>
  );
}
```

`CustomEditors.tsx`

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Scheduler, Slider, type AppointmentFormContext, type FormTemplateContext, type SchedulerForm } from '@motifx-community/ui';
import { bookings, people, rooms, type Booking } from './resource-data';

type Rated = Booking & { priority?: number };

const COLORS = ['#1565c0', '#2e7d32', '#ad1457', '#ef6c00', '#455a64'];

/** A custom component as an editor: a row of colors bound to the form's data. */
function ColorChoice(form: AppointmentFormContext<Rated>, place: FormTemplateContext) {
  const data = form.data as Record<string, unknown>;
  return (
    <div class="sched-colors" role="group" aria-label="Colour">
      <span class="sched-colors__label">Colour</span>
      {COLORS.map((color) => (
        <button
          key={color}
          type="button"
          class="sched-colors__swatch"
          style={{ background: color }}
          aria-label={color}
          aria-pressed={() => data[place.field] === color}
          onclick={() => (data[place.field] = data[place.field] === color ? '' : color)}
        />
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}

/**
 * Editors of your own: a slider made by a function (it takes the props a named editor gets, so it
 * is checked with the form), and a row of colours from a template. A rule of the form's own: an
 * interview needs two people.
 */
export default function CustomEditors() {
  const form: SchedulerForm<Rated> = {
    items: [
      'text',
      'start',
      'end',
      { field: 'priority', label: 'Priority', editor: (props) => new Slider({ ...props, min: 1, max: 5, step: 1 }), colSpan: 'all' },
      { field: 'color', colSpan: 'all', template: ColorChoice },
      'roomId',
      {
        field: 'ownerIds',
        rules: (f) => [
          {
            type: 'custom',
            ignoreEmpty: false,
            check: (value: unknown) => !/interview/i.test(String(f.data.text)) || (Array.isArray(value) && value.length >= 2) || 'An interview needs two people.',
          },
        ],
      },
      'description',
    ],
  };
  const appointments = reactive(bookings().map((b) => ({ ...b, priority: 3 }))) as Rated[];
  return (
    <div class="sched-demo">
      <Scheduler<Rated>
        appointments={appointments}
        resources={[
          { field: 'roomId', label: 'Room', items: rooms },
          { field: 'ownerIds', label: 'People', items: people, allowMultiple: true },
        ]}
        currentView="workWeek"
        startDayHour={8}
        endDayHour={18}
        editing={{ allowRecurrence: false, form }}
      />
    </div>
  );
}
```

`ConditionalFields.tsx`

```tsx
import { Scheduler, type SchedulerForm } from '@motifx-community/ui';
import { bookings, people, rooms, type Booking } from './resource-data';

type Catered = Booking & { catering?: boolean; guests?: number };

/**
 * Fields for one appointment only, each a function of the form: catering shows only for
 * Cappadocia (the big room), the number of guests only with catering; a booking that has begun
 * keeps its room; the people are needed for an interview.
 */
export default function ConditionalFields() {
  const now = new Date();
  const form: SchedulerForm<Catered> = {
    items: [
      'text',
      'start',
      'end',
      { field: 'roomId', readOnly: (f) => !f.isNew && !!f.appointment && f.appointment.startDate < now, helpText: (f) => (!f.isNew && !!f.appointment && f.appointment.startDate < now ? 'It has begun: the room stays.' : '') },
      { field: 'catering', label: 'Catering', editor: 'switch', visible: (f) => f.data.roomId === 3 },
      { field: 'guests', label: 'Guests', editor: 'number', editorProps: { min: 1, max: 40 }, visible: (f) => f.data.roomId === 3 && !!f.data.catering, required: true },
      { field: 'ownerIds', required: (f) => /interview/i.test(String(f.data.text)) },
      'description',
    ],
  };
  return (
    <div class="sched-demo">
      <Scheduler<Catered>
        appointments={bookings()}
        resources={[
          { field: 'roomId', label: 'Room', items: rooms, useColorAsDefault: true },
          { field: 'ownerIds', label: 'People', items: people, allowMultiple: true },
        ]}
        currentView="workWeek"
        startDayHour={8}
        endDayHour={18}
        editing={{ allowRecurrence: false, form }}
      />
    </div>
  );
}
```

`OwnForm.tsx`

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, FormLayout, MxForm, Scheduler, Stack, type FormOpeningEventArgs } from '@motifx-community/ui';
import { bookings, rooms, type Booking } from './resource-data';

/**
 * A form of your own: `onFormOpening` cancels the scheduler's and opens a short one (a title and a
 * room), then saves through the scheduler, so its events and its checks still run.
 */
export default function OwnForm() {
  const opening = async (e: FormOpeningEventArgs<Booking>) => {
    e.cancel = true;
    const data = reactive({ text: String(e.data.text), roomId: (e.data.roomId as number | null) ?? 1 });
    const form = new MxForm({ title: e.appointment ? 'Quick edit' : 'Quick booking', modal: true });
    let layout: FormLayout<typeof data> | null = null;
    form.content = (
      <FormLayout<typeof data>
        data={data}
        ref={(c: FormLayout<typeof data>) => (layout = c)}
        items={[
          { field: 'text', label: 'Title', required: true },
          { field: 'roomId', label: 'Room', editor: 'radio', editorProps: { items: rooms, itemText: 'text', itemValue: 'id', orientation: 'horizontal' } },
        ]}
      />
    );
    form.footer = (
      <Stack orientation="horizontal" justify="end">
        <Button text="Save" tone="accent" onclick={async () => layout && (await layout.validate()).valid && form.close('ok')} />
        <Button text="Cancel" onclick={() => form.close('cancel')} />
      </Stack>
    );
    if ((await form.showDialog(e.source)) !== 'ok') return;
    if (e.appointment) await e.source.updateAppointment(e.appointment, { text: data.text, roomId: data.roomId });
    else await e.source.addAppointment({ text: data.text, roomId: data.roomId, startDate: e.data.start ?? new Date(), endDate: e.data.end ?? new Date() });
  };
  return (
    <div class="sched-demo">
      <Scheduler<Booking>
        appointments={bookings()}
        resources={[{ field: 'roomId', label: 'Room', items: rooms, useColorAsDefault: true }]}
        currentView="workWeek"
        startDayHour={8}
        endDayHour={18}
        onFormOpening={(e) => void opening(e)}
      />
    </div>
  );
}
```


---

# Scheduler: Timeline

> Scheduler · @motifx-community/ui 0.1.0-beta.5

Displays one row per resource, with time running along the row, for a day, a week, a work week or a month. Appointments at the same time stack within a row, and the row grows to fit them.

## Timeline views

`timelineDay`, `timelineWeek`, `timelineWorkWeek` and `timelineMonth` show the groups as rows, or a single row without `groups`. The scale above the cells has two tiers: days over hours, or months over days. It stays at the top while the rows scroll, and the resource column stays at the start while the time scrolls. The current time indicator, blocked times and off-hours shading all apply. Dragging moves an appointment along its row or to another row, and dragging its ends changes its time.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';

export interface Job {
  id: number;
  text: string;
  startDate: Date;
  endDate: Date;
  allDay?: boolean;
  teamId?: number;
  ownerId?: number;
  color?: string;
  recurrenceRule?: string;
}

export interface Team {
  id: number;
  text: string;
  color: string;
}

export interface Member {
  id: number;
  text: string;
  color: string;
  /** The team the person is in. */
  teamId: number;
  workStartHour?: number;
  workEndHour?: number;
}

export const teams: Team[] = [
  { id: 1, text: 'Field service', color: '#1565c0' },
  { id: 2, text: 'Workshop', color: '#2e7d32' },
  { id: 3, text: 'Support desk', color: '#6a1b9a' },
];

export const members: Member[] = [
  { id: 1, text: 'Ana Silva', color: '#ad1457', teamId: 1 },
  { id: 2, text: 'Ben Okafor', color: '#ef6c00', teamId: 1 },
  { id: 3, text: 'Cem Yılmaz', color: '#00838f', teamId: 1, workStartHour: 7, workEndHour: 15 },
  { id: 4, text: 'Dana Ivanova', color: '#455a64', teamId: 2 },
  { id: 5, text: 'Emil Novak', color: '#5d4037', teamId: 2 },
  { id: 6, text: 'Fatma Demir', color: '#c62828', teamId: 3, workStartHour: 12, workEndHour: 20 },
  { id: 7, text: 'Gus Moreau', color: '#283593', teamId: 3 },
];

const WORK = ['Install', 'Repair', 'Inspection', 'Calls', 'Delivery', 'Training', 'Planning', 'Visit'];

/** A fortnight of jobs around today: a few a day for each person, some over each other, some over days. */
export function jobs(): Job[] {
  const today = new Date();
  const day = (offset: number, hour: number, minute = 0) => new Date(today.getFullYear(), today.getMonth(), today.getDate() + offset, hour, minute);
  const out: Job[] = [];
  let id = 1;
  for (const member of members) {
    for (let offset = -7; offset <= 7; offset++) {
      // A stable spread: each person's day has its own hours.
      const seed = (member.id * 31 + offset * 17 + 400) % 97;
      if (seed % 5 === 0) continue;
      const start = 8 + (seed % 6);
      const length = 1 + (seed % 3);
      out.push({ id: id++, text: WORK[seed % WORK.length], startDate: day(offset, start), endDate: day(offset, start + length, seed % 2 ? 30 : 0), teamId: member.teamId, ownerId: member.id });
      if (seed % 4 === 1) out.push({ id: id++, text: WORK[(seed + 3) % WORK.length], startDate: day(offset, start + 1), endDate: day(offset, start + 2, 30), teamId: member.teamId, ownerId: member.id });
    }
  }
  out.push({ id: id++, text: 'Trade fair', startDate: day(1, 0), endDate: day(3, 0), allDay: true, teamId: 1, ownerId: 1 });
  out.push({ id: id++, text: 'Night shift', startDate: day(0, 20), endDate: day(1, 6), teamId: 3, ownerId: 7 });
  out.push({ id: id++, text: 'Stand-up', startDate: day(-7, 9), endDate: day(-7, 9, 15), teamId: 2, ownerId: 4, recurrenceRule: 'FREQ=DAILY;BYDAY=MO,TU,WE,TH,FR' });
  return reactive(out) as Job[];
}
```

## Nested groups

With two types in `groups`, each row is an item of the inner type under an item of the outer type. The resource column has one level per type, with the outer name on the first of its rows. On right-to-left pages, time runs from right to left.

## Templates

Every template can be set on the scheduler and on a view, and the view's template takes precedence. A template is created once for the element it renders, and receives a context whose fields stay up to date.

```tsx

/** A fortnight of jobs around today: a few a day for each person, some over each other, some over days. */
export function jobs(): Job[] {

      const start = 8 + (seed % 6);
      const length = 1 + (seed % 3);
      out.push({ id: id++, text: WORK[seed % WORK.length], startDate: day(offset, start), endDate: day(offset, start + length, seed % 2 ? 30 : 0), teamId: member.teamId, ownerId: member.id });
      if (seed % 4 === 1) out.push({ id: id++, text: WORK[(seed + 3) % WORK.length], startDate: day(offset, start + 1), endDate: day(offset, start + 2, 30), teamId: member.teamId, ownerId: member.id });
    }
  }
  out.push({ id: id++, text: 'Trade fair', startDate: day(1, 0), endDate: day(3, 0), allDay: true, teamId: 1, ownerId: 1 });
  out.push({ id: id++, text: 'Night shift', startDate: day(0, 20), endDate: day(1, 6), teamId: 3, ownerId: 7 });
  out.push({ id: id++, text: 'Stand-up', startDate: day(-7, 9), endDate: day(-7, 9, 15), teamId: 2, ownerId: 4, recurrenceRule: 'FREQ=DAILY;BYDAY=MO,TU,WE,TH,FR' });
  return reactive(out) as Job[];
}
```

## Keyboard

| Key | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `Left / Right (cells)` | Moves along the time, mirrored on right-to-left pages. Moving past the first or last cell advances the view. |
| `Up / Down (cells)` | Moves to the row above or below. |
| `Home / End, Ctrl + Home / End` | Moves to the first or last cell of the row. With Ctrl, moves to the first or last cell of the first or last row. |
| `PageUp / PageDown` | Moves up or down one screen of rows. |
| `Shift + arrows` | Selects cells along the row. |
| `Left / Right (appointment)` | Moves it along the time by a snap step, or by a day in the timeline month. With Shift, changes its end. |
| `Up / Down (appointment)` | Moves it to the row above or below, which changes its group. Enter saves, and Escape reverts. |

## Accessibility

| Topic | Details |
| --- | --- |
| `Rows` | The rows are grid rows. Each cell announces its group, date and time, followed by any blocked time. |
| `Resource column, scale` | Decorative (`aria-hidden`), because every cell names its group and time. |
| `Appointments` | The appointments of each row are in their own cell, named by the row. An appointment announces its text, its time and whether it continues. |

## Styling

| Hook | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `scheduler.scale, scale-upper (`today`), scale-lower (`day-start`, `day`, `weekend`, `today`)` | Units: the header above the cells and its two tiers. |
| `scheduler.timeline-corner, timeline-corner-label` | Units: the corner above the resource column, and the type names. |
| `scheduler.resource-cell (`inner`, `first`, `continued`)` | Unit: a level of the resource column. |
| `scheduler.timeline-row (`first`), timeline-divider (`inner`)` | Units: a row along the time and the line above it, and the line where an outer group starts. |
| `scheduler.cell `line`, `line-hour`, `line-day`` | The cells along the time: the line before each cell, which is stronger where an hour or a day starts. |
| `scheduler.appointment `line`, `line-before`, `line-after`` | An appointment on a lane, and its cut ends. |
| `timeline-cell-width, timeline-resource-width, timeline-lane-size, timeline-row-min-height` | Plain tokens: the minimum cell width (cells stretch to fill the space when there are few), a level of the resource column, a lane, and an empty row. |

## API reference

### Timeline views

| Setting | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `type` | `'timelineDay' \\| 'timelineWeek' \\| 'timelineWorkWeek' \\| 'timelineMonth'` | — | One row per group, with time along it: the hours of a day, a week or a work week, or the days of a month. |
| `intervalCount` | `Bind<number>` | 1 | The number of days, weeks or months shown. |
| `startDate` | `Bind<Date \\| null>` | `null` | With an `intervalCount` greater than 1, the date intervals are counted from, so that they stay in place when the date changes. |
| `cellDuration` | `Bind<number>` | The scheduler's value | The minutes in a cell along the time. In the timeline month, a cell is a day. |
| `startDayHour / endDayHour` | `Bind<number>` | The scheduler's value | The hours shown for each day. Time before and after them is omitted. |
| `groups` | `Bind<string[]>` | The scheduler's value | The resource fields the rows are grouped by, outer first. Nested groups appear as levels of the resource column. |
| `maxAppointmentsPerCell` | `Bind<number \\| 'auto'>` | `'auto'` | The number of lanes a row has before "+N more" (per day). With `'auto'`, the row grows to fit them all. |
| `scrolling` | `Bind<'auto' \\| 'standard' \\| 'virtual'>` | `'auto'` | Whether every row and cell is rendered, or only the visible ones (see Big data). |
| `name, text` | `string`, `Bind<string>` | The type | Its name for `currentView`, and its caption in the toolbar. |
| `…Template` | See Templates | The scheduler's value | A view's own template takes precedence, and `null` disables a template for that view. |

### Templates

| Prop (and view setting) | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `appointmentTemplate` | `(context: AppointmentTemplateContext) => Component` | An appointment's content: `{ appointment, start, end, text, time, allDay, view, group }`. |
| `appointmentTooltipTemplate` | `(context: TooltipTemplateContext) => Component` | The tooltip's content: `{ appointment, text, time, canEdit, canDelete, edit(), remove(), close() }`. |
| `dataCellTemplate` | `(context: CellTemplateContext) => Component` | A cell's content: `{ start, end, allDay, resources, view, today, work, blocked }`. The cell keeps its appearance, keys and accessible name. |
| `dateCellTemplate` | `(context: DateTemplateContext) => Component` | A day header (dates, weekdays of a month, days of a timeline): `{ date, weekday, number, today, view, resources }`. |
| `timeCellTemplate` | `(context: TimeTemplateContext) => Component` | An hour of the time ruler or of a timeline scale: `{ date, minutes, text, view }`. |
| `resourceHeaderTemplate` | `(context: ResourceHeaderContext) => Component` | A group header. In a timeline, this is the cell in the resource column. |
| `agendaRowTemplate` | `(context: AgendaRowContext) => Component` | An agenda row's content (see Agenda). |
| `moreListTemplate` | `(context: MoreListContext) => Component` | The list opened by "+N more": `{ date, appointments, choose(appointment, event) }`. |

### Methods

| Method | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `scrollToTime(hour, minute?)` | In a timeline, scrolls along to that time on the displayed date, or on the first day if none is given. |
| `scrollTo(date, resources?)` | Scrolls a time into view: its cell along the time and the row of `resources` (the group's values). In the day views, this is its hour and column. |

`Timeline.tsx`

```tsx
import { Scheduler } from '@motifx-community/ui';
import { jobs, members, type Job } from './timeline-data';

/**
 * The four timeline views, a row per person. Jobs at the same time stack in their row, and the row
 * grows. Drag one along its row or to another person; drag its ends to change its time.
 */
export default function Timeline() {
  const resources = [{ field: 'ownerId', label: 'Person', items: members, useColorAsDefault: true }];
  return (
    <div class="sched-demo">
      <Scheduler<Job>
        appointments={jobs()}
        resources={resources}
        groups={['ownerId']}
        views={['timelineDay', 'timelineWeek', 'timelineWorkWeek', 'timelineMonth']}
        currentView="timelineWeek"
        startDayHour={7}
        endDayHour={20}
        cellDuration={60}
      />
    </div>
  );
}
```

`timeline-data.ts`

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';

export interface Job {
  id: number;
  text: string;
  startDate: Date;
  endDate: Date;
  allDay?: boolean;
  teamId?: number;
  ownerId?: number;
  color?: string;
  recurrenceRule?: string;
}

export interface Team {
  id: number;
  text: string;
  color: string;
}

export interface Member {
  id: number;
  text: string;
  color: string;
  /** The team the person is in. */
  teamId: number;
  workStartHour?: number;
  workEndHour?: number;
}

export const teams: Team[] = [
  { id: 1, text: 'Field service', color: '#1565c0' },
  { id: 2, text: 'Workshop', color: '#2e7d32' },
  { id: 3, text: 'Support desk', color: '#6a1b9a' },
];

export const members: Member[] = [
  { id: 1, text: 'Ana Silva', color: '#ad1457', teamId: 1 },
  { id: 2, text: 'Ben Okafor', color: '#ef6c00', teamId: 1 },
  { id: 3, text: 'Cem Yılmaz', color: '#00838f', teamId: 1, workStartHour: 7, workEndHour: 15 },
  { id: 4, text: 'Dana Ivanova', color: '#455a64', teamId: 2 },
  { id: 5, text: 'Emil Novak', color: '#5d4037', teamId: 2 },
  { id: 6, text: 'Fatma Demir', color: '#c62828', teamId: 3, workStartHour: 12, workEndHour: 20 },
  { id: 7, text: 'Gus Moreau', color: '#283593', teamId: 3 },
];

const WORK = ['Install', 'Repair', 'Inspection', 'Calls', 'Delivery', 'Training', 'Planning', 'Visit'];

/** A fortnight of jobs around today: a few a day for each person, some over each other, some over days. */
export function jobs(): Job[] {
  const today = new Date();
  const day = (offset: number, hour: number, minute = 0) => new Date(today.getFullYear(), today.getMonth(), today.getDate() + offset, hour, minute);
  const out: Job[] = [];
  let id = 1;
  for (const member of members) {
    for (let offset = -7; offset <= 7; offset++) {
      // A stable spread: each person's day has its own hours.
      const seed = (member.id * 31 + offset * 17 + 400) % 97;
      if (seed % 5 === 0) continue;
      const start = 8 + (seed % 6);
      const length = 1 + (seed % 3);
      out.push({ id: id++, text: WORK[seed % WORK.length], startDate: day(offset, start), endDate: day(offset, start + length, seed % 2 ? 30 : 0), teamId: member.teamId, ownerId: member.id });
      if (seed % 4 === 1) out.push({ id: id++, text: WORK[(seed + 3) % WORK.length], startDate: day(offset, start + 1), endDate: day(offset, start + 2, 30), teamId: member.teamId, ownerId: member.id });
    }
  }
  out.push({ id: id++, text: 'Trade fair', startDate: day(1, 0), endDate: day(3, 0), allDay: true, teamId: 1, ownerId: 1 });
  out.push({ id: id++, text: 'Night shift', startDate: day(0, 20), endDate: day(1, 6), teamId: 3, ownerId: 7 });
  out.push({ id: id++, text: 'Stand-up', startDate: day(-7, 9), endDate: day(-7, 9, 15), teamId: 2, ownerId: 4, recurrenceRule: 'FREQ=DAILY;BYDAY=MO,TU,WE,TH,FR' });
  return reactive(out) as Job[];
}
```

`NestedTimeline.tsx`

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Scheduler, Switch } from '@motifx-community/ui';
import { jobs, members, teams, type Job } from './timeline-data';

/**
 * Rows grouped by team, then by the people of each team (`parentExpr`). Up and Down on a job move it
 * to the row above or below; Left and Right move it along the time. "Right to left" mirrors the
 * time and the resource column.
 */
export default function NestedTimeline() {
  const s = reactive({ rtl: false });
  const resources = [
    { field: 'teamId', label: 'Team', items: teams },
    { field: 'ownerId', label: 'Person', items: members, parentExpr: 'teamId', useColorAsDefault: true },
  ];
  return (
    <div class="sched-demo" dir={() => (s.rtl ? 'rtl' : 'ltr')}>
      <Switch label="Right to left" x-model={() => s.rtl} />
      <Scheduler<Job>
        appointments={jobs()}
        resources={resources}
        groups={['teamId', 'ownerId']}
        views={['timelineDay', 'timelineWorkWeek']}
        currentView="timelineDay"
        startDayHour={7}
        endDayHour={21}
      />
    </div>
  );
}
```

`TimelineSettings.tsx`

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Scheduler, Switch, type MoreListContext } from '@motifx-community/ui';
import { jobs, members, type Job } from './timeline-data';

/** A short list of its own for "+N more": the day and each job's name. */
function Jobs(context: MoreListContext<Job>) {
  return (
    <div class="sched-more">
      <strong>{() => context.date?.toLocaleDateString() ?? ''}</strong>
      {context.appointments.map((job) => (
        <button key={job.id} type="button" class="sched-more__item" onclick={(e: MouseEvent) => context.choose(job, e)}>
          {job.text}
        </button>
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}

/**
 * Views with settings of their own: a working day in half hours, a fortnight in four-hour cells
 * counted from a fixed Monday (`startDate`), and a month of days with at most two lanes a row
 * ("+N more" opens a list of its own). A setting not given is the scheduler's.
 */
export default function TimelineSettings() {
  const s = reactive({ dim: true });
  const resources = [{ field: 'ownerId', label: 'Person', items: members, useColorAsDefault: true }];
  const monday = new Date(2026, 0, 5);
  return (
    <div class="sched-demo">
      <Switch label="Ended ones quieter" x-model={() => s.dim} />
      <Scheduler<Job>
        appointments={jobs()}
        resources={resources}
        groups={['ownerId']}
        views={[
          { type: 'timelineDay', name: 'workday', text: 'Workday', startDayHour: 8, endDayHour: 18, cellDuration: 30 },
          { type: 'timelineWeek', name: 'fortnight', text: 'Fortnight', intervalCount: 2, startDate: monday, cellDuration: 240 },
          { type: 'timelineMonth', name: 'month', text: 'Month', maxAppointmentsPerCell: 2, moreListTemplate: Jobs },
        ]}
        currentView="fortnight"
        dimPast={() => s.dim}
      />
    </div>
  );
}
```

`TimelineTemplates.tsx`

```tsx
import { Scheduler, type AppointmentTemplateContext, type CellTemplateContext, type DateTemplateContext, type ResourceHeaderContext, type TimeTemplateContext } from '@motifx-community/ui';
import { jobs, members, type Job, type Member } from './timeline-data';

/**
 * Templates, for the scheduler and for one view: the person's head with their hours, each day's
 * head, the hours, a mark on the cells outside the work hours (in the week only: a view's own
 * template wins) and the job's content.
 */
export default function TimelineTemplates() {
  const resources = [{ field: 'ownerId', label: 'Person', items: members, useColorAsDefault: true }];
  const head = (c: ResourceHeaderContext) => {
    const person = c.item as Member;
    return (
      <div class="sched-person">
        <span class="sched-person__avatar" style={{ '--person-color': c.color }} aria-hidden="true">
          {c.text
            .split(' ')
            .map((p) => p[0])
            .join('')}
        </span>
        <span class="sched-person__name">
          <strong>{c.text}</strong>
          <small>{`${person.workStartHour ?? 9}:00–${person.workEndHour ?? 17}:00`}</small>
        </span>
      </div>
    );
  };
  const date = (c: DateTemplateContext) => <span class="sched-date">{`${c.weekday} ${c.number}`}</span>;
  const time = (c: TimeTemplateContext) => <span class="sched-time">{c.text}</span>;
  const cell = (c: CellTemplateContext) => <span class="sched-off" data-off={() => (!c.work ? '' : null)} aria-hidden="true" />;
  const job = (c: AppointmentTemplateContext<Job>) => (
    <span class="sched-job">
      <strong>{c.text}</strong> <span>{c.time}</span>
    </span>
  );
  return (
    <div class="sched-demo">
      <Scheduler<Job>
        appointments={jobs()}
        resources={resources}
        groups={['ownerId']}
        views={['timelineDay', { type: 'timelineWeek', dataCellTemplate: cell }]}
        currentView="timelineWeek"
        startDayHour={7}
        endDayHour={20}
        cellDuration={60}
        resourceHeaderTemplate={head}
        dateCellTemplate={date}
        timeCellTemplate={time}
        appointmentTemplate={job}
      />
    </div>
  );
}
```

# Scheduler: Agenda

> Scheduler · @motifx-community/ui 0.1.0-beta.5

Displays upcoming days as a list, with each day's appointments in time order. Days without appointments are omitted.

## Agenda

`agenda` lists `agendaDuration` days, starting from the displayed date (7 by default). A multi-day appointment appears on each of its days, and an all-day appointment is labeled as such. The list is a list box, so the arrow keys move between rows, and Space and Enter act like a click and a double-click.

## Grouping by resource

With `groups`, each group's days appear under its name. As in other views, a data source is asked only for the displayed days.

```tsx

  id: number;

export function jobs(): Job[] {
```

## Templates

`agendaRowTemplate` customizes a row's content, and `appointmentTooltipTemplate` customizes the tooltip here and in every view.

```tsx

export function jobs(): Job[] {
  const today = new Date();
  const day = (offset: number, hour: number, minute = 0) => new Date(today.getFullYear(), today.getMonth(), today.getDate() + offset, hour, minute);
  const out: Job[] = [];
  let id = 1;
  for (const member of members) {
    for (let offset = -7; offset <= 7; offset++) {
      // A stable spread: each person's day has its own hours.
      const seed = (member.id * 31 + offset * 17 + 400) % 97;
      if (seed % 5 === 0) continue;
      const start = 8 + (seed % 6);
      const length = 1 + (seed % 3);
      out.push({ id: id++, text: WORK[seed % WORK.length], startDate: day(offset, start), endDate: day(offset, start + length, seed % 2 ? 30 : 0), teamId: member.teamId, ownerId: member.id });
      if (seed % 4 === 1) out.push({ id: id++, text: WORK[(seed + 3) % WORK.length], startDate: day(offset, start + 1), endDate: day(offset, start + 2, 30), teamId: member.teamId, ownerId: member.id });
    }
  }
  out.push({ id: id++, text: 'Trade fair', startDate: day(1, 0), endDate: day(3, 0), allDay: true, teamId: 1, ownerId: 1 });
  out.push({ id: id++, text: 'Night shift', startDate: day(0, 20), endDate: day(1, 6), teamId: 3, ownerId: 7 });
  out.push({ id: id++, text: 'Stand-up', startDate: day(-7, 9), endDate: day(-7, 9, 15), teamId: 2, ownerId: 4, recurrenceRule: 'FREQ=DAILY;BYDAY=MO,TU,WE,TH,FR' });
  return reactive(out) as Job[];
}
```

## Keyboard

| Key | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `Up / Down` | Moves to the row above or below and selects it. |
| `Home / End, PageUp / PageDown` | Moves to the first or last row, or up or down one screen of rows. |
| `Space` | Shows the tooltip, like a click. |
| `Enter` | Opens the form, like a double-click. |
| `Delete` | Deletes the appointment, after confirmation. |
| `T, N / P, A` | Today, and the next and previous days. `keys.agendaView` (A) shows the agenda. |

## Accessibility

| Topic | Details |
| --- | --- |
| `List` | A list box. Each day, within its group, is a group of options named by the day. |
| `Rows` | One option per appointment, with its text, its time, whether it continues and how it repeats. The focused row is the selected row. |
| `Empty` | When there are no appointments, the list is omitted and a message appears instead. |

## Styling

| Hook | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `scheduler.agenda, agenda-group (`first`), agenda-resource` | Units: the list, a day and the line above it, and a group name. |
| `scheduler.agenda-day (`today`), agenda-weekday (`today`), agenda-month, day-number `agenda`` | Units: a day header and its parts. |
| `scheduler.agenda-row (`hover`, `selected`, `open`, `focus`, `past`, `disabled`), agenda-content` | Units: a row and its side-by-side parts. |
| `scheduler.agenda-time, agenda-dot, agenda-text, agenda-empty` | Units: the time column, the appointment color (hidden unless a design language draws it), the text and the empty message. |
| `agenda-time-width` | Plain token: the width of the time column. |

## API reference

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `agendaDuration` | `Bind<number>` | 7 | The number of days the agenda shows, starting from the displayed date. A view's own value takes precedence. Previous and next move by this number. |
| `groups` | `Bind<string[]>` | `[]` | With groups, each group's days appear under its name, with that group's appointments. |
| `agendaRowTemplate` | `Bind<((context: AgendaRowContext) => Component) \\| null>` | `null` | A row's content: `{ appointment, start, end, text, time, allDay, date, group }`. The row keeps its color, keys and accessible name. |
| `appointmentTooltipTemplate` | `Bind<((context: TooltipTemplateContext) => Component) \\| null>` | `null` | The tooltip's content, in every view. |
| `texts.schedulerNoAppointments` | `string` | "No appointments" | The message shown when the displayed days have no appointments (`uiLocale`). |

`AgendaTemplates.tsx`

```tsx
import { Button, Scheduler, type AgendaRowContext, type TooltipTemplateContext } from '@motifx-community/ui';
import { jobs, members, type Job } from './timeline-data';

/**
 * An agenda row drawn by `agendaRowTemplate` (the person's name after the job), and a tooltip of
 * its own (`appointmentTooltipTemplate`) with the time and a button to open the form. The row
 * keeps its color, keys and accessible name.
 */
export default function AgendaTemplates() {
  const resources = [{ field: 'ownerId', label: 'Person', items: members, useColorAsDefault: true }];
  const person = (job: Job) => members.find((m) => m.id === job.ownerId)?.text ?? '';
  const row = (c: AgendaRowContext<Job>) => (
    <span class="sched-agenda-row">
      <strong>{c.time}</strong>
      <span>{c.text}</span>
      <small>{person(c.appointment)}</small>
    </span>
  );
  const tip = (c: TooltipTemplateContext<Job>) => (
    <div class="sched-tip">
      <strong>{() => c.text}</strong>
      <span>{() => c.time}</span>
      <span>{() => (c.appointment ? person(c.appointment) : '')}</span>
      <Button text="Open" visible={() => c.canEdit} onclick={() => c.edit()} />
    </div>
  );
  return (
    <div class="sched-demo">
      <Scheduler<Job>
        appointments={jobs()}
        resources={resources}
        views={[{ type: 'agenda', agendaDuration: 2 }, 'week']}
        currentView="agenda"
        agendaRowTemplate={row}
        appointmentTooltipTemplate={tip}
      />
    </div>
  );
}
```

# Scheduler: Big data

> Scheduler · @motifx-community/ui 0.1.0-beta.5

Handles thousands of resources and appointments. The scheduler renders only what is visible, and recalculates the layout only for what has changed.

## 1,000 resources, 10,000 appointments

A timeline week with one row for each of 1,000 lines and 10,000 generated tasks. Scroll down and sideways, and the visible rows, cells and tasks are rendered as they appear. The status line below shows the time taken by the first render and the number of elements the scheduler holds.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';

export interface Task {
  id: number;
  text: string;
  startDate: Date;
  endDate: Date;
  resourceId: number;
}

export interface Machine {
  id: number;
  text: string;
  color: string;
}

const COLORS = ['#1565c0', '#2e7d32', '#6a1b9a', '#ad1457', '#ef6c00', '#00838f', '#455a64', '#5d4037'];
const WORK = ['Cut', 'Weld', 'Paint', 'Check', 'Pack', 'Load', 'Clean', 'Test'];

/** `count` resources, named and coloured in turn. */
export function machines(count: number): Machine[] {
  return Array.from({ length: count }, (_, i) => ({ id: i + 1, text: `Line ${String(i + 1).padStart(4, '0')}`, color: COLORS[i % COLORS.length] }));
}

/**
 * `count` tasks over the week of `day`, spread over the resources: each one an hour or a few long,
 * in the working hours, some over each other (a pseudo-random spread, the same each time).
 */
export function tasks(count: number, resources: number, day = new Date()): Task[] {
  const monday = new Date(day.getFullYear(), day.getMonth(), day.getDate() - ((day.getDay() + 6) % 7));
  let seed = 7;
  const next = () => (seed = (seed * 48271) % 2147483647) / 2147483647;
  const out: Task[] = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
    const start = new Date(monday.getFullYear(), monday.getMonth(), monday.getDate() + Math.floor(next() * 7), 6 + Math.floor(next() * 12), next() < 0.5 ? 0 : 30);
    const end = new Date(start.getTime() + (1 + Math.floor(next() * 4)) * 3_600_000);
    out.push({ id: i + 1, text: `${WORK[i % WORK.length]} ${i + 1}`, startDate: start, endDate: end, resourceId: 1 + (i % resources) });
  }
  return reactive(out) as Task[];
}
```

## 200 groups in a week

A week grouped by 200 lines, for 1,400 columns of 48 cells and 4,000 tasks. Only the visible columns, plus one screen on each side, are rendered.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';

export interface Task {
  id: number;
  text: string;
  startDate: Date;
  endDate: Date;
  resourceId: number;
}

  id: number;
  text: string;
  color: string;
}

/**

  }

}
```

## How it stays fast

| Part | Details |
| --- | --- |
| `Rows of a timeline` | Uses `Virtualization` to render only the visible rows, plus a few on each side. Each row is as tall as its lanes. The model calculates the height (lanes × lane height) and the list reads it. While an appointment is being dragged, its rows grow in place, and the list receives the new heights afterward. |
| `Cells along the time` | The model keeps a window (`setWindow`) of the cells and appointments in the visible area, plus one screen on each side. Scrolling moves the window by a few cells at a time, and the rows render it through a keyed `.map` over that part of the data. |
| `Columns of a day or a week` | The same window applies to columns, so with many groups only the visible columns are rendered, each in its own position. |
| `Layout` | Each timeline row has its own layout, so a drag recalculates only the rows it leaves and enters. Appointments are read once for all layouts until they change. |
| `Data source` | Only the displayed range is requested (`rangeFilter`), along with the displayed resources when grouping by a single-value field. |

```tsx
// A data source is asked for what is shown: the days, and the resources of the groups.
<Scheduler dataSource={source} remoteFiltering groups={['resourceId']} views={['timelineWeek']} />
```

## API reference

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `scrolling` | `Bind<'auto' \| 'standard' \| 'virtual'>` | `'auto'` | `'standard'` renders every row and cell, and `'virtual'` renders only the visible ones. `'auto'` switches to virtual above about 2,000 cells (rows × cells along the time, or columns × time rows). A view's own value takes precedence. |

## Example files

`BigTimeline.tsx`

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Scheduler } from '@motifx-community/ui';
import { machines, tasks, type Task } from './big-data';

/**
 * 1,000 resources and 10,000 tasks in a timeline week. Only the rows in view are built (through
 * `Virtualization`, each as tall as its lanes), and in each row only the cells and tasks of the part
 * of the week in view. The numbers under it are measured as it shows and as you scroll.
 */
export default function BigTimeline() {
  const resources = [{ field: 'resourceId', label: 'Line', items: machines(1000), useColorAsDefault: true }];
  const s = reactive({ shown: '', nodes: 0 });
  const started = performance.now();
  return (
    <div class="sched-demo">
      <Scheduler<Task>
        appointments={tasks(10_000, 1000)}
        resources={resources}
        groups={['resourceId']}
        views={['timelineWeek', 'timelineDay']}
        currentView="timelineWeek"
        cellDuration={60}
        onContentReady={(e) => {
          // Shown: the frame after its first appointments are on the page.
          const look = () => {
            const el = e.source.element;
            if (!el.querySelector('.mx-scheduler__scroll .mx-scheduler__appointment')) return void requestAnimationFrame(look);
            requestAnimationFrame(() => {
              if (!s.shown) s.shown = `${Math.round(performance.now() - started)} ms`;
              s.nodes = el.querySelectorAll('*').length;
            });
          };
          look();
        }}
      />
      <p class="sched-log">{() => (s.shown ? `Shown in ${s.shown}; ${s.nodes.toLocaleString()} elements on the page.` : 'Building…')}</p>
    </div>
  );
}
```

# Scheduler: Tablet and phone

> Scheduler · @motifx-community/ui 0.1.0-beta.5

On tablets and phones, the scheduler keeps its appointments, views and date, and changes how it presents them. On a phone, it shows the agenda, a compact toolbar and bottom sheets. Touch gestures can lift and resize appointments, swipe between days, and pinch to zoom.

## Import

```tsx
import { Scheduler, type SchedulerPresentation } from '@motifx-community/ui';
```

## Three presentations of one scheduler

| Presentation | Displayed content |
| --- | --- |
| `Desktop` | The default layout: a toolbar with Today, previous and next, the date, and a button for each view. The tooltip appears next to the appointment, and the form opens in a window. |
| `Tablet` | The same layout, keeping its current view (a week, which is how tablet calendars usually open). On a touch screen, everything that can be tapped is larger. |
| `Phone` | The agenda, or a day view when the views have no agenda. The toolbar shows Today as an icon, the month (which opens the calendar) and one menu for the views, and swiping moves between days. The tooltip is an action sheet, and the form is a bottom sheet. The time ruler, resource column and time column are narrower so that a week still fits on the screen, and every view works. |

## Based on its own width

With `presentation: 'auto'` (the default), the scheduler monitors its own width and the device's pointer type, in the same way as the [TabDocumentManager](tabdocs-mobile.md). Below `phoneWidth` (560), it uses the phone presentation, and below `tabletWidth` (1024), it uses the tablet presentation on touch screens. Phones are typically 360 to 430 pixels wide.

## Touch

Listeners are attached before a finger lands, so lifting an appointment, swiping and pinching keep the page still, and any other movement scrolls natively. No click follows a drag, and no hover state remains after a touch. To try this, open this page on a phone or use your browser's touch emulation.

| Gesture | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `Tap an appointment` | Shows its tooltip (an action sheet on a phone) with Edit and Delete. |
| `Hold an appointment, then drag` | Lifts it after a moment so that it can be moved. The page does not scroll while it is lifted. Release it at a valid position to drop it. |
| `Let go of a lifted appointment` | Keeps it selected, with a handle at the middle of its start and end. Drag a handle to resize it, or tap elsewhere to release it. |
| `Swipe sideways over the view` | Moves to the next or previous days. A view that can still scroll in that direction (a wide week or a timeline) scrolls first, and the swipe advances the view at its end. |
| `Pinch` | Zooms the hours of the day views and the cells of a timeline (`timeZoom`, 0.5 to 4). |
| `Tap a free cell, then tap it again` | Selects it, and then opens the form for a new appointment there. |
| `Scroll` | Scrolls natively, like the rest of the page. |

## Accessibility

| Topic | Details |
| --- | --- |
| `Without gestures` | Every gesture has a button or key equivalent. The month opens the calendar, the arrow keys move the focused appointment (with Shift, its end), and N and P change the days. |
| `Sheets` | The tooltip and form are dialogs. Focus moves into them and returns afterward, and Escape and the Back button close them. |
| `Sizes` | On touch screens, the toolbar, agenda rows and month lines use the design language's large control height. |

## Styling

| Hook | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `scheduler.bar `phone`` | Unit: the toolbar in the phone presentation. |
| `scheduler.appointment `lifted`, `selected`` | Unit states: an appointment held by a finger, and one that has been released (with its handles). |
| `scheduler.resize-grip (`active`)` | Unit: a resize handle, at the middle of an edge. On the side of a bar, it is rotated. |
| `scheduler.swipe-edge (`ready`), swipe-icon (`previous`, `ready`)` | Units: the indicator on the side the next days come from while swiping. |
| `touch-target, touch-lane-size, phone-ruler-width, phone-column-min-width, phone-timeline-resource-width, phone-bar-size, swipe-inset, grip-ring, grip-ring-mix` | Plain tokens. |
| `today-icon-button, view-menu-button, tooltip-sheet, form-sheet` | Places: the kit buttons and sheets inside. |

## API reference

### Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `presentation` | `Bind<'auto' \| 'desktop' \| 'tablet' \| 'phone'>` | `'auto'` | The presentation: based on its own width, or always the same one. The appointments, views and date do not change. |
| `phoneWidth` | `Bind<number>` | `560` | Below this width (of the scheduler, not the screen), `auto` uses the phone presentation regardless of the pointer type. |
| `tabletWidth` | `Bind<number>` | `1024` | Below this width, `auto` uses the tablet presentation on touch screens (see `tabletWhen`). |
| `tabletWhen` | `Bind<'touch' \| 'width'>` | `'touch'` | With `'touch'`, the tablet presentation applies only when the device's pointer is a finger (`(pointer: coarse)`, tracked live). With `'width'`, only the width is considered. |
| `phoneView` | `Bind<string \| null>` | `'agenda'` | The view (by name or type) shown in the phone presentation, or a day view if the views do not include it. When leaving this presentation, the previous view returns, unless the user chose another. `null` keeps the current view. |
| `tabletView` | `Bind<string \| null>` | `null` | The same for the tablet presentation. `null` keeps the current view. |
| `swipeNavigation` | `Bind<boolean>` | `true` | Swiping sideways moves to the next or previous days. |
| `pinchZoom` | `Bind<boolean>` | `true` | Pinching zooms the time scale. |
| `timeZoom` | `Bind<number>` | `1` | The zoom level of the time scale, from 0.5 to 4. At 1, it uses the sizes set by the design language. |
| `onPresentationChanging` | `(e: SchedulerPresentationChangingEventArgs) => void` | — | `{ from, to, width, cancel }`. If canceled, the presentation stays the same until the width or the setting changes again. |
| `onPresentationChanged` | `(e: SchedulerPresentationChangedEventArgs) => void` | — | `{ from, to, width }`. |
| `onTimeZoomChanging` | `(e: TimeZoomChangingEventArgs) => void` | — | `{ from, to, cancel }`, raised when a pinch starts. If canceled, the page zooms instead. |
| `onTimeZoomChanged` | `(e: TimeZoomChangedEventArgs) => void` | — | `{ from, to }`, raised when the pinch ends. |
| `onFormOpening` | `(e: FormOpeningEventArgs) => void` | — | `e.form` is the window, or on a phone the `BottomSheet` that contains the form. |

### Members

| Member | Returns | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `currentPresentation` | read-only, reactive | The current presentation: `'desktop'`, `'tablet'` or `'phone'`. |

The sheets are the kit's [BottomSheet](bottomsheet.md) and [ActionSheet](actionsheet.md).

## Example files

`Presentations.tsx`

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { RadioGroup, Scheduler, Stack, type SchedulerPresentation } from '@motifx-community/ui';
import { sampleAppointments, type Meeting } from './sample-appointments';

/**
 * One scheduler shown three ways. As on a phone it shows the agenda (a day where it has none), the
 * bar holds the month, Today and a menu of the views, the tooltip and the form come up from the
 * bottom. Going back, it shows the view it had. The appointments and the date stay the same.
 */
export default function Presentations() {
  const s = reactive({ presentation: 'phone' as SchedulerPresentation, said: '' });
  const scheduler = (
    <Scheduler<Meeting>
      appointments={sampleAppointments()}
      views={['day', 'week', 'month', 'agenda']}
      presentation={() => s.presentation}
      startDayHour={7}
      onPresentationChanged={(e) => (s.said = `${e.from} → ${e.to}${e.width ? ` (${e.width} px wide)` : ''}`)}
    />
  ) as Scheduler<Meeting>;
  return (
    <div class="sched-demo">
      <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center" gap="lg">
        <RadioGroup
          label="Presentation"
          orientation="horizontal"
          items={[
            { value: 'auto', text: 'By its width' },
            { value: 'desktop', text: 'Desktop' },
            { value: 'tablet', text: 'Tablet' },
            { value: 'phone', text: 'Phone' },
          ]}
          itemText="text"
          itemValue="value"
          x-model={() => s.presentation}
        />
        <output class="sched-log">{() => (s.said ? `Shown: ${s.said}` : `Shown as: ${scheduler.currentPresentation}`)}</output>
      </Stack>
      {scheduler}
    </div>
  );
}
```
